  }),

    maxDefinitions: 10_000,

    requestTimeoutMs: 30_000,
    resourceItems: 0,
    resourceBytes: 0,
    tenantItems: 0,
    tenantBytes: 0,
  }),
});

function merge(base, ...sources) {
  const output = { ...base };
  for (const source of sources) {
    if (!source || typeof source !== 'object' || Array.isArray(source)) continue;
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(source)) {
      const previous = output[key];
      output[key] = value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
        && previous && typeof previous === 'object' && !Array.isArray(previous)
        ? merge(previous, value)
        : Array.isArray(value) ? value.slice() : value;
    }
  }
  return output;
}

function freeze(value, seen = new WeakSet()) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || seen.has(value)) return value;
  seen.add(value);
  for (const child of Object.values(value)) freeze(child, seen);
  return Object.freeze(value);
}

export function resolveEventCompatibilityProfile(profile = 'compat', overrides = {}) {
  const supplied = profile && typeof profile === 'object' ? profile : null;
  const requested = typeof profile === 'string' ? profile : supplied?.name || 'compat';
  const preset = EVENT_COMPATIBILITY_PROFILES[requested];
  if (!preset) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error(`Unsupported RawNode Events profile '${requested}'.`), {
      name: 'EventConfigurationError',
      code: 'EVENT_PROFILE_INVALID',
      details: { requested, supported: Object.keys(EVENT_COMPATIBILITY_PROFILES) },
    });
  }
  const resolved = merge(preset, supplied || {}, overrides || {}, { name: requested });
  resolved.acceptedEnvelopeVersions = Array.from(new Set(resolved.acceptedEnvelopeVersions || [1, 2, 3]));
  return freeze(resolved);
}

export const resolveCompatibilityProfile = resolveEventCompatibilityProfile;
export default resolveEventCompatibilityProfile;

'use strict';

// src/events/EventRegistry.js
// Lightweight provider-facing registry. Ascending priority remains the default
// because that is the historical EventRegistry contract; use priorityOrder:'desc'
// to align it with AdvancedEventDispatcher execution.

export class EventRegistry {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.map = new Map();
    this.priorityOrder = options.priorityOrder === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
    this._sequence = 0;
    this._owners = new Map();
  }

  listen(eventName, handler, priority = 10, options = {}) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    const entry = {
      id: ++this._sequence,
      handler,
      priority: Number(priority) || 0,
      owner: options.owner == null ? null : String(options.owner),
      tags: Array.isArray(options.tags) ? options.tags.map(String) : [],
    };
    const entries = this.map.get(name) || [];
    entries.push(entry);
    entries.sort((left, right) => {
      const priorityOrder = this.priorityOrder === 'desc'
        ? right.priority - left.priority
        : left.priority - right.priority;
      return priorityOrder || left.id - right.id;
    });
    this.map.set(name, entries);
    if (entry.owner) {
      let ids = this._owners.get(entry.owner);
      if (!ids) this._owners.set(entry.owner, ids = new Set());
      ids.add(entry.id);
    }
    // Historical EventRegistry.listen() returned undefined. Keep that exact
    // contract; use add()/subscribe() for fluent or disposable registration.
    return undefined;
  }

  add(eventName, handler, priority = 10, options = {}) {
    this.listen(eventName, handler, priority, options);
    return this;
  }

  subscribe(eventName, handler, priority = 10, options = {}) {
    this.listen(eventName, handler, priority, options);
    const id = this._sequence;
    return Object.freeze({
      id,
      dispose: () => this.removeById(id),
      off: () => this.removeById(id),
      [Symbol.dispose]: () => this.removeById(id),
    });
  }

  getListeners(eventName) { return this.map.get(String(eventName)) || []; }
  has(eventName) { return this.getListeners(eventName).length > 0; }
  eventNames() { return Array.from(this.map.keys()); }

  removeById(id) {
    for (const [eventName, entries] of this.map) {
      const index = entries.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === id);
      if (index === -1) continue;
      const [entry] = entries.splice(index, 1);
      if (!entries.length) this.map.delete(eventName);
      if (entry.owner) {
        const ids = this._owners.get(entry.owner);
        ids?.delete(entry.id);
        if (ids?.size === 0) this._owners.delete(entry.owner);
      }
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  removeOwner(owner) {
    const ids = Array.from(this._owners.get(String(owner)) || []);
    let removed = 0;
    for (const id of ids) if (this.removeById(id)) removed++;
    return removed;
  }

  clear(eventName = null) {
    if (eventName == null) {
      const count = Array.from(this.map.values()).reduce((sum, entries) => sum + entries.length, 0);
      this.map.clear();
      this._owners.clear();
      return count;
    }
    const entries = this.map.get(String(eventName)) || [];
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const ids = entry.owner ? this._owners.get(entry.owner) : null;
      ids?.delete(entry.id);
      if (ids?.size === 0) this._owners.delete(entry.owner);
    }
    this.map.delete(String(eventName));
    return entries.length;
  }

  registerSubscriber(SubscriberClass, options = {}) {
    const subscribed = SubscriberClass?.getSubscribedEvents?.();
    if (!subscribed) return undefined;
    const defaultPriority = Number(SubscriberClass.priority ?? options.priority ?? 10) || 0;

    for (const [eventName, definition] of Object.entries(subscribed)) {
      if (typeof definition === 'string') {
        this.listen(eventName, { subscriber: SubscriberClass, method: definition }, defaultPriority, options);
        continue;
      }
      if (Array.isArray(definition)) {
        const [method, priority = defaultPriority] = definition;
        this.listen(eventName, { subscriber: SubscriberClass, method }, priority, options);
        continue;
      }
      if (definition && typeof definition === 'object') {
        this.listen(
          eventName,
          { subscriber: SubscriberClass, method: definition.method || definition.handle },
          definition.priority ?? defaultPriority,
          { ...options, owner: definition.owner ?? options.owner, tags: definition.tags ?? options.tags },
        );
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  subscriber(SubscriberClass, options = {}) {
    this.registerSubscriber(SubscriberClass, options);
    return this;
  }

  manifest() {
    const output = [];
    for (const [eventName, entries] of this.map) {
      for (const entry of entries) output.push({ eventName, ...entry });
    }
    return output;
  }
}

export default EventRegistry;

'use strict';

import { deepFreeze } from '../support/safe.js';

export class EventStudioAnalyzer {
  analyze(input = {}) {
    const findings = [];
    const fabric = input.fabric || {};
    const transports = fabric.transports?.transports || fabric.transports || {};
    const definitions = fabric.definitions || {};

    if (fabric.profile === 'production' || fabric.profile === 'strict') {
      if (!fabric.gateway) findings.push(finding('error', 'EVENT_STUDIO_GATEWAY_MISSING', 'The hardened fabric has no inbound admission gateway snapshot.'));
      if ((definitions.size || 0) === 0) findings.push(finding('warning', 'EVENT_STUDIO_DEFINITIONS_EMPTY', 'The hardened fabric has no registered event definitions.'));
      for (const [id, transport] of Object.entries(transports || {})) {
        if (transport?.capabilities?.remote && transport?.ready && input.crypto === false) {
          findings.push(finding('error', 'EVENT_STUDIO_UNSIGNED_REMOTE', `Remote transport '${id}' is ready without envelope signing.`));
        }
      }
    }

    const resources = fabric.resources || {};
    if (resources.maxBytes > 0 && resources.bytes / resources.maxBytes >= 0.9) {
      findings.push(finding(
        'warning',
        'EVENT_STUDIO_RESOURCE_PRESSURE',
        'The global Event Fabric byte budget is above 90%.',
        { usedBytes: resources.bytes, limitBytes: resources.maxBytes },
      ));
    }
    for (const [category, value] of Object.entries(resources.categories || {})) {
      const limitBytes = Number(value?.limits?.maxBytes || value?.maxBytes || value?.limitBytes || 0);
      const usedBytes = Number(value?.bytes || value?.usedBytes || 0);
      if (limitBytes > 0 && usedBytes / limitBytes >= 0.9) {
        findings.push(finding(
          'warning',
          'EVENT_STUDIO_RESOURCE_PRESSURE',
          `Event resource category '${category}' is above 90% of its byte budget.`,
          { category, usedBytes, limitBytes },
        ));
      }
    }

    const outbox = input.outbox || {};
    const dead = Number(outbox.status?.dead || outbox.stats?.deadLettered || 0);
    if (dead > 0) findings.push(finding('warning', 'EVENT_STUDIO_DEAD_LETTERS', `${dead} event delivery records are dead-lettered.`, { count: dead }));

    const projection = input.projections || {};
    if (Number(projection.stats?.failures || 0) > 0) findings.push(finding('warning', 'EVENT_STUDIO_PROJECTION_FAILURES', 'One or more projection executions failed.', { failures: projection.stats.failures }));

    return deepFreeze({
      ok: !findings.some((entry) => entry.level === 'error'),
      findings,
      summary: {
        errors: findings.filter((entry) => entry.level === 'error').length,
        warnings: findings.filter((entry) => entry.level === 'warning').length,
        transports: Object.keys(transports || {}).length,
        definitions: Number(definitions.size || 0),
      },
    });
  }

  correlationGraph(records = []) {
    const nodes = new Map();
    const edges = [];
    for (const record of records || []) {
      const id = record.eventId || record.id || `record:${nodes.size + 1}`;
      nodes.set(id, {
        id,
        name: record.eventName || record.name || record.type || 'event',
        at: record.at || record.occurredAt || null,
        correlationId: record.correlationId || record.context?.correlationId || null,
      });
      const parent = record.causationId || record.context?.causationId || record.parentId || null;
      if (parent) edges.push({ from: parent, to: id, kind: 'causation' });
    }
    return deepFreeze({ nodes: [...nodes.values()], edges });
  }
}

function finding(level, code, message, details = null) {
  return Object.freeze({ level, code, message, details });
}
export default EventStudioAnalyzer;

'use strict';

import { EventStudioAnalyzer } from './analysis/EventStudioAnalyzer.js';
import { clonePublic, deepFreeze, safeError } from './support/safe.js';

export class EventStudioManager {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.app = options.app || null;
    this.manager = options.manager || resolve(this.app, 'events.manager');
    this.fabric = options.fabric || resolve(this.app, 'events.fabric') || this.manager?._fabric || null;
    this.readOnly = options.readOnly !== false;
    this.allowMutations = options.allowMutations === true && !this.readOnly;
    this.maxTimeline = Math.max(10, Number(options.historyLimit) || 2_000);
    this.analyzer = options.analyzer || new EventStudioAnalyzer();
    this.audit = options.audit || resolve(this.app, 'security.audit') || null;
    this.authorize = typeof options.authorize === 'function' ? options.authorize : null;
    this.stats = { snapshots: 0, operations: 0, denied: 0, failures: 0 };
  }

  refresh() {
    this.manager ||= resolve(this.app, 'events.manager');
    this.fabric ||= resolve(this.app, 'events.fabric') || this.manager?._fabric || null;
    return this;
  }

  snapshot(options = {}) {
    this.refresh();
    this.stats.snapshots++;
    const manager = this.manager?.snapshot?.() || null;
    const fabric = this.fabric?.snapshot?.() || manager?.fabric || null;
    const timeline = this.timeline({ limit: options.timelineLimit || this.maxTimeline });
    const analysis = this.analyzer.analyze({
      fabric,
      crypto: !!this.fabric?.cryptoProvider,
      outbox: manager?.outboxPublisher?.store || manager?.outbox || null,
      projections: manager?.projections || null,
    });
    return deepFreeze(clonePublic({
      ok: manager?.health?.ok !== false && analysis.ok,
      readOnly: this.readOnly,
      manager,
      fabric,
      timeline,
      graph: this.analyzer.correlationGraph(timeline.records),
      analysis,
      stats: { ...this.stats },
      generatedAt: Date.now(),
    }));
  }

  timeline(options = {}) {
    this.refresh();
    const recorder = this.fabric?.flightRecorder;
    const snapshot = recorder?.snapshot?.() || {};
    let records = snapshot.records || recorder?.records || [];
    if (options.eventName) records = records.filter((entry) => (entry.eventName || entry.name) === options.eventName);
    if (options.correlationId) records = records.filter((entry) => entry.correlationId === options.correlationId || entry.context?.correlationId === options.correlationId);
    const limit = Math.max(1, Number(options.limit) || this.maxTimeline);
    return deepFreeze({ enabled: snapshot.enabled !== false, records: clonePublic(records.slice(-limit)), total: records.length });
  }

  inspectEvent(name, options = {}) {
    this.refresh();
    const eventName = String(name);
    return deepFreeze(clonePublic({
      eventName,
      dispatchPlan: this.manager?._events?.inspect?.(eventName) || null,
      definitions: this.fabric?.definitions?.versions?.(eventName) || [],
      route: this.fabric?.router?.explain?.(eventName, options) || this.fabric?.router?.resolve?.(eventName, options) || null,
      middleware: this.fabric?.middleware?.snapshot?.() || null,
    }));
  }

  async operate(action, input = {}, context = {}) {
    this.stats.operations++;
    try {
      await this._authorize(action, input, context);
      const value = await this._execute(String(action), input, context);
      await this._audit(action, input, context, true);
      return deepFreeze({ ok: true, action, value: clonePublic(value), at: Date.now() });
    } catch (error) {
      this.stats.failures++;
      await this._audit(action, input, context, false, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async _authorize(action, input, context) {
    if (!this.allowMutations) {
      this.stats.denied++;
      throw studioError('Event Studio mutations are disabled.', 'EVENT_STUDIO_READ_ONLY');
    }
    if (!String(input.reason || '').trim()) throw studioError('Event Studio mutations require a reason.', 'EVENT_STUDIO_REASON_REQUIRED');
    if (this.authorize && await this.authorize({ action, input, context, studio: this }) !== true) {
      this.stats.denied++;
      throw studioError('Event Studio operation was not authorized.', 'EVENT_STUDIO_FORBIDDEN');
    }
  }

  async _execute(action, input, context) {
    this.refresh();
    switch (action) {
      case 'outbox.flush': return await this.manager?._outboxPublisher?.flush?.(input);
      case 'outbox.retry': return await retryOutbox(this.manager?._outboxStore, input.id, input);
      case 'dead-letter.retry': return await retryOutbox(this.manager?._outboxStore, input.id, input);
      case 'projection.rebuild': return await this.manager?._projections?.rebuild?.(input.name, { ...input, signal: context.signal });
      case 'workflow.cancel': return await cancelWorkflow(this.manager?._workflowStore, input.id, input);
      case 'transport.start': return await this.fabric?.transports?.require?.(input.id)?.start?.({ ...context, fabric: this.fabric });
      case 'transport.close': return await this.fabric?.transports?.require?.(input.id)?.close?.({ reason: input.reason });
      case 'event.replay': return await this._replay(input, context);
      default: throw studioError(`Unsupported Event Studio operation '${action}'.`, 'EVENT_STUDIO_OPERATION_UNKNOWN');
    }
  }

  async _replay(input, context) {
    const record = input.record || await this.manager?._eventStore?.get?.(input.id);
    if (!record) throw studioError('Replay event was not found.', 'EVENT_STUDIO_REPLAY_NOT_FOUND');
    const name = record.eventName || record.event || record.name;
    const payload = record.payload ?? record.args?.[0];
    return await this.fabric.publish({
      name,
      payload,
      version: record.eventVersion || record.version || 1,
      context: { ...(record.context || {}), replayedBy: context.actorId || null },
      metadata: { ...(record.metadata || {}), replay: true, sourceEventId: record.id || record._id || null },
    }, { via: input.via, durable: input.durable === true, localEcho: input.localEcho === true });
  }

  async _audit(action, input, context, success, error = null) {
    const record = {
      action: `events.studio.${action}`,
      success,
      actorId: context.actorId || context.principal?.id || null,
      tenantId: context.tenantId || null,
      reason: input.reason || null,
      target: input.id || input.name || null,
      error: safeError(error),
      at: Date.now(),
    };
    try {
      if (typeof this.audit?.record === 'function') await this.audit.record(record);
      else if (typeof this.audit?.write === 'function') await this.audit.write(record);
      else this.manager?._events?.dispatch?.('events:studio:operation', record);
    } catch {}
  }
}

async function retryOutbox(store, id, options = {}) {
  if (!store || !id) throw studioError('Outbox store and id are required.', 'EVENT_STUDIO_OUTBOX_REQUIRED');
  const record = await store.get?.(id);
  if (!record) throw studioError(`Outbox record '${id}' was not found.`, 'EVENT_STUDIO_OUTBOX_NOT_FOUND');
  if (typeof store.release === 'function' && record.status === 'processing') {
    return await store.release(id, {
      availableAt: Date.now(),
      owner: options.owner || record.leaseOwner,
      fencingToken: record.fencingToken,
    });
  }
  if (typeof store.append !== 'function') throw studioError('Outbox store cannot retry records.', 'EVENT_STUDIO_OUTBOX_RETRY_UNSUPPORTED');
  return await store.append({ ...record, id: options.newId, status: undefined, attempts: 0, availableAt: Date.now(), idempotencyKey: options.idempotencyKey || `${record.id || id}:retry:${Date.now()}` });
}
async function cancelWorkflow(store, id, options = {}) {
  if (!store || !id) throw studioError('Workflow store and id are required.', 'EVENT_STUDIO_WORKFLOW_REQUIRED');
  if (typeof store.update === 'function') return await store.update(id, { status: 'cancelled', cancelledAt: Date.now(), cancelReason: options.reason });
  if (typeof store.save === 'function') {
    const current = await (store.get?.(id) ?? store.load?.(id));
    if (!current) throw studioError(`Workflow '${id}' was not found.`, 'EVENT_STUDIO_WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND');
    return await store.save(
      { ...current, id, status: 'cancelled', cancelledAt: Date.now(), cancelReason: options.reason },
      { expectedVersion: current.storeVersion },
    );
  }
  throw studioError('Workflow store cannot cancel workflows.', 'EVENT_STUDIO_WORKFLOW_CANCEL_UNSUPPORTED');
}
function resolve(app, key) { try { return app?.resolve?.(key) ?? app?.container?.resolve?.(key) ?? null; } catch { return null; } }
function studioError(message, code) { return Object.assign(new Error(message), { name: 'EventStudioError', code }); }
export default EventStudioManager;

'use strict';

export class EventStudioRuntime {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.fabric = options.fabric || globalThis.RawNode?.eventFabric || globalThis.RawNode?.events?.fabric?.() || null;
    this.historyLimit = Math.max(10, Number(options.historyLimit) || 1_000);
    this.records = [];
    this.subscriptions = [];
    this.started = false;
  }
  start() {
    if (this.started || !this.fabric) return this;
    this.started = true;
    const bus = this.fabric.dispatcher;
    if (typeof bus?.subscribeAny === 'function') this.subscriptions.push(bus.subscribeAny((eventName, ...args) => this.record(eventName, args)) || null);
    else if (typeof bus?.onAny === 'function') this.subscriptions.push(bus.onAny((eventName, ...args) => this.record(eventName, args)) || null);
    return this;
  }
  record(name, args = []) { this.records.push({ name: String(name), args: summarize(args), at: Date.now(), context: summarize(this.fabric?.getContext?.()) }); if (this.records.length > this.historyLimit) this.records.splice(0, this.records.length - this.historyLimit); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ started: this.started, fabric: this.fabric?.snapshot?.() || null, records: Object.freeze([...this.records]) }); }
  stop() { for (const value of this.subscriptions.splice(0)) { try { if (typeof value === 'function') value(); else value?.dispose?.(); } catch {} } this.started = false; return this; }
}
function summarize(value, depth = 0) { if (value == null || typeof value !== 'object') return value; if (depth >= 4) return '[depth]'; if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.slice(0, 20).map((entry) => summarize(entry, depth + 1)); const output = {}; for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value).slice(0, 50)) output[key] = /secret|token|password|cookie|authorization/i.test(key) ? '[redacted]' : summarize(child, depth + 1); return output; }
export default EventStudioRuntime;

FILE PATH: ./studio/support/safe.js

'use strict';

export function deepFreeze(value, seen = new WeakSet()) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || seen.has(value)) return value;
  seen.add(value);
  for (const child of Object.values(value)) deepFreeze(child, seen);
  return Object.freeze(value);
}

export function safeError(error) {
  if (!error) return null;
  return Object.freeze({
    name: error.name || 'Error',
    message: error.message || String(error),
    code: error.code || null,
  });
}

export function clonePublic(value, options = {}, depth = 0, seen = new WeakSet()) {
  const maxDepth = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxDepth) || 12);
  const maxKeys = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxKeys) || 2_048);
  const maxArray = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxArray) || 1_000);
  const sensitive = options.sensitive || /secret|password|token|authorization|cookie|signature|private|credential/i;
  if (value == null || typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
  if (typeof value === 'string') return value.length > 8_192 ? `${value.slice(0, 8_192)}…` : value;
  if (typeof value === 'bigint') return String(value);
  if (typeof value === 'function') return `[Function ${value.name || 'anonymous'}]`;
  if (depth >= maxDepth) return '[DepthLimit]';
  if (seen.has(value)) return '[Circular]';
  if (value instanceof Date) return value.toISOString();
  if (value instanceof Uint8Array) return `[Uint8Array ${value.byteLength} bytes]`;
  seen.add(value);
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.slice(0, maxArray).map((entry) => clonePublic(entry, options, depth + 1, seen));
  const output = Object.create(null);
  let count = 0;
  for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) {
    if (++count > maxKeys) { output.__truncated__ = true; break; }
    output[key] = sensitive.test(key) ? '[redacted]' : clonePublic(child, options, depth + 1, seen);
  }
  return output;
}

'use strict';

import { createServer } from 'node:http';
import { timingSafeEqual, randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { URL } from 'node:url';

export class EventStudioServer {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    if (!options.studio) throw new TypeError('EventStudioServer requires a studio manager.');
    this.studio = options.studio;
    this.host = options.host || '127.0.0.1';
    this.port = Number(options.port) || 0;
    this.token = String(options.token || randomBytes(32).toString('base64url'));
    this.maxBodyBytes = Math.max(1_024, Number(options.maxBodyBytes) || 256 * 1024);
    this.server = null;
  }
  async start(options = {}) {
    if (this.server) return this.address();
    if (!['127.0.0.1', '::1', 'localhost'].includes(this.host) && options.allowRemote !== true) throw Object.assign(new Error('Remote Event Studio binding is disabled.'), { code: 'EVENT_STUDIO_REMOTE_DISABLED' });
    options.assertTransportStartAllowed?.();
    this.server = createServer((request, response) => void this.handle(request, response));
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { this.server.once('error', reject); this.server.listen(this.port, this.host, resolve); });
    options.signal?.addEventListener?.('abort', () => void this.close(), { once: true });
    return this.address();
  }
  async handle(request, response) {
    if (!authorized(request, this.token)) return send(response, 401, { ok: false, error: 'unauthorized' });
    const url = new URL(request.url || '/', `http://${request.headers.host || 'localhost'}`);
    try {
      if (request.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/api/events/snapshot') return send(response, 200, this.studio.snapshot());
      if (request.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/api/events/timeline') return send(response, 200, this.studio.timeline({ eventName: url.searchParams.get('event') || undefined, correlationId: url.searchParams.get('correlation') || undefined, limit: Number(url.searchParams.get('limit')) || undefined }));
      if (request.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/api/events/inspect') return send(response, 200, this.studio.inspectEvent(url.searchParams.get('event') || ''));
      if (request.method === 'POST' && url.pathname === '/api/events/operate') {
        const body = await readJson(request, this.maxBodyBytes);
        return send(response, 200, await this.studio.operate(body.action, body.input || {}, { actorId: request.headers['x-rawnode-actor'] || null, tenantId: request.headers['x-rawnode-tenant'] || null }));
      }
      return send(response, 404, { ok: false, error: 'not-found' });
    } catch (error) {
      return send(response, Number(error.status) || 500, { ok: false, error: { code: error.code || 'EVENT_STUDIO_ERROR', message: error.message || String(error) } });
    }
  }
  address() { const value = this.server?.address(); const host = typeof value === 'object' && value ? value.address : this.host; const port = typeof value === 'object' && value ? value.port : this.port; return Object.freeze({ host, port, token: this.token, url: `http://${String(host).includes(':') ? `[${host}]` : host}:${port}/api/events/snapshot` }); }
  async close() { if (!this.server) return; const server = this.server; this.server = null; await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve)); }
}
function authorized(request, expected) { const header = String(request.headers.authorization || ''); const supplied = header.startsWith('Bearer ') ? header.slice(7) : ''; if (!supplied || Buffer.byteLength(supplied) !== Buffer.byteLength(expected)) return false; return timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(supplied), Buffer.from(expected)); }
async function readJson(request, maxBytes) { const chunks = []; let bytes = 0; for await (const chunk of request) { bytes += chunk.length; if (bytes > maxBytes) throw Object.assign(new Error('Event Studio request body is too large.'), { code: 'EVENT_STUDIO_BODY_TOO_LARGE', status: 413 }); chunks.push(chunk); } return chunks.length ? JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')) : {}; }
function send(response, status, payload) { const body = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(payload)); response.writeHead(status, { 'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'content-length': body.length, 'cache-control': 'no-store', 'x-content-type-options': 'nosniff', 'x-frame-options': 'DENY', 'referrer-policy': 'no-referrer' }); response.end(body); }
export default EventStudioServer;

#!/usr/bin/env node
'use strict';

import { mkdtemp, mkdir, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';

const root = process.cwd();
function run(command, args, cwd = root) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = spawn(command, args, { cwd, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], env: process.env });
    let stdout = ''; let stderr = '';
    child.stdout.on('data', (chunk) => { stdout += chunk; });
    child.stderr.on('data', (chunk) => { stderr += chunk; });
    child.once('error', reject);
    child.once('close', (code) => code === 0 ? resolve({ stdout, stderr }) : reject(new Error(`${command} ${args.join(' ')} failed (${code})\n${stdout}\n${stderr}`)));
  });
}

const temporary = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), 'rawnode-events-consumer-'));
try {
  const packed = await run('npm', ['pack', '--ignore-scripts', '--json', '--pack-destination', temporary]);
  const metadata = JSON.parse(packed.stdout);
  const tarball = path.join(temporary, metadata[0].filename);
  const consumer = path.join(temporary, 'consumer');
  await mkdir(consumer, { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(path.join(consumer, 'package.json'), JSON.stringify({ private: true, type: 'module' }));
  await run('npm', ['install', '--ignore-scripts', '--no-audit', '--no-fund', tarball], consumer);
  await writeFile(path.join(consumer, 'consumer.mjs'), `
    import Events, { AdvancedEventDispatcher, Event, MemoryEventStore } from 'rawnode-events';
    import { EventJobQueue } from 'rawnode-events/queue';
    import { AggregateRoot } from 'rawnode-events/sourcing';
    import { FakeEventBus } from 'rawnode-events/testing';
    import config from 'rawnode-events/config';
    if (!Events || typeof AdvancedEventDispatcher !== 'function') throw new Error('root export unavailable');
    const bus = new AdvancedEventDispatcher();
    let received = 0;
    bus.on('consumer:ready', (value) => { received += value; });
    bus.dispatch('consumer:ready', 1);
    if (received !== 1) throw new Error('dispatch failed');
    class A extends AggregateRoot {}
    if (!(new A('a')) || !(new MemoryEventStore()) || !(new EventJobQueue()) || !(new FakeEventBus()) || !(new Event())) throw new Error('subpath surface failed');
    if (!config.profile) throw new Error('config export failed');
    await bus.close();
    process.stdout.write('consumer-ok');
  `);
  const result = await run(process.execPath, ['consumer.mjs'], consumer);
  if (result.stdout !== 'consumer-ok') throw new Error(`Unexpected consumer output: ${result.stdout}`);
  process.stdout.write(`Installed package consumer: OK (${path.basename(tarball)})\n`);
} finally {
  await rm(temporary, { recursive: true, force: true });
}

#!/usr/bin/env node
'use strict';

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import * as Events from '../src/events/index.js';

const baseline = JSON.parse(await readFile(new URL('../tests/fixtures/v1-public-manifest.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8'));
for (const name of baseline.exports) assert.ok(name in Events, `Missing v1 export: ${name}`);
for (const [name, methods] of Object.entries(baseline.files)) {
  const value = Events[name];
  assert.ok(value, `Missing v1 public symbol: ${name}`);
  if (typeof value !== 'function') continue;
  for (const method of methods) assert.equal(typeof value.prototype?.[method], 'function', `${name}.${method} is missing`);
}

// Behavioral probes that protect the most fragile legacy contracts.
const bus = new Events.AdvancedEventDispatcher({ profile: 'compat' });
const order = [];
bus.on('compat:probe:done', () => order.push('exact'));
bus.on('compat:probe:*', () => order.push('child'));
bus.on('compat:*', () => order.push('root'));
bus.onPattern('compat:**', () => order.push('pattern'));
bus.onAny(() => order.push('any'));
assert.equal(bus.dispatch('compat:probe:done'), undefined);
assert.deepEqual(order, ['exact', 'child', 'root', 'pattern', 'any']);
assert.equal(bus.dispatch('udp.peerValidated'), undefined); // dot normalization remains opt-in.
await bus.close();

const legacy = new Events.EventDispatcher();
assert.equal(legacy.on('x', () => {}), undefined);
assert.equal(legacy.dispatch('x'), undefined);
process.stdout.write(`Compatibility verified across ${baseline.exports.length} v1 symbols and behavioral probes\n`);

#!/usr/bin/env node
'use strict';

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFile, readdir, stat, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';

const root = process.cwd();
const output = path.join(root, 'MANIFEST.json');
const ignored = new Set(['node_modules', '.git', 'coverage', 'MANIFEST.json']);
async function walk(directory, files = []) {
  const entries = await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true });
  entries.sort((left, right) => left.name.localeCompare(right.name));
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (ignored.has(entry.name)) continue;
    const absolute = path.join(directory, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) await walk(absolute, files);
    else if (entry.isFile()) files.push(absolute);
  }
  return files;
}
const entries = [];
let totalBytes = 0;
for (const absolute of await walk(root)) {
  const data = await readFile(absolute);
  const info = await stat(absolute);
  totalBytes += data.length;
  entries.push({
    path: path.relative(root, absolute).split(path.sep).join('/'),
    bytes: data.length,
    mode: `0${(info.mode & 0o777).toString(8)}`,
    sha256: createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex'),
  });
}
const pkg = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'));
const manifest = { schemaVersion: 1, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), package: { name: pkg.name, version: pkg.version }, fileCount: entries.length, totalBytes, hashAlgorithm: 'sha256', files: entries };
await writeFile(output, `${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)}\n`);
process.stdout.write(`Manifest written: ${entries.length} files, ${totalBytes} bytes\n`);

#!/usr/bin/env node
'use strict';

import { access, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const root = process.cwd();
const pkg = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'));
const failures = [];
let imported = 0;
for (const [subpath, definition] of Object.entries(pkg.exports || {})) {
  if (subpath === './package.json') { await access(path.join(root, definition)); continue; }
  const target = typeof definition === 'string' ? definition : definition?.import;
  const types = typeof definition === 'object' ? definition?.types : null;
  if (!target) { failures.push(`${subpath}: import target missing`); continue; }
  try { await import(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(root, target)).href); imported++; }
  catch (error) { failures.push(`${subpath} -> ${target}: ${error?.message || error}`); }
  if (types) {
    try { await access(path.resolve(root, types)); }
    catch { failures.push(`${subpath}: declaration missing ${types}`); }
  }
}

const rootModule = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, 'index.js')).href);
for (const name of [
  'AdvancedEventDispatcher', 'EventDispatcher', 'Event', 'ProtocolEvent', 'Broadcastable',
  'RedisEventBridge', 'RedisStreamTransport', 'EventOutbox', 'EventJobQueue', 'WorkflowEngine',
  'AggregateRoot', 'MemoryEventStore', 'ProjectionManager', 'EventServiceProvider',
]) if (!(name in rootModule)) failures.push(`root export missing: ${name}`);
if (!rootModule.default) failures.push('root default export missing');

if (failures.length) {
  failures.forEach((failure) => process.stderr.write(`${failure}\n`));
  process.exitCode = 1;
} else process.stdout.write(`Validated ${imported} JavaScript export targets and ${Object.keys(pkg.exports || {}).length} package entries: OK\n`);

#!/usr/bin/env node
'use strict';

import { access, readFile, readdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';

const root = process.cwd();
const ignored = new Set(['node_modules', '.git', 'coverage', '.rawnode']);
const extensions = new Set(['.js', '.mjs']);
const importPattern = /(?:\bimport\s*(?:[^'"()]*?\sfrom\s*)?|\bexport\s+[^'"]*?\sfrom\s*|\bimport\s*\()\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/g;

async function walk(directory, output = []) {
  for (const entry of await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (ignored.has(entry.name)) continue;
    const absolute = path.join(directory, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) await walk(absolute, output);
    else if (entry.isFile() && extensions.has(path.extname(entry.name))) output.push(absolute);
  }
  return output;
}

function syntax(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const child = spawn(process.execPath, ['--check', file], { stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'pipe'] });
    let stderr = '';
    child.stderr.on('data', (chunk) => { stderr += chunk; });
    child.once('close', (code) => resolve({ file, code, stderr }));
  });
}

async function exists(file) { try { await access(file); return true; } catch { return false; } }
async function resolveRelative(importer, specifier) {
  if (!specifier.startsWith('.')) return true;
  const base = path.resolve(path.dirname(importer), specifier);
  const candidates = path.extname(base) ? [base] : [base, `${base}.js`, `${base}.mjs`, path.join(base, 'index.js')];
  for (const candidate of candidates) if (await exists(candidate)) return true;
  return false;
}

const files = (await walk(root)).sort();
const failures = [];
let cursor = 0;
const concurrency = Math.max(1, Math.min(8, Number(process.env.CHECK_CONCURRENCY) || 4));
await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: concurrency }, async () => {
  while (cursor < files.length) {
    const result = await syntax(files[cursor++]);
    if (result.code !== 0) failures.push({ type: 'syntax', ...result });
  }
}));

for (const file of files) {
  const source = await readFile(file, 'utf8');
  importPattern.lastIndex = 0;
  for (let match; (match = importPattern.exec(source));) {
    if (!(await resolveRelative(file, match[1]))) failures.push({ type: 'import', file, specifier: match[1] });
  }
}

if (failures.length) {
  for (const failure of failures) {
    process.stderr.write(`${failure.type}: ${path.relative(root, failure.file)}${failure.specifier ? ` -> ${failure.specifier}` : ''}\n${failure.stderr || ''}`);
  }
  process.exitCode = 1;
} else process.stdout.write(`Checked ${files.length} JavaScript modules and relative imports: OK\n`);

}

if (!files.length) throw new Error('No event tests were discovered');

'use strict';

import { compileMatcherList, matchesAny } from '../support/glob.js';
import { EventTransportError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

function isDispatcher(value) {
  return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && (
    typeof value.subscribeAny === 'function' || typeof value.onAny === 'function'
  );
}

function asArray(value) { return Array.isArray(value) ? value : value == null ? [] : [value]; }

export class BroadcastManager {
  constructor(dispatcherOrOptions = null, maybeOptions = {}) {
    this.dispatcher = isDispatcher(dispatcherOrOptions) ? dispatcherOrOptions : null;
    const options = this.dispatcher ? maybeOptions : (dispatcherOrOptions || {});
    this.transports = new Map();
    this.allow = compileMatcherList(options.allow || []);
    this.deny = compileMatcherList(options.deny || []);
    this.errorPolicy = options.errorPolicy || 'isolate';
    this.defaultChannel = options.defaultChannel || 'global';
    this.handle = null;
    this.started = false;
    this.stats = { considered: 0, broadcast: 0, deliveries: 0, skipped: 0, errors: 0 };
    for (const [name, transport] of Object.entries(options.adapters || options.transports || {})) {
      this.register(name, transport);
    }
  }

  setDispatcher(dispatcher) {
    if (!isDispatcher(dispatcher)) throw new TypeError('BroadcastManager requires an event dispatcher');
    this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
    return this;
  }

  register(name, transport, options = {}) {
    const key = String(name || '').trim();
    if (!key) throw new TypeError('Broadcast transport name is required');
    if (!transport || (
      typeof transport.broadcast !== 'function' &&
      typeof transport.publish !== 'function' &&
      typeof transport.emit !== 'function'
    )) {
      throw new TypeError('Broadcast transport must expose broadcast(), publish(), or emit()');
    }
    if (this.transports.has(key) && options.replace !== true) throw new Error(`Broadcast transport already exists: ${key}`);
    this.transports.set(key, { transport, options: { ...options } });
    return this;
  }

  unregister(name) { return this.transports.delete(String(name)); }

  start(dispatcher = this.dispatcher) {
    if (this.started) return this;
    this.setDispatcher(dispatcher);
    const listener = (eventName, eventObject) => {
      if (!eventObject || typeof eventObject !== 'object') return;
      void this.broadcast(eventObject, this.dispatcher.getContext?.(), { eventName }).catch(() => {});
    };
    if (typeof this.dispatcher.subscribeAny === 'function') {
      this.handle = this.dispatcher.subscribeAny(listener, {
        priority: -900,
        owner: 'rawnode:events:broadcast-manager',
        tags: ['broadcast'],
      });
    } else {
      this.dispatcher.onAny(listener, { priority: -900 });
      this._legacyListener = listener;
    }
    this.started = true;
    return this;
  }

  async broadcast(eventObject, context = null, options = {}) {
    if (!eventObject || typeof eventObject !== 'object') throw new TypeError('BroadcastManager.broadcast expects an event object');
    const eventName = String(options.eventName || eventObject.eventName || eventObject.constructor?.eventName || eventObject.constructor?.name || 'Event');
    this.stats.considered++;
    if (this.allow.length && !matchesAny(this.allow, eventName)) return this._skip('allow');
    if (this.deny.length && matchesAny(this.deny, eventName)) return this._skip('deny');
    if (typeof eventObject.shouldBroadcast === 'function' && eventObject.shouldBroadcast() !== true) return this._skip('shouldBroadcast');
    if (typeof eventObject.broadcastWhen === 'function' && await eventObject.broadcastWhen(context, options) === false) return this._skip('condition');

    const envelope = typeof eventObject.toBroadcastEnvelope === 'function'
      ? eventObject.toBroadcastEnvelope()
      : {
          event: typeof eventObject.broadcastAs === 'function' ? eventObject.broadcastAs() : eventName,
          channels: resolveChannels(eventObject, this.defaultChannel),
          payload: typeof eventObject.broadcastWith === 'function' ? eventObject.broadcastWith() : eventObject.payload ?? eventObject,
          id: eventObject.id,
          timestamp: eventObject.timestamp,
          meta: eventObject.meta ? { ...eventObject.meta } : null,
        };
    envelope.channels = asArray(envelope.channels).map(String).filter(Boolean);
    if (!envelope.channels.length) envelope.channels = [this.defaultChannel];

    const selected = options.transports ? new Set(asArray(options.transports).map(String)) : null;
    const deliveries = [];
    for (const [name, record] of this.transports) {
      if (selected && !selected.has(name)) continue;
      try {
        const value = await invoke(record.transport, envelope, {
          ...record.options,
          ...options,
          context,
          transportName: name,
          eventObject,
        });
        deliveries.push({ transport: name, status: 'fulfilled', value });
        this.stats.deliveries++;
      } catch (error) {
        this.stats.errors++;
        deliveries.push({ transport: name, status: 'rejected', error });
        if (options.errorPolicy === 'fail-fast' || this.errorPolicy === 'fail-fast') {
          throw new EventTransportError(`Broadcast transport "${name}" failed`, {
            code: 'EVENT_BROADCAST_FAILED',
            cause: error,
            details: { transport: name, eventName },
          });
        }
      }
    }
    this.stats.broadcast++;
    return { broadcast: true, event: envelope.event, channels: envelope.channels, envelope, deliveries };
  }

  _skip(reason) {
    this.stats.skipped++;
    return { broadcast: false, reason, deliveries: [] };
  }

  async stop() {
    this.handle?.dispose?.();
    if (this._legacyListener) this.dispatcher?.offAny?.(this._legacyListener);
    this.handle = null;
    this._legacyListener = null;
    this.started = false;
    return this;
  }

  async close(options = {}) {
    await this.stop();
    if (options.closeTransports !== false) {
      for (const { transport } of this.transports.values()) {
        try {
          if (typeof transport.close === 'function') await transport.close();
          else if (typeof transport.dispose === 'function') await transport.dispose();
        } catch (error) {
          this.stats.errors++;
          if (this.errorPolicy === 'fail-fast') throw error;
        }
      }
    }
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      started: this.started,
      transports: Object.freeze(Array.from(this.transports.keys())),
      errorPolicy: this.errorPolicy,
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }

  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await this.close(); }
}

function resolveChannels(eventObject, fallback) {
  if (typeof eventObject.broadcastChannels === 'function') return asArray(eventObject.broadcastChannels());
  if (typeof eventObject.broadcastChannel === 'function') return asArray(eventObject.broadcastChannel());
  return [fallback];
}

async function invoke(transport, envelope, options) {
  if (typeof transport.broadcast === 'function') return transport.broadcast(envelope, options);
  if (typeof transport.publish === 'function') return transport.publish(envelope.event, envelope, options);
  return transport.emit(envelope.event, envelope, options);
}

export default BroadcastManager;

'use strict';

import { AsyncLocalStorage } from 'node:async_hooks';
import { createEventContext } from './EventContext.js';

function defaultIdFactory() {
  const pid = process.pid.toString(36);
  const boot = Date.now().toString(36);
  let sequence = 0;
  return () => {
    sequence = (sequence + 1) >>> 0;
    return `${pid}-${boot}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${sequence.toString(36)}-${((Math.random() * 0xfffff) | 0).toString(36)}`;
  };
}

export class EventContextManager {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.enabled = options.enabled !== false;
    this.storage = this.enabled ? new AsyncLocalStorage() : null;
    this.idFactory = typeof options.idFactory === 'function' ? options.idFactory : defaultIdFactory();
    this.closed = false;
  }

  create(meta = {}) { return createEventContext(meta, this.get(), this.idFactory); }
  get() { return this.storage?.getStore?.() || null; }
  id() { return this.get()?.id ?? null; }

  run(context, fn) {
    if (typeof fn !== 'function') throw new TypeError('EventContextManager.run expects a function');
    if (!this.storage || !context) return fn();
    return this.storage.run(context, fn);
  }

  runIfMissing(meta, fn) {
    return this.get() ? fn() : this.run(this.create(meta), fn);
  }

  enter(context) { if (this.storage && context) this.storage.enterWith(context); }

  bind(fn, context = this.get()) {
    if (typeof fn !== 'function') throw new TypeError('EventContextManager.bind expects a function');
    if (!this.storage || !context) return fn;
    const storage = this.storage;
    return function boundEventContext(...args) {
      return storage.run(context, () => Reflect.apply(fn, this, args));
    };
  }

  close() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this.closed = true;
    this.storage?.disable?.();
  }
}

export default EventContextManager;

'use strict';

export function createEventContext(meta = {}, parent = null, idFactory = null) {
  const id = meta.id ?? (typeof idFactory === 'function' ? idFactory() : null);
  const parentId = meta.parentId ?? parent?.id ?? null;
  const correlationId = meta.correlationId ?? parent?.correlationId ?? parent?.id ?? id;
  const context = {
    ...meta,
    id,
    parentId,
    correlationId,
    causationId: meta.causationId ?? parent?.id ?? parentId,
    transport: meta.transport ?? parent?.transport ?? 'internal',
    tenantId: meta.tenantId ?? parent?.tenantId ?? null,
    actorId: meta.actorId ?? parent?.actorId ?? null,
    traceId: meta.traceId ?? parent?.traceId ?? null,
    spanId: meta.spanId ?? null,
    requestId: meta.requestId ?? parent?.requestId ?? null,
    source: meta.source ?? parent?.source ?? null,
    remote: meta.remote === true,
    originTransport: meta.originTransport ?? parent?.originTransport ?? null,
    originNode: meta.originNode ?? parent?.originNode ?? null,
    envelopeId: meta.envelopeId ?? parent?.envelopeId ?? null,
    hop: Math.max(0, Number(meta.hop ?? parent?.hop ?? 0) || 0),
    ts: meta.ts ?? Date.now(),
    headers: meta.headers && typeof meta.headers === 'object' ? { ...meta.headers } : (parent?.headers || null),
  };
  return context;
}

export function shallowEventContext(context) {
  if (!context || typeof context !== 'object') return null;
  return {
    id: context.id ?? null,
    parentId: context.parentId ?? null,
    correlationId: context.correlationId ?? null,
    causationId: context.causationId ?? null,
    transport: context.transport ?? null,
    tenantId: context.tenantId ?? null,
    actorId: context.actorId ?? null,
    traceId: context.traceId ?? null,
    spanId: context.spanId ?? null,
    requestId: context.requestId ?? null,
    source: context.source ?? null,
    remote: context.remote === true,
    originTransport: context.originTransport ?? null,
    originNode: context.originNode ?? null,
    envelopeId: context.envelopeId ?? null,
    hop: context.hop ?? 0,
  };
}

'use strict';

export class ListenerHandle {
  constructor(target, id) {
    this.target = target;
    this.dispatcher = target;
    this.id = Number(id);
  }

  _entry() {
    return this.target?.getEntry?.(this.id)
      || this.target?._registry?.getEntry?.(this.id)
      || null;
  }

  get active() { return this._entry()?.active === true; }
  get paused() { return this._entry()?.paused === true; }
  get metadata() {
    const entry = this._entry();
    if (!entry) return null;
    if (typeof this.target?.describeEntry === 'function') return this.target.describeEntry(entry);
    if (typeof this.target?._listenerMetadata === 'function') return this.target._listenerMetadata(this.id);
    return this.target?._registry?.describeEntry?.(entry) || null;
  }

  describe() { return this.metadata; }

  pause() {
    if (typeof this.target?.pause === 'function') this.target.pause(this.id);
    else if (typeof this.target?._setListenerPaused === 'function') this.target._setListenerPaused(this.id, true);
    else this.target?._registry?.pause?.(this.id);
    return this;
  }

  resume() {
    if (typeof this.target?.resume === 'function') this.target.resume(this.id);
    else if (typeof this.target?._setListenerPaused === 'function') this.target._setListenerPaused(this.id, false);
    else this.target?._registry?.resume?.(this.id);
    return this;
  }

  dispose() {
    if (typeof this.target?.removeById === 'function') return this.target.removeById(this.id) === true;
    if (typeof this.target?._disposeListenerById === 'function') return this.target._disposeListenerById(this.id) === true;
    return this.target?._registry?.removeById?.(this.id) === true;
  }

  unsubscribe() { return this.dispose(); }
  off() { return this.dispose(); }

  toJSON() {
    return Object.freeze({ id: this.id, active: this.active, paused: this.paused, ...(this.metadata || {}) });
  }

  [Symbol.dispose]() { this.dispose(); }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { this.dispose(); }
}

export default ListenerHandle;

'use strict';

export class ListenerScope {
  constructor(dispatcher, owner) {
    this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
    this.owner = String(owner || `scope:${Date.now()}`);
    this.handles = new Set();
    this.closed = false;
  }

  _track(handle) {
    if (handle) this.handles.add(handle);
    return handle;
  }

  subscribe(eventName, listener, options = {}) { return this._track(this.dispatcher.subscribe(eventName, listener, { ...options, owner: options.owner || this.owner })); }
  on(eventName, listener, options = {}) { this.subscribe(eventName, listener, options); return this; }
  once(eventName, listener, options = {}) { this.subscribe(eventName, listener, { ...options, once: true }); return this; }
  pattern(pattern, listener, options = {}) { return this._track(this.dispatcher.subscribePattern(pattern, listener, { ...options, owner: options.owner || this.owner })); }
  onPattern(pattern, listener, options = {}) { this.pattern(pattern, listener, options); return this; }
  any(listener, options = {}) { return this._track(this.dispatcher.subscribeAny(listener, { ...options, owner: options.owner || this.owner })); }
  onAny(listener, options = {}) { this.any(listener, options); return this; }

  pause() { for (const handle of this.handles) handle.pause(); return this; }
  resume() { for (const handle of this.handles) handle.resume(); return this; }

  dispose() {
    if (this.closed) return 0;
    this.closed = true;
    let removed = 0;
    for (const handle of this.handles) if (handle.dispose()) removed++;
    this.handles.clear();
    return removed;
  }

  [Symbol.dispose]() { this.dispose(); }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { this.dispose(); }
}

export default ListenerScope;

'use strict';

export class SubscriptionBuilder {
  constructor(dispatcher, kind, expression) {
    this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
    this.kind = kind;
    this.expression = expression;
    this.options = Object.create(null);
  }

  priority(value) { this.options.priority = Number(value) || 0; return this; }
  prepend(value = true) { this.options.prepend = value !== false; return this; }
  once(value = true) { this.options.once = value !== false; return this; }
  replay(value = true) { this.options.replay = value; return this; }
  replayConsumesOnce(value = true) { this.options.replayConsumesOnce = value !== false; return this; }
  owner(value) { this.options.owner = value == null ? null : String(value); return this; }
  tag(...values) {
    const tags = values.flat().filter((value) => value != null).map(String);
    this.options.tags = [...(this.options.tags || []), ...tags];
    return this;
  }
  timeout(value) { this.options.timeoutMs = Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0); return this; }
  errorPolicy(value) { this.options.errorPolicy = value; return this; }
  meta(value) { this.options.meta = value; return this; }
  paused(value = true) { this.options.paused = value !== false; return this; }
  when(condition) { this.options.condition = condition; return this; }

  listen(listener) {
    if (this.options.condition === false) return null;
    if (typeof this.options.condition === 'function' && this.options.condition() === false) return null;
    if (this.kind === 'pattern') return this.dispatcher.subscribePattern(this.expression, listener, this.options);
    if (this.kind === 'any') return this.dispatcher.subscribeAny(listener, this.options);
    return this.dispatcher.subscribe(this.expression, listener, this.options);
  }

  handle(listener) { return this.listen(listener); }
  using(listener) { return this.listen(listener); }
}

export default SubscriptionBuilder;

'use strict';

import { computeWildcardEvents, firstStaticSegment, globPrefix, globToRegExp } from '../support/glob.js';
import { ListenerHandle } from './ListenerHandle.js';
import { EventAdmissionError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

const DEFAULT_MAX = 5000;

function finiteLimit(value, fallback) {
  if (value === 0) return 0;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= 0 ? Math.trunc(parsed) : fallback;
}

function compareEntries(left, right) {
  if (left.priority !== right.priority) return right.priority - left.priority;
  return left.order - right.order;
}

function insertSorted(bucket, entry) {
  let low = 0;
  let high = bucket.length;
  while (low < high) {
    const middle = (low + high) >>> 1;
    if (compareEntries(entry, bucket[middle]) < 0) high = middle;
    else low = middle + 1;
  }
  bucket.splice(low, 0, entry);
}

export class ListenerRegistry {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.exact = new Map();
    this.patterns = [];
    this.any = [];
    this.entries = new Map();
    this.patternIndex = new Map();
    this.ownerIndex = new Map();
    this.tagIndex = new Map();
    this.patternCounts = new Map();

    this.sequence = 0;
    this.total = 0;
    this.generation = 0;
    this.registrationFrozen = false;

    const compatibilityLimit = finiteLimit(options.maxListenersPerEvent, DEFAULT_MAX);
    this.limits = Object.freeze({
      maxListenersPerEvent: compatibilityLimit,
      maxListenersTotal: finiteLimit(options.maxListenersTotal, 0),
      maxPatternListeners: finiteLimit(options.maxPatternListeners, compatibilityLimit),
      maxListenersPerPattern: finiteLimit(options.maxListenersPerPattern, compatibilityLimit),
      maxAnyListeners: finiteLimit(options.maxAnyListeners, compatibilityLimit),
    });

    this.planCacheMax = Math.max(0, finiteLimit(options.planCacheMax, 1024));
    this.planCache = new Map();
  }

  _nextId() { this.sequence = (this.sequence + 1) >>> 0 || 1; return this.sequence; }

  _touch() {
    this.generation = (this.generation + 1) >>> 0;
    this.planCache.clear();
  }

  _assertMutable() {
    if (this.registrationFrozen) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Listener registration is frozen.', { code: 'EVENT_LISTENER_REGISTRY_FROZEN' });
    }
  }

  _assertTotal() {
    this._assertMutable();
    const max = this.limits.maxListenersTotal;
    if (max && this.total >= max) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Exceeded maxListenersTotal (${max}).`, { code: 'EVENT_LISTENER_TOTAL_LIMIT' });
    }
  }

  _assertBucket(bucket, label, max = this.limits.maxListenersPerEvent) {
    if (max && bucket.length >= max) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Exceeded listener limit (${max}) for "${label}".`, {
        code: 'EVENT_LISTENER_BUCKET_LIMIT',
        details: { label, maximum: max },
      });
    }
  }

  _entry(kind, key, fn, options = {}) {
    if (typeof fn !== 'function') throw new TypeError(`Listener for "${key ?? '*'}" must be a function`);
    const id = this._nextId();
    const prepend = options.prepend === true;
    const tags = Array.from(new Set((Array.isArray(options.tags) ? options.tags : options.tag ? [options.tag] : []).map(String)));
    return {
      id,
      kind,
      key,
      fn,
      once: options.once === true,
      prepend,
      priority: Number(options.priority ?? 0) || 0,
      order: prepend ? -id : id,
      meta: options.meta ?? null,
      owner: options.owner == null ? null : String(options.owner),
      tags,
      timeoutMs: Math.max(0, Number(options.timeoutMs) || 0),
      errorPolicy: options.errorPolicy || null,
      active: true,
      paused: options.paused === true,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    };
  }

  _index(entry) {
    this.entries.set(entry.id, entry);
    if (entry.owner) {
      let ids = this.ownerIndex.get(entry.owner);
      if (!ids) this.ownerIndex.set(entry.owner, ids = new Set());
      ids.add(entry.id);
    }
    for (const tag of entry.tags) {
      let ids = this.tagIndex.get(tag);
      if (!ids) this.tagIndex.set(tag, ids = new Set());
      ids.add(entry.id);
    }
    this.total++;
    this._touch();
    return new ListenerHandle(this, entry.id);
  }

  addExact(eventName, fn, options = {}) {
    this._assertTotal();
    const bucket = this.exact.get(eventName) || [];
    this._assertBucket(bucket, eventName);
    const entry = this._entry('exact', eventName, fn, options);
    insertSorted(bucket, entry);
    this.exact.set(eventName, bucket);
    return { entry, handle: this._index(entry) };
  }

  addPattern(pattern, fn, options = {}) {
    this._assertTotal();
    this._assertBucket(this.patterns, pattern, this.limits.maxPatternListeners);
    const count = this.patternCounts.get(pattern) || 0;
    const perPattern = this.limits.maxListenersPerPattern;
    if (perPattern && count >= perPattern) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Exceeded maxListenersPerPattern (${perPattern}) for "${pattern}".`, {
        code: 'EVENT_PATTERN_LISTENER_LIMIT',
      });
    }
    const entry = Object.assign(this._entry('pattern', pattern, fn, options), {
      pattern,
      prefix: globPrefix(pattern),
      regex: globToRegExp(pattern),
      segment: firstStaticSegment(pattern),
    });
    insertSorted(this.patterns, entry);
    let indexed = this.patternIndex.get(entry.segment);
    if (!indexed) this.patternIndex.set(entry.segment, indexed = new Set());
    indexed.add(entry);
    this.patternCounts.set(pattern, count + 1);
    return { entry, handle: this._index(entry) };
  }

  addAny(fn, options = {}) {
    this._assertTotal();
    this._assertBucket(this.any, '*', this.limits.maxAnyListeners);
    const entry = this._entry('any', '*', fn, options);
    insertSorted(this.any, entry);
    return { entry, handle: this._index(entry) };
  }

  getEntry(id) { return this.entries.get(Number(id)) || null; }

  describeEntry(entry) {
    return Object.freeze({
      id: entry.id,
      kind: entry.kind,
      eventName: entry.kind === 'exact' ? entry.key : null,
      pattern: entry.kind === 'pattern' ? entry.pattern : null,
      priority: entry.priority,
      once: entry.once,
      prepend: entry.prepend,
      active: entry.active,
      paused: entry.paused,
      owner: entry.owner,
      tags: entry.tags.slice(),
      timeoutMs: entry.timeoutMs,
      errorPolicy: entry.errorPolicy,
      meta: entry.meta,
      listener: entry.fn,
      listenerName: entry.fn.name || '(anonymous)',
      createdAt: entry.createdAt,
    });
  }

  _unindex(entry) {
    this.entries.delete(entry.id);
    if (entry.owner) {
      const ids = this.ownerIndex.get(entry.owner);
      ids?.delete(entry.id);
      if (ids?.size === 0) this.ownerIndex.delete(entry.owner);
    }
    for (const tag of entry.tags) {
      const ids = this.tagIndex.get(tag);
      ids?.delete(entry.id);
      if (ids?.size === 0) this.tagIndex.delete(tag);
    }
    entry.active = false;
    this.total = Math.max(0, this.total - 1);
    this._touch();
  }

  removeById(id) {
    const entry = this.entries.get(Number(id));
    if (!entry || !entry.active) return false;
    if (entry.kind === 'exact') {
      const bucket = this.exact.get(entry.key);
      if (bucket) {
        const index = bucket.indexOf(entry);
        if (index !== -1) bucket.splice(index, 1);
        if (bucket.length === 0) this.exact.delete(entry.key);
      }
    } else if (entry.kind === 'pattern') {
      const index = this.patterns.indexOf(entry);
      if (index !== -1) this.patterns.splice(index, 1);
      const indexed = this.patternIndex.get(entry.segment);
      indexed?.delete(entry);
      if (indexed?.size === 0) this.patternIndex.delete(entry.segment);
      const count = (this.patternCounts.get(entry.pattern) || 1) - 1;
      if (count <= 0) this.patternCounts.delete(entry.pattern);
      else this.patternCounts.set(entry.pattern, count);
    } else {
      const index = this.any.indexOf(entry);
      if (index !== -1) this.any.splice(index, 1);
    }
    this._unindex(entry);
    return true;
  }

  claimOnce(entry) {
    if (!entry.once) return entry.active;
    if (!entry.active) return false;
    return this.removeById(entry.id);
  }

  removeExact(eventName, fn) {
    const bucket = this.exact.get(eventName);
    if (!bucket) return false;
    const entry = bucket.find((candidate) => candidate.fn === fn && candidate.active);
    return entry ? this.removeById(entry.id) : false;
  }

  removePattern(pattern, fn) {
    const entry = this.patterns.find((candidate) => candidate.pattern === pattern && candidate.fn === fn && candidate.active);
    return entry ? this.removeById(entry.id) : false;
  }

  removeAny(fn) {
    const entry = this.any.find((candidate) => candidate.fn === fn && candidate.active);
    return entry ? this.removeById(entry.id) : false;
  }

  pause(id) {
    const entry = this.getEntry(id);
    if (!entry || entry.paused) return false;
    entry.paused = true;
    this._touch();
    return true;
  }

  resume(id) {
    const entry = this.getEntry(id);
    if (!entry || !entry.paused) return false;
    entry.paused = false;
    this._touch();
    return true;
  }

  removeOwner(owner) {
    const ids = Array.from(this.ownerIndex.get(String(owner)) || []);
    let removed = 0;
    for (const id of ids) if (this.removeById(id)) removed++;
    return removed;
  }

  removeTag(tag) {
    const ids = Array.from(this.tagIndex.get(String(tag)) || []);
    let removed = 0;
    for (const id of ids) if (this.removeById(id)) removed++;
    return removed;
  }

  clear(eventName = null) {
    if (eventName != null) {
      const bucket = Array.from(this.exact.get(eventName) || []);
      for (const entry of bucket) this.removeById(entry.id);
      return bucket.length;
    }
    const ids = Array.from(this.entries.keys());
    for (const id of ids) this.removeById(id);
    return ids.length;
  }

  _patternCandidates(eventName) {
    const segment = String(eventName).split(':', 1)[0];
    const output = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const key of [segment, '*']) {
      const entries = this.patternIndex.get(key);
      if (!entries) continue;
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (seen.has(entry.id)) continue;
        seen.add(entry.id);
        if (!entry.active || entry.paused) continue;
        if (entry.prefix && !eventName.startsWith(entry.prefix)) continue;
        if (entry.regex.test(eventName)) output.push(entry);
      }
    }
    output.sort(compareEntries);
    return output;
  }

  plan(eventName, wildcardNames = null) {
    const cached = this.planCache.get(eventName);
    if (cached && cached.generation === this.generation) {
      // Dispatch plans are immutable and invalidated by registry generation.
      // A cache hit therefore needs no delete/reinsert LRU churn on the hot path.
      return cached.plan;
    }
    const resolvedWildcards = wildcardNames || computeWildcardEvents(eventName);
    const exactStages = [eventName, ...resolvedWildcards].map((name) => ({
      eventName: name,
      entries: (this.exact.get(name) || []).filter((entry) => entry.active && !entry.paused).slice(),
    }));
    const plan = Object.freeze({
      eventName,
      wildcardNames: Object.freeze(resolvedWildcards.slice()),
      exactStages,
      patterns: this._patternCandidates(eventName),
      any: this.any.filter((entry) => entry.active && !entry.paused).slice(),
    });
    if (this.planCacheMax > 0) {
      this.planCache.set(eventName, { generation: this.generation, plan });
      while (this.planCache.size > this.planCacheMax) this.planCache.delete(this.planCache.keys().next().value);
    }
    return plan;
  }

  hasPotential(eventName, wildcardNames = []) {
    if (this.exact.has(eventName)) return true;
    for (const name of wildcardNames) if (this.exact.has(name)) return true;
    return this.patterns.length > 0 || this.any.length > 0;
  }

  willDispatchTo(eventName, wildcardNames = []) {
    const plan = this.plan(eventName, wildcardNames);
    return plan.exactStages.some((stage) => stage.entries.length) || plan.patterns.length > 0 || plan.any.length > 0;
  }

  freeze() { this.registrationFrozen = true; return this; }
  unfreeze() { this.registrationFrozen = false; return this; }

  manifest() {
    return Array.from(this.entries.values())
      .filter((entry) => entry.active)
      .sort((left, right) => left.id - right.id)
      .map((entry) => this.describeEntry(entry));
  }
}

export default ListenerRegistry;

export class DispatchReport {
  constructor(eventName, options = {}) {
    this.eventName = eventName;
    this.mode = options.mode || 'sequential';
    this.startedAt = options.startedAt || Date.now();
    this.completedAt = null;
    this.durationMs = 0;
    this.matched = 0;
    this.invoked = 0;
    this.skipped = 0;
    this.results = [];
    this.errors = [];
    this.aborted = false;
    this.timedOut = false;
    this.stopped = false;
    this.stopValue = undefined;
    this.context = options.context || null;
  }

  complete(durationMs) {
    this.durationMs = Number(durationMs) || 0;
    this.completedAt = Date.now();
    return this;
  }

  finish(durationMs) { return this.complete(durationMs); }

  get ok() { return this.errors.length === 0 && !this.aborted && !this.timedOut; }
  get errorCount() { return this.errors.length; }

  toJSON() {

      eventName: this.eventName,
      mode: this.mode,

      errors: this.errors,

      timedOut: this.timedOut,
      stopped: this.stopped,

      context: this.context,

  }

'use strict';

import { deferred, abortError } from '../support/async.js';

export class AsyncEventIterator {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 1024);
    this.overflow = options.overflow || 'drop-oldest';
    this.queue = [];
    this.waiters = [];
    this.closed = false;
    this.error = null;
    this.handle = null;
    this.signal = options.signal || null;
    this.onAbort = null;
    if (this.signal) {
      this.onAbort = () => this.fail(abortError());
      if (this.signal.aborted) this.onAbort();
      else this.signal.addEventListener('abort', this.onAbort, { once: true });
    }
  }

  attach(handle) { this.handle = handle; return this; }

  push(value) {
    if (this.closed) return false;
    const waiter = this.waiters.shift();
    if (waiter) { waiter.resolve({ value, done: false }); return true; }
    if (this.queue.length >= this.maxItems) {
      if (this.overflow === 'drop-newest') return false;
      if (this.overflow === 'reject') {
        this.fail(new Error('Event iterator queue capacity exceeded'));
        return false;
      }
      this.queue.shift();
    }
    this.queue.push(value);
    return true;
  }

  next() {
    if (this.queue.length) return Promise.resolve({ value: this.queue.shift(), done: false });
    if (this.error) return Promise.reject(this.error);
    if (this.closed) return Promise.resolve({ value: undefined, done: true });
    const waiter = deferred();
    this.waiters.push(waiter);
    return waiter.promise;
  }

  return() { this.close(); return Promise.resolve({ value: undefined, done: true }); }
  throw(error) { this.fail(error); return Promise.reject(error); }

  close() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this.closed = true;
    this.handle?.dispose?.();
    this.handle = null;
    if (this.onAbort) this.signal?.removeEventListener?.('abort', this.onAbort);
    for (const waiter of this.waiters) waiter.resolve({ value: undefined, done: true });
    this.waiters.length = 0;
  }

  fail(error) {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this.error = error || new Error('Event iterator failed');
    this.closed = true;
    this.handle?.dispose?.();
    this.handle = null;
    if (this.onAbort) this.signal?.removeEventListener?.('abort', this.onAbort);
    for (const waiter of this.waiters) waiter.reject(this.error);
    this.waiters.length = 0;
  }

  [Symbol.asyncIterator]() { return this; }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { this.close(); }
}

export default AsyncEventIterator;
