'use strict';

import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { deferred } from '../support/async.js';
import { estimateValueBytes } from '../support/size.js';
import { EventAdmissionError, EventClosedError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

const VALID_OVERFLOW = new Set(['reject', 'drop-newest', 'drop-oldest', 'coalesce']);

export class DeferredEventScheduler {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxItems ?? 0) || 0);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxBytes ?? 0) || 0);
    this.maxInFlight = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxInFlight ?? 1) || 1);
    this.budgetMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.budgetMs ?? 4) || 0);
    this.maxPerSlice = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxPerSlice ?? 256) || 256);
    this.overflow = VALID_OVERFLOW.has(options.overflow) ? options.overflow : 'reject';
    this.awaitTasks = options.awaitTasks === true;
    this.unrefTimers = options.unrefTimers === true;
    this.sizeOf = typeof options.sizeOf === 'function' ? options.sizeOf : (item) => estimateValueBytes(item?.metadata ?? item);
    this.onDiagnostic = typeof options.onDiagnostic === 'function' ? options.onDiagnostic : null;

    this.queue = [];
    this.head = 0;
    this.bytes = 0;
    this.inFlight = 0;
    this.scheduled = false;
    this.accepting = true;
    this.closed = false;
    this.flushWaiters = new Set();
    this.coalesced = new Map();
    this.stats = { accepted: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, rejected: 0, dropped: 0, highWaterItems: 0, highWaterBytes: 0, slices: 0, yields: 0 };
  }

  get length() { return this.queue.length - this.head; }
  get idle() { return this.length === 0 && this.inFlight === 0; }

  schedule(task, options = {}) {
    if (typeof task !== 'function') throw new TypeError('DeferredEventScheduler.schedule expects a function');
    if (this.closed) throw new EventClosedError('Deferred event scheduler is closed');
    if (!this.accepting) throw new EventAdmissionError('Deferred event scheduler is draining', { code: 'EVENT_SCHEDULER_DRAINING' });

    const completion = deferred();
    const item = {
      task,
      metadata: options.metadata || null,
      key: options.key == null ? null : String(options.key),
      bytes: Math.max(0, Number(options.bytes) || this.sizeOf({ metadata: options.metadata })),
      completion,
      awaitTask: options.awaitTask === true,
      acceptedAt: Date.now(),
    };

    const admission = this._admit(item);
    if (!admission.accepted) {
      const error = new EventAdmissionError(`Deferred event rejected: ${admission.reason}`, {
        code: 'EVENT_DEFERRED_REJECTED',
        details: admission,
      });
      completion.reject(error);
      completion.promise.catch(() => {});
      return { ...admission, promise: completion.promise };
    }

    this.stats.accepted++;
    this.stats.highWaterItems = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterItems, this.length);
    this.stats.highWaterBytes = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterBytes, this.bytes);
    this._ensureScheduled(true);
    return { accepted: true, promise: completion.promise, item };
  }

  _fits(item) {
    if (this.maxItems && this.length >= this.maxItems) return false;
    if (this.maxBytes && this.bytes + item.bytes > this.maxBytes) return false;
    return true;
  }

  _admit(item) {
    if (item.key && this.overflow === 'coalesce') {
      const existing = this.coalesced.get(item.key);
      if (existing) {
        const nextBytes = this.bytes - existing.bytes + item.bytes;
        if (this.maxBytes && nextBytes > this.maxBytes) {
          this.stats.rejected++;
          return { accepted: false, reason: 'item-too-large', items: this.length, bytes: this.bytes };
        }
        existing.task = item.task;
        existing.metadata = item.metadata;
        this.bytes += item.bytes - existing.bytes;
        existing.bytes = item.bytes;
        existing.completion.resolve({ coalesced: true });
        existing.completion = item.completion;
        return { accepted: true, coalesced: true };
      }
    }

    if (!this._fits(item)) {
      if (this.overflow === 'drop-oldest') {
        while (!this._fits(item) && this.length > 0) {
          const dropped = this._shift();
          if (!dropped) break;
          this.stats.dropped++;
          dropped.completion.reject(new EventAdmissionError('Deferred event dropped by overflow policy', { code: 'EVENT_DEFERRED_DROPPED' }));
          dropped.completion.promise.catch(() => {});
        }
      } else if (this.overflow === 'drop-newest' || this.overflow === 'coalesce') {
        this.stats.dropped++;
        return { accepted: false, reason: 'drop-newest', items: this.length, bytes: this.bytes };
      } else {
        this.stats.rejected++;
        return { accepted: false, reason: 'capacity', items: this.length, bytes: this.bytes };
      }
    }

    if (!this._fits(item)) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      return { accepted: false, reason: 'item-too-large', items: this.length, bytes: this.bytes };
    }

    this.queue.push(item);
    this.bytes += item.bytes;
    if (item.key) this.coalesced.set(item.key, item);
    return { accepted: true };
  }

  _shift() {
    while (this.head < this.queue.length) {
      const item = this.queue[this.head++];
      if (!item) continue;
      this.bytes = Math.max(0, this.bytes - item.bytes);
      if (item.key && this.coalesced.get(item.key) === item) this.coalesced.delete(item.key);
      if (this.head > 4096 && this.head > this.queue.length / 2) {
        this.queue = this.queue.slice(this.head);
        this.head = 0;
      }
      return item;
    }
    this.queue.length = 0;
    this.head = 0;
    return null;
  }

  _ensureScheduled(microtask = false) {
    if (this.scheduled || this.closed) return;
    this.scheduled = true;
    if (microtask) queueMicrotask(() => this._runSlice());
    else {
      const immediate = setImmediate(() => this._runSlice());
      if (this.unrefTimers) immediate.unref?.();
    }
  }

  _runSlice() {
    this.scheduled = false;
    if (this.closed) return this._resolveFlush();
    this.stats.slices++;
    const started = performance.now();
    let processed = 0;

    while (this.length > 0 && this.inFlight < this.maxInFlight) {
      const item = this._shift();
      if (!item) break;
      processed++;
      this.inFlight++;
      let result;
      let threw = false;
      try { result = item.task(); }
      catch (error) { threw = true; this._settle(item, error); }

      if (threw) {
        if (processed >= this.maxPerSlice || (this.budgetMs > 0 && performance.now() - started >= this.budgetMs)) break;
        continue;
      }

      if (result && typeof result.then === 'function') {
        if (this.awaitTasks || item.awaitTask) {
          Promise.resolve(result).then(
            (value) => this._settle(item, null, value),
            (error) => this._settle(item, error),
          );
        } else {
          Promise.resolve(result).catch((error) => this.onDiagnostic?.('task:error', { error, metadata: item.metadata }));
          this._settle(item, null, undefined);
        }
      } else if (this.inFlight > 0 && item.completion) {
        this._settle(item, null, result);
      }

      if (processed >= this.maxPerSlice || (this.budgetMs > 0 && performance.now() - started >= this.budgetMs)) break;
    }

    if (this.length > 0) {
      this.stats.yields++;
      this._ensureScheduled(false);
    }
    this._resolveFlush();
  }

  _settle(item, error, value) {
    this.inFlight = Math.max(0, this.inFlight - 1);
    if (error) {
      this.stats.failed++;
      item.completion.reject(error);
      item.completion.promise.catch(() => {});
      this.onDiagnostic?.('task:error', { error, metadata: item.metadata });
    } else {
      this.stats.completed++;
      item.completion.resolve(value);
    }
    if (this.length > 0) this._ensureScheduled(false);
    this._resolveFlush();
  }

  flush() {
    if (this.idle) return Promise.resolve(this.snapshot());
    const waiter = deferred();
    this.flushWaiters.add(waiter);
    return waiter.promise;
  }

  _resolveFlush() {
    if (!this.idle) return;
    const snapshot = this.snapshot();
    for (const waiter of this.flushWaiters) waiter.resolve(snapshot);
    this.flushWaiters.clear();
  }

  async drain() {
    this.accepting = false;
    return this.flush();
  }

  async close(options = {}) {
    if (this.closed) return this.snapshot();
    this.accepting = false;
    if (options.force !== true) await this.flush();
    while (this.length) {
      const item = this._shift();
      if (!item) break;
      item.completion.reject(new EventClosedError('Deferred event scheduler closed'));
      item.completion.promise.catch(() => {});
    }
    this.closed = true;
    this._resolveFlush();
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      accepting: this.accepting,
      closed: this.closed,
      queuedItems: this.length,
      queuedBytes: this.bytes,
      inFlight: this.inFlight,
      limits: Object.freeze({ maxItems: this.maxItems, maxBytes: this.maxBytes, maxInFlight: this.maxInFlight, overflow: this.overflow }),
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }
}

export default DeferredEventScheduler;

FILE PATH: ./universal/middleware/EventMiddlewarePipeline.js

'use strict';

import { globToRegExp } from '../../support/glob.js';
import { deepFreeze } from '../support/safe.js';

const PHASES = new Set(['beforeEnvelope', 'beforeDispatch', 'beforeHandler', 'afterHandler', 'onHandlerError', 'afterDispatch', 'beforePublish', 'afterPublish', 'onTransportError', 'inbound']);

export class EventMiddlewarePipeline {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxMiddleware = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxMiddleware) || 10_000);
    this.errorPolicy = options.errorPolicy || 'propagate';
    this.entries = new Map();
    this.sequence = 0;
    this.generation = 0;
    this.cache = new Map();
    this.frozen = false;
  }

  use(phase, middleware, options = {}) {
    const name = String(phase);
    if (!PHASES.has(name)) throw new TypeError(`Unsupported event middleware phase '${name}'.`);
    if (typeof middleware !== 'function' && typeof middleware?.handle !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Event middleware must be a function or expose handle().');
    if (this.frozen) throw Object.assign(new Error('Event middleware registration is frozen.'), { code: 'EVENT_MIDDLEWARE_FROZEN' });
    if (this.size >= this.maxMiddleware) throw Object.assign(new Error('Event middleware limit exceeded.'), { code: 'EVENT_MIDDLEWARE_LIMIT' });
    const event = options.event || options.pattern || '**';
    const entry = {
      id: `middleware-${++this.sequence}`,
      phase: name,
      middleware,
      priority: Number(options.priority) || 0,
      order: this.sequence,
      event: String(event),
      matcher: globToRegExp(String(event)),
      transport: options.transport == null ? null : String(options.transport),
      audience: options.audience == null ? null : String(options.audience),
      owner: options.owner == null ? null : String(options.owner),
      tags: [...new Set((Array.isArray(options.tags) ? options.tags : options.tag ? [options.tag] : []).map(String))],
      active: true,
    };
    const list = this.entries.get(name) || [];
    list.push(entry); list.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority || a.order - b.order);
    this.entries.set(name, list); this._touch();
    return Object.freeze({ id: entry.id, dispose: () => this.remove(entry.id), [Symbol.dispose]: () => this.remove(entry.id) });
  }

  remove(id) { for (const [phase, list] of this.entries) { const index = list.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === id); if (index !== -1) { list[index].active = false; list.splice(index, 1); if (!list.length) this.entries.delete(phase); this._touch(); return true; } } return false; }
  removeOwner(owner) { let removed = 0; for (const list of this.entries.values()) for (const entry of [...list]) if (entry.owner === String(owner) && this.remove(entry.id)) removed++; return removed; }
  removeTag(tag) { let removed = 0; for (const list of this.entries.values()) for (const entry of [...list]) if (entry.tags.includes(String(tag)) && this.remove(entry.id)) removed++; return removed; }
  get size() { let total = 0; for (const list of this.entries.values()) total += list.length; return total; }
  freeze() { this.frozen = true; return this; }
  unfreeze() { this.frozen = false; return this; }
  _touch() { this.generation++; this.cache.clear(); }

  plan(phase, context = {}) {
    const eventName = String(context.eventName || context.name || '*');
    const transport = context.transport?.id || context.transport || null;
    const audience = context.audience || context.routing?.audience || null;
    const key = `${this.generation}:${phase}:${eventName}:${transport || ''}:${audience || ''}`;
    if (this.cache.has(key)) return this.cache.get(key);
    const plan = Object.freeze((this.entries.get(String(phase)) || []).filter((entry) => entry.active && entry.matcher.test(eventName) && (!entry.transport || entry.transport === transport) && (!entry.audience || entry.audience === audience)));
    if (this.cache.size > 4_096) this.cache.delete(this.cache.keys().next().value);
    this.cache.set(key, plan);
    return plan;
  }

  async run(phase, context, destination = null) {
    const plan = this.plan(phase, context);
    let index = -1;
    const invoke = async (cursor) => {
      if (cursor <= index) throw Object.assign(new Error('Event middleware called next() more than once.'), { code: 'EVENT_MIDDLEWARE_NEXT_MULTIPLE' });
      index = cursor;
      const entry = plan[cursor];
      if (!entry) return destination ? await destination(context) : context;
      const handler = typeof entry.middleware === 'function' ? entry.middleware : entry.middleware.handle.bind(entry.middleware);
      try { return await handler(context, () => invoke(cursor + 1)); }
      catch (error) {
        if (this.errorPolicy === 'isolate') { context.middlewareErrors ||= []; context.middlewareErrors.push({ id: entry.id, error }); return invoke(cursor + 1); }
        throw error;
      }
    };
    return invoke(0);
  }

  snapshot() { return deepFreeze({ frozen: this.frozen, size: this.size, generation: this.generation, phases: Object.fromEntries([...this.entries].map(([phase, list]) => [phase, list.map(({ middleware, matcher, ...entry }) => ({ ...entry, name: middleware.name || middleware.constructor?.name || 'anonymous' }))])) }); }
}

export default EventMiddlewarePipeline;

'use strict';

import { deepFreeze, randomId } from '../support/safe.js';

/**
 * Browser/universal context carrier. It intentionally does not claim ambient
 * propagation through arbitrary Promise chains. Context is preserved by
 * RawNode Events operations, scopes, bindings, envelopes, and transport calls.
 */
export class ExplicitEventContextManager {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.enabled = options.enabled !== false;
    this.stack = [];
    this.idFactory = options.idFactory || (() => randomId('ctx'));
  }

  create(meta = {}) {
    if (!this.enabled) return null;
    const parent = meta.parent || this.get();
    const id = meta.id || this.idFactory();
    return deepFreeze({
      id,
      parentId: meta.parentId ?? parent?.id ?? null,
      causationId: meta.causationId ?? parent?.eventId ?? parent?.id ?? null,
      correlationId: meta.correlationId ?? parent?.correlationId ?? parent?.id ?? id,
      traceId: meta.traceId ?? parent?.traceId ?? null,
      spanId: meta.spanId ?? null,
      requestId: meta.requestId ?? parent?.requestId ?? null,
      tenantId: meta.tenantId ?? parent?.tenantId ?? null,
      actorId: meta.actorId ?? parent?.actorId ?? null,
      connectionId: meta.connectionId ?? parent?.connectionId ?? null,
      tabId: meta.tabId ?? parent?.tabId ?? null,
      transport: meta.transport ?? null,
      source: meta.source ?? null,
      eventId: meta.eventId ?? null,
      createdAt: Number(meta.createdAt) || Date.now(),
      baggage: meta.baggage && typeof meta.baggage === 'object' ? { ...meta.baggage } : null,
    });
  }

  get() { return this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] || null; }
  id() { return this.get()?.id || null; }

  run(context, callback) {
    if (!this.enabled || !context) return callback();
    this.stack.push(context);
    let value;
    try { value = callback(); }
    catch (error) { this.stack.pop(); throw error; }
    if (value && typeof value.then === 'function') return Promise.resolve(value).finally(() => { if (this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] === context) this.stack.pop(); else this._remove(context); });
    this.stack.pop();
    return value;
  }

  runIfMissing(meta, callback) { return this.get() ? callback(this.get()) : this.run(this.create(meta), callback); }
  enter(context) { if (context) this.stack.push(context); return context; }
  leave(context = null) { if (!context || this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] === context) return this.stack.pop() || null; return this._remove(context); }
  bind(callback, context = this.get()) { return (...args) => this.run(context, () => callback(...args)); }
  child(meta = {}) { return this.create({ ...meta, parent: this.get() }); }
  _remove(context) { const index = this.stack.lastIndexOf(context); if (index !== -1) return this.stack.splice(index, 1)[0]; return null; }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ enabled: this.enabled, depth: this.stack.length, current: this.get() }); }
}

export default ExplicitEventContextManager;

'use strict';

import { deepFreeze } from '../support/safe.js';

export const EVENT_TRANSPORT_CAPABILITIES = Object.freeze({
  local: false,
  remote: true,
  ordered: false,
  orderedByPartition: false,
  acknowledged: false,
  durable: false,
  fanout: false,
  binary: false,
  requestReply: false,
  browser: false,
  server: false,
  maxPacketBytes: 0,
});

export class EventTransport {
  constructor(id, options = {}) {
    const value = String(id || options.id || '').trim();
    if (!value) throw new TypeError('Event transport id is required.');
    this.id = value;
    this.options = options;
    this.state = 'idle';
    this.startedAt = 0;
    this.lastError = null;
    this.stats = { published: 0, received: 0, rejected: 0, errors: 0, bytesOut: 0, bytesIn: 0, starts: 0, closes: 0 };
    this._capabilities = deepFreeze({ ...EVENT_TRANSPORT_CAPABILITIES, ...(options.capabilities || {}) });
  }
  capabilities() { return this._capabilities; }
  async start() { if (this.state === 'started') return this; if (this.state === 'closed') throw transportError(`Transport '${this.id}' is closed.`, 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_CLOSED'); this.state = 'started'; this.startedAt ||= Date.now(); this.stats.starts++; return this; }
  subscribe() { return () => {}; }
  async publish() { throw transportError(`Transport '${this.id}' does not implement publish().`, 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED'); }
  async flush() { return true; }
  health() { return deepFreeze({ ok: this.state !== 'failed' && this.state !== 'closed', ready: this.state === 'started', state: this.state, id: this.id, uptimeMs: this.startedAt ? Date.now() - this.startedAt : 0, capabilities: this.capabilities(), stats: { ...this.stats }, lastError: this.lastError }); }
  diagnostics() { return this.health(); }
  async close() { if (this.state === 'closed') return this.health(); this.state = 'closed'; this.stats.closes++; return this.health(); }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await this.close(); }
  _error(error) { this.stats.errors++; this.lastError = { at: Date.now(), name: error?.name || 'Error', message: error?.message || String(error), code: error?.code || null }; this.state = 'failed'; return error; }
}
export function transportError(message, code = 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_ERROR', options = {}) { return Object.assign(new Error(message), { name: 'EventTransportError', code, retryable: options.retryable === true, details: options.details || null, cause: options.cause }); }

'use strict';

import { EventDeliveryResult, EventDeliveryState, deliveryError } from '../delivery/EventDelivery.js';
import { deepFreeze, safeError, timeout } from '../support/safe.js';

export class EventTransportRouter {
  constructor(registry, options = {}) {
    if (!registry) throw new TypeError('EventTransportRouter requires a transport registry.');
    this.registry = registry;
    this.defaultTransport = options.defaultTransport || 'local';
    this.fallbackEnabled = options.fallback !== false;
    this.defaultTimeoutMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.timeoutMs) || 30_000);
    this.policies = [];
    this.sequence = 0;
    this.stats = { published: 0, accepted: 0, rejected: 0, failed: 0, fallbacks: 0, fanouts: 0 };
  }

  policy(pattern, config = {}) { const entry = { id: `transport-policy-${++this.sequence}`, pattern: String(pattern || '**'), regex: globRegex(pattern || '**'), priority: Number(config.priority) || 0, config: { ...config } }; this.policies.push(entry); this.policies.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority || a.id.localeCompare(b.id)); return () => { const index = this.policies.indexOf(entry); if (index !== -1) this.policies.splice(index, 1); }; }
  resolve(envelope, options = {}) {
    const eventName = String(envelope?.name || envelope?.eventName || envelope || '');
    const definition = options.definition || null;
    const matchedPolicy = this.policies.find((entry) => entry.regex.test(eventName)) || null;
    const policy = matchedPolicy?.config || {};
    const primary = unique(firstNonEmpty(
      options.via,
      envelope?.routing?.transports,
      definition?.transports,
      policy.via,
      policy.transports,
      [this.defaultTransport],
    ));
    const fallback = unique(firstNonEmpty(
      options.fallback,
      envelope?.routing?.fallback,
      policy.fallback,
      [],
    ));
    const fanout = options.fanout === true || policy.fanout === true;
    return {
      eventName,
      policyId: matchedPolicy?.id || null,
      policyPattern: matchedPolicy?.pattern || null,
      primary,
      fallback,
      fanout,
      required: options.required === true || policy.required === true,
      timeoutMs: Math.max(0, Number(options.timeoutMs ?? policy.timeoutMs ?? this.defaultTimeoutMs) || 0),
    };
  }

  explain(eventOrEnvelope, options = {}) {
    const envelope = typeof eventOrEnvelope === 'string'
      ? {
          name: eventOrEnvelope,
          routing: {
            transports: options.transports || options.via || [],
            fallback: options.fallback || [],
          },
          delivery: {
            mode: options.deliveryMode || (options.durable === true ? 'at-least-once' : 'best-effort'),
            partitionKey: options.partitionKey || null,
          },
          byteLength: () => Math.max(0, Number(options.bytes) || 0),
        }
      : eventOrEnvelope;
    const route = this.resolve(envelope, options);
    const candidates = unique([...route.primary, ...(this.fallbackEnabled ? route.fallback : [])]);
    const transports = candidates.map((id, index) => {
      const transport = this.registry.get(id);
      const capabilities = transport?.capabilities?.() || null;
      const mismatch = transport ? capabilityMismatch(capabilities || {}, envelope, options) : {
        code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_UNKNOWN',
        reason: 'unknown-transport',
      };
      return {
        id,
        role: index < route.primary.length ? 'primary' : 'fallback',
        registered: !!transport,
        state: transport?.state || transport?.health?.()?.state || null,
        capabilities,
        compatible: !mismatch,
        rejection: mismatch,
      };
    });
    return deepFreeze({
      ...route,
      fallbackEnabled: this.fallbackEnabled,
      transports,
      acceptedCandidates: transports.filter((entry) => entry.compatible).map((entry) => entry.id),
    });
  }

  async publish(envelope, options = {}) {
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    const route = this.resolve(envelope, options);
    this.stats.published++;
    if (route.fanout) return this._fanout(envelope, route, options, startedAt);
    const candidates = [...route.primary, ...(this.fallbackEnabled ? route.fallback : [])];
    const results = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < candidates.length; index++) {
      const id = candidates[index];
      const transport = this.registry.get(id);
      if (!transport) { results.push(EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_UNKNOWN', reason: 'unknown-transport' })); continue; }
      const compatibility = capabilityMismatch(transport.capabilities?.() || {}, envelope, options);
      if (compatibility) { results.push(EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: id, eventId: envelope.id, code: compatibility.code, reason: compatibility.reason })); continue; }
      const result = await this._publishOne(transport, envelope, route, options);
      results.push(result);
      if (result.accepted) {
        this.stats.accepted++;
        if (index > 0) this.stats.fallbacks++;
        return new EventDeliveryResult({ ...result, results: results.map((value) => value.toJSON?.() || value), startedAt, finishedAt: Date.now() });
      }
    }
    this.stats.rejected++;
    const result = EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: candidates[0] || null, eventId: envelope.id, state: EventDeliveryState.REJECTED, code: results.at(-1)?.code || 'EVENT_DELIVERY_REJECTED', reason: results.at(-1)?.reason || 'no-compatible-transport', retryable: results.some((entry) => entry.retryable), results: results.map((value) => value.toJSON?.() || value), startedAt, finishedAt: Date.now() });
    if (route.required || options.failurePolicy === 'throw') throw deliveryError(`No event transport accepted '${envelope.name}'.`, result);
    return result;
  }

  async _fanout(envelope, route, options, startedAt) {
    this.stats.fanouts++;
    const ids = unique([...route.primary, ...route.fallback]);
    const results = await Promise.all(ids.map(async (id) => {
      const transport = this.registry.get(id);
      if (!transport) return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_UNKNOWN', reason: 'unknown-transport' });
      const mismatch = capabilityMismatch(transport.capabilities?.() || {}, envelope, options);
      return mismatch ? EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: id, eventId: envelope.id, code: mismatch.code, reason: mismatch.reason }) : this._publishOne(transport, envelope, route, options);
    }));
    const accepted = results.filter((entry) => entry.accepted);
    this.stats.accepted += accepted.length;
    this.stats.rejected += results.length - accepted.length;
    const result = new EventDeliveryResult({ accepted: accepted.length > 0 && (!route.required || accepted.length === results.length), state: accepted.length === results.length ? EventDeliveryState.SENT : accepted.length ? EventDeliveryState.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN : EventDeliveryState.REJECTED, eventId: envelope.id, acknowledged: accepted.every((entry) => entry.acknowledged), persisted: accepted.some((entry) => entry.persisted), retryable: results.some((entry) => entry.retryable), results: results.map((entry) => entry.toJSON?.() || entry), startedAt, finishedAt: Date.now() });
    if ((!result.accepted || (route.required && accepted.length !== results.length)) && options.failurePolicy === 'throw') throw deliveryError(`Event fanout failed for '${envelope.name}'.`, result);
    return result;
  }

  async _publishOne(transport, envelope, route, options) {
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    try {
      await transport.start?.(options.context || {});
      const value = await timeout(transport.publish(envelope, options), route.timeoutMs, { code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT', message: `Event transport '${transport.id}' timed out after ${route.timeoutMs}ms.` });
      if (value instanceof EventDeliveryResult) return value;
      if (value?.accepted === false) return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ ...value, transport: transport.id, eventId: envelope.id, startedAt, finishedAt: Date.now() });
      return EventDeliveryResult.accepted({ transport: transport.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: value?.state || (value?.acknowledged ? EventDeliveryState.ACKNOWLEDGED : value?.persisted ? EventDeliveryState.PERSISTED : EventDeliveryState.SENT), acknowledged: value?.acknowledged === true, persisted: value?.persisted === true, value, startedAt, finishedAt: Date.now() });
    } catch (error) { this.stats.failed++; return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: transport.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: error?.delivery || EventDeliveryState.FAILED, code: error?.code || 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_PUBLISH_FAILED', reason: error?.message || String(error), retryable: error?.retryable === true, error: safeError(error), startedAt, finishedAt: Date.now() }); }
  }

  snapshot() { return deepFreeze({ defaultTransport: this.defaultTransport, fallbackEnabled: this.fallbackEnabled, policies: this.policies.map(({ regex, ...entry }) => entry), stats: { ...this.stats } }); }
}
function firstNonEmpty(...values) {
  for (const value of values) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      if (value.length) return value;
      continue;
    }
    if (value != null && value !== '') return value;
  }
  return [];
}
function unique(value) { return [...new Set((Array.isArray(value) ? value : value == null ? [] : [value]).map(String).filter(Boolean))]; }
function capabilityMismatch(capabilities, envelope, options) {
  if (options.requireAcknowledgement === true && capabilities.acknowledged !== true) return { code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_ACK_UNSUPPORTED', reason: 'acknowledgement-required' };
  if ((options.durable === true || envelope.delivery?.mode === 'at-least-once' || envelope.delivery?.mode === 'effectively-once') && capabilities.durable !== true && options.allowNonDurable !== true) return { code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_DURABILITY_UNSUPPORTED', reason: 'durability-required' };
  if (envelope.delivery?.partitionKey && options.requireOrdering === true && capabilities.orderedByPartition !== true) return { code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_ORDERING_UNSUPPORTED', reason: 'partition-ordering-required' };
  const bytes = envelope.byteLength?.() || 0;
  if (capabilities.maxPacketBytes > 0 && bytes > capabilities.maxPacketBytes) return { code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_PACKET_TOO_LARGE', reason: 'packet-too-large' };
  return null;
}
function globRegex(value) { let source = '^'; const text = String(value); for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) { const c = text[i]; if (c === '*') { if (text[i + 1] === '*') { source += '.*'; i++; } else source += '[^:]*'; } else if (c === '?') source += '[^:]'; else source += '\\.^$|()[]{}+'.includes(c) ? `\\${c}` : c; } return new RegExp(`${source}$`); }
export default EventTransportRouter;

'use strict';

import { deepFreeze } from '../support/safe.js';

export class EventTransportRegistry {
  constructor(options = {}) { this.maxTransports = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxTransports) || 128); this.transports = new Map(); this.owned = new Set(); this.frozen = false; this.generation = 0; }
  register(transport, options = {}) {
    if (this.frozen) throw registryError('Event transport registration is frozen.', 'EVENT_TRANSPORTS_FROZEN');
    if (!transport?.id || typeof transport.publish !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Event transport must expose id and publish().');
    const id = String(options.id || transport.id);
    if (this.transports.has(id) && options.replace !== true) throw registryError(`Event transport already exists: ${id}`, 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_DUPLICATE');
    if (!this.transports.has(id) && this.transports.size >= this.maxTransports) throw registryError('Event transport limit exceeded.', 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_LIMIT');
    this.transports.set(id, transport); if (options.owned !== false) this.owned.add(id); else this.owned.delete(id); this.generation++; return transport;
  }
  get(id) { return this.transports.get(String(id)) || null; }
  require(id) { const value = this.get(id); if (!value) throw registryError(`Unknown event transport: ${id}`, 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_UNKNOWN'); return value; }
  has(id) { return this.transports.has(String(id)); }
  remove(id) { if (this.frozen) throw registryError('Event transport registration is frozen.', 'EVENT_TRANSPORTS_FROZEN'); const key = String(id); const value = this.transports.get(key); this.transports.delete(key); this.owned.delete(key); if (value) this.generation++; return value || null; }
  names() { return [...this.transports.keys()]; }
  all() { return [...this.transports.values()]; }
  freeze() { this.frozen = true; return this; }
  unfreeze() { this.frozen = false; return this; }
  async startAll(context = {}) { const results = []; for (const transport of this.transports.values()) results.push(await transport.start?.(context) || transport); return results; }
  async close(options = {}) { const results = []; for (const [id, transport] of [...this.transports].reverse()) { if (!this.owned.has(id) && options.closeExternal !== true) continue; try { results.push(await transport.close?.(options)); } catch (error) { results.push({ id, error }); } } return results; }
  snapshot() { return deepFreeze({ frozen: this.frozen, generation: this.generation, maxTransports: this.maxTransports, transports: Object.fromEntries([...this.transports].map(([id, transport]) => [id, transport.health?.() || { id, state: transport.state || 'unknown', capabilities: transport.capabilities?.() || null }])) }); }
}
function registryError(message, code) { return Object.assign(new Error(message), { name: 'EventTransportRegistryError', code }); }
export default EventTransportRegistry;

'use strict';

import { EventTransport } from './EventTransport.js';
import { EventDeliveryResult, EventDeliveryState } from '../delivery/EventDelivery.js';

export class LocalEventTransport extends EventTransport {
  constructor(dispatcher, options = {}) {
    super(options.id || 'local', { ...options, capabilities: { local: true, remote: false, ordered: true, acknowledged: true, durable: false, fanout: false, binary: false, requestReply: true, browser: true, server: true, ...(options.capabilities || {}) } });
    if (!dispatcher) throw new TypeError('LocalEventTransport requires a dispatcher.');
    this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
  }
  async publish(envelope, options = {}) {
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    await this.start();
    const payload = envelope?.content?.payload;
    const eventName = envelope?.name;
    if (!eventName) return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope?.id, code: 'EVENT_NAME_REQUIRED', reason: 'missing-event-name' });
    try {
      if (options.async !== false && typeof this.dispatcher.dispatchAsync === 'function') await this.dispatcher.dispatchAsync(eventName, payload, envelope);
      else this.dispatcher.dispatch?.(eventName, payload, envelope);
      this.stats.published++;
      return EventDeliveryResult.accepted({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: EventDeliveryState.ACKNOWLEDGED, acknowledged: true, startedAt, finishedAt: Date.now() });
    } catch (error) { this._error(error); return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: EventDeliveryState.FAILED, code: error.code || 'EVENT_LOCAL_DISPATCH_FAILED', reason: error.message, retryable: false, error, startedAt, finishedAt: Date.now() }); }
  }
}

'use strict';

import { UniversalEventEnvelope } from '../envelope/UniversalEventEnvelope.js';
import { SeenEventWindow } from './SeenEventWindow.js';
import { byteLength, deepFreeze } from '../support/safe.js';

export class EventAdmissionGateway {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.profile = options.profile || {};
    this.definitions = options.definitions || null;
    this.cryptoProvider = options.cryptoProvider || null;
    this.authorizer = options.authorizer || null;
    this.authenticator = options.authenticator || null;
    this.tenantResolver = options.tenantResolver || null;
    this.seen = options.seen || new SeenEventWindow(options.seenOptions || {});
    this.limits = options.limits || this.profile.limits || {};
    this.stats = { admitted: 0, rejected: 0, duplicates: 0, invalid: 0, unauthorized: 0, unauthenticated: 0, unknown: 0, contractFailures: 0 };
  }

  async admit(input, context = {}) {
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    try {
      const rawBytes = typeof input === 'string' || input instanceof Uint8Array || input instanceof ArrayBuffer ? byteLength(input) : 0;
      if (this.limits.maxEnvelopeBytes > 0 && rawBytes > this.limits.maxEnvelopeBytes) return this._reject('EVENT_ENVELOPE_TOO_LARGE', 'packet-too-large', { rawBytes });
      const wireEnvelope = UniversalEventEnvelope.normalize(input, {
        acceptedVersions: this.profile.acceptedEnvelopeVersions || [1, 2, 3],
        limits: this.limits,
      });
      await UniversalEventEnvelope.verify(wireEnvelope, {
        acceptedVersions: this.profile.acceptedEnvelopeVersions || [1, 2, 3],
        cryptoProvider: this.cryptoProvider,
        requireSignature: context.remote === true
          ? this.profile.allowUnsignedRemote === false
          : this.profile.allowUnsignedLocal === false,
        maxHops: this.limits.maxHops,
        maxClockSkewMs: context.maxClockSkewMs,
      });
      if (!this.seen.checkAndAdd(wireEnvelope.id)) {
        this.stats.duplicates++;
        return this._reject('EVENT_DUPLICATE', 'duplicate', { envelope: wireEnvelope }, false);
      }

      const latestDefinition = this.definitions?.get?.(wireEnvelope.name) || null;
      const exactDefinition = this.definitions?.get?.(wireEnvelope.name, wireEnvelope.version) || null;
      if (!latestDefinition && this.profile.allowUnknownEvents === false) {
        this.stats.unknown++;
        return this._reject('EVENT_DEFINITION_UNKNOWN', 'unknown-event', { envelope: wireEnvelope });
      }

      let envelope = wireEnvelope;
      let definition = exactDefinition || latestDefinition;
      let upcast = null;
      if (latestDefinition && latestDefinition.version > wireEnvelope.version && context.upcast !== false) {
        try {
          upcast = this.definitions.upcast(
            wireEnvelope.name,
            wireEnvelope.version,
            wireEnvelope.content?.payload,
            latestDefinition.version,
            { envelope: wireEnvelope, context, phase: 'remote-inbound' },
          );
          envelope = upcastEnvelope(wireEnvelope, upcast, latestDefinition);
          definition = latestDefinition;
        } catch (error) {
          this.stats.contractFailures++;
          return this._reject(error.code || 'EVENT_UPCAST_FAILED', 'upcast-failed', {
            envelope: wireEnvelope,
            error: { name: error?.name || 'Error', code: error?.code || null, message: error?.message || String(error) },
          });
        }
      } else if (latestDefinition && !exactDefinition && this.profile.requireRemoteContracts) {
        this.stats.contractFailures++;
        return this._reject(
          wireEnvelope.version > latestDefinition.version
            ? 'EVENT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED'
            : 'EVENT_DEFINITION_VERSION_UNKNOWN',
          wireEnvelope.version > latestDefinition.version
            ? 'future-version-unsupported'
            : 'definition-version-unknown',
          { envelope: wireEnvelope, latestVersion: latestDefinition.version },
        );
      }

      const tenant = this.tenantResolver
        ? await this.tenantResolver({ envelope, wireEnvelope, context })
        : envelope.context?.tenantId || context.tenant || null;
      if (this.profile.requireTenantResolution && !tenant) {
        return this._reject('EVENT_TENANT_UNRESOLVED', 'tenant-unresolved', { envelope });
      }
      const principal = this.authenticator
        ? await this.authenticator({ envelope, wireEnvelope, context, tenant })
        : context.principal || envelope.security?.principal || null;
      if (context.remote === true && this.profile.requireRemoteAuthentication && !principal && envelope.security?.authenticated !== true) {
        this.stats.unauthenticated++;
        return this._reject('EVENT_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED', 'authentication-required', { envelope });
      }
      const channel = envelope.routing?.channel;
      if (channel && this.authorizer) {
        const decision = await this.authorizer.authorize(channel, {
          envelope,
          wireEnvelope,
          context,
          tenant,
          principal,
          transport: context.transport,
          event: definition,
        });
        if (!decision.allowed) {
          this.stats.unauthorized++;
          return this._reject('EVENT_CHANNEL_DENIED', decision.reason || 'channel-denied', { envelope, decision });
        }
      }
      if (definition && (this.profile.remoteValidation !== false || context.validate === true)) {
        const validation = await this.definitions.validate(
          envelope.name,
          envelope.version,
          envelope.content?.payload,
          { eventContext: envelope.context, envelope, wireEnvelope, phase: 'remote-inbound' },
        );
        if (!validation.ok) {
          this.stats.contractFailures++;
          return this._reject('EVENT_CONTRACT_INVALID', 'contract-invalid', { envelope, errors: validation.errors });
        }
      }
      this.stats.admitted++;
      return deepFreeze({
        accepted: true,
        envelope,
        wireEnvelope,
        definition,
        tenant,
        principal,
        upcasted: !!upcast,
        originalVersion: wireEnvelope.version,
        startedAt,
        finishedAt: Date.now(),
      });
    } catch (error) { this.stats.invalid++; return this._reject(error.code || 'EVENT_ADMISSION_FAILED', error.message || 'admission-failed', { error }, error.retryable === true); }
  }

  _reject(code, reason, details = null, retryable = false) { this.stats.rejected++; return deepFreeze({ accepted: false, code, reason, retryable, details, finishedAt: Date.now() }); }
  snapshot() { return deepFreeze({ profile: this.profile.name || null, limits: { ...this.limits }, seen: this.seen.snapshot(), stats: { ...this.stats } }); }
}
function upcastEnvelope(envelope, upcast, definition) {
  return new UniversalEventEnvelope({
    ...envelope,
    version: upcast.version,
    content: {
      ...envelope.content,
      schema: `${envelope.name}@${upcast.version}`,
      payload: upcast.payload,
    },
    security: {
      ...envelope.security,
      signature: null,
      verified: true,
      verifiedKeyId: envelope.security?.keyId || null,
    },
    metadata: {
      ...(envelope.metadata || {}),
      admission: {
        ...((envelope.metadata || {}).admission || {}),
        upcasted: true,
        originalVersion: envelope.version,
        targetVersion: upcast.version,
        definitionId: definition?.id || null,
      },
    },
  });
}

export default EventAdmissionGateway;

'use strict';

import { globToRegExp } from '../../support/glob.js';
import { deepFreeze } from '../support/safe.js';

export class ChannelAuthorizationRegistry {
  constructor(options = {}) { this.defaultEffect = options.defaultEffect || 'deny'; this.maxPolicies = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxPolicies) || 10_000); this.policies = []; this.sequence = 0; this.frozen = false; }
  define(pattern, authorize, options = {}) {
    if (this.frozen) throw authorizationError('Channel authorization registry is frozen.', 'EVENT_CHANNEL_POLICIES_FROZEN');
    if (typeof authorize !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Channel authorization policy must be a function.');
    if (this.policies.length >= this.maxPolicies) throw authorizationError('Channel authorization policy limit exceeded.', 'EVENT_CHANNEL_POLICY_LIMIT');
    const policy = { id: options.id || `channel-policy-${++this.sequence}`, pattern: String(pattern), matcher: globToRegExp(String(pattern)), authorize, priority: Number(options.priority) || 0, owner: options.owner || null, metadata: options.metadata || null };
    this.policies.push(policy); this.policies.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
    return Object.freeze({ id: policy.id, dispose: () => this.remove(policy.id), [Symbol.dispose]: () => this.remove(policy.id) });
  }
  remove(id) { const index = this.policies.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === id); if (index === -1) return false; this.policies.splice(index, 1); return true; }
  removeOwner(owner) { let removed = 0; for (const policy of [...this.policies]) if (policy.owner === owner && this.remove(policy.id)) removed++; return removed; }
  async authorize(channel, context = {}) {
    const name = String(channel || '');
    const matches = this.policies.filter((policy) => policy.matcher.test(name));
    if (!matches.length) return { allowed: this.defaultEffect === 'allow', effect: this.defaultEffect, policy: null, reason: 'default' };
    for (const policy of matches) {
      const result = await policy.authorize({ ...context, channel: name, policy });
      if (result === undefined || result === null) continue;
      if (result === true || result?.allowed === true || result?.effect === 'allow') return { allowed: true, effect: 'allow', policy: policy.id, result };
      if (result === false || result?.allowed === false || result?.effect === 'deny') return { allowed: false, effect: 'deny', policy: policy.id, reason: result?.reason || 'denied', result };
    }
    return { allowed: this.defaultEffect === 'allow', effect: this.defaultEffect, policy: null, reason: 'no-decision' };
  }
  freeze() { this.frozen = true; return this; }
  snapshot() { return deepFreeze({ frozen: this.frozen, defaultEffect: this.defaultEffect, policies: this.policies.map(({ matcher, authorize, ...value }) => ({ ...value, handler: authorize.name || 'anonymous' })) }); }
}
function authorizationError(message, code) { return Object.assign(new Error(message), { name: 'EventAuthorizationError', code }); }
export default ChannelAuthorizationRegistry;

'use strict';

export class SeenEventWindow {
  constructor(options = {}) { this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 100_000); this.ttlMs = Math.max(1, Number(options.ttlMs) || 5 * 60_000); this.values = new Map(); this.stats = { added: 0, duplicates: 0, expired: 0, evicted: 0 }; }
  has(id, now = Date.now()) { const key = String(id); const expiresAt = this.values.get(key); if (!expiresAt) return false; if (expiresAt <= now) { this.values.delete(key); this.stats.expired++; return false; } this.stats.duplicates++; return true; }
  add(id, now = Date.now()) { const key = String(id); this.prune(now); if (!this.values.has(key) && this.values.size >= this.maxItems) { const oldest = this.values.keys().next().value; this.values.delete(oldest); this.stats.evicted++; } this.values.delete(key); this.values.set(key, now + this.ttlMs); this.stats.added++; return true; }
  checkAndAdd(id, now = Date.now()) { if (this.has(id, now)) return false; this.add(id, now); return true; }
  prune(now = Date.now()) { for (const [id, expiresAt] of this.values) { if (expiresAt > now) break; this.values.delete(id); this.stats.expired++; } }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ size: this.values.size, maxItems: this.maxItems, ttlMs: this.ttlMs, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
  clear() { this.values.clear(); }
}
export default SeenEventWindow;

'use strict';

import { deepFreeze, randomId } from '../support/safe.js';

export class EventResourceLease {
  constructor(governor, record) { this.governor = governor; this.record = record; this.released = false; }
  get accepted() { return true; }
  get id() { return this.record.id; }
  release() { if (this.released) return false; this.released = true; return this.governor.release(this.record.id); }
  [Symbol.dispose]() { this.release(); }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { this.release(); }
}

export class EventResourceGovernor {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = nonNegative(options.maxItems ?? options.resourceItems, 0);
    this.maxBytes = nonNegative(options.maxBytes ?? options.resourceBytes, 0);
    this.tenantMaxItems = nonNegative(options.tenantMaxItems ?? options.tenantItems, 0);
    this.tenantMaxBytes = nonNegative(options.tenantMaxBytes ?? options.tenantBytes, 0);
    this.categoryLimits = new Map(Object.entries(options.categories || {}));
    this.records = new Map();
    this.categories = new Map();
    this.tenants = new Map();
    this.items = 0;
    this.bytes = 0;
    this.highWaterItems = 0;
    this.highWaterBytes = 0;
    this.stats = { admitted: 0, rejected: 0, released: 0, leakedReleases: 0 };
  }

  reserve(input = {}) {
    const category = String(input.category || 'default');
    const tenantId = input.tenantId == null ? null : String(input.tenantId);
    const items = Math.max(1, Number(input.items) || 1);
    const bytes = Math.max(0, Number(input.bytes) || 0);
    const categoryUsage = this.categories.get(category) || { items: 0, bytes: 0 };
    const categoryLimit = this.categoryLimits.get(category) || {};
    const tenantUsage = tenantId ? this.tenants.get(tenantId) || { items: 0, bytes: 0 } : null;
    const reason = this._rejection({ items, bytes, categoryUsage, categoryLimit, tenantUsage });
    if (reason) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      return deepFreeze({ accepted: false, code: 'EVENT_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED', reason, retryable: true, category, tenantId, requested: { items, bytes }, snapshot: this.snapshot() });
    }
    const record = { id: input.id || randomId('lease'), category, tenantId, items, bytes, createdAt: Date.now(), label: input.label || null };
    this.records.set(record.id, record);
    this.items += items; this.bytes += bytes;
    categoryUsage.items += items; categoryUsage.bytes += bytes; this.categories.set(category, categoryUsage);
    if (tenantUsage) { tenantUsage.items += items; tenantUsage.bytes += bytes; this.tenants.set(tenantId, tenantUsage); }
    this.highWaterItems = Math.max(this.highWaterItems, this.items);
    this.highWaterBytes = Math.max(this.highWaterBytes, this.bytes);
    this.stats.admitted++;
    return new EventResourceLease(this, record);
  }

  _rejection({ items, bytes, categoryUsage, categoryLimit, tenantUsage }) {
    if (this.maxItems && this.items + items > this.maxItems) return 'global-item-budget';
    if (this.maxBytes && this.bytes + bytes > this.maxBytes) return 'global-byte-budget';
    if (categoryLimit.maxItems && categoryUsage.items + items > categoryLimit.maxItems) return 'category-item-budget';
    if (categoryLimit.maxBytes && categoryUsage.bytes + bytes > categoryLimit.maxBytes) return 'category-byte-budget';
    if (tenantUsage && this.tenantMaxItems && tenantUsage.items + items > this.tenantMaxItems) return 'tenant-item-budget';
    if (tenantUsage && this.tenantMaxBytes && tenantUsage.bytes + bytes > this.tenantMaxBytes) return 'tenant-byte-budget';
    return null;
  }

  release(id) {
    const record = this.records.get(String(id));
    if (!record) { this.stats.leakedReleases++; return false; }
    this.records.delete(record.id);
    this.items = Math.max(0, this.items - record.items); this.bytes = Math.max(0, this.bytes - record.bytes);
    decrement(this.categories, record.category, record);
    if (record.tenantId) decrement(this.tenants, record.tenantId, record);
    this.stats.released++;
    return true;
  }

  configureCategory(name, limits = {}) { this.categoryLimits.set(String(name), { maxItems: nonNegative(limits.maxItems, 0), maxBytes: nonNegative(limits.maxBytes, 0) }); return this; }
  assert(input) { const lease = this.reserve(input); if (!lease.accepted) throw Object.assign(new Error(`Event resource admission rejected: ${lease.reason}`), { name: 'EventAdmissionError', code: lease.code, retryable: lease.retryable, details: lease }); return lease; }
  snapshot() {
    return deepFreeze({
      items: this.items, bytes: this.bytes, maxItems: this.maxItems, maxBytes: this.maxBytes,
      tenantMaxItems: this.tenantMaxItems, tenantMaxBytes: this.tenantMaxBytes,
      highWaterItems: this.highWaterItems, highWaterBytes: this.highWaterBytes,
      categories: Object.fromEntries([...this.categories].map(([key, value]) => [key, { ...value, limits: { ...(this.categoryLimits.get(key) || {}) } }])),
      tenants: Object.fromEntries([...this.tenants].map(([key, value]) => [key, { ...value }])),
      activeLeases: this.records.size, stats: { ...this.stats },
    });
  }
  close() { this.records.clear(); this.categories.clear(); this.tenants.clear(); this.items = 0; this.bytes = 0; }
}

function nonNegative(value, fallback) { const number = Number(value); return Number.isFinite(number) && number >= 0 ? number : fallback; }
function decrement(map, key, record) { const usage = map.get(key); if (!usage) return; usage.items = Math.max(0, usage.items - record.items); usage.bytes = Math.max(0, usage.bytes - record.bytes); if (!usage.items && !usage.bytes) map.delete(key); }
export default EventResourceGovernor;

'use strict';

import { byteLength, randomId, toUint8Array } from '../support/safe.js';

export class UniversalRuntimeAdapter {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.name = options.name || detectRuntimeName();
    this.id = options.id || randomId(this.name);
    this.clock = options.clock || null;
  }

  now() { return typeof this.clock?.now === 'function' ? Number(this.clock.now()) : Date.now(); }
  monotonicNow() { return typeof globalThis.performance?.now === 'function' ? globalThis.performance.now() : this.now(); }
  randomId(prefix = 'evt') { return randomId(prefix); }
  byteLength(value) { return byteLength(value); }
  encode(value) { return toUint8Array(value); }
  decode(bytes) { return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes instanceof Uint8Array ? bytes : new Uint8Array(bytes)); }
  microtask(callback) { queueMicrotask(callback); }
  schedule(callback, options = {}) {
    const mode = options.mode || 'task';
    if (mode === 'animation' && typeof globalThis.requestAnimationFrame === 'function') return globalThis.requestAnimationFrame(() => callback());
    if (mode === 'idle' && typeof globalThis.requestIdleCallback === 'function') return globalThis.requestIdleCallback(() => callback(), { timeout: options.timeoutMs || 100 });
    if (mode === 'microtask') { queueMicrotask(callback); return 0; }
    if (typeof globalThis.MessageChannel === 'function') {
      const channel = new MessageChannel();
      channel.port1.onmessage = () => { channel.port1.close(); channel.port2.close(); callback(); };
      channel.port2.postMessage(0);
      return channel;
    }
    return setTimeout(callback, 0);
  }
  capabilities() {
    return Object.freeze({
      runtime: this.name,
      crypto: !!globalThis.crypto,
      webCrypto: !!globalThis.crypto?.subtle,
      eventTarget: typeof globalThis.EventTarget === 'function',
      broadcastChannel: typeof globalThis.BroadcastChannel === 'function',
      messageChannel: typeof globalThis.MessageChannel === 'function',
      serviceWorker: !!globalThis.navigator?.serviceWorker,
      dom: typeof globalThis.document !== 'undefined',
    });
  }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ name: this.name, id: this.id, capabilities: this.capabilities() }); }
}

function detectRuntimeName() {
  if (typeof globalThis.window !== 'undefined' && globalThis.window === globalThis) return 'browser';
  if (typeof globalThis.WorkerGlobalScope !== 'undefined' && globalThis instanceof globalThis.WorkerGlobalScope) return 'worker';
  if (typeof globalThis.process !== 'undefined' && globalThis.process?.versions?.node) return 'node';
  return 'universal';
}

export default UniversalRuntimeAdapter;

'use strict';

import { cloneSafe, deepFreeze } from '../support/safe.js';

export class EventFlightRecorder {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.enabled = options.enabled === true;
    this.limit = Math.max(0, Number(options.limit || options.maxRecords) || 0);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxBytes) || 8 * 1024 * 1024);
    this.sampleRate = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(options.sampleRate ?? 1)));
    this.redactKeys = options.redactKeys || [];
    this.records = new Array(this.limit || 1);
    this.cursor = 0;
    this.size = 0;
    this.bytes = 0;
    this.sequence = 0;
    this.stats = { recorded: 0, sampledOut: 0, evicted: 0, oversized: 0 };
  }

  record(type, input = {}) {
    if (!this.enabled || !this.limit) return null;
    if (this.sampleRate < 1 && Math.random() > this.sampleRate && input.force !== true) { this.stats.sampledOut++; return null; }
    const value = cloneSafe({ id: ++this.sequence, type: String(type), at: Date.now(), ...input }, { maxDepth: 12, maxKeys: 2_048, maxArrayItems: 256, maxStringBytes: 8_192, redactKeys: this.redactKeys });
    const bytes = estimate(value);
    if (this.maxBytes && bytes > this.maxBytes) { this.stats.oversized++; return null; }
    while (this.size && this.maxBytes && this.bytes + bytes > this.maxBytes) this._evictOldest();
    if (this.size === this.limit) this._evictAt(this.cursor);
    this.records[this.cursor] = { value, bytes };
    this.cursor = (this.cursor + 1) % this.limit;
    this.size = Math.min(this.limit, this.size + 1);
    this.bytes += bytes;
    this.stats.recorded++;
    return value;
  }

  _evictOldest() { if (!this.size) return; const index = this.size === this.limit ? this.cursor : 0; this._evictAt(index); if (this.size < this.limit) { for (let cursor = index; cursor < this.size; cursor++) this.records[cursor] = this.records[cursor + 1]; this.records[this.size] = undefined; this.cursor = this.size % this.limit; } }
  _evictAt(index) { const record = this.records[index]; if (record) this.bytes = Math.max(0, this.bytes - record.bytes); this.records[index] = undefined; this.size = Math.max(0, this.size - 1); this.stats.evicted++; }
  list(options = {}) {
    const output = [];
    const start = this.size === this.limit ? this.cursor : 0;
    for (let offset = 0; offset < this.size; offset++) { const record = this.records[(start + offset) % this.limit]; if (record?.value) output.push(record.value); }
    let filtered = output;
    if (options.type) filtered = filtered.filter((record) => record.type === options.type);
    if (options.eventName) filtered = filtered.filter((record) => record.eventName === options.eventName);
    if (options.correlationId) filtered = filtered.filter((record) => record.correlationId === options.correlationId);
    if (options.since) filtered = filtered.filter((record) => record.at >= Number(options.since));
    if (options.limit) filtered = filtered.slice(-Math.max(1, Number(options.limit)));
    return deepFreeze(filtered.slice());
  }
  clear() { this.records.fill(undefined); this.cursor = 0; this.size = 0; this.bytes = 0; }
  snapshot() { return deepFreeze({ enabled: this.enabled, limit: this.limit, size: this.size, bytes: this.bytes, maxBytes: this.maxBytes, stats: { ...this.stats } }); }
}
function estimate(value) { try { return typeof TextEncoder === 'function' ? new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(value)).byteLength : JSON.stringify(value).length * 2; } catch { return 0; } }
export default EventFlightRecorder;

'use strict';

import { deepFreeze } from '../support/safe.js';

export class UniversalEventMetrics {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.enabled = options.enabled === true;
    this.prefix = String(options.prefix || 'rawnode_events_fabric').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_:]/g, '_');
    this.maxSeries = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxSeries) || 2_048);
    this.counters = new Map();
    this.histograms = new Map();
    this.overflow = 0;
    this.createdAt = Date.now();
  }

  increment(name, value = 1, labels = null) { if (!this.enabled) return; const key = this._key(name, labels); if (!key) return; this.counters.set(key, (this.counters.get(key) || 0) + Number(value || 0)); }
  observe(name, value, labels = null) {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    const key = this._key(name, labels); if (!key) return;
    const current = this.histograms.get(key) || { count: 0, sum: 0, min: Infinity, max: -Infinity };
    const number = Number(value) || 0; current.count++; current.sum += number; current.min = Math.min(current.min, number); current.max = Math.max(current.max, number); this.histograms.set(key, current);
  }
  _key(name, labels) {
    const suffix = labels && typeof labels === 'object' ? `{${Object.entries(labels).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${normalizeLabel(value)}`).join(',')}}` : '';
    const key = `${String(name)}${suffix}`;
    if (this.counters.has(key) || this.histograms.has(key)) return key;
    if (this.counters.size + this.histograms.size >= this.maxSeries) { this.overflow++; return null; }
    return key;
  }
  snapshot() { return deepFreeze({ enabled: this.enabled, prefix: this.prefix, uptimeMs: Date.now() - this.createdAt, counters: Object.fromEntries(this.counters), histograms: Object.fromEntries([...this.histograms].map(([key, value]) => [key, { ...value, average: value.count ? value.sum / value.count : 0 }])), overflow: this.overflow }); }
  prometheus(prefix = this.prefix) {
    const lines = [];
    for (const [key, value] of this.counters) { const { name, labels } = parseKey(key); lines.push(`${metric(prefix, name)}${labels} ${value}`); }
    for (const [key, value] of this.histograms) { const { name, labels } = parseKey(key); const base = metric(prefix, name); lines.push(`${base}_count${labels} ${value.count}`, `${base}_sum${labels} ${value.sum}`, `${base}_min${labels} ${Number.isFinite(value.min) ? value.min : 0}`, `${base}_max${labels} ${Number.isFinite(value.max) ? value.max : 0}`); }
    lines.push(`${metric(prefix, 'series_overflow_total')} ${this.overflow}`);
    return `${lines.join('\n')}\n`;
  }
  reset() { this.counters.clear(); this.histograms.clear(); this.overflow = 0; }
}
function normalizeLabel(value) { return String(value ?? '').replace(/[{},=\s]/g, '_').slice(0, 128); }
function metric(prefix, name) { return `${prefix}_${String(name).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_:]/g, '_')}`; }
function parseKey(key) { const index = key.indexOf('{'); if (index === -1) return { name: key, labels: '' }; const pairs = key.slice(index + 1, -1).split(',').filter(Boolean).map((pair) => { const at = pair.indexOf('='); return `${pair.slice(0, at)}="${pair.slice(at + 1)}"`; }).join(','); return { name: key.slice(0, index), labels: pairs ? `{${pairs}}` : '' }; }
export default UniversalEventMetrics;

  }

  ttl(value) { this.operation.ttlMs = Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0); return this; }
  timeout(value) { this.operation.options.timeoutMs = Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0); return this; }
  requireAcknowledgement(value = true) { this.operation.options.requireAcknowledgement = value !== false; return this; }
  requireOrdering(value = true) { this.operation.options.requireOrdering = value !== false; return this; }
  classification(value) { this.operation.security.classification = String(value); return this; }
  authenticated(principal = null) { this.operation.security.authenticated = true; this.operation.security.principal = principal; return this; }
  key(value) { this.operation.security.keyId = value == null ? null : String(value); return this; }
  codec(value) { this.operation.codec = String(value); return this; }
  schema(value) { this.operation.schema = String(value); return this; }
  meta(value) { this.operation.metadata = { ...(this.operation.metadata || {}), ...(value || {}) }; return this; }
  option(name, value) { this.operation.options[name] = value; return this; }
  local() { return this.fabric.dispatch(this.operation.name, this.operation.payload, this.operation.options); }
  localAsync() { return this.fabric.dispatchAsync(this.operation.name, this.operation.payload, this.operation.options); }
  publish(options = {}) { return this.fabric.publish(this.operation, { ...this.operation.options, ...options }); }
  broadcast(options = {}) { return this.fabric.broadcast(this.operation, { ...this.operation.options, ...options }); }
  enqueue(options = {}) { return this.fabric.enqueue(this.operation, { ...this.operation.options, ...options }); }
  record(options = {}) { return this.fabric.record(this.operation, { ...this.operation.options, ...options }); }
  request(options = {}) { return this.fabric.request(this.operation, { ...this.operation.options, ...options }); }
  snapshot() { return structuredCloneSafe(this.operation); }
}
function structuredCloneSafe(value) { try { return structuredClone(value); } catch { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)); } }
export default EventOperationBuilder;

'use strict';

import { timeout } from '../support/safe.js';

export class EventSubscriptionBuilder {
  constructor(fabric, eventName, options = {}) { this.fabric = fabric; this.eventName = String(eventName); this.options = { ...options }; this.listener = null; }
  handle(listener) { if (typeof listener !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Event subscription handler must be a function.'); this.listener = listener; return this; }
  priority(value) { this.options.priority = Number(value) || 0; return this; }
  prepend(value = true) { this.options.prepend = value !== false; return this; }
  once(value = true) { this.options.once = value !== false; return this; }
  replay(value = true) { this.options.replay = value; return this; }
  owner(value) { this.options.owner = value == null ? null : String(value); return this; }
  tag(...values) { this.options.tags = [...(this.options.tags || []), ...values.flat().map(String)]; return this; }
  signal(value) { this.options.signal = value; return this; }
  timeout(value) { this.options.timeoutMs = Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0); return this; }
  retry(attempts = 1, options = {}) { this.options.retry = { attempts: Math.max(0, Number(attempts) || 0), delayMs: Math.max(0, Number(options.delayMs) || 0), backoff: Math.max(1, Number(options.backoff) || 2), maxDelayMs: Math.max(0, Number(options.maxDelayMs) || 30_000) }; return this; }
  serialBy(selector) { this.options.serialBy = selector; return this; }
  debounce(milliseconds) { this.options.debounceMs = Math.max(0, Number(milliseconds) || 0); return this; }
  throttle(milliseconds) { this.options.throttleMs = Math.max(0, Number(milliseconds) || 0); return this; }
  onError(policy) { this.options.errorPolicy = policy; return this; }
  idempotent(value = true) { this.options.idempotent = value !== false; return this; }
  queued(value = true) { this.options.queued = value !== false; return this; }
  durable(value = true) { this.options.durable = value !== false; return this; }
  pattern(value = true) { this.options.pattern = value !== false; return this; }
  any(value = true) { this.options.any = value !== false; return this; }
  register() {
    if (!this.listener) throw new TypeError(`Event subscription '${this.eventName}' requires handle().`);
    const wrapped = wrapHandler(this.listener, this.options, this.fabric);
    if (this.options.signal?.aborted) return null;
    const dispatcher = this.fabric.dispatcher;
    const handle = this.options.any ? dispatcher.subscribeAny(wrapped, this.options) : this.options.pattern || this.eventName.includes('**') || this.eventName.includes('?') ? dispatcher.subscribePattern(this.eventName, wrapped, this.options) : dispatcher.subscribe(this.eventName, wrapped, this.options);
    if (this.options.signal && handle) {
      const dispose = () => handle.dispose?.();
      this.options.signal.addEventListener('abort', dispose, { once: true });
    }
    return handle;
  }
  listen(listener = null) { if (listener) this.handle(listener); return this.register(); }
}

function wrapHandler(listener, options, fabric) {
  const chains = new Map();
  let debounceTimer = null;
  let lastRun = 0;
  let pendingDebounce = null;
  const execute = async (...args) => {
    if (options.queued) return fabric.queue ? fabric.queue.add?.('dispatch-listener', { listener, args, eventName: options.eventName }, options) : listener(...args);
    let attempt = 0; const retries = options.retry?.attempts || 0;
    while (true) {
      try { return await timeout(Promise.resolve(listener(...args)), options.timeoutMs, { code: 'EVENT_LISTENER_TIMEOUT' }); }
      catch (error) { if (attempt++ >= retries || options.idempotent !== true) throw error; const delay = Math.min(options.retry.maxDelayMs, options.retry.delayMs * (options.retry.backoff ** Math.max(0, attempt - 1))); if (delay) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay)); }
    }
  };
  return (...args) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (options.throttleMs > 0 && now - lastRun < options.throttleMs) return undefined;
    if (options.debounceMs > 0) {
      clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      pendingDebounce ||= deferred();
      debounceTimer = setTimeout(async () => { const current = pendingDebounce; pendingDebounce = null; try { lastRun = Date.now(); current.resolve(await execute(...args)); } catch (error) { current.reject(error); } }, options.debounceMs);
      return pendingDebounce.promise;
    }
    lastRun = now;
    if (options.serialBy) {
      const key = String(typeof options.serialBy === 'function' ? options.serialBy(...args) : args[0]?.[options.serialBy] ?? 'default');
      const previous = chains.get(key) || Promise.resolve();
      const next = previous.catch(() => {}).then(() => execute(...args)).finally(() => { if (chains.get(key) === next) chains.delete(key); });
      chains.set(key, next); return next;
    }
    return execute(...args);
  };
}
function deferred() { let resolve; let reject; const promise = new Promise((res, rej) => { resolve = res; reject = rej; }); return { promise, resolve, reject }; }
export default EventSubscriptionBuilder;

'use strict';

import { randomId } from '../support/safe.js';

export class EventRequestManager {
  constructor(fabric, options = {}) { this.fabric = fabric; this.timeoutMs = Math.max(1, Number(options.timeoutMs) || 30_000); this.prefix = options.replyPrefix || '__events:reply:'; this.pending = new Map(); this.handlers = new Map(); this.closed = false; }

  async request(operation, options = {}) {
    if (this.closed) throw Object.assign(new Error('Event request manager is closed.'), { code: 'EVENT_REQUEST_MANAGER_CLOSED' });
    const requestId = operation.delivery?.requestId || options.requestId || randomId('request');
    const replyEvent = `${this.prefix}${requestId}`;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const signal = options.signal;
    if (signal?.aborted) controller.abort(signal.reason);
    else signal?.addEventListener('abort', () => controller.abort(signal.reason), { once: true });
    const response = this.fabric.dispatcher.waitFor
      ? this.fabric.dispatcher.waitFor(replyEvent, { timeoutMs: options.timeoutMs || this.timeoutMs, signal: controller.signal, map: (_eventName, payload) => payload })
      : waitForFallback(this.fabric.dispatcher, replyEvent, options.timeoutMs || this.timeoutMs, controller.signal);
    this.pending.set(requestId, { requestId, replyEvent, startedAt: Date.now(), controller });
    try {
      const delivery = await this.fabric.publish({ ...operation, delivery: { ...(operation.delivery || {}), requestId, replyTo: replyEvent } }, { ...options, requireAcknowledgement: options.requireAcknowledgement !== false });
      if (!delivery.accepted) throw Object.assign(new Error(`Event request '${operation.name}' was not admitted.`), { code: delivery.code || 'EVENT_REQUEST_NOT_ADMITTED', delivery: delivery.state, result: delivery });
      const packet = await response;
      if (packet?.ok === false) {
        throw Object.assign(
          new Error(packet.error?.message || `Event request '${operation.name}' failed.`),
          packet.error || {},
        );
      }
      return packet?.ok === true ? packet.value : packet;
    } finally { this.pending.delete(requestId); controller.abort('request-complete'); }
  }

  handle(eventName, handler, options = {}) {
    if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Event request handler must be a function.');
    const subscription = this.fabric.subscription(eventName).handle(async (payload, envelope) => {
      const requestId = envelope?.delivery?.requestId || envelope?.requestId;
      const replyTo = envelope?.delivery?.replyTo || envelope?.replyTo;
      if (!requestId || !replyTo) return;
      try {
        const value = await handler(payload, envelope);
        return await this.fabric.event(replyTo).payload({ ok: true, value, requestId }).correlation(envelope.context?.correlationId).causation(envelope.id).via(...(options.via || envelope.routing?.transports || [])).publish({ ...options, localEcho: true });
      } catch (error) {
        await this.fabric.event(replyTo).payload({ ok: false, error: { name: error.name, message: error.message, code: error.code }, requestId }).correlation(envelope.context?.correlationId).causation(envelope.id).via(...(options.via || envelope.routing?.transports || [])).publish({ ...options, localEcho: true });
        if (options.errorPolicy === 'throw') throw error;
      }
    }).register();
    this.handlers.set(String(eventName), subscription);
    return subscription;
  }

  snapshot() { return { closed: this.closed, pending: this.pending.size, handlers: [...this.handlers.keys()] }; }
  close() { this.closed = true; for (const handle of this.handlers.values()) handle?.dispose?.(); this.handlers.clear(); for (const value of this.pending.values()) value.controller.abort('request-manager-closed'); this.pending.clear(); }
}
function waitForFallback(dispatcher, event, timeoutMs, signal) { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { let timer; const cleanup = () => { clearTimeout(timer); handle?.dispose?.(); signal?.removeEventListener?.('abort', aborted); }; const aborted = () => { cleanup(); reject(signal.reason || new Error('Event request aborted.')); }; const handle = dispatcher.subscribe(event, (payload) => { cleanup(); if (payload?.ok === false) reject(Object.assign(new Error(payload.error?.message || 'Event request failed.'), payload.error || {})); else resolve(payload?.value ?? payload); }, { once: true }); timer = setTimeout(() => { cleanup(); reject(Object.assign(new Error(`Event request timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms.`), { code: 'EVENT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT' })); }, timeoutMs); signal?.addEventListener?.('abort', aborted, { once: true }); }); }
export default EventRequestManager;

'use strict';

import { EventMiddlewarePipeline } from './middleware/EventMiddlewarePipeline.js';

import { EventFlightRecorder } from './observability/EventFlightRecorder.js';

import { EventTransportRouter } from './transport/EventTransportRouter.js';
import { LocalEventTransport } from './transport/LocalEventTransport.js';
