import { assertEventName, byteLength, deepFreeze, safeError } from './support/safe.js';

export class UniversalEventFabric {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    if (!options.dispatcher) throw new TypeError('UniversalEventFabric requires a dispatcher.');
    this.dispatcher = options.dispatcher;
    this.profile = resolveEventCompatibilityProfile(options.profile || options.configuration?.profile || 'compat', options.compatibilityOverrides || {});
    this.runtime = options.runtime || new UniversalRuntimeAdapter(options.runtimeOptions || {});
    this.contexts = options.contexts || new ExplicitEventContextManager(options.context || {});
    this.definitions = options.definitions instanceof EventDefinitionRegistry ? options.definitions : new EventDefinitionRegistry({ maxDefinitions: this.profile.limits.maxDefinitions, ...(options.definitions || {}), definitions: options.eventDefinitions || options.definitions?.definitions });
    this.resources = options.resources || new EventResourceGovernor({ ...this.profile.limits, ...(options.resourceGovernor || {}) });
    this.middleware = options.middleware || new EventMiddlewarePipeline({ maxMiddleware: this.profile.limits.maxMiddleware, errorPolicy: this.profile.middlewareErrorPolicy, ...(options.middlewareOptions || {}) });
    this.metrics = options.metrics instanceof UniversalEventMetrics ? options.metrics : new UniversalEventMetrics({ enabled: this.profile.metrics, maxSeries: this.profile.limits.maxMetricSeries, ...(options.metrics || {}) });
    this.flightRecorder = options.flightRecorder instanceof EventFlightRecorder ? options.flightRecorder : new EventFlightRecorder({ enabled: this.profile.flightRecorder, limit: this.profile.limits.maxFlightRecords, ...(options.flightRecorder || {}) });
    this.transports = options.transports instanceof EventTransportRegistry ? options.transports : new EventTransportRegistry({ maxTransports: this.profile.limits.maxTransports, ...(options.transports || {}) });
    this.router = options.router || new EventTransportRouter(this.transports, { defaultTransport: options.defaultTransport || 'local', fallback: this.profile.transportFallback, ...(options.routerOptions || {}) });
    this.authorizer = options.authorizer || new ChannelAuthorizationRegistry({ defaultEffect: this.profile.name === 'compat' ? 'allow' : 'deny', ...(options.authorization || {}) });
    this.cryptoProvider = options.cryptoProvider || null;
    this.gateway = options.gateway || new EventAdmissionGateway({ profile: this.profile, definitions: this.definitions, cryptoProvider: this.cryptoProvider, authorizer: this.authorizer, authenticator: options.authenticator, tenantResolver: options.tenantResolver, seenOptions: options.seen, limits: this.profile.limits });
    this.requests = options.requests || new EventRequestManager(this, { timeoutMs: this.profile.limits.requestTimeoutMs, ...(options.requestOptions || {}) });
    this.queue = options.queue || null;
    this.outbox = options.outbox || this.dispatcher.outbox?.() || null;
    this.eventStore = options.eventStore || null;
    this.application = options.application || null;
    this.nodeId = options.nodeId || null;
    this.state = 'created';
    this.startedAt = 0;
    this.stats = { dispatches: 0, publishes: 0, durable: 0, enqueued: 0, recorded: 0, inbound: 0, rejected: 0, errors: 0 };
    this.transportReceivers = new Map();
    if (!this.transports.has('local')) this.transports.register(new LocalEventTransport(this.dispatcher), { owned: true });
    for (const transport of options.transportList || []) this.transports.register(transport, { owned: options.ownTransports !== false });
    for (const transport of this.transports.all()) this._bindTransport(transport);
    this.outboxTransport = new OutboxFabricTransport(this);
    this.attach(options.attach !== false);
  }

  attach(enabled = true) {
    if (!enabled) return this;
    const bus = this.dispatcher;
    const methods = {
      fabric: () => this,
      event: (name, payload) => this.event(name, payload),
      subscription: (name, options) => this.subscription(name, options),
      defineEvent: (definition, options) => this.define(definition, options),
      registerTransport: (transport, options) => this.transport(transport, options),
      publish: (eventOrOperation, payload, options) => this.publish(eventOrOperation, payload, options),
      requestEvent: (eventOrOperation, payload, options) => this.request(eventOrOperation, payload, options),
      inboundEvent: (envelope, context) => this.inbound(envelope, context),
      eventFabricSnapshot: () => this.snapshot(),
    };
    for (const [name, fn] of Object.entries(methods)) if (typeof bus[name] !== 'function') Object.defineProperty(bus, name, { value: fn, configurable: true, writable: false, enumerable: false });
    Object.defineProperty(bus, '__rawnodeUniversalEventFabric', { value: this, configurable: true, writable: false, enumerable: false });
    return this;
  }

  async start(context = {}) {
    if (this.state === 'started') return this;
    if (this.state === 'closed') throw Object.assign(new Error('Universal Event Fabric is closed.'), { code: 'EVENT_FABRIC_CLOSED' });
    this.state = 'starting';
    try {
      if (context.startTransports !== false) await this.transports.startAll({ ...context, fabric: this });
      if (this.profile.freezeDefinitions) this.definitions.freeze();
      if (this.profile.freezeTransports) this.transports.freeze();
      if (this.profile.dynamicRegistration === false) this.middleware.freeze();
      this.state = 'started'; this.startedAt ||= Date.now();
      this.flightRecorder.record('fabric:started', { profile: this.profile.name, runtime: this.runtime.snapshot() });
      return this;
    } catch (error) { this.state = 'failed'; this.stats.errors++; throw error; }
  }

  event(name, payload = undefined) { return new EventOperationBuilder(this, name, payload); }
  subscription(name, options = {}) { return new EventSubscriptionBuilder(this, name, options); }
  define(definition, options = {}) { return this.definitions.register(definition, options); }
  transport(transport, options = {}) { const registered = this.transports.register(transport, options); this._bindTransport(registered); return registered; }
  _bindTransport(transport) {
    if (!transport?.id || transport.id === 'local' || typeof transport.subscribe !== 'function' || this.transportReceivers.has(transport.id)) return transport;
    const dispose = transport.subscribe((envelope, context = {}) => this.inbound(envelope, { ...context, transport, remote: context.remote !== false }));
    this.transportReceivers.set(transport.id, typeof dispose === 'function' ? dispose : () => dispose?.dispose?.());
    return transport;
  }
  transportPolicy(pattern, policy = {}) { return this.router.policy(pattern, policy); }
  channel(pattern, authorize, options = {}) { return this.authorizer.define(pattern, authorize, options); }
  use(phase, middleware, options = {}) { return this.middleware.use(phase, middleware, options); }
  scope(owner) { return this.dispatcher.scope(owner); }
  getContext() { return this.dispatcher.getContext?.() || this.contexts.get(); }
  createContext(meta = {}) { return this.dispatcher.createContext?.(meta) || this.contexts.create(meta); }

  dispatch(eventName, payload, options = {}) {

      if (!definition && !this.profile.allowUnknownEvents) throw Object.assign(new Error(`Unknown event '${name}'.`), { code: 'EVENT_DEFINITION_UNKNOWN' });
    }
    this.stats.dispatches++; this.metrics.increment('dispatch_total', 1, { event: metricEvent(name) });
    this.flightRecorder.record('dispatch:started', { eventName: name, correlationId: this.getContext()?.correlationId || null });
    return this.dispatcher.dispatch(name, payload);
  }

  async dispatchAsync(eventName, payload, options = {}) {
    const name = assertEventName(eventName, this.profile.limits);
    if (this.profile.localValidation) await this.definitions.assert(name, options.version || 1, payload, { eventContext: options.context || this.getContext(), phase: 'local' });
    const started = this.runtime.monotonicNow(); this.stats.dispatches++;
    try {
      return await this.middleware.run('beforeDispatch', { fabric: this, eventName: name, payload, options, context: options.context || this.getContext() }, async (context) => {
        const value = await this.dispatcher.dispatchAsync(name, context.payload);
        await this.middleware.run('afterDispatch', { ...context, result: value });
        return value;
      });
    } finally { const duration = this.runtime.monotonicNow() - started; this.metrics.increment('dispatch_total', 1, { event: metricEvent(name) }); this.metrics.observe('dispatch_duration_ms', duration, { event: metricEvent(name) }); this.flightRecorder.record('dispatch:finished', { eventName: name, durationMs: duration, correlationId: options.context?.correlationId || this.getContext()?.correlationId || null }); }
  }

  async publish(eventOrOperation, payloadOrOptions = undefined, maybeOptions = undefined) {
    const { operation, options } = normalizeOperation(eventOrOperation, payloadOrOptions, maybeOptions);
    const name = assertEventName(operation.name, this.profile.limits);
    operation.name = name;
    operation.context ||= options.context || this.getContext() || this.createContext({ source: 'publish' });
    operation.delivery ||= {};
    if (operation.delivery.partitionKey == null && typeof operation.partitionResolver === 'function') {
      operation.delivery.partitionKey = operation.partitionResolver(operation.payload, operation.context);
    }

      operation.routing ||= {};
      if ((!operation.routing.transports || !operation.routing.transports.length) && definition.transports.length) operation.routing.transports = [...definition.transports];

      operation.security ||= {};
      operation.security.classification ||= definition.classification;
      operation.delivery ||= {};

      operation.delivery.partitionKey ??= definition.partition(operation.payload, operation.context);
      if (definition.idempotency && !operation.delivery.idempotencyKey) operation.delivery.idempotencyKey = `${name}:${operation.version}:${operation.delivery.partitionKey || operation.id || ''}`;
      if (this.profile.remoteValidation !== false || options.validate === true) await this.definitions.assert(name, operation.version, operation.payload, { eventContext: operation.context, phase: 'publish' });

        const bytes = envelope.byteLength();
        const lease = this.resources.reserve({ category: options.durable || definition?.durable ? 'durable-publish' : 'publish', tenantId: envelope.context?.tenantId, items: 1, bytes, label: envelope.name });
        if (!lease.accepted) {
          this.stats.rejected++; this.metrics.increment('admission_rejected_total', 1, { reason: lease.reason });
          const rejected = EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ eventId: envelope.id, code: lease.code, reason: lease.reason, retryable: lease.retryable });
          if (options.failurePolicy === 'throw' || this.profile.deliveryFailurePolicy === 'throw') throw deliveryError(`Event '${name}' was rejected by the resource governor.`, rejected);
          return rejected;
        }
        try {
          if ((options.durable === true || definition?.durable === true || envelope.delivery.mode === 'at-least-once' || envelope.delivery.mode === 'effectively-once') && !options.fromOutbox && this.outbox) {
            const inserted = await this.outbox.enqueue(envelope.name, [envelope], { version: envelope.version, context: envelope.context, idempotencyKey: envelope.delivery.idempotencyKey, headers: { protocolVersion: envelope.protocolVersion }, meta: { routing: envelope.routing, security: envelope.security, metadata: envelope.metadata } });
            this.stats.durable++; this.metrics.increment('durable_enqueued_total', 1, { event: metricEvent(name) });
            return EventDeliveryResult.accepted({ eventId: envelope.id, transport: 'outbox', state: EventDeliveryState.PERSISTED, persisted: true, value: inserted });
          }
          return await this.middleware.run('beforePublish', { ...prepared, envelope }, async (publishContext) => {
            let result = await this.router.publish(envelope, { ...options, definition, failurePolicy: options.failurePolicy || this.profile.deliveryFailurePolicy });
            if (options.localEcho === true && !envelope.routing.transports?.includes('local')) {
              const local = await this.transports.require('local').publish(envelope, { async: options.localAsync !== false });
              result = new EventDeliveryResult({ ...result, results: [...(result.results || [result]), local] });
            }
            await this.middleware.run('afterPublish', { ...publishContext, result });
            return result;
          });
        } finally { lease.release(); }
      });
    } catch (error) { this.stats.errors++; this.metrics.increment('publish_error_total', 1, { event: metricEvent(name), code: error.code || 'error' }); this.flightRecorder.record('publish:error', { eventName: name, error: safeError(error), correlationId: operation.context?.correlationId || null, force: true }); throw error; }
    finally { const duration = this.runtime.monotonicNow() - started; this.metrics.observe('publish_duration_ms', duration, { event: metricEvent(name) }); this.flightRecorder.record('publish:finished', { eventName: name, durationMs: duration, correlationId: operation.context?.correlationId || null }); }
  }

  broadcast(eventOrOperation, payloadOrOptions, maybeOptions = undefined) { return this.publish(eventOrOperation, payloadOrOptions, { ...maybeOptions, fanout: true }); }

  async enqueue(eventOrOperation, payloadOrOptions, maybeOptions = undefined) {
    const { operation, options } = normalizeOperation(eventOrOperation, payloadOrOptions, maybeOptions);
    if (!this.queue?.add && !this.queue?.enqueue) throw Object.assign(new Error('Event queue is unavailable.'), { code: 'EVENT_QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE' });
    this.stats.enqueued++;
    const add = this.queue.add?.bind(this.queue) || this.queue.enqueue.bind(this.queue);
    return add(options.handler || 'dispatch', { eventName: operation.name, args: [operation.payload], context: operation.context || this.getContext(), operation }, options);
  }

  async record(eventOrOperation, payloadOrOptions, maybeOptions = undefined) {
    const { operation, options } = normalizeOperation(eventOrOperation, payloadOrOptions, maybeOptions);
    if (!this.eventStore?.append) throw Object.assign(new Error('Event store is unavailable.'), { code: 'EVENT_STORE_UNAVAILABLE' });
    const streamId = options.streamId || operation.streamId || operation.delivery?.partitionKey;
    if (!streamId) throw Object.assign(new Error('Event recording requires streamId or partitionBy().'), { code: 'EVENT_STREAM_ID_REQUIRED' });
    this.stats.recorded++;
    return this.eventStore.append(String(streamId), [{ id: operation.id || this.runtime.randomId('evt'), type: operation.name, eventName: operation.name, version: operation.version || 1, payload: operation.payload, context: operation.context || this.getContext(), createdAt: Date.now() }], { expectedVersion: options.expectedVersion, ...options });
  }

  request(eventOrOperation, payloadOrOptions, maybeOptions = undefined) { const { operation, options } = normalizeOperation(eventOrOperation, payloadOrOptions, maybeOptions); return this.requests.request(operation, options); }
  handleRequest(eventName, handler, options = {}) { return this.requests.handle(eventName, handler, options); }

  async inbound(input, context = {}) {
    this.stats.inbound++;
    const admission = await this.gateway.admit(input, { ...context, remote: context.remote !== false });
    if (!admission.accepted) { this.stats.rejected++; this.metrics.increment('inbound_rejected_total', 1, { code: admission.code }); this.flightRecorder.record('inbound:rejected', { code: admission.code, reason: admission.reason, force: true }); return admission; }
    const envelope = admission.envelope;
    return this.middleware.run('inbound', { fabric: this, eventName: envelope.name, envelope, admission, context }, async () => {
      const eventContext = this.createContext({ ...envelope.context, eventId: envelope.id, transport: context.transport?.id || context.transport || null, source: envelope.source });
      const dispatch = () => this.dispatcher.dispatchAsync ? this.dispatcher.dispatchAsync(envelope.name, envelope.content?.payload, envelope) : this.dispatcher.dispatch(envelope.name, envelope.content?.payload, envelope);
      const value = await this.run(eventContext, dispatch);
      this.metrics.increment('inbound_total', 1, { event: metricEvent(envelope.name), transport: context.transport?.id || context.transport || 'unknown' });
      this.flightRecorder.record('inbound:dispatched', { eventName: envelope.name, eventId: envelope.id, correlationId: envelope.context?.correlationId, transport: context.transport?.id || context.transport || null });
      return deepFreeze({ accepted: true, envelope, value, admission });
    });
  }

  setQueue(queue) { this.queue = queue; return this; }
  setOutbox(outbox) { this.outbox = outbox; return this; }
  setEventStore(store) { this.eventStore = store; return this; }
  outboxPublisherTransport() { return this.outboxTransport; }
  health() { return deepFreeze({ ok: this.state !== 'failed' && this.state !== 'closed', ready: this.state === 'started', state: this.state, profile: this.profile.name, runtime: this.runtime.snapshot(), uptimeMs: this.startedAt ? Date.now() - this.startedAt : 0, transports: this.transports.snapshot(), resources: this.resources.snapshot(), gateway: this.gateway.snapshot(), stats: { ...this.stats } }); }
  snapshot() { return deepFreeze({ ...this.health(), definitions: this.definitions.snapshot(), middleware: this.middleware.snapshot(), metrics: this.metrics.snapshot(), flightRecorder: this.flightRecorder.snapshot(), requests: this.requests.snapshot(), router: this.router.snapshot() }); }
  prometheus(prefix) { return this.metrics.prometheus(prefix); }

  async close(options = {}) {
    if (this.state === 'closed') return this.snapshot();
    this.state = 'closing';
    this.requests.close();
    for (const dispose of this.transportReceivers.values()) { try { await dispose?.(); } catch {} }
    this.transportReceivers.clear();
    await this.transports.close(options);
    this.resources.close();
    this.state = 'closed';
    this.flightRecorder.record('fabric:closed', { reason: options.reason || null, force: true });
    return this.snapshot();
  }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await this.close(); }
}

function normalizeOperation(eventOrOperation, payloadOrOptions, maybeOptions) {
  if (eventOrOperation && typeof eventOrOperation === 'object' && (eventOrOperation.name || eventOrOperation.eventName)) {
    const operation = { ...eventOrOperation, name: eventOrOperation.name || eventOrOperation.eventName, routing: { ...(eventOrOperation.routing || {}) }, delivery: { ...(eventOrOperation.delivery || {}) }, security: { ...(eventOrOperation.security || {}) }, metadata: { ...(eventOrOperation.metadata || {}) } };
    const options = payloadOrOptions && typeof payloadOrOptions === 'object' && !Array.isArray(payloadOrOptions) ? payloadOrOptions : maybeOptions || {};
    return { operation, options };
  }
  const payloadIsOptions = maybeOptions === undefined && payloadOrOptions && typeof payloadOrOptions === 'object' && !Array.isArray(payloadOrOptions) && ('via' in payloadOrOptions || 'durable' in payloadOrOptions || 'timeoutMs' in payloadOrOptions || 'fanout' in payloadOrOptions);
  return { operation: { name: String(eventOrOperation), payload: payloadIsOptions ? undefined : payloadOrOptions, version: maybeOptions?.version || 1, context: maybeOptions?.context || null, routing: {}, delivery: {}, security: {}, metadata: {} }, options: payloadIsOptions ? payloadOrOptions : maybeOptions || {} };
}
function metricEvent(name) { const value = String(name); return value.length > 96 ? `${value.slice(0, 92)}...` : value; }
export default UniversalEventFabric;

'use strict';

import { assertEventName, byteLength, cloneSafe, deepFreeze, stableStringify, toUint8Array } from '../support/safe.js';

export const UNIVERSAL_EVENT_PROTOCOL = 'rawnode.events';
export const UNIVERSAL_EVENT_PROTOCOL_VERSION = 3;

export class UniversalEventEnvelope {
  constructor(value) { Object.assign(this, value); deepFreeze(this); }

  static async create(operation = {}, options = {}) {
    const runtime = options.runtime;
    const now = Number(operation.occurredAt || runtime?.now?.() || Date.now());
    const eventName = assertEventName(operation.name || operation.eventName, options.limits || {});
    const eventId = String(operation.id || operation.eventId || runtime?.randomId?.('evt') || `evt_${now.toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`);
    const context = operation.context && typeof operation.context === 'object' ? operation.context : {};
    const source = operation.source && typeof operation.source === 'object' ? operation.source : {};
    const delivery = operation.delivery && typeof operation.delivery === 'object' ? operation.delivery : {};
    const routing = operation.routing && typeof operation.routing === 'object' ? operation.routing : {};
    const securityInput = operation.security && typeof operation.security === 'object' ? operation.security : {};
    const content = operation.content && typeof operation.content === 'object'
      ? operation.content
      : {
          codec: operation.codec || 'json',
          contentType: operation.contentType || 'application/json',
          schema: operation.schema || `${eventName}@${Math.max(1, Number(operation.version) || 1)}`,
          payload: operation.payload,
        };
    const value = {
      protocol: UNIVERSAL_EVENT_PROTOCOL,
      protocolVersion: UNIVERSAL_EVENT_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
      id: eventId,
      name: eventName,
      version: Math.max(1, Number(operation.version) || 1),
      occurredAt: now,
      emittedAt: Number(operation.emittedAt) || Number(runtime?.now?.() || Date.now()),
      expiresAt: operation.expiresAt == null ? (operation.ttlMs > 0 ? now + Number(operation.ttlMs) : null) : Number(operation.expiresAt),
      source: {
        application: source.application || options.application || null,
        runtime: source.runtime || runtime?.name || options.runtimeName || 'universal',
        runtimeId: source.runtimeId || runtime?.id || null,
        nodeId: source.nodeId || options.nodeId || null,
        processId: source.processId || options.processId || null,
        tabId: source.tabId || context.tabId || null,
        connectionId: source.connectionId || context.connectionId || null,
      },
      context: {
        contextId: context.id || context.contextId || null,
        correlationId: context.correlationId || context.id || eventId,
        causationId: context.causationId || null,
        traceId: context.traceId || null,
        spanId: context.spanId || null,
        requestId: context.requestId || null,
        tenantId: context.tenantId || null,
        actorId: context.actorId || null,
        baggage: context.baggage || null,
      },
      delivery: {
        mode: delivery.mode || operation.deliveryMode || 'best-effort',
        attempt: Math.max(1, Number(delivery.attempt) || 1),
        partitionKey: delivery.partitionKey ?? operation.partitionKey ?? null,
        sequence: delivery.sequence == null ? null : Number(delivery.sequence),
        idempotencyKey: delivery.idempotencyKey || operation.idempotencyKey || null,
        replyTo: delivery.replyTo || operation.replyTo || null,
        requestId: delivery.requestId || operation.requestId || null,
      },
      routing: {
        channel: routing.channel || operation.channel || null,
        audience: routing.audience || operation.audience || 'local',
        transports: Object.freeze(normalizeStrings(routing.transports || operation.transports || operation.via)),
        fallback: Object.freeze(normalizeStrings(routing.fallback || operation.fallback)),
        hops: Object.freeze(normalizeStrings(routing.hops || [])),
      },
      content: {
        codec: content.codec || 'json',
        contentType: content.contentType || 'application/json',
        schema: content.schema || `${eventName}@${Math.max(1, Number(operation.version) || 1)}`,
        payload: content.payload,
      },
      security: {
        classification: securityInput.classification || operation.classification || 'internal',
        authenticated: securityInput.authenticated === true,
        principal: securityInput.principal || null,
        keyId: securityInput.keyId || null,
        algorithm: securityInput.algorithm || null,
        signature: securityInput.signature || null,
        nonce: securityInput.nonce || runtime?.randomId?.('nonce') || null,
      },
      metadata: operation.metadata && typeof operation.metadata === 'object' ? cloneSafe(operation.metadata, { redact: true }) : null,
    };
    if (options.cryptoProvider && options.sign !== false) {
      // Resolve signing metadata first, then sign the final canonical form so
      // keyId and algorithm cannot be substituted without invalidating it.
      const provisional = await options.cryptoProvider.sign(
        toUint8Array(UniversalEventEnvelope.canonical(value)),
        {
          keyId: securityInput.keyId || options.keyId,
          purpose: 'event-envelope',
          envelope: value,
        },
      );
      if (provisional) {
        value.security = {
          ...value.security,
          keyId: provisional.keyId || value.security.keyId,
          algorithm: provisional.algorithm || value.security.algorithm,
          signature: null,
        };
        const signed = await options.cryptoProvider.sign(
          toUint8Array(UniversalEventEnvelope.canonical(value)),
          {
            keyId: value.security.keyId,
            algorithm: value.security.algorithm,
            purpose: 'event-envelope',
            envelope: value,
          },
        );
        value.security = {
          ...value.security,
          keyId: signed?.keyId || value.security.keyId,
          algorithm: signed?.algorithm || value.security.algorithm,
          signature: signed?.signature || signed || null,
        };
      }
    }
    const envelope = new UniversalEventEnvelope(value);
    const bytes = byteLength(JSON.stringify(envelope));
    if (options.limits?.maxEnvelopeBytes > 0 && bytes > options.limits.maxEnvelopeBytes) throw envelopeError(`Event envelope exceeds ${options.limits.maxEnvelopeBytes} bytes.`, 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_TOO_LARGE', { bytes, maximum: options.limits.maxEnvelopeBytes });
    return envelope;
  }

  static canonical(value) {
    const security = { ...(value.security || {}) };
    delete security.signature;
    return stableStringify({ ...value, security });
  }

  static normalize(input, options = {}) {
    const source = typeof input === 'string' ? JSON.parse(input) : input;
    if (!source || typeof source !== 'object') throw envelopeError('Event envelope must be an object.', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_INVALID');
    const protocolVersion = Math.max(1, Number(source.protocolVersion || source.v || source.version || 1));
    const accepted = options.acceptedVersions || [1, 2, 3];
    if (!accepted.includes(protocolVersion)) throw envelopeError(`Unsupported event protocol version ${protocolVersion}.`, 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED', { protocolVersion, accepted });
    if (protocolVersion === 3 && source.protocol === UNIVERSAL_EVENT_PROTOCOL) return new UniversalEventEnvelope(source);
    return new UniversalEventEnvelope(normalizeLegacy(source, protocolVersion, options));
  }

  static async verify(input, options = {}) {
    const envelope = input instanceof UniversalEventEnvelope ? input : UniversalEventEnvelope.normalize(input, options);
    const now = Number(options.now) || Date.now();
    if (envelope.expiresAt && envelope.expiresAt <= now - Math.max(0, Number(options.maxClockSkewMs) || 0)) throw envelopeError('Event envelope has expired.', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_EXPIRED');
    if ((envelope.routing?.hops?.length || 0) > Math.max(1, Number(options.maxHops) || 8)) throw envelopeError('Event envelope exceeded its hop limit.', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_HOP_LIMIT');
    if (options.namespace && envelope.routing?.namespace && options.namespace !== envelope.routing.namespace) throw envelopeError('Event envelope namespace mismatch.', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_NAMESPACE');
    const signature = envelope.security?.signature;
    if (!signature) {
      if (options.requireSignature === true) throw envelopeError('Event envelope signature is required.', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED');
      return { ok: true, signed: false, envelope };
    }
    if (!options.cryptoProvider) throw envelopeError('A crypto provider is required to verify the event envelope.', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_CRYPTO_REQUIRED');
    const ok = await options.cryptoProvider.verify(toUint8Array(UniversalEventEnvelope.canonical(envelope)), signature, {
      keyId: envelope.security?.keyId,
      algorithm: envelope.security?.algorithm,
      purpose: 'event-envelope',
      envelope,
    });
    if (!ok) throw envelopeError('Event envelope signature is invalid.', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_SIGNATURE_INVALID');
    return { ok: true, signed: true, envelope };
  }

  withHop(hop) {
    return new UniversalEventEnvelope({ ...this, routing: { ...this.routing, hops: Object.freeze([...this.routing.hops, String(hop)]) } });
  }

  toJSON() { return { ...this }; }
  encode() { return JSON.stringify(this); }
  byteLength() { return byteLength(this.encode()); }
}

function normalizeLegacy(source, protocolVersion, options) {
  const name = assertEventName(source.name || source.event || source.eventName || source.type, options.limits || {});
  const payload = source.content?.payload ?? source.payload ?? source.args?.[0] ?? source.data ?? null;
  const context = source.context || source.meta?.context || {};
  return {
    protocol: UNIVERSAL_EVENT_PROTOCOL,
    protocolVersion,
    id: String(source.id || source.messageId || source.eventId || `legacy_${Date.now().toString(36)}`),
    name,
    version: Math.max(1, Number(source.eventVersion || source.schemaVersion || 1)),
    occurredAt: Number(source.occurredAt || source.createdAt || source.timestamp) || Date.now(),
    emittedAt: Number(source.emittedAt || source.createdAt || source.timestamp) || Date.now(),
    expiresAt: source.expiresAt == null ? null : Number(source.expiresAt),
    source: { application: source.application || null, runtime: source.runtime || 'legacy', runtimeId: null, nodeId: source.nodeId || source.origin || null, processId: null, tabId: null, connectionId: source.connectionId || null },
    context: { contextId: context.id || null, correlationId: context.correlationId || source.correlationId || null, causationId: context.causationId || source.causationId || null, traceId: context.traceId || null, spanId: context.spanId || null, requestId: context.requestId || null, tenantId: context.tenantId || source.tenantId || null, actorId: context.actorId || source.actorId || null, baggage: context.baggage || null },
    delivery: { mode: source.delivery?.mode || 'best-effort', attempt: Number(source.attempt) || 1, partitionKey: source.partitionKey || null, sequence: source.sequence || null, idempotencyKey: source.idempotencyKey || null, replyTo: source.replyTo || null, requestId: source.requestId || null },
    routing: { channel: source.channel || null, audience: source.audience || 'internal', transports: Object.freeze(normalizeStrings(source.transports || [])), fallback: Object.freeze([]), hops: Object.freeze(normalizeStrings(source.hops || [])) },
    content: { codec: source.codec || 'json', contentType: source.contentType || 'application/json', schema: source.schema || `${name}@1`, payload },
    security: { classification: source.classification || 'internal', authenticated: source.authenticated === true, principal: source.principal || null, keyId: source.keyId || source.kid || null, algorithm: source.algorithm || source.alg || null, signature: source.signature || null, nonce: source.nonce || null },
    metadata: source.metadata || null,
  };
}
function normalizeStrings(value) { return [...new Set((Array.isArray(value) ? value : value == null ? [] : [value]).map(String).filter(Boolean))]; }

'use strict';

const BLOCKED = new Set(['__proto__', 'prototype', 'constructor']);
const REDACT = /^(?:password|passwd|secret|token|authorization|cookie|set-cookie|api[-_]?key|private[-_]?key|session)$/i;

export function isPlainObject(value) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
  const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  return prototype === Object.prototype || prototype === null;
}

export function deepMerge(base, ...sources) {
  const output = isPlainObject(base) ? { ...base } : {};
  for (const source of sources) {
    if (!isPlainObject(source)) continue;
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(source)) {
      if (BLOCKED.has(key)) continue;
      if (isPlainObject(value) && isPlainObject(output[key])) output[key] = deepMerge(output[key], value);
      else if (isPlainObject(value)) output[key] = deepMerge({}, value);
      else if (Array.isArray(value)) output[key] = value.slice();
      else if (value !== undefined) output[key] = value;
    }
  }
  return output;
}

export function deepFreeze(value, seen = new WeakSet()) {
  if (!value || (typeof value !== 'object' && typeof value !== 'function') || seen.has(value)) return value;
  seen.add(value);
  for (const key of Reflect.ownKeys(value)) {
    try { deepFreeze(value[key], seen); } catch {}
  }
  try { return Object.freeze(value); } catch { return value; }
}

export function byteLength(value) {
  if (value == null) return 0;
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    if (typeof TextEncoder === 'function') return new TextEncoder().encode(value).byteLength;
    if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined') return Buffer.byteLength(value);
    return value.length * 2;
  }
  if (value instanceof ArrayBuffer) return value.byteLength;
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) return value.byteLength;
  try { return byteLength(JSON.stringify(value)); } catch { return 0; }
}

export function stableObject(value, seen = new WeakMap(), path = '$') {
  if (value == null || typeof value !== 'object') {
    if (typeof value === 'bigint') return { __rnType: 'BigInt', value: String(value) };
    if (typeof value === 'number' && !Number.isFinite(value)) return { __rnType: 'Number', value: String(value) };
    return value;
  }
  if (seen.has(value)) return `[Circular:${seen.get(value)}]`;
  seen.set(value, path);
  if (value instanceof Date) return { __rnType: 'Date', value: Number.isFinite(value.getTime()) ? value.toISOString() : null };
  if (value instanceof Uint8Array) return { __rnType: 'Uint8Array', value: base64Encode(value) };
  if (value instanceof ArrayBuffer) return { __rnType: 'ArrayBuffer', value: base64Encode(new Uint8Array(value)) };
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((item, index) => stableObject(item, seen, `${path}[${index}]`));
  if (value instanceof Map) return { __rnType: 'Map', value: [...value].map(([key, item], index) => [stableObject(key, seen, `${path}.k${index}`), stableObject(item, seen, `${path}.v${index}`)]) };
  if (value instanceof Set) return { __rnType: 'Set', value: [...value].map((item, index) => stableObject(item, seen, `${path}.s${index}`)) };
  if (value instanceof Error) return { __rnType: 'Error', name: value.name, message: value.message, code: value.code, details: stableObject(value.details, seen, `${path}.details`) };
  const output = Object.create(null);
  for (const key of Object.keys(value).sort()) {
    if (BLOCKED.has(key)) continue;
    let child;
    try { child = value[key]; } catch { child = '[GetterError]'; }
    output[key] = stableObject(child, seen, `${path}.${key}`);
  }
  return output;
}

export function stableStringify(value) { return JSON.stringify(stableObject(value)); }

export function cloneSafe(value, options = {}) {
  const maxDepth = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxDepth) || 16);
  const maxKeys = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxKeys) || 10_000);
  const maxArrayItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxArrayItems) || 1_000);
  const maxStringBytes = Math.max(16, Number(options.maxStringBytes) || 64 * 1024);
  const redact = options.redact !== false;
  const extra = Array.isArray(options.redactKeys) ? options.redactKeys : [];
  const seen = new WeakMap();
  let keys = 0;
  const visit = (input, depth, path) => {
    if (input == null || typeof input === 'boolean' || typeof input === 'number') return input;
    if (typeof input === 'string') return truncateUtf8(input, maxStringBytes);
    if (typeof input === 'bigint') return String(input);
    if (typeof input === 'function') return `[Function:${input.name || 'anonymous'}]`;
    if (typeof input === 'symbol') return `[Symbol:${input.description || ''}]`;
    if (depth >= maxDepth) return '[MaxDepth]';
    if (seen.has(input)) return `[Circular:${seen.get(input)}]`;
    seen.set(input, path);
    if (input instanceof Date) return Number.isFinite(input.getTime()) ? input.toISOString() : null;
    if (input instanceof Error) return { name: input.name, message: truncateUtf8(input.message || '', maxStringBytes), code: input.code, details: visit(input.details, depth + 1, `${path}.details`) };
    if (input instanceof ArrayBuffer) return { type: 'ArrayBuffer', bytes: input.byteLength };
    if (ArrayBuffer.isView(input)) return { type: input.constructor?.name || 'TypedArray', bytes: input.byteLength };
    if (Array.isArray(input)) {
      const size = Math.min(input.length, maxArrayItems);
      const output = new Array(size);
      for (let index = 0; index < size; index++) output[index] = visit(input[index], depth + 1, `${path}[${index}]`);
      if (size < input.length) output.push(`[Truncated:${input.length - size}]`);
      return output;
    }
    const output = Object.create(null);
    for (const key of Object.keys(input)) {
      if (++keys > maxKeys) { output.__truncated = true; break; }
      if (BLOCKED.has(key)) continue;
      const sensitive = REDACT.test(key) || extra.some((rule) => typeof rule === 'string' ? rule === key : rule instanceof RegExp ? rule.test(key) : false);
      if (redact && sensitive) { output[key] = '[redacted]'; continue; }
      let child;
      try { child = input[key]; } catch { child = '[GetterError]'; }
      output[key] = visit(child, depth + 1, `${path}.${key}`);
    }
    return output;
  };
  return visit(value, 0, '$');
}

export function truncateUtf8(value, maxBytes) {
  const text = String(value ?? '');
  if (!maxBytes || byteLength(text) <= maxBytes) return text;
  if (typeof TextEncoder !== 'function' || typeof TextDecoder !== 'function') return `${text.slice(0, Math.max(0, Math.floor(maxBytes / 2) - 3))}...`;
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(text);
  return `${new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.subarray(0, Math.max(0, maxBytes - 3)))}...`;
}

export function randomId(prefix = 'evt') {
  const crypto = globalThis.crypto;
  if (typeof crypto?.randomUUID === 'function') return `${prefix}_${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
  if (typeof crypto?.getRandomValues === 'function') {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(16); crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
    return `${prefix}_${[...bytes].map((value) => value.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`;
  }
  return `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
}

export function base64Encode(bytes) {
  const value = bytes instanceof Uint8Array ? bytes : new Uint8Array(bytes || 0);
  if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined') return Buffer.from(value.buffer, value.byteOffset, value.byteLength).toString('base64');
  let binary = '';
  const chunk = 0x8000;
  for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index += chunk) binary += String.fromCharCode(...value.subarray(index, index + chunk));
  return globalThis.btoa(binary);
}

export function base64Decode(value) {
  if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined') return Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from(String(value || ''), 'base64'));
  const binary = globalThis.atob(String(value || ''));
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
  for (let index = 0; index < binary.length; index++) bytes[index] = binary.charCodeAt(index);
  return bytes;
}

export function toUint8Array(value) {
  if (value instanceof Uint8Array) return value;
  if (value instanceof ArrayBuffer) return new Uint8Array(value);
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) return new Uint8Array(value.buffer, value.byteOffset, value.byteLength);
  return new TextEncoder().encode(typeof value === 'string' ? value : stableStringify(value));
}

export function safeError(error) {
  return Object.freeze({
    name: error?.name || 'Error',
    message: String(error?.message || error || 'Unknown error'),
    code: error?.code || null,
    retryable: error?.retryable === true,
    delivery: error?.delivery || null,
  });
}

export function assertEventName(value, limits = {}) {
  const name = String(value || '').trim();
  if (!name) throw Object.assign(new TypeError('Event name is required.'), { code: 'EVENT_NAME_REQUIRED' });
  if (/\p{Cc}/u.test(name)) throw Object.assign(new TypeError('Event name contains control characters.'), { code: 'EVENT_NAME_CONTROL_CHARACTER' });
  const bytes = byteLength(name);
  if (limits.maxEventNameBytes > 0 && bytes > limits.maxEventNameBytes) {
    throw Object.assign(new RangeError(`Event name exceeds ${limits.maxEventNameBytes} bytes.`), { code: 'EVENT_NAME_TOO_LARGE', details: { bytes, maximum: limits.maxEventNameBytes } });
  }
  return name;
}

export function timeout(operation, milliseconds, options = {}) {
  const ms = Math.max(0, Number(milliseconds) || 0);
  if (!ms) return Promise.resolve(operation);
  let timer;
  return Promise.race([
    Promise.resolve(operation),
    new Promise((_, reject) => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => reject(Object.assign(new Error(options.message || `Event operation timed out after ${ms}ms.`), { name: 'EventTimeoutError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_TIMEOUT', timeoutMs: ms })), ms);
      timer?.unref?.();
    }),
  ]).finally(() => clearTimeout(timer));
}

export function linkAbortSignals(signals = []) {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const listeners = [];
  for (const signal of signals.filter(Boolean)) {
    if (signal.aborted) { controller.abort(signal.reason); break; }
    const listener = () => controller.abort(signal.reason);
    signal.addEventListener('abort', listener, { once: true });
    listeners.push([signal, listener]);
  }
  return {
    signal: controller.signal,
    abort: (reason) => controller.abort(reason),
    dispose() { for (const [signal, listener] of listeners) signal.removeEventListener('abort', listener); },
  };
}

'use strict';

export const EventDeliveryState = Object.freeze({
  NOT_ADMITTED: 'notAdmitted',
  QUEUED: 'queued',
  PERSISTED: 'persisted',
  WRITTEN: 'written',
  SENT: 'sent',
  ACKNOWLEDGED: 'acknowledged',
  REJECTED: 'rejected',
  FAILED: 'failed',
  OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: 'outcomeUnknown',
});

export class EventDeliveryResult {
  constructor(input = {}) {
    this.accepted = input.accepted !== false;
    this.state = input.state || (this.accepted ? EventDeliveryState.SENT : EventDeliveryState.NOT_ADMITTED);
    this.transport = input.transport || null;
    this.eventId = input.eventId || null;
    this.persisted = input.persisted === true;
    this.acknowledged = input.acknowledged === true;
    this.retryable = input.retryable === true;
    this.code = input.code || null;
    this.reason = input.reason || null;
    this.value = input.value;
    this.error = input.error || null;
    this.startedAt = input.startedAt || Date.now();
    this.finishedAt = input.finishedAt || Date.now();
    this.durationMs = Number(input.durationMs) || Math.max(0, this.finishedAt - this.startedAt);
    this.attempts = Math.max(1, Number(input.attempts) || 1);
    this.results = Array.isArray(input.results) ? input.results : null;
    Object.freeze(this);
  }

  static accepted(input = {}) { return new EventDeliveryResult({ ...input, accepted: true }); }
  static rejected(input = {}) { return new EventDeliveryResult({ ...input, accepted: false, state: input.state || EventDeliveryState.REJECTED }); }
  toJSON() { return { ...this }; }
}

export function deliveryError(message, result, options = {}) {
  const error = Object.assign(new Error(message), {
    name: 'EventDeliveryError',
    code: options.code || result?.code || 'EVENT_DELIVERY_FAILED',
    delivery: result?.state || EventDeliveryState.FAILED,
    retryable: result?.retryable === true,
    result,
    details: options.details || null,
  });
  if (options.cause) error.cause = options.cause;
  return error;
}

'use strict';

import { EventDefinition, defineEvent } from './EventDefinition.js';
import { deepFreeze } from '../support/safe.js';

export class EventDefinitionRegistry {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxDefinitions = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxDefinitions || options.maxEvents) || 10_000);
    this.maxVersionsPerEvent = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxVersionsPerEvent) || 100);
    this.definitions = new Map();
    this.latest = new Map();
    this.frozen = false;
    for (const definition of normalizeDefinitions(options.definitions || options.events || [])) this.register(definition);
  }

  register(input, options = {}) {
    if (this.frozen) throw error('Event definitions are frozen.', 'EVENT_DEFINITIONS_FROZEN');
    const definition = defineEvent(input);
    const versions = this.definitions.get(definition.name) || new Map();
    if (!versions.has(definition.version) && this.size >= this.maxDefinitions) throw error('Event definition limit exceeded.', 'EVENT_DEFINITION_LIMIT');
    if (!versions.has(definition.version) && versions.size >= this.maxVersionsPerEvent) throw error(`Event '${definition.name}' version limit exceeded.`, 'EVENT_DEFINITION_VERSION_LIMIT');
    if (versions.has(definition.version) && options.replace !== true) throw error(`Event definition already exists: ${definition.id}`, 'EVENT_DEFINITION_DUPLICATE');
    versions.set(definition.version, definition);
    this.definitions.set(definition.name, versions);
    const latest = this.latest.get(definition.name);
    if (!latest || definition.version >= latest.version) this.latest.set(definition.name, definition);
    return definition;
  }

  define(input, options) { return this.register(input, options); }
  has(name, version = null) { return version == null ? this.latest.has(String(name)) : this.definitions.get(String(name))?.has(Number(version)) === true; }
  get(name, version = null) { return version == null ? this.latest.get(String(name)) || null : this.definitions.get(String(name))?.get(Number(version)) || null; }
  require(name, version = null) { const value = this.get(name, version); if (!value) throw error(`Unknown event definition: ${name}${version == null ? '' : `@${version}`}`, 'EVENT_DEFINITION_UNKNOWN'); return value; }
  versions(name) { return [...(this.definitions.get(String(name))?.values() || [])].sort((a, b) => a.version - b.version); }
  all() { return [...this.definitions.values()].flatMap((versions) => [...versions.values()]).sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)); }
  get size() { let total = 0; for (const versions of this.definitions.values()) total += versions.size; return total; }
  freeze() { this.frozen = true; return this; }
  unfreeze() { this.frozen = false; return this; }

  async validate(name, version, payload, context = {}) {
    const definition = this.get(name, version);
    if (!definition) return { ok: false, unknown: true, errors: [{ path: '$', code: 'EVENT_DEFINITION_UNKNOWN', message: `Unknown event ${name}@${version || 1}` }] };
    const errors = [];
    if (definition.validator) {
      const result = await definition.validator(payload, { ...context, definition });
      if (result === false) errors.push({ path: '$', code: 'EVENT_VALIDATION_FAILED', message: 'Event validator returned false.' });
      else if (result?.ok === false) errors.push(...normalizeErrors(result.errors || result.error || result.message));
    } else if (definition.payload) validateSchema(payload, definition.payload, '$', errors);
    if (definition.context && context.eventContext) validateSchema(context.eventContext, definition.context, '$context', errors);
    return { ok: errors.length === 0, unknown: false, definition, errors };
  }

  async assert(name, version, payload, context = {}) {
    const result = await this.validate(name, version, payload, context);
    if (!result.ok) throw Object.assign(new TypeError(`Event contract validation failed for ${name}@${version || 1}.`), { name: 'EventContractError', code: result.unknown ? 'EVENT_DEFINITION_UNKNOWN' : 'EVENT_CONTRACT_INVALID', details: { errors: result.errors }, eventName: name });
    return result.definition;
  }

  upcast(name, fromVersion, payload, targetVersion = null, context = {}) {
    const target = targetVersion == null ? this.get(name)?.version : Number(targetVersion);
    if (!target) throw error(`Unknown event definition: ${name}`, 'EVENT_DEFINITION_UNKNOWN');
    let value = payload;
    let current = Math.max(1, Number(fromVersion) || 1);
    while (current < target) {
      const next = this.get(name, current + 1);
      if (!next) throw error(`Missing event definition ${name}@${current + 1}.`, 'EVENT_UPCAST_VERSION_MISSING');
      const upcaster = next.upcasters.find((entry) => Number(entry?.from || entry?.version || current) === current) || next.upcasters[0];
      if (typeof upcaster === 'function') value = upcaster(value, { ...context, name, fromVersion: current, toVersion: current + 1 });
      else if (typeof upcaster?.upcast === 'function') value = upcaster.upcast(value, { ...context, name, fromVersion: current, toVersion: current + 1 });
      else throw error(`Missing upcaster ${name}@${current}->${current + 1}.`, 'EVENT_UPCASTER_MISSING');
      current++;
    }
    return { payload: value, version: current };
  }

  manifest(options = {}) {
    return deepFreeze({
      schemaVersion: 1,
      generatedAt: options.generatedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
      definitions: this.all().map((definition) => definition.toJSON()),
      frozen: this.frozen,
      count: this.size,
    });
  }

  snapshot() { return deepFreeze({ frozen: this.frozen, size: this.size, events: [...this.latest.keys()].sort(), versions: Object.fromEntries([...this.definitions].map(([name, versions]) => [name, [...versions.keys()].sort((a, b) => a - b)])) }); }
}

function normalizeDefinitions(input) {
  if (Array.isArray(input)) return input;
  if (!input || typeof input !== 'object') return [];
  const output = [];
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(input)) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) for (const definition of value) output.push({ name, ...definition });
    else output.push({ name, ...(value || {}) });
  }
  return output;
}

function validateSchema(value, schema, path, errors) {
  if (typeof schema === 'function') { const result = schema(value); if (result === false) errors.push({ path, code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_FUNCTION', message: 'Schema predicate returned false.' }); return; }
  if (!schema || typeof schema !== 'object') return;
  if (schema.required === true && (value === undefined || value === null)) { errors.push({ path, code: 'EVENT_REQUIRED', message: `${path} is required.` }); return; }
  if (value == null) { if (Array.isArray(schema.required)) errors.push({ path, code: 'EVENT_REQUIRED', message: `${path} is required.` }); return; }
  const type = schema.type;
  if (type && !matchesType(value, type)) { errors.push({ path, code: 'EVENT_TYPE', message: `${path} must be ${type}.`, expected: type, actual: typeOf(value) }); return; }
  if (Array.isArray(schema.enum) && !schema.enum.some((candidate) => Object.is(candidate, value))) errors.push({ path, code: 'EVENT_ENUM', message: `${path} is not an accepted value.` });
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    if (schema.minLength != null && value.length < schema.minLength) errors.push({ path, code: 'EVENT_MIN_LENGTH', message: `${path} is too short.` });
    if (schema.maxLength != null && value.length > schema.maxLength) errors.push({ path, code: 'EVENT_MAX_LENGTH', message: `${path} is too long.` });
    if (schema.pattern && !(schema.pattern instanceof RegExp ? schema.pattern : new RegExp(schema.pattern)).test(value)) errors.push({ path, code: 'EVENT_PATTERN', message: `${path} does not match the required pattern.` });
  }
  if (typeof value === 'number') {
    if (schema.minimum != null && value < schema.minimum) errors.push({ path, code: 'EVENT_MINIMUM', message: `${path} is below the minimum.` });
    if (schema.maximum != null && value > schema.maximum) errors.push({ path, code: 'EVENT_MAXIMUM', message: `${path} exceeds the maximum.` });
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (schema.minItems != null && value.length < schema.minItems) errors.push({ path, code: 'EVENT_MIN_ITEMS', message: `${path} has too few items.` });
    if (schema.maxItems != null && value.length > schema.maxItems) errors.push({ path, code: 'EVENT_MAX_ITEMS', message: `${path} has too many items.` });
    if (schema.items) value.forEach((item, index) => validateSchema(item, schema.items, `${path}[${index}]`, errors));
  }
  if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
    for (const key of schema.required || []) if (!(key in value)) errors.push({ path: `${path}.${key}`, code: 'EVENT_REQUIRED', message: `${path}.${key} is required.` });
    for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(schema.properties || {})) if (key in value) validateSchema(value[key], child, `${path}.${key}`, errors);
    if (schema.additionalProperties === false) for (const key of Object.keys(value)) if (!(key in (schema.properties || {}))) errors.push({ path: `${path}.${key}`, code: 'EVENT_UNKNOWN_KEY', message: `${path}.${key} is not allowed.` });
  }
}

function matchesType(value, type) { const types = Array.isArray(type) ? type : [type]; return types.some((entry) => entry === 'array' ? Array.isArray(value) : entry === 'integer' ? Number.isInteger(value) : entry === 'null' ? value === null : entry === 'object' ? value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) : typeof value === entry); }
function typeOf(value) { return value === null ? 'null' : Array.isArray(value) ? 'array' : Number.isInteger(value) ? 'integer' : typeof value; }
function normalizeErrors(value) { if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((entry) => typeof entry === 'string' ? { path: '$', code: 'EVENT_VALIDATION_FAILED', message: entry } : entry); if (typeof value === 'string') return [{ path: '$', code: 'EVENT_VALIDATION_FAILED', message: value }]; return [{ path: '$', code: 'EVENT_VALIDATION_FAILED', message: 'Event validation failed.' }]; }
function error(message, code) { return Object.assign(new Error(message), { name: 'EventDefinitionError', code }); }

export default EventDefinitionRegistry;

'use strict';

import { assertEventName, deepFreeze, deepMerge } from '../support/safe.js';

const VISIBILITY = new Set(['local', 'public', 'private', 'presence', 'internal', 'system']);
const CLASSIFICATION = new Set(['public', 'internal', 'confidential', 'restricted']);
const DELIVERY = new Set(['best-effort', 'at-most-once', 'at-least-once', 'effectively-once']);
const ORDERING = new Set(['none', 'global', 'partition']);

export class EventDefinition {
  constructor(input = {}) {
    const name = assertEventName(input.name || input.eventName);
    const version = Math.max(1, Number(input.version) || 1);
    const visibility = String(input.visibility || 'local');
    const classification = String(input.classification || (visibility === 'public' ? 'public' : 'internal'));
    const delivery = String(input.delivery || (input.durable ? 'at-least-once' : 'best-effort'));
    const ordering = String(input.ordering || (input.partitionBy ? 'partition' : 'none'));
    if (!VISIBILITY.has(visibility)) throw new TypeError(`Unsupported event visibility '${visibility}'.`);
    if (!CLASSIFICATION.has(classification)) throw new TypeError(`Unsupported event classification '${classification}'.`);
    if (!DELIVERY.has(delivery)) throw new TypeError(`Unsupported event delivery '${delivery}'.`);
    if (!ORDERING.has(ordering)) throw new TypeError(`Unsupported event ordering '${ordering}'.`);
    this.kind = 'event-definition';
    this.name = name;
    this.version = version;
    this.id = `${name}@${version}`;
    this.owner = input.owner == null ? null : String(input.owner);
    this.description = input.description == null ? null : String(input.description);
    this.payload = input.payload || input.schema || null;
    this.context = input.context || null;
    this.visibility = visibility;
    this.classification = classification;
    this.transports = Object.freeze(normalizeStrings(input.transports));
    this.channels = Object.freeze(normalizeStrings(input.channels));
    this.durable = input.durable === true;
    this.replayable = input.replayable !== false;
    this.delivery = delivery;
    this.ordering = ordering;
    this.partitionBy = input.partitionBy || null;
    this.idempotency = input.idempotency === true || delivery === 'effectively-once';
    this.retention = input.retention || null;
    this.redact = Object.freeze(normalizeStrings(input.redact));
    this.deprecated = input.deprecated || false;
    this.sunsetAt = input.sunsetAt || null;
    this.security = deepFreeze(deepMerge({}, input.security || {}));
    this.metadata = deepFreeze(deepMerge({}, input.metadata || {}));
    this.validator = typeof input.validate === 'function' ? input.validate : typeof input.validator === 'function' ? input.validator : null;
    this.upcasters = Object.freeze(Array.isArray(input.upcasters) ? input.upcasters.slice() : []);
    this.downcasters = Object.freeze(Array.isArray(input.downcasters) ? input.downcasters.slice() : []);
    deepFreeze(this);
  }

  partition(payload, context = null) {
    if (typeof this.partitionBy === 'function') return this.partitionBy(payload, context);
    if (typeof this.partitionBy === 'string' && payload && typeof payload === 'object') return getPath(payload, this.partitionBy);
    return null;
  }

  toJSON() {
    const { validator, upcasters, downcasters, ...value } = this;
    return { ...value, payload: describeContract(this.payload), context: describeContract(this.context), upcasters: upcasters.length, downcasters: downcasters.length };
  }
}

function normalizeStrings(value) { return [...new Set((Array.isArray(value) ? value : value == null ? [] : [value]).map(String).map((entry) => entry.trim()).filter(Boolean))]; }
function getPath(value, path) { return String(path).split('.').reduce((current, key) => current?.[key], value); }
function describeContract(value) { if (!value) return null; if (typeof value === 'function') return { type: 'function', name: value.name || 'anonymous' }; if (typeof value?.describe === 'function') return value.describe(); return value; }

export function defineEvent(input) { return input instanceof EventDefinition ? input : new EventDefinition(input); }
export default EventDefinition;

'use strict';

import { EventConfigurationError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

const PROFILES = Object.freeze({
  compat: Object.freeze({
    listeners: { maxPerEvent: 5000, maxTotal: 0, maxPatterns: 5000, maxPerPattern: 5000, maxAny: 5000, planCacheMax: 1024 },
    history: { maxEntriesPerEvent: 0, maxEventNames: 0, maxEntriesTotal: 0, maxBytes: 0, maxPayloadBytes: 0, ttlMs: 0, clonePolicy: 'reference' },
    deferred: { maxItems: 0, maxBytes: 0, maxInFlight: 1, budgetMs: 4, maxPerSlice: 256, overflow: 'reject', awaitTasks: false },
    metrics: { enabled: false, maxSeries: 2048, slowMs: 0, prefix: 'rawnode_events' },
    context: { enabled: true },
    diagnostics: { enabled: false, historyLimit: 0, maxHistoryBytes: 0, publishChannel: true },
    contracts: { autoValidate: false },
    broadcasting: { enabled: false, auto: false, errorPolicy: 'isolate', defaultChannel: 'global' },
    security: {
      strictNames: false,
      maxEventNameBytes: 0,
      maxSegments: 0,
      maxPatternBytes: 0,
      maxDispatchPayloadBytes: 0,
      maxContextBytes: 0,
      blockControlChars: false,
      namespaceAllow: null,
      namespaceDeny: null,
    },
    dispatch: { errorPolicy: 'isolate' },
    lifecycle: { shutdownTimeoutMs: 0, forceOnTimeout: false },
  }),
  production: Object.freeze({
    listeners: { maxPerEvent: 5000, maxTotal: 100_000, maxPatterns: 10_000, maxPerPattern: 1000, maxAny: 1000, planCacheMax: 4096 },
    history: { maxEntriesPerEvent: 0, maxEventNames: 1024, maxEntriesTotal: 100_000, maxBytes: 64 * 1024 * 1024, maxPayloadBytes: 256 * 1024, ttlMs: 60 * 60 * 1000, clonePolicy: 'shallow' },
    deferred: { maxItems: 100_000, maxBytes: 64 * 1024 * 1024, maxInFlight: 32, budgetMs: 4, maxPerSlice: 256, overflow: 'drop-oldest', awaitTasks: false },
    metrics: { enabled: true, maxSeries: 2048, slowMs: 25, prefix: 'rawnode_events' },
    context: { enabled: true },
    diagnostics: { enabled: false, historyLimit: 256, maxHistoryBytes: 4 * 1024 * 1024, publishChannel: true },
    contracts: { autoValidate: false },
    broadcasting: { enabled: false, auto: false, errorPolicy: 'isolate', defaultChannel: 'global' },
    security: {
      strictNames: true,
      maxEventNameBytes: 512,
      maxSegments: 32,
      maxPatternBytes: 4096,
      maxDispatchPayloadBytes: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
      maxContextBytes: 64 * 1024,
      blockControlChars: true,
      namespaceAllow: null,
      namespaceDeny: null,
    },
    dispatch: { errorPolicy: 'isolate' },
    lifecycle: { shutdownTimeoutMs: 30_000, forceOnTimeout: true },
  }),
});

const ENUMS = Object.freeze({
  'history.clonePolicy': new Set(['reference', 'shallow', 'serialized']),
  'deferred.overflow': new Set(['reject', 'drop-newest', 'drop-oldest', 'coalesce']),
  'dispatch.errorPolicy': new Set(['isolate', 'collect', 'fail-fast']),
});

function object(value) { return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value : {}; }
function number(value, fallback, minimum = 0) {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= minimum ? parsed : fallback;
}
function merge(base, override) {
  const output = { ...base };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(object(override))) {
    output[key] = value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) && base[key] && typeof base[key] === 'object'
      ? merge(base[key], value)
      : value;
  }
  return output;
}
function deepFreeze(value) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Object.isFrozen(value)) return value;
  const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  if (!Array.isArray(value) && prototype !== Object.prototype && prototype !== null) return value;
  for (const item of Object.values(value)) deepFreeze(item);
  Object.freeze(value);
  return value;
}

export class EventConfiguration {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    const requestedProfile = String(options.profile || 'compat').toLowerCase();
    const profile = requestedProfile === 'enterprise' || requestedProfile === 'strict'
      ? 'production'
      : requestedProfile;
    if (!PROFILES[profile]) throw new EventConfigurationError(`Unknown events profile: ${profile}`);
    const selected = merge(PROFILES[profile], options);

    selected.profile = profile;
    selected.normalizeDot = options.normalizeDot === true;
    selected.logEvents = options.logEvents === true;
    selected.logger = options.logger || console;

    selected.listeners = merge(selected.listeners, object(options.listeners));
    selected.listeners.maxPerEvent = number(options.maxListenersPerEvent ?? selected.listeners.maxPerEvent, selected.listeners.maxPerEvent);
    selected.listeners.maxTotal = number(options.maxListenersTotal ?? selected.listeners.maxTotal, selected.listeners.maxTotal);
    selected.listeners.maxPatterns = number(options.maxPatternListeners ?? selected.listeners.maxPatterns, selected.listeners.maxPatterns);
    selected.listeners.maxPerPattern = number(options.maxListenersPerPattern ?? selected.listeners.maxPerPattern, selected.listeners.maxPerPattern);
    selected.listeners.maxAny = number(options.maxAnyListeners ?? selected.listeners.maxAny, selected.listeners.maxAny);
    selected.listeners.planCacheMax = number(options.planCacheMax ?? selected.listeners.planCacheMax, selected.listeners.planCacheMax);

    selected.history = merge(selected.history, object(options.history));
    selected.history.maxEntriesPerEvent = number(options.historyLimit ?? selected.history.maxEntriesPerEvent, selected.history.maxEntriesPerEvent);
    selected.history.maxEventNames = number(options.maxHistoryEvents ?? options.historyMaxEventNames ?? selected.history.maxEventNames, selected.history.maxEventNames);
    selected.history.maxEntriesTotal = number(options.maxHistoryEntries ?? selected.history.maxEntriesTotal, selected.history.maxEntriesTotal);
    selected.history.maxBytes = number(options.maxHistoryBytes ?? selected.history.maxBytes, selected.history.maxBytes);
    selected.history.maxPayloadBytes = number(options.maxHistoryPayloadBytes ?? selected.history.maxPayloadBytes, selected.history.maxPayloadBytes);
    selected.history.ttlMs = number(options.historyTtlMs ?? selected.history.ttlMs, selected.history.ttlMs);
    selected.history.allow = options.historyAllow ?? selected.history.allow ?? null;
    selected.history.deny = options.historyDeny ?? selected.history.deny ?? null;

    selected.metrics = merge(selected.metrics, object(options.metrics));
    if (options.metrics === true) selected.metrics.enabled = true;
    selected.metrics.enabled = selected.metrics.enabled === true;
    selected.metrics.slowMs = number(selected.metrics.slowMs, 0);
    selected.metrics.maxSeries = Math.max(1, number(selected.metrics.maxSeries, 2048, 1));

    selected.context = merge(selected.context, object(options.context));
    selected.diagnostics = merge(selected.diagnostics, object(options.diagnostics));
    selected.contracts = merge(selected.contracts, object(options.contracts));
    selected.broadcasting = merge(selected.broadcasting, object(options.broadcasting));
    selected.deferred = merge(selected.deferred, object(options.deferred));
    selected.security = merge(selected.security, object(options.security));
    selected.dispatch = merge(selected.dispatch, object(options.dispatch));
    selected.lifecycle = merge(selected.lifecycle, object(options.lifecycle));
    selected.lifecycle.shutdownTimeoutMs = number(options.shutdownTimeoutMs ?? selected.lifecycle.shutdownTimeoutMs, selected.lifecycle.shutdownTimeoutMs);
    selected.lifecycle.forceOnTimeout = options.forceOnShutdownTimeout ?? selected.lifecycle.forceOnTimeout;

    this._validate(selected);
    this.value = deepFreeze(selected);
  }

  _validate(value) {
    for (const [path, accepted] of Object.entries(ENUMS)) {
      const current = path.split('.').reduce((target, key) => target?.[key], value);
      if (!accepted.has(current)) throw new EventConfigurationError(`Invalid ${path}: ${current}`, { code: 'EVENT_CONFIGURATION_ENUM' });
    }
    for (const [name, current] of Object.entries(value.listeners)) {
      if (name.startsWith('max') || name.endsWith('Max')) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(Number(current)) || Number(current) < 0) throw new EventConfigurationError(`listeners.${name} must be non-negative`);
      }
    }
    if (value.history.maxEntriesPerEvent > 0 && value.history.maxEventNames === 0 && value.profile === 'production') {
      throw new EventConfigurationError('Production history requires a positive maxEventNames bound');
    }
  }

  get(path, fallback = undefined) {
    const value = String(path).split('.').reduce((target, key) => target?.[key], this.value);
    return value === undefined ? fallback : value;
  }

  toJSON() { return this.value; }
  static profiles() { return Object.keys(PROFILES); }
}

export default EventConfiguration;

'use strict';

'use strict';

import { compileMatcherList, matchesAny } from '../support/glob.js';
import { estimateValueBytes } from '../support/size.js';
import { EventAdmissionError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

const CONTROL = /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\u009f]/;

export class EventSecurityPolicy {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.strictNames = options.strictNames === true;
    this.maxEventNameBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxEventNameBytes) || 0);
    this.maxSegments = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxSegments) || 0);
    this.maxPatternBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxPatternBytes) || 0);
    this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxDispatchPayloadBytes) || 0);
    this.maxContextBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxContextBytes) || 0);
    this.blockControlChars = options.blockControlChars === true;
    this.allow = compileMatcherList(options.namespaceAllow || options.allow);
    this.deny = compileMatcherList(options.namespaceDeny || options.deny);
    this.nameValidationActive = this.strictNames || this.blockControlChars || this.maxEventNameBytes > 0 || this.maxSegments > 0 || this.allow.length > 0 || this.deny.length > 0;
    this.dispatchValidationActive = this.nameValidationActive || this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes > 0 || this.maxContextBytes > 0;
  }

  validateName(name, options = {}) {
    if (!this.nameValidationActive) return true;
    if (typeof name !== 'string' || !name) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Event name must be a non-empty string', { code: 'EVENT_NAME_INVALID' });
    }
    if (this.blockControlChars && CONTROL.test(name)) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Event name contains control characters', { code: 'EVENT_NAME_CONTROL_CHARS' });
    }
    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(name);
    const maximum = options.pattern ? this.maxPatternBytes || this.maxEventNameBytes : this.maxEventNameBytes;
    if (maximum && bytes > maximum) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event ${options.pattern ? 'pattern' : 'name'} exceeds ${maximum} bytes`, {
        code: options.pattern ? 'EVENT_PATTERN_MAX_BYTES' : 'EVENT_NAME_MAX_BYTES',
        details: { bytes, maximum },
      });
    }
    const segments = name.split(':').length;
    if (this.maxSegments && segments > this.maxSegments) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event name exceeds ${this.maxSegments} segments`, {
        code: 'EVENT_NAME_MAX_SEGMENTS',
        details: { segments, maximum: this.maxSegments },
      });
    }
    if (this.allow.length && !matchesAny(this.allow, name)) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event name is outside the allowed namespaces: ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_NAMESPACE_NOT_ALLOWED' });
    }
    if (this.deny.length && matchesAny(this.deny, name)) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event namespace is denied: ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_NAMESPACE_DENIED' });
    }
    return true;
  }

  validatePattern(pattern) {
    return this.validateName(pattern, { pattern: true });
  }

  validateDispatch(eventName, args, context = null, options = {}) {
    if (!this.dispatchValidationActive) return true;
    if (options.skipName !== true) this.validateName(eventName);
    if (this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes) {
      const bytes = estimateValueBytes(args, { maximum: this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes + 1 });
      if (bytes > this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes) {
        throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event payload exceeds ${this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes} bytes`, {
          code: 'EVENT_PAYLOAD_MAX_BYTES',
          details: { eventName, bytes, maximum: this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes },
        });
      }
    }
    if (this.maxContextBytes && context) {
      const bytes = estimateValueBytes(context, { maximum: this.maxContextBytes + 1 });
      if (bytes > this.maxContextBytes) {
        throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event context exceeds ${this.maxContextBytes} bytes`, {
          code: 'EVENT_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES',
          details: { eventName, bytes, maximum: this.maxContextBytes },
        });
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      maxEventNameBytes: this.maxEventNameBytes,
      strictNames: this.strictNames,
      maxSegments: this.maxSegments,
      maxPatternBytes: this.maxPatternBytes,
      maxDispatchPayloadBytes: this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes,
      maxContextBytes: this.maxContextBytes,
      blockControlChars: this.blockControlChars,
      allow: Object.freeze(this.allow.map((matcher) => matcher.raw)),
      deny: Object.freeze(this.deny.map((matcher) => matcher.raw)),
    });
  }
}

export default EventSecurityPolicy;

'use strict';

// src/events/Event.js

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

export class Event {
  constructor(payload = {}, options = {}) {
    this.payload = payload;
    this.timestamp = Number(options.timestamp) || Date.now();
    this.id = options.id || randomUUID();
    this.version = Math.max(1, Number(options.version) || Number(this.constructor.version) || 1);
    this.meta = options.meta && typeof options.meta === 'object' ? { ...options.meta } : {};
  }

  get eventName() {
    return this.constructor.eventName || this.constructor.name;
  }

  get occurredAt() { return new Date(this.timestamp); }
  get correlationId() { return this.meta.correlationId ?? this.ctx?.correlationId ?? null; }
  get causationId() { return this.meta.causationId ?? this.ctx?.causationId ?? null; }
  get tenantId() { return this.meta.tenantId ?? this.ctx?.tenantId ?? null; }

  withMeta(meta = {}) {
    if (meta && typeof meta === 'object') Object.assign(this.meta, meta);
    return this;
  }

  shouldBroadcast() { return false; }
  broadcastAs() { return this.constructor.name; }

  toJSON() {
    return {
      id: this.id,
      eventName: this.eventName,
      version: this.version,
      timestamp: this.timestamp,
      occurredAt: this.occurredAt.toISOString(),
      payload: this.payload,
      meta: { ...this.meta },
    };
  }
}

'use strict';

const TRANSITIONS = Object.freeze({
  idle: new Set(['disabled', 'starting', 'closed']),
  disabled: new Set(['starting', 'closed']),
  starting: new Set(['ready', 'failed', 'stopping']),
  ready: new Set(['degraded', 'stopping', 'failed']),
  degraded: new Set(['ready', 'stopping', 'failed']),
  failed: new Set(['starting', 'stopping', 'closed']),
  stopping: new Set(['stopped', 'failed']),
  stopped: new Set(['starting', 'closed']),
  closed: new Set(),
});

export class BridgeStateMachine {
  constructor() { this.state = 'idle'; this.changedAt = Date.now(); this.lastError = null; }

  transition(next, error = null) {
    if (next === this.state) return this.state;
    if (!TRANSITIONS[this.state]?.has(next)) throw new Error(`Invalid bridge state transition: ${this.state} -> ${next}`);
    this.state = next;
    this.changedAt = Date.now();
    if (error) this.lastError = error;
    return this.state;
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: this.state,
      changedAt: this.changedAt,
      lastError: this.lastError ? { name: this.lastError.name, message: this.lastError.message, code: this.lastError.code } : null,
    });
  }
}

export default BridgeStateMachine;

'use strict';
export { RedisEventBridge } from '../RedisEventBridge.js';
