'use strict';

import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

import { SafeJsonCodec } from '../serialization/SafeJsonCodec.js';
import { createEventEnvelope, validateEventEnvelope } from '../serialization/EventEnvelope.js';
import { EventTransportError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

function method(client, ...names) {
  for (const name of names) if (typeof client?.[name] === 'function') return client[name].bind(client);
  return null;
}

function sleep(ms, unref = false) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(resolve, Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0));
    if (unref) timer.unref?.();
  });
}

export class RedisStreamTransport extends EventEmitter {
  constructor(client, options = {}) {
    super();
    if (!client) throw new TypeError('Redis client is required');
    this.client = client;
    this.stream = options.stream || 'rawnode:events:durable';
    this.deadLetterStream = options.deadLetterStream || `${this.stream}:dead`;
    this.group = options.group || 'rawnode-events';
    this.consumer = options.consumer || `${process.pid}-${randomUUID()}`;
    this.nodeId = options.nodeId || this.consumer;
    this.namespace = options.namespace || 'default';
    this.maxLength = Math.max(100, Number(options.maxLength) || 100_000);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(1024, Number(options.maxBytes) || 1024 * 1024);
    this.maxAttempts = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxAttempts) || 5);
    this.blockMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.blockMs) || 5000);
    this.batchSize = Math.max(1, Number(options.batchSize) || 100);
    this.retryDelayMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.retryDelayMs) || 250);
    this.pollErrorDelayMs = Math.max(10, Number(options.pollErrorDelayMs) || 250);
    this.claimIdleMs = Math.max(1000, Number(options.claimIdleMs) || 30_000);
    this.claimCount = Math.max(1, Number(options.claimCount) || this.batchSize);
    this.secret = options.secret || null;
    this.acceptUnsignedV1 = options.acceptUnsignedV1 !== false;
    this.maxAgeMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxAgeMs) || 0);
    this.unrefTimers = options.unrefTimers === true;
    this.codec = options.codec || new SafeJsonCodec({ maxBytes: this.maxBytes });
    this.state = 'idle';
    this._controller = null;
    this._loopPromise = null;
    this._handler = null;
    this.stats = {
      published: 0,
      publishBytes: 0,
      read: 0,
      decoded: 0,
      handled: 0,
      acked: 0,
      retried: 0,
      claimed: 0,
      deadLettered: 0,
      expired: 0,
      invalid: 0,
      handlerErrors: 0,
      pollErrors: 0,
    };
  }

  async ensureGroup() {
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xgroup', 'xGroup');
    if (!fn) throw new EventTransportError('Redis client does not expose XGROUP', { code: 'EVENT_STREAM_XGROUP_MISSING' });
    try {
      await fn('CREATE', this.stream, this.group, '0', 'MKSTREAM');
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (/BUSYGROUP/i.test(error?.message || '')) return true;
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async publish(eventName, args = [], options = {}) {
    const envelope = createEventEnvelope(eventName, args, {
      ...options,
      nodeId: options.nodeId || this.nodeId,
      namespace: options.namespace || this.namespace,
      secret: options.secret || this.secret,
    });
    return this.publishEnvelope(envelope, options);
  }

  async publishEnvelope(envelope, options = {}) {
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xadd', 'xAdd');
    if (!fn) throw new EventTransportError('Redis client does not expose XADD', { code: 'EVENT_STREAM_XADD_MISSING' });
    const encoded = this.codec.encode(envelope, { maxBytes: this.maxBytes });
    const attempt = Math.max(0, Number(options.attempt) || 0);
    const availableAt = Math.max(0, Number(options.availableAt) || 0);
    const id = await fn(
      this.stream, 'MAXLEN', '~', this.maxLength, '*',
      'id', String(envelope.id || randomUUID()),
      'envelope', encoded.text,
      'attempt', String(attempt),
      'createdAt', String(envelope.ts || Date.now()),
      'availableAt', String(availableAt),
    );
    this.stats.published++;
    this.stats.publishBytes += encoded.bytes;
    return { id, envelopeId: envelope.id, persisted: true, stream: this.stream, attempt };
  }

  async read(options = {}) {
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xreadgroup', 'xReadGroup');
    if (!fn) throw new EventTransportError('Redis client does not expose XREADGROUP', { code: 'EVENT_STREAM_XREADGROUP_MISSING' });
    const result = await fn(
      'GROUP', this.group, this.consumer,
      'COUNT', options.count || this.batchSize,
      'BLOCK', options.blockMs ?? this.blockMs,
      'STREAMS', this.stream, options.id || '>',
    );
    const messages = this._normalize(result);
    this.stats.read += messages.length;
    return messages;
  }

  decode(message, options = {}) {
    try {
      const raw = message?.fields?.envelope || message?.fields?.payload || '';
      if (Buffer.byteLength(String(raw)) > this.maxBytes) {
        this.stats.invalid++;
        return { ok: false, reason: 'maxBytes', code: 'EVENT_STREAM_MAX_BYTES', message };
      }
      const envelope = this.codec.parse(raw);
      const validation = validateEventEnvelope(envelope, {
        namespace: options.namespace || this.namespace,
        secret: options.secret || this.secret,
        acceptUnsignedV1: options.acceptUnsignedV1 ?? this.acceptUnsignedV1,
        maxAgeMs: options.maxAgeMs ?? this.maxAgeMs,
      });
      if (!validation.ok) {
        if (validation.code === 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_EXPIRED') this.stats.expired++;
        else this.stats.invalid++;
        return { ...validation, message };
      }
      this.stats.decoded++;
      return { ok: true, envelope: validation.envelope, message };
    } catch (error) {
      this.stats.invalid++;
      return { ok: false, error, reason: error.message, message };
    }
  }

  async ack(...ids) {
    const values = ids.flat().filter(Boolean);
    if (!values.length) return 0;
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xack', 'xAck');
    if (!fn) return 0;
    const count = Number(await fn(this.stream, this.group, ...values)) || 0;
    this.stats.acked += count;
    return count;
  }

  async fail(message, error, options = {}) {
    const attempt = Number(message?.fields?.attempt || 0) + 1;
    if (attempt >= this.maxAttempts || options.deadLetter === true) {
      await this.deadLetter(message, error);
      await this.ack(message.id);
      return { deadLettered: true, attempt };
    }

    let envelope;
    try { envelope = this.codec.parse(message?.fields?.envelope || ''); }
    catch { envelope = null; }
    if (!envelope) {
      await this.deadLetter(message, error);
      await this.ack(message.id);
      return { deadLettered: true, attempt, invalid: true };
    }

    if (this.retryDelayMs > 0) await sleep(this.retryDelayMs, this.unrefTimers);
    const published = await this.publishEnvelope(envelope, { attempt });
    await this.ack(message.id);
    this.stats.retried++;
    return { retry: true, attempt, published };
  }

  async deadLetter(message, error) {
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xadd', 'xAdd');
    if (!fn) throw new EventTransportError('Redis client does not expose XADD', { code: 'EVENT_STREAM_XADD_MISSING' });
    await fn(
      this.deadLetterStream, 'MAXLEN', '~', this.maxLength, '*',
      'sourceId', String(message?.id || ''),
      'envelope', String(message?.fields?.envelope || ''),
      'attempt', String(message?.fields?.attempt || '0'),
      'error', String(error?.stack || error?.message || error || ''),
      'failedAt', String(Date.now()),
    );
    this.stats.deadLettered++;
    return true;
  }

  async recoverPending(options = {}) {
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xautoclaim', 'xAutoClaim');
    if (!fn) return [];
    const result = await fn(
      this.stream,
      this.group,
      this.consumer,
      options.minIdleMs || this.claimIdleMs,
      options.start || '0-0',
      'COUNT', options.count || this.claimCount,
    );
    // Redis variants return [nextId, entries, deletedIds] or an object.
    const entries = Array.isArray(result) ? result[1] : result?.messages || result?.entries || [];
    const normalized = this._normalize([[this.stream, entries]]);
    this.stats.claimed += normalized.length;
    return normalized;
  }

  async consumeOnce(handler = this._handler, options = {}) {
    if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new TypeError('RedisStreamTransport.consumeOnce expects a handler function');
    const recovered = options.recover === false ? [] : await this.recoverPending(options).catch(() => []);
    const messages = recovered.length ? recovered : await this.read(options);
    const results = [];
    for (const message of messages) {
      const availableAt = Number(message.fields.availableAt || 0);
      if (availableAt > Date.now()) {
        results.push({ message, deferred: true });
        continue;
      }
      const decoded = this.decode(message, options);
      if (!decoded.ok) {
        await this.deadLetter(message, decoded.error || new Error(decoded.reason || 'Invalid event envelope'));
        await this.ack(message.id);
        results.push({ message, ok: false, invalid: true, reason: decoded.reason });
        continue;
      }
      try {
        const value = await handler(decoded.envelope, message, this);
        await this.ack(message.id);
        this.stats.handled++;
        results.push({ message, envelope: decoded.envelope, ok: true, value });
      } catch (error) {
        this.stats.handlerErrors++;
        const retry = await this.fail(message, error);
        results.push({ message, envelope: decoded.envelope, ok: false, error, ...retry });
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  async start(handler, options = {}) {
    if (this.state === 'running') return this;
    if (this.state === 'closed') throw new EventTransportError('Redis stream transport is closed', { code: 'EVENT_STREAM_CLOSED' });
    if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new TypeError('RedisStreamTransport.start expects a handler function');
    this._handler = handler;
    await this.ensureGroup();
    this.state = 'running';
    this._controller = new AbortController();
    this._loopPromise = this._consumeLoop(options).finally(() => {
      if (this.state !== 'closed') this.state = 'stopped';
      this._loopPromise = null;
    });
    this.emit('started', this.snapshot());
    return this;
  }

  async _consumeLoop(options) {
    while (!this._controller.signal.aborted) {
      try {
        const results = await this.consumeOnce(this._handler, options);
        if (results.length) this.emit('batch', results);
      } catch (error) {
        if (this._controller.signal.aborted) break;
        this.stats.pollErrors++;
        if (this.listenerCount('error')) this.emit('error', error);
        else this.emit('transportError', error);
        await sleep(this.pollErrorDelayMs, this.unrefTimers);
      }
    }
  }

  async stop() {
    if (!this._loopPromise) {
      if (this.state !== 'closed') this.state = 'stopped';
      return this.snapshot();
    }
    this.state = 'stopping';
    this._controller?.abort();
    await this._loopPromise;
    this.state = 'stopped';
    this.emit('stopped', this.snapshot());
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  async close() {
    if (this.state === 'closed') return this.snapshot();
    await this.stop();
    this.state = 'closed';
    this.removeAllListeners();
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  _normalize(result) {
    if (!Array.isArray(result)) return [];
    const output = [];
    for (const stream of result) {
      const entries = Array.isArray(stream) ? stream[1] : stream?.messages || [];
      for (const entry of entries || []) {
        const id = Array.isArray(entry) ? entry[0] : entry.id;
        const raw = Array.isArray(entry) ? entry[1] : entry.message || entry.fields;
        const fields = {};
        if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
          for (let index = 0; index < raw.length; index += 2) fields[String(raw[index])] = raw[index + 1];
        } else Object.assign(fields, raw || {});
        output.push({ id, fields });
      }
    }
    return output;
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: this.state,
      stream: this.stream,
      deadLetterStream: this.deadLetterStream,
      group: this.group,
      consumer: this.consumer,
      namespace: this.namespace,
      limits: Object.freeze({ maxLength: this.maxLength, maxBytes: this.maxBytes, maxAttempts: this.maxAttempts }),
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }

  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await this.close(); }
}

export default RedisStreamTransport;

'use strict';

export class PublishQueue {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 10_000);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxBytes) || 16 * 1024 * 1024);
    this.overflow = options.overflow || 'drop-oldest';
    this.items = [];
    this.head = 0;
    this.bytes = 0;
    this.stats = { accepted: 0, rejected: 0, dropped: 0, highWaterItems: 0, highWaterBytes: 0 };
  }

  get length() { return this.items.length - this.head; }

  push(item) {
    if (item.bytes > this.maxBytes) { this.stats.rejected++; return { accepted: false, reason: 'item-too-large' }; }
    while (this.length >= this.maxItems || this.bytes + item.bytes > this.maxBytes) {
      if (this.overflow === 'drop-oldest') {
        const dropped = this.shift();
        if (!dropped) break;
        this.stats.dropped++;
        dropped.onDrop?.('overflow');
      } else {
        if (this.overflow === 'drop-newest') this.stats.dropped++;
        else this.stats.rejected++;
        return { accepted: false, reason: this.overflow === 'drop-newest' ? 'drop-newest' : 'capacity' };
      }
    }
    this.items.push(item);
    this.bytes += item.bytes;
    this.stats.accepted++;
    this.stats.highWaterItems = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterItems, this.length);
    this.stats.highWaterBytes = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterBytes, this.bytes);
    return { accepted: true };
  }

  unshift(item) {
    if (item.bytes > this.maxBytes) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      item.onDrop?.('item-too-large');
      return { accepted: false, reason: 'item-too-large' };
    }
    while (this.length >= this.maxItems || this.bytes + item.bytes > this.maxBytes) {
      const dropped = this.shift();
      if (!dropped) break;
      this.stats.dropped++;
      dropped.onDrop?.('overflow');
    }
    if (this.length >= this.maxItems || this.bytes + item.bytes > this.maxBytes) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      item.onDrop?.('capacity');
      return { accepted: false, reason: 'capacity' };
    }
    const remaining = this.items.slice(this.head);
    this.items = [item, ...remaining];
    this.head = 0;
    this.bytes += item.bytes;
    this.stats.accepted++;
    this.stats.highWaterItems = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterItems, this.length);
    this.stats.highWaterBytes = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterBytes, this.bytes);
    return { accepted: true };
  }

  shift() {
    while (this.head < this.items.length) {
      const item = this.items[this.head++];
      if (!item) continue;
      this.bytes = Math.max(0, this.bytes - item.bytes);
      if (this.head > 4096 && this.head > this.items.length / 2) {
        this.items = this.items.slice(this.head);
        this.head = 0;
      }
      return item;
    }
    this.items.length = 0;
    this.head = 0;
    return null;
  }

  clear(reason = 'cleared') {
    let count = 0;
    while (this.length) {
      const item = this.shift();
      if (!item) break;
      count++;
      item.onDrop?.(reason);
    }
    return count;
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      items: this.length,
      bytes: this.bytes,
      maxItems: this.maxItems,
      maxBytes: this.maxBytes,
      overflow: this.overflow,
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }
}

export default PublishQueue;

'use strict';

export class SeenMessageWindow {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems ?? options.limit) || 50_000);
    this.ttlMs = Math.max(1, Number(options.ttlMs) || 60_000);
    this.map = new Map();
    this.queue = [];
    this.head = 0;
    this.stats = { remembered: 0, duplicate: 0, expired: 0, evicted: 0 };
  }

  has(id, now = Date.now()) {
    const expiresAt = this.map.get(id);
    if (expiresAt == null) return false;
    if (expiresAt <= now) {
      this.map.delete(id);
      this.stats.expired++;
      return false;
    }
    this.stats.duplicate++;
    return true;
  }

  remember(id, now = Date.now()) {
    const expiresAt = now + this.ttlMs;
    this.map.set(id, expiresAt);
    this.queue.push({ id, expiresAt });
    this.stats.remembered++;
    this.prune(now);
    while (this.map.size > this.maxItems) {
      const marker = this.queue[this.head++];
      if (!marker) break;
      if (this.map.get(marker.id) === marker.expiresAt) {
        this.map.delete(marker.id);
        this.stats.evicted++;
      }
    }
    this._compact();
    return this;
  }

  prune(now = Date.now(), budget = 1024) {
    let checked = 0;
    while (this.head < this.queue.length && checked++ < budget) {
      const marker = this.queue[this.head];
      const current = this.map.get(marker.id);
      if (current !== marker.expiresAt) { this.head++; continue; }
      if (marker.expiresAt > now) break;
      this.head++;
      this.map.delete(marker.id);
      this.stats.expired++;
    }
    this._compact();
  }

  _compact() {
    if (this.head > 4096 && this.head > this.queue.length / 2) {
      this.queue = this.queue.slice(this.head);
      this.head = 0;
    }
  }

  clear() { this.map.clear(); this.queue.length = 0; this.head = 0; }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ size: this.map.size, maxItems: this.maxItems, ttlMs: this.ttlMs, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
}

export default SeenMessageWindow;

'use strict';

import { EventConfigurationError, EventAdmissionError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

function positiveVersion(value) {
  const version = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(version) || version < 1) throw new TypeError('Event schema version must be a positive safe integer');
  return version;
}

function normalizeDefinition(definition = {}) {
  if (typeof definition === 'function') return { validate: definition };
  if (!definition || typeof definition !== 'object') throw new TypeError('Event schema definition must be an object or validator function');
  return { ...definition };
}

/** Versioned contracts, validators, and sequential upcasters for persisted events. */
export class EventSchemaRegistry {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.events = new Map();
    this.maxEvents = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxEvents) || 10_000);
    this.maxVersionsPerEvent = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxVersionsPerEvent) || 100);
    this.frozen = false;
  }

  register(eventName, version, definition = {}, options = {}) {
    if (this.frozen) throw new EventConfigurationError('Event schema registry is frozen', { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_REGISTRY_FROZEN' });
    const name = String(eventName || '').trim();
    if (!name) throw new TypeError('Event schema name is required');
    const normalizedVersion = positiveVersion(version);
    if (!this.events.has(name) && this.events.size >= this.maxEvents) {
      throw new EventConfigurationError('Event schema registry event limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_EVENT_LIMIT' });
    }
    let versions = this.events.get(name);
    if (!versions) this.events.set(name, versions = new Map());
    if (!versions.has(normalizedVersion) && versions.size >= this.maxVersionsPerEvent) {
      throw new EventConfigurationError(`Version limit exceeded for ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_VERSION_LIMIT' });
    }
    if (versions.has(normalizedVersion) && options.replace !== true) {
      throw new EventConfigurationError(`Event schema already registered: ${name}@${normalizedVersion}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_DUPLICATE' });
    }
    const record = normalizeDefinition(definition);
    versions.set(normalizedVersion, Object.freeze({
      eventName: name,
      version: normalizedVersion,
      validate: typeof record.validate === 'function' ? record.validate : null,
      upcast: typeof record.upcast === 'function' ? record.upcast : null,
      downcast: typeof record.downcast === 'function' ? record.downcast : null,
      schema: record.schema ?? null,
      deprecated: record.deprecated === true,
      description: record.description ? String(record.description) : '',
      meta: record.meta && typeof record.meta === 'object' ? Object.freeze({ ...record.meta }) : null,
    }));
    return this;
  }

  define(eventName, version = 1) {
    const definition = { validate: null, upcast: null, downcast: null, schema: null, deprecated: false, description: '', meta: null };
    const builder = {
      validate: (fn) => { definition.validate = fn; return builder; },
      upcast: (fn) => { definition.upcast = fn; return builder; },
      downcast: (fn) => { definition.downcast = fn; return builder; },
      schema: (value) => { definition.schema = value; return builder; },
      deprecated: (value = true) => { definition.deprecated = value !== false; return builder; },
      describe: (value) => { definition.description = String(value); return builder; },
      meta: (value) => { definition.meta = value; return builder; },
      register: (options) => { this.register(eventName, version, definition, options); return this; },
    };
    return builder;
  }

  has(eventName, version = null) {
    const versions = this.events.get(String(eventName));
    return version == null ? !!versions?.size : versions?.has(Number(version)) === true;
  }

  get(eventName, version = null) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    const versions = this.events.get(name);
    if (!versions?.size) return null;
    const selected = version == null ? this.latestVersion(name) : positiveVersion(version);
    return versions.get(selected) || null;
  }

  latestVersion(eventName) {
    const versions = this.events.get(String(eventName));
    if (!versions?.size) return null;
    let latest = 0;
    for (const version of versions.keys()) latest = Math.max(latest, version);
    return latest;
  }

  validate(eventName, version, payload, context = {}) {
    const contract = this.get(eventName, version);
    if (!contract) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Unknown event contract: ${eventName}@${version}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN', eventName });
    if (!contract.validate) return { ok: true, payload };
    let result;
    try { result = contract.validate(payload, { eventName: String(eventName), version: contract.version, ...context }); }
    catch (cause) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event contract validation failed: ${eventName}@${version}`, {
        code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION', eventName, cause,
      });
    }
    if (result && typeof result.then === 'function') {
      throw new EventConfigurationError('Async event validator used through validate(); call validateAsync()', { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_ASYNC_VALIDATOR' });
    }
    if (result === false || result?.ok === false) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(result?.message || `Event payload rejected by ${eventName}@${version}`, {
        code: result?.code || 'EVENT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION', eventName, details: result?.details,
      });
    }
    return { ok: true, payload: result?.payload ?? payload, contract };
  }

  async validateAsync(eventName, version, payload, context = {}) {
    const contract = this.get(eventName, version);
    if (!contract) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Unknown event contract: ${eventName}@${version}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN', eventName });
    if (!contract.validate) return { ok: true, payload, contract };
    let result;
    try { result = await contract.validate(payload, { eventName: String(eventName), version: contract.version, ...context }); }
    catch (cause) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event contract validation failed: ${eventName}@${version}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION', eventName, cause });
    }
    if (result === false || result?.ok === false) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(result?.message || `Event payload rejected by ${eventName}@${version}`, {
        code: result?.code || 'EVENT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION', eventName, details: result?.details,
      });
    }
    return { ok: true, payload: result?.payload ?? payload, contract };
  }

  upcast(eventName, fromVersion, payload, targetVersion = null, context = {}) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    let version = positiveVersion(fromVersion);
    const target = targetVersion == null ? this.latestVersion(name) : positiveVersion(targetVersion);
    if (!target) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Unknown event contract: ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN', eventName: name });
    if (target < version) return this.downcast(name, version, payload, target, context);
    let value = payload;
    while (version < target) {
      const contract = this.get(name, version);
      if (!contract?.upcast) {
        throw new EventAdmissionError(`Missing upcaster for ${name}@${version} -> ${version + 1}`, {
          code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_UPCASTER_MISSING', eventName: name,
        });
      }
      value = contract.upcast(value, { eventName: name, fromVersion: version, toVersion: version + 1, ...context });
      if (value && typeof value.then === 'function') {
        throw new EventConfigurationError('Async upcaster used through upcast(); call upcastAsync()', { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_ASYNC_UPCASTER' });
      }
      version++;
    }
    return { eventName: name, version, payload: value };
  }

  async upcastAsync(eventName, fromVersion, payload, targetVersion = null, context = {}) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    let version = positiveVersion(fromVersion);
    const target = targetVersion == null ? this.latestVersion(name) : positiveVersion(targetVersion);
    if (!target) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Unknown event contract: ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN', eventName: name });
    let value = payload;
    while (version < target) {
      const contract = this.get(name, version);
      if (!contract?.upcast) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Missing upcaster for ${name}@${version}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_UPCASTER_MISSING', eventName: name });
      value = await contract.upcast(value, { eventName: name, fromVersion: version, toVersion: version + 1, ...context });
      version++;
    }
    return { eventName: name, version, payload: value };
  }

  downcast(eventName, fromVersion, payload, targetVersion, context = {}) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    let version = positiveVersion(fromVersion);
    const target = positiveVersion(targetVersion);
    let value = payload;
    while (version > target) {
      const contract = this.get(name, version);
      if (!contract?.downcast) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Missing downcaster for ${name}@${version}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_DOWNCASTER_MISSING', eventName: name });
      value = contract.downcast(value, { eventName: name, fromVersion: version, toVersion: version - 1, ...context });
      version--;
    }
    return { eventName: name, version, payload: value };
  }

  freeze() { this.frozen = true; return this; }
  unfreeze() { this.frozen = false; return this; }
  eventNames() { return Array.from(this.events.keys()).sort(); }
  manifest() {
    return this.eventNames().flatMap((eventName) => Array.from(this.events.get(eventName).values())
      .sort((a, b) => a.version - b.version)
      .map((record) => ({ ...record, validate: !!record.validate, upcast: !!record.upcast, downcast: !!record.downcast })));
  }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ frozen: this.frozen, events: this.events.size, contracts: this.manifest().length }); }
}

export default EventSchemaRegistry;

'use strict';

import { EventConfigurationError, EventTransportError } from '../errors/EventError.js';
import { SafeJsonCodec } from './SafeJsonCodec.js';

export class EventCodecRegistry {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.codecs = new Map();
    this.defaultName = String(options.default || 'json');
    this.maxCodecs = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxCodecs) || 1000);
    this.frozen = false;
    this.register('json', options.jsonCodec || new SafeJsonCodec(options.json || {}));
    for (const [name, codec] of Object.entries(options.codecs || {})) this.register(name, codec, { replace: true });
  }

  register(name, codec, options = {}) {
    if (this.frozen) throw new EventConfigurationError('Event codec registry is frozen', { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_REGISTRY_FROZEN' });
    const key = String(name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!key) throw new TypeError('Codec name is required');
    if (!codec || typeof codec.encode !== 'function' || typeof codec.parse !== 'function') {
      throw new TypeError('Event codec must expose encode() and parse()');
    }
    if (this.codecs.has(key) && options.replace !== true) {
      throw new EventConfigurationError(`Event codec already exists: ${key}`, { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_DUPLICATE' });
    }
    if (!this.codecs.has(key) && this.codecs.size >= this.maxCodecs) {
      throw new EventConfigurationError('Event codec registry limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_LIMIT' });
    }
    this.codecs.set(key, codec);
    return this;
  }

  unregister(name) {
    if (this.frozen) throw new EventConfigurationError('Event codec registry is frozen', { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_REGISTRY_FROZEN' });
    const key = String(name).toLowerCase();
    if (key === this.defaultName) throw new EventConfigurationError('Cannot remove the active default event codec');
    return this.codecs.delete(key);
  }

  has(name) { return this.codecs.has(String(name).toLowerCase()); }

  get(name = this.defaultName) {
    const key = String(name || this.defaultName).toLowerCase();
    const codec = this.codecs.get(key);
    if (!codec) throw new EventTransportError(`Unknown event codec: ${key}`, { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_UNKNOWN' });
    return codec;
  }

  use(name) { this.get(name); this.defaultName = String(name).toLowerCase(); return this; }
  encode(value, options = {}, name = this.defaultName) { return this.get(name).encode(value, options); }
  parse(value, options = {}, name = this.defaultName) { return this.get(name).parse(value, options); }
  freeze() { this.frozen = true; return this; }
  unfreeze() { this.frozen = false; return this; }
  names() { return Array.from(this.codecs.keys()); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ default: this.defaultName, frozen: this.frozen, codecs: Object.freeze(this.names()), limits: Object.freeze({ maxCodecs: this.maxCodecs }) }); }
}

export default EventCodecRegistry;

'use strict';

import { EventTransportError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

const DEFAULT_REDACT = /^(?:password|passwd|secret|token|authorization|cookie|set-cookie|api[-_]?key|private[-_]?key)$/i;
const TYPED_ARRAYS = Object.freeze({
  Uint8Array,
  Uint8ClampedArray,
  Int8Array,
  Uint16Array,
  Int16Array,
  Uint32Array,
  Int32Array,
  Float32Array,
  Float64Array,
  BigInt64Array: globalThis.BigInt64Array,
  BigUint64Array: globalThis.BigUint64Array,
});

function safeSet(target, key, value) {
  if (key === '__proto__' || key === 'constructor' || key === 'prototype') {
    Object.defineProperty(target, key, { value, enumerable: true, configurable: true, writable: true });
  } else target[key] = value;
}

function truncateUtf8(value, maxBytes) {
  if (!maxBytes || Buffer.byteLength(value) <= maxBytes) return value;
  const buffer = Buffer.from(value);
  return `${buffer.subarray(0, Math.max(0, maxBytes - 3)).toString('utf8')}...`;
}

function shouldRedact(key, rules) {
  if (DEFAULT_REDACT.test(key)) return true;
  for (const rule of rules) {
    if (typeof rule === 'string' && rule === key) return true;
    if (rule instanceof RegExp && rule.test(key)) return true;
    if (typeof rule === 'function' && rule(key)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export class SafeJsonCodec {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.options = Object.freeze({
      maxDepth: Math.max(1, Number(options.maxDepth) || 32),
      maxKeys: Math.max(1, Number(options.maxKeys) || 100_000),
      maxStringBytes: Math.max(16, Number(options.maxStringBytes) || 2 * 1024 * 1024),
      maxBytes: Math.max(0, Number(options.maxBytes) || 0),
      getterPolicy: options.getterPolicy || 'skip',
      circularPolicy: options.circularPolicy || 'marker',
      unsupportedPolicy: options.unsupportedPolicy || 'marker',
      redact: options.redact !== false,
      redactWith: options.redactWith || '[redacted]',
      redactKeys: Array.isArray(options.redactKeys) ? options.redactKeys.slice() : [],
      reconstruct: options.reconstruct !== false,
    });
  }

  sanitize(input, overrides = {}) {
    const options = { ...this.options, ...overrides };
    const seen = new WeakMap();
    let keyCount = 0;
    let truncated = false;

    const visit = (value, depth, path) => {
      if (value === null) return null;
      if (value === undefined) return { __rnType: 'Undefined' };
      const type = typeof value;
      if (type === 'string') {
        const output = truncateUtf8(value, options.maxStringBytes);
        if (output !== value) truncated = true;
        return output;
      }
      if (type === 'number' || type === 'boolean') return value;
      if (type === 'bigint') return { __rnType: 'BigInt', value: value.toString() };
      if (type === 'symbol') return options.unsupportedPolicy === 'omit' ? undefined : `[Symbol:${value.description || ''}]`;
      if (type === 'function') return options.unsupportedPolicy === 'omit' ? undefined : `[Function:${value.name || 'anonymous'}]`;

      if (Buffer.isBuffer(value)) return { __rnType: 'Buffer', value: value.toString('base64') };
      if (value instanceof Uint8Array) return { __rnType: value.constructor?.name || 'Uint8Array', value: Buffer.from(value.buffer, value.byteOffset, value.byteLength).toString('base64') };
      if (value instanceof Date) return { __rnType: 'Date', value: Number.isFinite(value.getTime()) ? value.toISOString() : null };
      if (value instanceof RegExp) return { __rnType: 'RegExp', source: value.source, flags: value.flags };
      if (value instanceof Error) {
        return {
          __rnType: 'Error',
          name: value.name,
          message: truncateUtf8(value.message || '', options.maxStringBytes),
          stack: truncateUtf8(value.stack || '', options.maxStringBytes),
          code: value.code,
          details: depth < options.maxDepth ? visit(value.details, depth + 1, `${path}.details`) : '[MaxDepth]',
        };
      }

      if (depth >= options.maxDepth) { truncated = true; return '[MaxDepth]'; }
      if (seen.has(value)) {
        if (options.circularPolicy === 'throw') throw new EventTransportError(`Circular value at ${path}`, { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_CIRCULAR' });
        if (options.circularPolicy === 'omit') return undefined;
        return `[Circular:${seen.get(value)}]`;
      }
      seen.set(value, path || '$');

      if (value instanceof Map) {
        const entries = [];
        for (const [key, item] of value) {
          if (++keyCount > options.maxKeys) { truncated = true; break; }
          entries.push([visit(key, depth + 1, `${path}.<key>`), visit(item, depth + 1, `${path}.<value>`)]);
        }
        return { __rnType: 'Map', value: entries };
      }
      if (value instanceof Set) {
        const entries = [];
        for (const item of value) {
          if (++keyCount > options.maxKeys) { truncated = true; break; }
          entries.push(visit(item, depth + 1, `${path}[]`));
        }
        return { __rnType: 'Set', value: entries };
      }

      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        const output = new Array(Math.min(value.length, options.maxKeys - keyCount));
        for (let index = 0; index < output.length; index++) {
          keyCount++;
          output[index] = visit(value[index], depth + 1, `${path}[${index}]`);
        }
        if (output.length < value.length) truncated = true;
        return output;
      }

      const output = Object.create(null);
      for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
        if (++keyCount > options.maxKeys) { truncated = true; break; }
        if (options.redact && shouldRedact(key, options.redactKeys)) {
          output[key] = options.redactWith;
          continue;
        }
        const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, key);
        if (descriptor?.get && options.getterPolicy !== 'invoke') {
          if (options.getterPolicy !== 'omit') output[key] = '[Getter]';
          continue;
        }
        let item;
        try { item = value[key]; }
        catch (error) { item = `[GetterError:${error?.message || error}]`; }
        const encoded = visit(item, depth + 1, path ? `${path}.${key}` : key);
        if (encoded !== undefined) output[key] = encoded;
      }
      return output;
    };

    return { value: visit(input, 0, '$'), truncated, keyCount };
  }

  encode(input, overrides = {}) {
    const options = { ...this.options, ...overrides };
    const sanitized = this.sanitize(input, options);
    let text;
    try { text = JSON.stringify(sanitized.value); }
    catch (cause) {
      throw new EventTransportError('Could not encode event payload', { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_ENCODE_FAILED', cause });
    }
    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(text);
    const maxBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxBytes) || 0);
    if (maxBytes && bytes > maxBytes) {
      throw new EventTransportError(`Encoded event payload exceeds ${maxBytes} bytes`, {
        code: 'EVENT_CODEC_MAX_BYTES',
        details: { bytes, maxBytes },
      });
    }
    return { text, bytes, truncated: sanitized.truncated, keyCount: sanitized.keyCount };
  }

  stringify(input, overrides = {}) { return this.encode(input, overrides).text; }

  parse(text, overrides = {}) {
    const options = { ...this.options, ...overrides };
    const value = JSON.parse(Buffer.isBuffer(text) ? text.toString('utf8') : String(text));
    return options.reconstruct === false ? value : this._reconstruct(value);
  }

  _reconstruct(value) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((item) => this._reconstruct(item));
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
    const type = value.__rnType;
    if (type === 'Undefined') return undefined;
    if (type === 'BigInt') { try { return BigInt(value.value); } catch { return value.value; } }
    if (type === 'Buffer') return Buffer.from(value.value || '', 'base64');
    if (type === 'Date') return value.value ? new Date(value.value) : new Date(NaN);
    if (type === 'RegExp') return new RegExp(value.source || '', value.flags || '');
    if (type === 'Map') return new Map((value.value || []).map(([key, item]) => [this._reconstruct(key), this._reconstruct(item)]));
    if (type === 'Set') return new Set((value.value || []).map((item) => this._reconstruct(item)));
    if (type === 'Error') {
      const error = new Error(value.message || 'Event error');
      error.name = value.name || 'Error';
      error.stack = value.stack || error.stack;
      if (value.code !== undefined) error.code = value.code;
      if (value.details !== undefined) error.details = this._reconstruct(value.details);
      return error;
    }
    if (type && /Array$/.test(type) && typeof value.value === 'string') {
      const bytes = Buffer.from(value.value, 'base64');
      const Constructor = TYPED_ARRAYS[type];
      if (!Constructor || type === 'Uint8Array') return new Uint8Array(bytes);
      try {
        const owned = Uint8Array.from(bytes);
        return new Constructor(owned.buffer, 0, Math.floor(owned.byteLength / Constructor.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT));
      } catch { return new Uint8Array(bytes); }
    }
    const output = {};
    for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(value)) safeSet(output, key, this._reconstruct(item));
    return output;
  }
}

export default SafeJsonCodec;

'use strict';
export * from './SafeJsonCodec.js';
export * from './EventEnvelope.js';

'use strict';

import { createHmac, randomUUID, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { EventTransportError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

export const EVENT_ENVELOPE_VERSION = 2;

const TYPED_ARRAY_NAMES = new Set([
  'Uint8Array', 'Uint8ClampedArray', 'Int8Array',
  'Uint16Array', 'Int16Array', 'Uint32Array', 'Int32Array',
  'Float32Array', 'Float64Array', 'BigInt64Array', 'BigUint64Array',
]);

function encodeString(value) {
  return JSON.stringify(String(value));
}

function numberToken(value) {
  if (Number.isNaN(value)) return 'd:NaN';
  if (value === Infinity) return 'd:+Infinity';
  if (value === -Infinity) return 'd:-Infinity';
  if (Object.is(value, -0)) return 'd:-0';
  return `d:${String(value)}`;
}

function taggedToken(value, state, depth, path) {
  const type = value?.__rnType;
  if (typeof type !== 'string') return null;

  switch (type) {
    case 'Undefined': return 'u';
    case 'BigInt': return `i:${String(value.value || '0')}`;
    case 'Buffer': return `x:Buffer:${String(value.value || '')}`;
    case 'Date': return `t:${encodeString(value.value || '')}`;
    case 'RegExp': return `g:${encodeString(value.source || '')}:${encodeString(value.flags || '')}`;
    case 'Map': {
      const entries = Array.isArray(value.value) ? value.value : [];
      return `m:[${entries.map((entry, index) => {
        const pair = Array.isArray(entry) ? entry : [undefined, undefined];
        return `${canonicalToken(pair[0], state, depth + 1, `${path}.map[${index}].key`)}=>${canonicalToken(pair[1], state, depth + 1, `${path}.map[${index}].value`)}`;
      }).join(',')}]`;
    }
    case 'Set': {
      const entries = Array.isArray(value.value) ? value.value : [];
      return `q:[${entries.map((entry, index) => canonicalToken(entry, state, depth + 1, `${path}.set[${index}]`)).join(',')}]`;
    }
    case 'Error':
      return `e:${canonicalToken({
        name: value.name || 'Error',
        message: value.message || '',
        stack: value.stack || '',
        code: value.code,
        details: value.details,
      }, state, depth + 1, `${path}.error`)}`;
    default:
      if (TYPED_ARRAY_NAMES.has(type) && typeof value.value === 'string') {
        return `x:${type}:${value.value}`;
      }
      return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Deterministic, type-aware canonicalization used only for signing.
 *
 * It intentionally does not depend on JSON.stringify so BigInt, Buffer, Error,
 * Date, Map, Set and typed arrays are valid envelope values. Object keys are
 * sorted, special numeric values are distinct, and cycles are represented by a
 * stable first-seen path. SafeJsonCodec tagged wire values canonicalize to the
 * same tokens as their reconstructed runtime counterparts.
 */
function canonicalToken(value, state, depth, path) {
  if (depth > state.maxDepth) return `z:${encodeString('[MaxDepth]')}`;
  if (value === null) return 'n';
  if (value === undefined) return 'u';

  const primitive = typeof value;
  if (primitive === 'string') return `s:${encodeString(value)}`;
  if (primitive === 'boolean') return value ? 'b:1' : 'b:0';
  if (primitive === 'number') return numberToken(value);
  if (primitive === 'bigint') return `i:${value.toString()}`;
  if (primitive === 'symbol') return `y:${encodeString(value.description || '')}`;
  if (primitive === 'function') return `f:${encodeString(value.name || 'anonymous')}`;

  const tagged = taggedToken(value, state, depth, path);
  if (tagged !== null) return tagged;

  if (Buffer.isBuffer(value)) return `x:Buffer:${value.toString('base64')}`;
  if (value instanceof Uint8Array) {
    const name = value.constructor?.name || 'Uint8Array';
    const bytes = Buffer.from(value.buffer, value.byteOffset, value.byteLength).toString('base64');
    return `x:${name}:${bytes}`;
  }
  if (value instanceof Date) {
    return `t:${encodeString(Number.isFinite(value.getTime()) ? value.toISOString() : '')}`;
  }
  if (value instanceof RegExp) return `g:${encodeString(value.source)}:${encodeString(value.flags)}`;
  if (value instanceof Error) {
    return `e:${canonicalToken({
      name: value.name || 'Error',
      message: value.message || '',
      stack: value.stack || '',
      code: value.code,
      details: value.details,
    }, state, depth + 1, `${path}.error`)}`;
  }

  if (state.seen.has(value)) return `r:${encodeString(state.seen.get(value))}`;
  state.seen.set(value, path);

  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return `a:${value.length}:[${value.map((entry, index) => canonicalToken(entry, state, depth + 1, `${path}[${index}]`)).join(',')}]`;
  }

  if (value instanceof Map) {
    const entries = [];
    let index = 0;
    for (const [key, entry] of value) {
      entries.push(`${canonicalToken(key, state, depth + 1, `${path}.map[${index}].key`)}=>${canonicalToken(entry, state, depth + 1, `${path}.map[${index}].value`)}`);
      index++;
    }
    return `m:[${entries.join(',')}]`;
  }

  if (value instanceof Set) {
    const entries = [];
    let index = 0;
    for (const entry of value) {
      entries.push(canonicalToken(entry, state, depth + 1, `${path}.set[${index++}]`));
    }
    return `q:[${entries.join(',')}]`;
  }

  const keys = Object.keys(value).sort();
  const entries = [];
  for (const key of keys) {
    let entry;
    try { entry = value[key]; }
    catch (error) { entry = `[GetterError:${error?.message || error}]`; }
    entries.push(`${encodeString(key)}:${canonicalToken(entry, state, depth + 1, `${path}.${key}`)}`);
  }
  return `o:{${entries.join(',')}}`;
}

export function canonicalizeEventEnvelope(envelope, options = {}) {
  const selected = {
    v: Number(envelope?.v) || 0,
    id: envelope?.id == null ? '' : String(envelope.id),
    node: envelope?.node == null ? '' : String(envelope.node),
    ts: Number(envelope?.ts) || 0,
    expiresAt: Number(envelope?.expiresAt) || 0,
    hop: Number(envelope?.hop) || 0,
    namespace: envelope?.namespace == null ? '' : String(envelope.namespace),
    event: envelope?.event == null ? '' : String(envelope.event),
    args: Array.isArray(envelope?.args) ? envelope.args : [],
    ctx: envelope?.ctx ?? null,
    headers: envelope?.headers ?? null,
  };
  return canonicalToken(selected, {
    seen: new WeakMap(),
    maxDepth: Math.max(8, Number(options.maxDepth) || 128),
  }, 0, '$');
}

export function signEventEnvelope(envelope, secret) {
  if (!secret) return null;
  return createHmac('sha256', secret)
    .update(canonicalizeEventEnvelope(envelope))
    .digest('base64url');
}

export function verifyEventEnvelopeSignature(envelope, secret) {
  if (!secret) return true;
  if (typeof envelope?.signature !== 'string' || !envelope.signature) return false;

  let expected;
  let actual;
  try {
    expected = Buffer.from(signEventEnvelope({ ...envelope, signature: undefined }, secret), 'base64url');
    actual = Buffer.from(envelope.signature, 'base64url');
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
  return expected.length === actual.length && expected.length > 0 && timingSafeEqual(expected, actual);
}

export function createEventEnvelope(eventName, args = [], options = {}) {
  const now = Number(options.ts) || Date.now();
  const envelope = {
    v: EVENT_ENVELOPE_VERSION,
    id: options.id || randomUUID(),
    node: String(options.nodeId || options.node || ''),
    ts: now,
    expiresAt: Number(options.expiresAt) || (Number(options.ttlMs) > 0 ? now + Number(options.ttlMs) : 0),
    hop: Math.max(0, Number(options.hop) || 0),
    namespace: options.namespace ? String(options.namespace) : 'default',
    event: String(eventName),
    args: Array.isArray(args) ? args : [args],
    ctx: options.context && typeof options.context === 'object' ? options.context : null,
    headers: options.headers && typeof options.headers === 'object' ? options.headers : null,
  };
  if (options.secret) envelope.signature = signEventEnvelope(envelope, options.secret);
  return envelope;
}

export function normalizeEventEnvelope(input) {
  if (!input || typeof input !== 'object') return null;
  if (Number(input.v) === 1) {
    return {
      v: 1,
      id: input.id,
      node: input.node,
      ts: input.ts,
      expiresAt: input.expiresAt || 0,
      hop: input.hop || 0,
      // Old v1 producers did not include a namespace. Preserve that absence so
      // a configured receiver can adopt its local namespace compatibly.
      namespace: input.namespace == null ? null : String(input.namespace),
      event: input.event,
      args: Array.isArray(input.args) ? input.args : [],
      ctx: input.ctx && typeof input.ctx === 'object' ? input.ctx : null,
      headers: input.headers && typeof input.headers === 'object' ? input.headers : null,
      signature: input.signature,
    };
  }
  return input;
}

export function validateEventEnvelope(input, options = {}) {
  const envelope = normalizeEventEnvelope(input);
  const fail = (reason, code = 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_INVALID') => ({ ok: false, reason, code, envelope });
  if (!envelope) return fail('Envelope must be an object');

  const version = Number(envelope.v);
  const acceptedVersions = options.acceptedVersions || [1, EVENT_ENVELOPE_VERSION];
  if (!acceptedVersions.includes(version)) return fail(`Unsupported envelope version ${envelope.v}`, 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_VERSION');
  if (typeof envelope.id !== 'string' || !envelope.id || Buffer.byteLength(envelope.id) > (options.maxIdBytes || 256)) return fail('Invalid envelope id');
  if (typeof envelope.node !== 'string' || !envelope.node || Buffer.byteLength(envelope.node) > (options.maxNodeBytes || 256)) return fail('Invalid origin node');
  if (typeof envelope.event !== 'string' || !envelope.event) return fail('Invalid event name');
  if (Buffer.byteLength(envelope.event) > (options.maxEventNameBytes || 512)) return fail('Event name is too large', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_EVENT_NAME_BYTES');
  if (!Array.isArray(envelope.args)) return fail('Envelope args must be an array');
  if (envelope.args.length > (options.maxArgs || 128)) return fail('Envelope has too many arguments', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_MAX_ARGS');

  const now = Number(options.now) || Date.now();
  const maxAgeMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxAgeMs) || 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(Number(envelope.ts))) return fail('Invalid envelope timestamp');
  if (maxAgeMs && now - Number(envelope.ts) > maxAgeMs) return fail('Envelope is too old', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_EXPIRED');
  if (Number(envelope.ts) - now > (Number(options.maxClockSkewMs) || 30_000)) return fail('Envelope timestamp is in the future', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_CLOCK_SKEW');
  if (Number(envelope.expiresAt) > 0 && now >= Number(envelope.expiresAt)) return fail('Envelope expired', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_EXPIRED');
  if ((Number(envelope.hop) || 0) > (Number(options.maxHops) || 4)) return fail('Envelope exceeded hop limit', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_HOPS');

  if (options.namespace) {
    if (version === 1 && envelope.namespace == null) {
      envelope.namespace = String(options.namespace);
    } else if (String(envelope.namespace || 'default') !== String(options.namespace)) {
      return fail('Envelope namespace mismatch', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_NAMESPACE');
    }
  }

  const unsignedLegacyAccepted = version === 1 && options.acceptUnsignedV1 !== false && !envelope.signature;
  if (options.secret && !unsignedLegacyAccepted && !verifyEventEnvelopeSignature(envelope, options.secret)) {
    return fail('Envelope signature is invalid', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_SIGNATURE');
  }
  return { ok: true, envelope };
}

export function assertEventEnvelope(input, options = {}) {
  const result = validateEventEnvelope(input, options);
  if (!result.ok) {
    throw new EventTransportError(result.reason, {
      code: result.code,
      details: { envelopeId: result.envelope?.id },
    });
  }
  return result.envelope;
}

'use strict';

// src/events/EventName.js

import { normalizeEventName as normalize } from './support/glob.js';

export const RESERVED_EVENT_PREFIXES = Object.freeze(['internal', 'http', 'tcp', 'udp', 'ws', 'redis']);

export function validateEventName(name) {
  if (typeof name !== 'string') throw new TypeError('Event name must be a string');
  const [domain] = name.split(':');
  if (!domain || !name.includes(':')) throw new Error(`Invalid event name '${name}'`);
  if (RESERVED_EVENT_PREFIXES.includes(domain)) throw new Error(`Event namespace '${domain}' is reserved`);
  return true;
}

export function normalizeEventName(name, options = {}) {
  return normalize(name, options.normalizeDot === true);
}

export function parseEventName(name, options = {}) {
  const normalized = normalizeEventName(name, options);
  if (typeof normalized !== 'string' || !normalized) throw new TypeError('Event name must be a non-empty string');
  const segments = normalized.split(':');
  return Object.freeze({
    value: normalized,
    domain: segments[0] || null,
    subject: segments.length > 2 ? segments.slice(1, -1).join(':') : segments[1] || null,
    verb: segments.length > 1 ? segments.at(-1) : null,
    segments: Object.freeze(segments),
    reserved: RESERVED_EVENT_PREFIXES.includes(segments[0]),
  });
}

export function eventName(domain, subject, verb) {
  return [domain, subject, verb].flat().filter((value) => value != null && String(value).length).map(String).join(':');
}

export function isReservedEventName(name) {
  return RESERVED_EVENT_PREFIXES.includes(String(name).split(':', 1)[0]);
}

export function assertFrameworkEventName(name) {
  const parsed = parseEventName(name);
  if (!parsed.reserved) throw new Error(`Event namespace '${parsed.domain}' is not a framework-reserved namespace`);
  return true;
}

'use strict';

// src/events/EventDispatcher.js

import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';

export class EventDispatcher {
  constructor() {
    this.emitter = new EventEmitter();
    this.emitter.setMaxListeners(0);
  }

  // Historical return values are intentionally preserved (undefined).
  on(event, listener) { this.emitter.on(event, listener); }
  once(event, listener) { this.emitter.once(event, listener); }
  off(event, listener) { this.emitter.off(event, listener); }
  dispatch(event, ...args) { this.emitter.emit(event, ...args); }
  emit(event, ...args) { return this.dispatch(event, ...args); }

  subscribe(event, listener, options = {}) {
    if (options.once) this.emitter.once(event, listener);
    else this.emitter.on(event, listener);
    let active = true;
    const emitter = this.emitter;
    const dispose = () => {
      if (!active) return false;
      active = false;
      emitter.off(event, listener);
      return true;
    };
    return Object.freeze({ dispose, off: dispose, unsubscribe: dispose, [Symbol.dispose]: dispose });
  }

  listeners(event) { return this.emitter.listeners(event); }
  listenerCount(event) { return this.emitter.listenerCount(event); }
  eventNames() { return this.emitter.eventNames(); }
  removeAllListeners(event) { this.emitter.removeAllListeners(event); }
}

export default EventDispatcher;

'use strict';

// src/events/EventMetrics.js

import { formatPrometheusSnapshot } from './observability/PrometheusFormatter.js';

export class EventMetrics {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.stats = new Map();
    this.maxSeries = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxSeries) || 2048);
    this.prefix = options.prefix || 'rawnode_events';
  }

  record(event, duration, error = null) {
    const name = this.stats.has(event) || this.stats.size < this.maxSeries ? String(event) : '__overflow__';
    const record = this.stats.get(name) || {
      count: 0,
      failures: 0,
      totalTime: 0,
      minTime: Infinity,
      maxTime: 0,
      lastTime: 0,
    };
    const ms = Number(duration) || 0;
    record.count++;
    record.totalTime += ms;
    record.minTime = Math.min(record.minTime, ms);
    record.maxTime = Math.max(record.maxTime, ms);
    record.lastTime = ms;
    if (error) record.failures++;
    this.stats.set(name, record);
    return this;
  }

  reset() { this.stats.clear(); return this; }

  snapshot() {
    const output = {};
    for (const [event, record] of this.stats) {
      output[event] = {
        ...record,
        minTime: Number.isFinite(record.minTime) ? record.minTime : 0,
        averageTime: record.count ? record.totalTime / record.count : 0,
      };
    }
    return output;
  }

  prometheus(prefix = this.prefix) {
    const series = Object.entries(this.snapshot()).map(([eventName, record]) => ({
      eventName,
      count: record.count,
      errorCount: record.failures,
      totalMs: record.totalTime,
      minMs: record.minTime,
      maxMs: record.maxTime,
    }));
    return formatPrometheusSnapshot({ counters: {}, series, histogram: {} }, prefix);
  }
}

export default EventMetrics;

'use strict';

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { EventOutbox, MemoryOutboxStore, OutboxPublisher } from '../../src/events/index.js';

test('outbox publisher awaits admission-style transport delivery before completing', async () => {
  const store = new MemoryOutboxStore();
  const outbox = new EventOutbox({ store });
  const record = await outbox.enqueue('durable:admission', [{ ok: true }]);
  let delivered = false;
  const transport = {
    publish() {
      return { accepted: true, promise: new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(() => { delivered = true; resolve({ published: true }); })) };
    },
  };
  const publisher = new OutboxPublisher(store, transport, { unrefTimers: false });
  const result = await publisher.runOnce();
  assert.equal(delivered, true);
  assert.equal(result.published, 1);
  assert.equal(store.get(record.record.id).status, 'published');
});

test('outbox publisher retries when admission is rejected', async () => {
  const store = new MemoryOutboxStore({ maxAttempts: 2 });
  const outbox = new EventOutbox({ store });
  const record = await outbox.enqueue('durable:rejected', []);
  const publisher = new OutboxPublisher(store, { publish: () => ({ accepted: false, code: 'FULL', promise: Promise.resolve() }) }, { retryBaseMs: 0, unrefTimers: false });
  const result = await publisher.runOnce();
  assert.equal(result.failed, 1);
  assert.equal(store.get(record.record.id).status, 'failed');
});

FILE PATH: ./tests/fixtures/redis-stub.js

'use strict';

import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';

const channels = new Map();
const streams = new Map();
let streamSequence = 0;

export class FakeRedisClient extends EventEmitter {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    super();
    this.options = options;
    this.status = 'wait';
    this.ready = false;
    this.subscriptions = new Map();
    this.published = [];
    this.failPublish = options.failPublish || false;
  }

  isReady() { return this.ready; }
  connect() { this.status = 'ready'; this.ready = true; queueMicrotask(() => this.emit('ready')); return this; }
  async connectAsync() { this.connect(); return this; }

  async publish(channel, message) {
    if (this.failPublish) throw new Error('publish failed');
    this.published.push({ channel, message });
    const subscribers = Array.from(channels.get(channel) || []);
    for (const record of subscribers) queueMicrotask(() => record.callback(message, channel));
    return subscribers.length;
  }

  async subscribe(channel, callback) {
    let records = channels.get(channel);
    if (!records) channels.set(channel, records = new Set());
    const record = { client: this, callback };
    records.add(record);
    this.subscriptions.set(channel, record);
    return {
      ready: async () => true,
      unsubscribe: async () => {
        records.delete(record);
        this.subscriptions.delete(channel);
      },
    };
  }

  async unsubscribe(channel) {
    const record = this.subscriptions.get(channel);
    if (record) channels.get(channel)?.delete(record);
    this.subscriptions.delete(channel);
  }

  async quit() {
    for (const channel of Array.from(this.subscriptions.keys())) await this.unsubscribe(channel);
    this.status = 'closed';
    this.ready = false;
  }

  async xgroup() { return 'OK'; }
  async xadd(stream, ...parts) {
    const id = `${Date.now()}-${++streamSequence}`;
    let list = streams.get(stream);
    if (!list) streams.set(stream, list = []);
    const star = parts.indexOf('*');
    list.push([id, parts.slice(star + 1)]);
    return id;
  }
  async xreadgroup(...parts) {
    const streamIndex = parts.indexOf('STREAMS');
    const stream = parts[streamIndex + 1];
    const list = streams.get(stream) || [];
    return list.length ? [[stream, list.splice(0)]] : [];
  }
  async xack(_stream, _group, ...ids) { return ids.length; }
}

export function createClient(options = {}) { return new FakeRedisClient(options); }
export function resetRedisStub() { channels.clear(); streams.clear(); streamSequence = 0; }

'use strict';

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {
  EventSchemaRegistry,
  EventCodecRegistry,
  SafeJsonCodec,
  EventDiagnostics,
  MemoryOutboxStore,
  EventOutbox,
  OutboxPublisher,
  MemoryEventInbox,
  MemoryEventTransport,
  AdvancedEventDispatcher,
  Event,
} from '../../src/events/index.js';

const silentLogger = { debug() {}, info() {}, warn() {}, error() {} };

test('versioned contracts validate payloads and apply sequential upcasters', async () => {
  const schemas = new EventSchemaRegistry();
  schemas.register('billing:paid', 1, {
    validate: (payload) => payload.amount > 0,
    upcast: (payload) => ({ ...payload, currency: 'USD' }),
  });
  schemas.register('billing:paid', 2, {
    validate: (payload) => ({ ok: typeof payload.currency === 'string', payload: { ...payload, currency: payload.currency.toUpperCase() } }),
  });

  const upgraded = schemas.upcast('billing:paid', 1, { amount: 42 });
  assert.deepEqual(upgraded, { eventName: 'billing:paid', version: 2, payload: { amount: 42, currency: 'USD' } });
  const validated = schemas.validate('billing:paid', 2, upgraded.payload);
  assert.equal(validated.ok, true);
  assert.throws(() => schemas.validate('billing:paid', 1, { amount: 0 }), /rejected|validation/i);
  schemas.freeze();
  assert.throws(() => schemas.register('billing:paid', 3, {}), /frozen/i);
});

test('codec registry exposes replace-safe named codecs', () => {
  const registry = new EventCodecRegistry();
  const encoded = registry.encode({ value: 9n });
  assert.equal(registry.parse(encoded.text).value, 9n);
  assert.throws(() => registry.register('json', registry.get()), /already exists/i);
  assert.deepEqual(registry.names(), ['json']);
});

test('codec registry enforces bounded codec cardinality', () => {
  const registry = new EventCodecRegistry({ maxCodecs: 2 });
  const codec = new SafeJsonCodec();
  registry.register('secondary', codec);
  assert.throws(
    () => registry.register('third', codec),
    (error) => error?.code === 'EVENT_CODEC_LIMIT',
  );
  assert.equal(registry.snapshot().limits.maxCodecs, 2);
});

test('diagnostics are isolated, redacted, bounded, and safe for the error name', () => {
  const diagnostics = new EventDiagnostics({ enabled: true, historyLimit: 2, maxHistoryBytes: 4096 });
  const seen = [];
  diagnostics.on('*', (name, payload) => seen.push([name, payload]));
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => diagnostics.emit('error', { token: 'hidden', nested: { password: 'hidden' } }));
  diagnostics.emit('dispatch', { value: 1 });
  diagnostics.emit('slow', { value: 2 });
  assert.equal(seen[0][1].token, '[redacted]');
  assert.equal(seen[0][1].nested.password, '[redacted]');
  assert.equal(diagnostics.history().length, 2);
  assert.equal(diagnostics.snapshot().stats.historyEvictions, 1);
  diagnostics.close();
});

test('durable outbox publishes with leases, retry metadata, and idempotency', async () => {
  const store = new MemoryOutboxStore({ maxItems: 100, maxBytes: 1024 * 1024 });
  const transport = new MemoryEventTransport();
  const outbox = new EventOutbox({ store, nodeId: 'test-node' });
  const first = await outbox.enqueue('billing:paid', [{ id: 1 }], { idempotencyKey: 'pay-1' });
  const duplicate = await outbox.enqueue('billing:paid', [{ id: 1 }], { idempotencyKey: 'pay-1' });
  assert.equal(first.inserted, true);
  assert.equal(duplicate.duplicate, true);

  const publisher = new OutboxPublisher(store, transport, { batchSize: 10, concurrency: 2 });
  const result = await publisher.runOnce();
  assert.deepEqual(result, { claimed: 1, published: 1, failed: 0 });
  assert.equal(store.get(first.record.id).status, 'published');
  assert.equal(transport.all('billing:paid').length, 1);
  await publisher.close();
  await transport.close();
});

test('idempotency inbox coalesces concurrent duplicates and remembers completion', async () => {
  const inbox = new MemoryEventInbox({ ttlMs: 1000 });
  let calls = 0;
  const handler = async () => { calls++; await Promise.resolve(); return 'ok'; };
  const [one, two] = await Promise.all([inbox.run('message-1', handler), inbox.run('message-1', handler)]);
  assert.equal(calls, 1);
  assert.equal(one.value, 'ok');
  assert.equal(two.value, 'ok');
  const duplicate = await inbox.run('message-1', handler);
  assert.equal(duplicate.duplicate, true);
  assert.equal(calls, 1);
});

test('dispatcher can auto-validate registered event-object contracts and freeze registrations', () => {
  class UserCreated extends Event { static eventName = 'user:created'; static version = 1; }
  const schemas = new EventSchemaRegistry();
  schemas.register('user:created', 1, (payload) => typeof payload.id === 'string');
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger, schemaRegistry: schemas, contracts: { autoValidate: true } });
  events.dispatch(new UserCreated({ id: 'u1' }));
  assert.throws(() => events.dispatch(new UserCreated({ id: 1 })), /rejected|validation/i);
  events.freezeRegistrations();
  assert.throws(() => events.on('user:created', () => {}), /frozen/i);
});

'use strict';

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {
  AdvancedEventDispatcher,
  EventDispatcher,
  Event,
} from '../../src/events/index.js';

test('legacy EventDispatcher keeps undefined return values and EventEmitter semantics', () => {
  const events = new EventDispatcher();
  let received = null;
  assert.equal(events.on('user:created', (value) => { received = value; }), undefined);
  assert.equal(events.dispatch('user:created', 42), undefined);
  assert.equal(received, 42);
});

test('dispatch ordering remains exact, hierarchical wildcard, pattern, then any', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher();
  const order = [];
  events.on('http:request:received', () => order.push('exact'));
  events.on('http:request:*', () => order.push('request:*'));
  events.on('http:*', () => order.push('http:*'));
  events.onPattern('http:**', (name) => order.push(`pattern:${name}`));
  events.onAny((name) => order.push(`any:${name}`));
  assert.equal(events.dispatch('http:request:received', { ok: true }), undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(order, [
    'exact',
    'request:*',
    'http:*',
    'pattern:http:request:received',
    'any:http:request:received',
  ]);
});

test('priority, prepend and stable registration order remain compatible', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher();
  const order = [];
  events.on('task:run', () => order.push('normal-1'), { priority: 10 });
  events.on('task:run', () => order.push('normal-2'), { priority: 10 });
  events.on('task:run', () => order.push('prepend-1'), { priority: 10, prepend: true });
  events.on('task:run', () => order.push('prepend-2'), { priority: 10, prepend: true });
  events.on('task:run', () => order.push('higher'), { priority: 20 });
  events.dispatch('task:run');
  assert.deepEqual(order, ['higher', 'prepend-2', 'prepend-1', 'normal-1', 'normal-2']);
});

test('dot normalization remains disabled by default and opt-in when requested', () => {
  const compat = new AdvancedEventDispatcher();
  let colon = 0;
  compat.on('udp:peerValidated', () => colon++);
  compat.dispatch('udp.peerValidated');
  assert.equal(colon, 0);

  const normalized = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ normalizeDot: true });
  normalized.on('udp:peerValidated', () => colon++);
  normalized.dispatch('udp.peerValidated');
  assert.equal(colon, 1);
});

test('event-object dispatch preserves object as first argument and attaches context', () => {
  class UserRegistered extends Event { static eventName = 'user:registered'; }
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher();
  let received;
  events.on('user:registered', (event) => { received = event; });
  const context = events.createContext({ transport: 'http', requestId: 'req-1' });
  const event = new UserRegistered({ id: 7 });
  events.run(context, () => events.dispatch(event));
  assert.equal(received, event);
  assert.equal(event.ctx.id, context.id);
  assert.equal(event.payload.id, 7);
});

test('history shape and conservative hasListeners behavior remain compatible', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ historyLimit: 2, historyAllow: ['user:**'] });
  events.dispatch('user:created', 1);
  events.dispatch('user:created', 2);
  events.dispatch('user:created', 3);
  const history = events.getHistory('user:created');
  assert.equal(history.length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(history.map((entry) => entry.args[0]), [2, 3]);

  events.onPattern('billing:paid:**', () => {});
  assert.equal(events.hasListeners('unrelated:event'), true, 'legacy conservative method stays conservative');
  assert.equal(events.willDispatchTo('unrelated:event'), false, 'new precise method is accurate');
});

test('dispatchAsync remains sequential and resolves undefined', async () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher();
  const order = [];
  events.on('job:run', async () => { await Promise.resolve(); order.push(1); });
  events.on('job:run', async () => { order.push(2); });
  assert.equal(await events.dispatchAsync('job:run'), undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(order, [1, 2]);
});

'use strict';

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { setTimeout as delay } from 'node:timers/promises';
import { AdvancedEventDispatcher } from '../../src/events/index.js';

const silentLogger = { debug() {}, info() {}, warn() {}, error() {} };

test('disposable handles support pause, resume, metadata and disposal', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  let count = 0;
  const handle = events.subscribe('user:updated', () => count++, {
    priority: 50,
    owner: 'users-provider',
    tags: ['domain', 'audit'],
    meta: { source: 'test' },
  });
  assert.equal(handle.active, true);
  assert.equal(handle.metadata.owner, 'users-provider');
  assert.deepEqual(handle.metadata.tags, ['domain', 'audit']);

  handle.pause();
  events.dispatch('user:updated');
  assert.equal(count, 0);
  handle.resume();
  events.dispatch('user:updated');
  assert.equal(count, 1);
  assert.equal(handle.dispose(), true);
  assert.equal(handle.dispose(), false);
  events.dispatch('user:updated');
  assert.equal(count, 1);
});

test('owner and tag cleanup make provider/plugin teardown deterministic', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  events.subscribe('a:event', () => {}, { owner: 'provider:a', tags: ['shared'] });
  events.subscribe('b:event', () => {}, { owner: 'provider:a', tags: ['other'] });
  events.subscribe('c:event', () => {}, { owner: 'provider:c', tags: ['shared'] });
  assert.equal(events.removeOwner('provider:a'), 2);
  assert.equal(events.listenerCount(), 1);
  assert.equal(events.removeTag('shared'), 1);
  assert.equal(events.listenerCount(), 0);
});

test('fluent subscription builder composes priority, once, replay, owner and tags', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ historyLimit: 10, logger: silentLogger });
  events.dispatch('invoice:paid', 1);
  let count = 0;
  const handle = events.when('invoice:paid')
    .priority(100)
    .owner('billing')
    .tag('financial', 'critical')
    .once()
    .replay(1)
    .listen(() => count++);
  assert.equal(count, 1);
  assert.equal(handle.active, true, 'compatibility replay does not consume once by default');
  events.dispatch('invoice:paid', 2);
  assert.equal(count, 2);
  assert.equal(handle.active, false);
});

test('inspect exposes the exact execution plan without invoking listeners', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  events.on('http:request:*', () => {});
  events.onPattern('http:**', () => {});
  events.onAny(() => {});
  const inspection = events.inspect('http:request:received');
  assert.equal(inspection.total, 3);
  assert.deepEqual(inspection.wildcardNames, ['http:request:*', 'http:*']);
  assert.equal(inspection.patterns[0].pattern, 'http:**');
});

test('dispatchWithReport captures synchronous values and isolated failures', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  events.on('math:calculate', (value) => value * 2);
  events.on('math:calculate', () => { throw new Error('bad listener'); });
  const report = events.dispatchWithReport('math:calculate', 4);
  assert.equal(report.invoked, 2);
  assert.equal(report.errorCount, 1);
  assert.equal(report.results[0].value, 8);
  assert.equal(report.ok, false);
});

test('dispatchSettled is sequential and returns a complete report', async () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  const order = [];
  events.on('pipeline:run', async () => { await delay(5); order.push('first'); return 1; });
  events.on('pipeline:run', async () => { order.push('second'); return 2; });
  const report = await events.dispatchSettled('pipeline:run');
  assert.deepEqual(order, ['first', 'second']);
  assert.deepEqual(report.results.map((entry) => entry.value), [1, 2]);
  assert.equal(report.ok, true);
});

test('dispatchParallelWith observes its concurrency ceiling', async () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  let active = 0;
  let highWater = 0;
  for (let index = 0; index < 8; index++) {
    events.on('parallel:run', async () => {
      active++;
      highWater = Math.max(highWater, active);
      await delay(5);
      active--;
      return index;
    });
  }
  const report = await events.dispatchParallelWith({ concurrency: 3 }, 'parallel:run');
  assert.equal(report.invoked, 8);
  assert.ok(highWater <= 3);
  assert.ok(highWater >= 2);
});

test('dispatchFirst and dispatchUntil stop on matching listener results', async () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  events.on('lookup:value', () => undefined);
  events.on('lookup:value', () => 'found');
  events.on('lookup:value', () => 'too-late');
  assert.equal(await events.dispatchFirst('lookup:value'), 'found');

  const report = await events.dispatchUntil((value) => value === 'found', 'lookup:value');
  assert.equal(report.stopped, true);
  assert.equal(report.stopValue, 'found');
  assert.equal(report.invoked, 2);
});

test('waitFor supports exact events, mapping, timeout and AbortSignal', async () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  const waiting = events.waitFor('order:created', {
    timeoutMs: 1000,
    map: (_name, payload) => payload.id,
  });
  events.dispatchDeferred('order:created', { id: 'o-1' });
  assert.equal(await waiting, 'o-1');

  await assert.rejects(events.waitFor('never:happens', { timeoutMs: 5 }), (error) => error.code === 'EVENT_WAIT_TIMEOUT');

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const aborted = events.waitFor('never:again', { signal: controller.signal });
  controller.abort();
  await assert.rejects(aborted, (error) => error.code === 'EVENT_ABORTED');
});

  events.dispatch('stream:item', 1);
  events.dispatch('stream:item', 2);

  assert.deepEqual((await iterator.next()).value.args, [2]);

    tenantId: 'acme',
    actorId: 'user-7',
    traceId: 'trace-1',

  await events.drain();
  assert.equal(received.id, context.id);
  assert.equal(received.tenantId, 'acme');
  assert.equal(received.actorId, 'user-7');

'use strict';

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

import {
  AdvancedEventDispatcher,
  AggregateRoot,
  Event,
  EventJobQueue,
  MemoryEventStore,
  ProjectionManager,
} from '../../src/events/index.js';

const silentLogger = { debug() {}, info() {}, warn() {}, error() {} };

test('child contexts use the immediate parent as causation while preserving correlation', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  const root = events.createContext({ id: 'root', correlationId: 'correlation' });
  const child = events.run(root, () => events.createContext({ id: 'child' }));
  const grandchild = events.run(child, () => events.createContext({ id: 'grandchild' }));
  assert.equal(child.parentId, 'root');
  assert.equal(child.causationId, 'root');
  assert.equal(grandchild.parentId, 'child');
  assert.equal(grandchild.causationId, 'child');
  assert.equal(grandchild.correlationId, 'correlation');
});

test('per-listener fail-fast overrides an isolating dispatcher policy', async () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger, dispatch: { errorPolicy: 'isolate' } });
  const calls = [];
  events.on('policy:test', () => { calls.push('first'); throw new Error('stop'); }, { errorPolicy: 'fail-fast' });
  events.on('policy:test', () => calls.push('second'));
  await assert.rejects(events.dispatchAsync('policy:test'), /stop/);
  assert.deepEqual(calls, ['first']);
  await events.close();
});

test('late diagnostics-channel subscribers activate diagnostics without dispatcher reconfiguration', async () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  const diagnosticChannel = channel('rawnode.events.diagnostics');
  const records = [];
  const subscriber = (record) => records.push(record);
  diagnosticChannel.subscribe(subscriber);
  try {
    events.dispatch('diagnostic:late', { ok: true });
    assert.equal(records.some((record) => record.name === 'dispatch' && record.payload.eventName === 'diagnostic:late'), true);
  } finally {
    diagnosticChannel.unsubscribe(subscriber);
    await events.close();
  }
});

test('versioned dispatch does not leak internal schema metadata into listener arguments', async () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  events.registerSchema('contract:created', 1, { validate: (payload) => payload?.ok === true });
  let received = null;
  events.on('contract:created', (...args) => { received = args; });
  const result = events.dispatchVersioned('contract:created', { ok: true }, { version: 1 });
  assert.equal(result.version, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(received, [{ ok: true }]);
  await events.close();
});

test('production close has a bounded force-on-timeout path for unresolved listener promises', async () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({
    profile: 'production',
    logger: silentLogger,
    lifecycle: { shutdownTimeoutMs: 5, forceOnTimeout: true },
  });
  events.on('never:resolves', () => new Promise(() => {}));
  events.dispatch('never:resolves');
  const snapshot = await events.close();
  assert.equal(snapshot.closed, true);
