test('job queue truly drops the oldest queued item and supports running cancellation', async () => {
  const queue = new EventJobQueue({ maxItems: 2, maxBytes: 1024 * 1024, overflow: 'drop-oldest', concurrency: 1, shutdownTimeoutMs: 20 });
  queue.register('delayed', async (_payload, context) => delay(1000, null, { signal: context.signal }));
  const oldest = queue.enqueue('delayed', 'oldest', { delayMs: 500 });
  const newer = queue.enqueue('delayed', 'newer', { delayMs: 500 });
  const newest = queue.enqueue('delayed', 'newest', { delayMs: 500 });
  await assert.rejects(oldest, /dropped/i);
  assert.equal(queue.get(newer.id)?.status, 'queued');
  assert.equal(queue.get(newest.id)?.status, 'queued');

  const running = queue.enqueue('delayed', 'running', { priority: 100 });
  await delay(5);
  assert.equal(running.cancel('test cancellation'), true);
  await assert.rejects(running, /cancel|abort/i);
  await queue.close({ drain: false, force: true });
});

test('event store enforces optimistic concurrency and projections rebuild from checkpoints', async () => {
  class Deposited extends Event { static eventName = 'account:deposited'; }
  class Account extends AggregateRoot {
    constructor(id) { super(id); this.balance = 0; }
    applyAccountDeposited(payload) { this.balance += payload.amount; }
    deposit(amount) { return this.record(new Deposited({ amount })); }
  }

  const store = new MemoryEventStore({ maxStreams: 10, maxEvents: 100, maxBytes: 1024 * 1024 });
  const account = new Account('account-1').deposit(10).deposit(5);
  const committed = await store.commit(account);
  assert.equal(committed.version, 2);
  assert.equal(account.hasUncommittedEvents(), false);
  await assert.rejects(
    store.append('account-1', new Deposited({ amount: 1 }), { expectedVersion: 0 }),
    (error) => error?.code === 'EVENT_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT',
  );

  let projectedBalance = 0;
  const projections = new ProjectionManager(store, { batchSize: 1, budgetMs: 1 });
  projections.register('balances', {
    'account:deposited': (payload) => { projectedBalance += payload.amount; },
  }, { reset: () => { projectedBalance = 0; } });
  const rebuilt = await projections.rebuild('balances');
  assert.equal(rebuilt.processed, 2);
  assert.equal(projectedBalance, 15);
  assert.equal(rebuilt.position, 2);
  store.close();
});

'use strict';

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { setImmediate as immediate } from 'node:timers/promises';
import { AdvancedEventDispatcher } from '../../src/events/index.js';

test('recursive once listener is claimed before invocation', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher();
  let count = 0;
  events.once('recursive:event', () => {
    count++;
    events.dispatch('recursive:event');
  });
  events.dispatch('recursive:event');
  assert.equal(count, 1);
});

test('concurrent dispatchAsync calls invoke one once listener exactly once', async () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher();
  let count = 0;
  events.once('concurrent:event', async () => {
    count++;
    await immediate();
  });
  await Promise.all([
    events.dispatchAsync('concurrent:event'),
    events.dispatchAsync('concurrent:event'),
  ]);
  assert.equal(count, 1);
});

test('replay listener failures are isolated and reported rather than escaping registration', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ historyLimit: 10 });
  const diagnostics = [];
  events.onDiagnostic('listener:error', (entry) => diagnostics.push(entry));
  events.dispatch('audit:entry', { id: 1 });
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => {
    events.on('audit:entry', () => { throw new Error('replay failure'); }, { replay: true });
  });
  assert.equal(diagnostics.length, 1);
  assert.equal(diagnostics[0].phase, 'replay');
});

test('async rejection from synchronous dispatch emits one listener:error diagnostic', async () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ metrics: true });
  let diagnostics = 0;
  events.onDiagnostic('listener:error', () => diagnostics++);
  events.on('async:reject', async () => { throw new Error('nope'); });
  events.dispatch('async:reject');
  await events.flush();
  assert.equal(diagnostics, 1);
  assert.equal(events.metrics().counters.async_listener_rejections_total, 1);
});

test('once plus replay retains compatibility unless replayConsumesOnce is selected', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ historyLimit: 10 });
  events.dispatch('cache:warmed', 1);

  let compatible = 0;
  events.once('cache:warmed', () => compatible++, { replay: true });
  assert.equal(compatible, 1);
  events.dispatch('cache:warmed', 2);
  assert.equal(compatible, 2);

  let consumed = 0;
  events.once('cache:warmed', () => consumed++, { replay: 1, replayConsumesOnce: true });
  assert.equal(consumed, 1);
  events.dispatch('cache:warmed', 3);
  assert.equal(consumed, 1);
});

'use strict';

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { setImmediate as immediate } from 'node:timers/promises';
import {
  AdvancedEventDispatcher,
  RedisEventBridge,
  RedisStreamTransport,
  SafeJsonCodec,
  createEventEnvelope,
  validateEventEnvelope,
} from '../../src/events/index.js';
import { SeenMessageWindow } from '../../src/events/bridge/SeenMessageWindow.js';
import { createClient, FakeRedisClient, resetRedisStub } from '../fixtures/redis-stub.js';

const silentLogger = { debug() {}, info() {}, warn() {}, error() {} };

function appFor(events, values = {}) {
  const config = {
    get(path, fallback) {
      const parts = String(path).split('.');
      let current = values;
      for (const part of parts) {
        if (!current || typeof current !== 'object' || !(part in current)) return fallback;
        current = current[part];
      }
      return current;
    },
  };
  return {
    resolve(key) {
      if (key === 'events') return events;
      if (key === 'config') return config;
      if (key === 'logger') return silentLogger;
      return null;
    },
  };
}

function bridgeOptions(nodeId, channel = 'test:events') {
  return {
    enabled: true,
    profile: 'production',
    nodeId,
    channel,
    namespace: 'tests',
    allow: ['domain:**'],
    deny: [],
    secret: 'cluster-secret',
    clientFactory: createClient,
    connectTimeoutMs: 1000,
    publishTimeoutMs: 1000,
    maxPublishRetries: 0,
    queue: { maxItems: 100, maxBytes: 1024 * 1024, overflow: 'reject' },
  };
}

test('Redis bridge propagates typed events with context and prevents async echo loops', async () => {
  resetRedisStub();
  const busA = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  const busB = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ logger: silentLogger });
  const bridgeA = new RedisEventBridge(appFor(busA));
  const bridgeB = new RedisEventBridge(appFor(busB));
  await bridgeA.start(bridgeOptions('node-a'));
  await bridgeB.start(bridgeOptions('node-b'));

  let received = null;
  let remoteContext = null;
  busB.on('domain:typed', (payload) => {
    received = payload;
    remoteContext = busB.getContext();
    busB.dispatchDeferred('domain:echo', { source: payload.big });
  });

  const sourceContext = busA.createContext({ transport: 'http', tenantId: 'acme', actorId: 'u-1', traceId: 'trace-9' });
  busA.run(sourceContext, () => {
    busA.dispatch('domain:typed', {
      big: 42n,
      bytes: Buffer.from('rawnode'),
      error: Object.assign(new Error('typed'), { code: 'E_TYPED' }),
    });
  });

  await bridgeA.flush();
  await immediate();
  await busB.flush();
  await bridgeB.flush();

  assert.equal(received.big, 42n);
  assert.equal(Buffer.isBuffer(received.bytes), true);
  assert.equal(received.bytes.toString(), 'rawnode');
  assert.equal(received.error instanceof Error, true);
  assert.equal(remoteContext.originTransport, 'redis');
  assert.equal(remoteContext.originNode, 'node-a');
  assert.equal(remoteContext.tenantId, 'acme');
  assert.equal(bridgeB.stats.published, 0, 'deferred child dispatch keeps remote-origin suppression');
  assert.ok(bridgeB.stats.loopPrevented >= 1);

  await bridgeA.close();
  await bridgeB.close();
  await busA.close();
  await busB.close();
});

test('safe codec preserves common Node types, redacts secrets and bounds packets', () => {
  const codec = new SafeJsonCodec({ maxBytes: 4096 });
  const circular = { token: 'secret', value: 1n, bytes: Buffer.from('x'), error: new Error('boom') };
  circular.self = circular;
  const encoded = codec.encode(circular);
  const decoded = codec.parse(encoded.text);
  assert.equal(decoded.token, '[redacted]');
  assert.equal(decoded.value, 1n);
  assert.equal(Buffer.isBuffer(decoded.bytes), true);
  assert.equal(decoded.error instanceof Error, true);
  assert.match(decoded.self, /Circular/);

'use strict';

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

test('job queue enforces concurrency, priority, retries, cancellation, and drain', async () => {
  const queue = new EventJobQueue({ concurrency: 2, maxItems: 20, maxBytes: 1024 * 1024, retryBaseMs: 1 });
  const order = [];
  let retryCalls = 0;
  queue.register('work', async (payload) => { order.push(payload); await delay(2); return payload; });
  queue.register('retry', async () => { if (++retryCalls === 1) throw new Error('retry'); return 'done'; });
  const low = queue.enqueue('work', 'low', { priority: 0 });
  const high = queue.enqueue('work', 'high', { priority: 10 });
  const retry = queue.enqueue('retry', null, { attempts: 2 });
  const cancelled = queue.enqueue('work', 'cancelled', { delayMs: 1000 });
  assert.equal(cancelled.cancel(), true);
  assert.equal(await high, 'high');
  assert.equal(await low, 'low');
  assert.equal(await retry, 'done');
  await queue.flush();
  assert.equal(order[0], 'high');
  assert.equal(queue.snapshot().stats.retried, 1);
  await queue.close();
});

test('scheduler fires one-shot and interval tasks without retaining referenced timers', async () => {
  const scheduler = new EventScheduler();

  scheduler.at(Date.now() + 5, () => { fired++; });
  scheduler.every(5, () => { fired++; }, { maxRuns: 2 });
  await delay(35);
  assert.equal(fired, 3);
  scheduler.close();
});

test('workflow engine persists steps and compensates completed work in reverse order', async () => {

    { name: 'charge', run: () => { log.push('charge'); throw new Error('declined'); }, compensate: () => log.push('refund') },
  ]);
  const record = await workflow.start('checkout');
  assert.equal(record.status, 'compensated');
  assert.deepEqual(log, ['reserve', 'charge', 'unreserve']);
  assert.equal(workflow.snapshot().stats.compensated, 1);
  await workflow.close();
});

test('broadcast manager fans Broadcastable event objects to registered transports', async () => {

class FakeApplication {
  constructor(configuration) {
    this.factories = new Map();
    this.instances = new Map();
    this.tags = new Map();
    this.container = new EventEmitter();
    this.container.has = (key) => this.factories.has(key) || this.instances.has(key);
    this.container.tag = (key, tag) => this.tag(key, tag);
    this.singleton('app', () => this);
    this.singleton('config', () => ({ get: (key) => key === 'events' ? configuration : undefined }));
    this.singleton('logger', () => silentLogger);
  }
  singleton(key, factory) { this.factories.set(key, factory); return this; }
  bind(key, factory) { return this.singleton(key, factory); }
  resolve(key) {
    if (this.instances.has(key)) return this.instances.get(key);
    const factory = this.factories.get(key);
    if (!factory) return null;
    const value = factory(this);
    this.instances.set(key, value);
    return value;
  }
  tag(key, tag) { let set = this.tags.get(tag); if (!set) this.tags.set(tag, set = new Set()); set.add(key); }
  make(Class) { return new Class(); }
  basePath() { return process.cwd(); }
}

test('EventServiceProvider registers config listeners atomically, commands, lifecycle, and teardown', async () => {
  const calls = [];
  const app = new FakeApplication({
    profile: 'production',
    failFast: true,
    freezeListeners: true,
    lifecycle: { enabled: true },
    bus: { metrics: { enabled: true }, history: { maxEntriesPerEvent: 0 } },
    listeners: {
      'domain:created': [
        { listener: (payload) => calls.push(payload.id), priority: 10, tags: ['domain'] },
      ],
      'domain:**': [
        { listener: (eventName) => calls.push(eventName), priority: -10 },
      ],
    },
    bridge: { redis: { enabled: false } },
  });
  const provider = new EventServiceProvider(app);
  provider.register();
  const report = await provider.boot();
  const events = app.resolve('events');
  events.dispatch('domain:created', { id: 'x' });
  assert.deepEqual(calls, ['x', 'domain:created']);
  assert.equal(report.loaded.length, 2);

  assert.equal(events.codecs().frozen, true);
  assert.ok(app.tags.get('console.command').has('command.events.doctor'));
  const doctor = new EventsDoctorCommand(app);
  assert.equal((await doctor.handle()).ok, true);
  await provider.teardown();
  assert.equal(events.snapshot().closed, true);
});

test('EventServiceProvider lazily binds and supervises queue, scheduler, workflows, and sourcing subsystems', async () => {
  const app = new FakeApplication({
    profile: 'production',
    bus: { lifecycle: { shutdownTimeoutMs: 100, forceOnTimeout: true } },
    queue: { enabled: true, maxItems: 100, maxBytes: 1024 * 1024, concurrency: 2 },
    scheduler: { enabled: true },
    workflows: { enabled: true, memory: { maxItems: 100 } },
    sourcing: { enabled: true, memory: { maxStreams: 10, maxEvents: 100, maxBytes: 1024 * 1024 } },
    bridge: { redis: { enabled: false } },
  });
  const provider = new EventServiceProvider(app);
  provider.register();
  await provider.boot();

  const events = app.resolve('events');
  const queue = app.resolve('events.queue');
  const scheduler = app.resolve('events.scheduler');
  const workflows = app.resolve('events.workflows');
  const store = app.resolve('events.store');
  const projections = app.resolve('events.projections');

  events.on('provider:queued', (value) => { queued += value; });

  assert.equal(events.subsystem('scheduler'), scheduler);

  assert.equal(events.subsystem('event-store'), store);
  assert.equal(events.subsystem('projections'), projections);
  assert.equal(Object.keys(events.subsystems()).length, 5);
  assert.equal(events.health().ok, true);

  await provider.teardown();
  assert.equal(queue.snapshot().closed, true);
  assert.equal(scheduler.snapshot().closed, true);
  assert.equal(store.snapshot().closed, true);
});

'use strict';

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {
  EventConfiguration,
  EventJournal,
  DeferredEventScheduler,
  EventMetricsStore,
  AdvancedEventDispatcher,
} from '../../src/events/index.js';

const silentLogger = { debug() {}, info() {}, warn() {}, error() {} };

test('production profile validates bounded history and freezes configuration', () => {
  const config = new EventConfiguration({ profile: 'production', historyLimit: 10 });
  assert.equal(config.get('history.maxEntriesPerEvent'), 10);
  assert.ok(config.get('history.maxEventNames') > 0);
  assert.equal(Object.isFrozen(config.value), true);
  assert.throws(
    () => new EventConfiguration({ profile: 'production', historyLimit: 10, maxHistoryEvents: 0 }),
    /maxEventNames/,
  );
});

test('journal enforces per-event, global event-name, total-entry, byte and TTL bounds', () => {
  const journal = new EventJournal({
    historyLimit: 2,
    maxEventNames: 2,
    maxEntriesTotal: 3,
    maxBytes: 1024,
    maxPayloadBytes: 256,
    ttlMs: 100,
    clonePolicy: 'shallow',
  });
  journal.record('a:event', [1], null, 0);
  journal.record('a:event', [2], null, 1);
  journal.record('a:event', [3], null, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(journal.get('a:event', { now: 2 }).map((entry) => entry.args[0]), [2, 3]);

  journal.record('b:event', [4], null, 3);
  journal.record('c:event', [5], null, 4);
  assert.ok(journal.eventCount <= 2);
  assert.ok(journal.totalEntries <= 3);
  assert.ok(journal.totalBytes <= 1024);

  journal.pruneExpired(1000);
  assert.equal(journal.totalEntries, 0);
});

test('journal rejects oversized payloads without retaining them', () => {
  const journal = new EventJournal({ historyLimit: 10, maxPayloadBytes: 32 });
  const result = journal.record('large:event', ['x'.repeat(100)]);
  assert.equal(result.accepted, false);
  assert.equal(result.reason, 'maxPayloadBytes');
  assert.equal(journal.totalEntries, 0);
});

test('deferred scheduler applies bounded overflow and resolves flush', async () => {
  const scheduler = new DeferredEventScheduler({ maxItems: 2, maxBytes: 1024, overflow: 'drop-newest', maxPerSlice: 1 });
  const order = [];
  const one = scheduler.schedule(() => order.push(1), { bytes: 1 });
  const two = scheduler.schedule(() => order.push(2), { bytes: 1 });
  const three = scheduler.schedule(() => order.push(3), { bytes: 1 });
  assert.equal(one.accepted, true);
  assert.equal(two.accepted, true);
  assert.equal(three.accepted, false);
  await scheduler.flush();
  assert.deepEqual(order, [1, 2]);
  assert.equal(scheduler.snapshot().stats.dropped, 1);
  await scheduler.close();
});

test('metrics bound event-name cardinality and expose Prometheus text', () => {
  const metrics = new EventMetricsStore({ enabled: true, maxSeries: 2, prefix: 'rawnode_events_test' });
  metrics.recordDispatch('a:event', 1, 0, 1);
  metrics.recordDispatch('b:event', 2, 0, 1);
  metrics.recordDispatch('c:event', 3, 0, 1);
  assert.ok(metrics.series.size <= 2, 'maxSeries is a strict total including overflow');
  assert.ok(metrics.snapshot().counters.series_overflow_total >= 1);
  assert.match(metrics.prometheus(), /rawnode_events_test_dispatch_total/);
});

test('dispatcher production profile exposes health, snapshots and bounded metrics', () => {
  const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ profile: 'production', logger: silentLogger });
  events.on('health:check', () => {});
  events.dispatch('health:check');
  assert.equal(events.health().ok, true);
  assert.equal(events.metrics().counters.dispatches_total, 1);
  assert.match(events.prometheus(), /rawnode_events_dispatch_total/);
  assert.equal(events.snapshot().profile, 'production');
});
