          const task = await this._resolveCallable(definition.task || definition.handler || definition.use);
          if (definition.cron) handle = scheduler.cron(definition.cron, task, definition);
          else if (definition.at) handle = scheduler.at(definition.at, task, definition);
          else handle = scheduler.every(definition.everyMs || definition.intervalMs, task, definition);
        }
        this.registrationReport.schedules.push({ name: definition.name, id: handle?.id || null });
      } catch (error) {
        this._recordFailure('schedule', { name }, error, raw?.required === true);
      }
    }
  }

  async _registerWorkflows(workflows, definitions) {
    for (const [name, raw] of Object.entries(definitions || {})) {
      try {
        const definition = Array.isArray(raw) ? { steps: raw } : raw;
        if (!isPlainObject(definition)) {
          throw providerError(
            `Workflow [${name}] must be an object or an array of steps`,
            'EVENTS_PROVIDER_WORKFLOW_INVALID',
          );
        }
        const steps = [];
        for (const [index, stepRaw] of (definition.steps || []).entries()) {
          const step = typeof stepRaw === 'function' || typeof stepRaw === 'string'
            ? { name: `step-${index + 1}`, run: stepRaw }
            : { ...stepRaw };
          step.run = await this._resolveCallable(step.run || step.handle || step.use);
          if (step.compensate) step.compensate = await this._resolveCallable(step.compensate);
          steps.push(step);
        }
        workflows.define(name, steps, {
          version: definition.version,
          replace: definition.replace === true,
          compensateOnFailure: definition.compensateOnFailure,
        });
        this.registrationReport.workflows.push({ name, steps: steps.length });
      } catch (error) {
        this._recordFailure('workflow', { name }, error, raw?.required === true);
      }
    }
  }

  async _registerProjections(projections, definitions) {
    for (const [name, raw] of Object.entries(definitions || {})) {
      try {
        const definition = typeof raw === 'function' ? { handlers: raw } : raw;
        const source = definition.handlers || definition.events || definition;
        let handlers;
        if (typeof source === 'function' || typeof source === 'string') handlers = await this._resolveCallable(source);
        else {
          handlers = {};
          for (const [eventName, handlerDefinition] of Object.entries(source || {})) {
            if (['reset', 'replace', 'required'].includes(eventName)) continue;
            handlers[eventName] = await this._resolveCallable(handlerDefinition);
          }
        }
        const reset = definition.reset ? await this._resolveCallable(definition.reset) : null;
        projections.register(name, handlers, { replace: definition.replace === true, reset });
        this.registrationReport.projections.push({ name, handlers: typeof handlers === 'function' ? 1 : Object.keys(handlers).length });
      } catch (error) {
        this._recordFailure('projection', { name }, error, raw?.required === true);
      }
    }
  }

  _forwardContainerLifecycle() {
    const options = this.settings.lifecycle || {};
    if (options.enabled === false) return;
    const container = this.app?.container || this.app;
    if (!container) return;

    const shouldForward = (serviceName) => {
      const name = String(serviceName ?? '');
      if (!name) return true;
      if (options.includeEventBindings !== true && (name === 'events' || name.startsWith('events.'))) return false;
      const deny = Array.isArray(options.exclude) ? options.exclude : [];
      return !deny.some((entry) => entry === name || (entry.endsWith('*') && name.startsWith(entry.slice(0, -1))));
    };
    const forward = (eventName, payloadFactory) => (...args) => {
      if (this._forwardingContainerLifecycle) return;
      const serviceName = args[0];
      if (!shouldForward(serviceName)) return;
      this._forwardingContainerLifecycle = true;
      try { safeDispatch(this._events, eventName, payloadFactory(...args), this.logger); }
      finally { this._forwardingContainerLifecycle = false; }
    };
    const attachEmitter = (eventName, listener) => {
      if (typeof container.on !== 'function') return false;
      container.on(eventName, listener);
      this._lifecycleCleanups.push(() => container.off?.(eventName, listener) || container.removeListener?.(eventName, listener));
      return true;
    };
    const attachHook = (method, listener) => {
      if (typeof container?.[method] !== 'function') return false;
      const cleanup = container[method](listener);
      if (typeof cleanup === 'function') this._lifecycleCleanups.push(cleanup);
      return true;
    };

    attachEmitter('bound', forward('container:bound', (serviceName, scope) => ({ serviceName, scope })));
    if (!attachHook('onAllResolving', forward('container:resolving', (serviceName) => ({ serviceName })))) {
      attachEmitter('resolving', forward('container:resolving', (serviceName) => ({ serviceName })));
    }
    if (!attachHook('onAllResolved', forward('container:resolved', (serviceName) => ({ serviceName })))) {
      attachEmitter('resolved', forward('container:resolved', (serviceName) => ({ serviceName })));
    }
    if (!attachHook('onAllFailed', forward('container:failed', (serviceName, error) => ({ serviceName, error })))) {
      attachEmitter('failed', forward('container:failed', (serviceName, error) => ({ serviceName, error })));
    }
  }

  _registerHealthCheck() {
    if (this._healthCleanup || this.settings.health?.register === false) return;
    const health = safeResolve(this.app, this.settings.health?.binding || 'health', null)
      || safeResolve(this.app, 'health.manager', null)
      || safeResolve(this.app, 'health.registry', null);
    if (!health) {
      if (this.settings.health?.required === true) {
        throw providerError(
          `Required health registry binding [${this.settings.health?.binding || 'health'}] is unavailable`,
          'EVENTS_PROVIDER_HEALTH_REGISTRY_MISSING',
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    const name = this.settings.health?.name || 'events';
    const check = () => this.health();
    let cleanup = null;
    try {
      if (typeof health.register === 'function') {
        const result = health.register(name, check, {
          critical: this.settings.health?.critical ?? this.settings.production,
          timeoutMs: this.settings.health?.timeoutMs || this.settings.readyTimeoutMs,
          tags: ['events', 'infrastructure'],
        });
        if (typeof result === 'function') cleanup = result;
        else cleanup = () => health.unregister?.(name) ?? health.remove?.(name);
      } else if (typeof health.add === 'function') {
        const result = health.add(name, check);
        if (typeof result === 'function') cleanup = result;
        else cleanup = () => health.remove?.(name);
      } else if (typeof health.check === 'function' && typeof health.set === 'function') {
        health.set(name, check);
        cleanup = () => health.delete?.(name);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.registrationReport.warnings.push({
        code: 'EVENTS_HEALTH_REGISTRATION_FAILED',
        message: error?.message || String(error),
      });
      if (this.settings.health?.required === true) throw error;
    }
    this._healthCleanup = cleanup;
  }

  _subscribe(kind, eventName, handler, options) {
    if (this._scope) {
      if (kind === 'any') return this._scope.any(handler, options);
      if (kind === 'pattern') return this._scope.pattern(eventName, handler, options);
      return this._scope.subscribe(eventName, handler, options);
    }
    if (kind === 'any') return this._events.subscribeAny(handler, options);
    if (kind === 'pattern') return this._events.subscribePattern(eventName, handler, options);
    return this._events.subscribe(eventName, handler, options);
  }

  async _coerceListener(definition) {
    let target = definition;
    let method = null;
    const options = {};
    let identity = null;
    let required = false;

    if (isPlainObject(definition)) {
      if (definition.enabled === false) return { skip: true, reason: 'disabled' };
      if (!this._environmentMatches(definition)) return { skip: true, reason: 'environment' };
      if (definition.when !== undefined) {
        const result = typeof definition.when === 'function'
          ? await definition.when({ app: this.app, config: this.settings, environment: this.settings.environment })
          : definition.when;
        if (!result) return { skip: true, reason: 'condition' };
      }
      if (definition.unless !== undefined) {
        const result = typeof definition.unless === 'function'
          ? await definition.unless({ app: this.app, config: this.settings, environment: this.settings.environment })
          : definition.unless;
        if (result) return { skip: true, reason: 'condition' };
      }
      target = definition.listener ?? definition.use ?? definition.handler ?? definition.binding ?? definition.module;
      method = definition.method || null;
      required = definition.required === true;
      for (const key of LISTENER_OPTION_KEYS) if (definition[key] !== undefined) options[key] = definition[key];
      if (definition.binding) target = `binding:${definition.binding}`;
      if (definition.export) options.exportName = definition.export;
      options.transient = definition.transient === true || definition.singleton === false;
      options.owned = definition.owned === true;
    }

    const parsed = typeof target === 'string' ? this._parseReference(target) : null;
    identity = parsed ? `${parsed.spec}${parsed.exportName ? `#${parsed.exportName}` : ''}${parsed.method ? `@${parsed.method}` : ''}` : target;
    if (parsed) method ||= parsed.method;
    const resolved = await this._resolveDefinitionValue(target, { exportName: options.exportName || parsed?.exportName });

    if (typeof resolved === 'function') {
      const selected = method || 'handle';
      if (resolved.prototype && typeof resolved.prototype[selected] === 'function') {
        const instance = this._instance(resolved, { transient: options.transient });
        return { handler: instance[selected].bind(instance), options, identity: identity || resolved, required };
      }
      return { handler: resolved, options, identity: identity || resolved, required };
    }
    if (resolved && typeof resolved === 'object') {
      const selected = method || 'handle';
      if (typeof resolved[selected] === 'function') {
        if (options.owned) this._ownedListenerInstances.add(resolved);
        return { handler: resolved[selected].bind(resolved), options, identity: identity || resolved, required };
      }
    }
    return { handler: null, options, identity, required };
  }

  _environmentMatches(definition) {
    const only = normalizeTags(definition.environments || definition.environment || definition.onlyEnvironments);
    const except = normalizeTags(definition.exceptEnvironments || definition.exceptEnvironment);
    if (only.length && !only.includes(this.settings.environment)) return false;
    if (except.includes(this.settings.environment)) return false;
    return true;
  }

  async _resolveCallable(definition) {
    const value = await this._resolveDefinitionValue(definition);
    if (typeof value === 'function') {
      if (value.prototype && typeof value.prototype.handle === 'function') {
        const instance = this._instance(value);
        return instance.handle.bind(instance);
      }
      return value;
    }
    if (value && typeof value.handle === 'function') return value.handle.bind(value);
    throw providerError('Definition did not resolve to a callable value', 'EVENTS_PROVIDER_CALLABLE_INVALID', { definition: this._safeDefinition(definition) });
  }

  async _resolveDefinitionValue(definition, options = {}) {
    if (definition == null) return null;
    if (typeof definition !== 'string') return definition;
    const parsed = this._parseReference(definition);
    const exportName = options.exportName || parsed.exportName;
    if (parsed.binding) return safeResolve(this.app, parsed.binding, null);
    if (hasBinding(this.app, parsed.spec) && !parsed.spec.startsWith('#') && !parsed.spec.includes('/') && !parsed.spec.startsWith('.')) {
      return safeResolve(this.app, parsed.spec, null);
    }
    const module = await this._import(parsed.spec);
    if (exportName) return module?.[exportName] ?? null;
    if (module?.default !== undefined) return module.default;
    const keys = Object.keys(module || {}).filter((key) => key !== 'default');
    return keys.length === 1 ? module[keys[0]] : null;
  }

  _parseReference(input) {
    let spec = String(input || '').trim();
    if (spec.startsWith('binding:')) return { spec, binding: spec.slice('binding:'.length), method: null, exportName: null };
    let method = null;
    let exportName = null;

    const at = spec.lastIndexOf('@');
    if (at > spec.lastIndexOf('/')) {
      method = spec.slice(at + 1);
      spec = spec.slice(0, at);
    } else {
      const dot = spec.lastIndexOf('.');
      if (dot > spec.lastIndexOf('/') && !/\.(?:js|mjs|cjs|json)$/.test(spec)) {
        method = spec.slice(dot + 1);
        spec = spec.slice(0, dot);
      }
    }

    const hash = spec.indexOf('#', 1);
    if (hash > 0) {
      exportName = spec.slice(hash + 1);
      spec = spec.slice(0, hash);
    }
    if (spec.startsWith('@listeners/')) {
      const name = spec.slice('@listeners/'.length);
      spec = `#app/Listeners/${name}${/\.(?:js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(name) ? '' : '.js'}`;
    }
    return { spec, binding: null, method, exportName };
  }

  async _import(spec) {
    if (!spec) throw providerError('Module reference is empty', 'EVENTS_PROVIDER_IMPORT_EMPTY');
    try {
      return await importApplicationModule(this.app, spec);
    } catch (error) {
      throw providerError(
        `Unable to import configured Events module [${spec}] from the application package scope`,
        'EVENTS_PROVIDER_IMPORT_FAILED',
        {
          specifier: spec,
          applicationRoot: error?.details?.applicationRoot || null,
          resolution: error?.details || null,
        },
        error,
      );
    }
  }

  _instance(Class, options = {}) {
    if (!options.transient && this._listenerInstances.has(Class)) return this._listenerInstances.get(Class);
    let instance = null;
    let owned = false;
    try {
      instance = this.app?.make?.(Class);
      if (instance) owned = true;
    } catch {}
    if (!instance) {
      try {
        instance = this.app?.container?.make?.(Class);
        if (instance) owned = true;
      } catch {}
    }
    if (!instance) {
      const dependencies = Array.isArray(Class.dependencies)
        ? Class.dependencies.map((key) => safeResolve(this.app, key, null))
        : [];
      instance = new Class(...dependencies);
      owned = true;
    }
    if (instance && typeof instance === 'object' && !instance.app) {
      try { instance.app = this.app; } catch {}
    }
    if (!options.transient) this._listenerInstances.set(Class, instance);
    if (owned) this._ownedListenerInstances.add(instance);
    return instance;
  }

  async _closeOwnedListenerInstances() {
    const instances = Array.from(this._ownedListenerInstances).reverse();
    this._ownedListenerInstances.clear();
    this._listenerInstances.clear();
    for (const instance of instances) {
      try {
        const operation = instance?.close?.() ?? instance?.stop?.() ?? instance?.dispose?.();
        if (operation && typeof operation.then === 'function') await operation;
      } catch (error) {
        log(this.logger, 'warn', '[EventsServiceProvider] listener instance cleanup failed:', error?.message || error);
      }
    }
  }

  _listenerSignature(eventName, identity, options) {
    let source;
    if (typeof identity === 'string') source = identity;
    else if ((typeof identity === 'function' || (identity && typeof identity === 'object'))) {
      let id = this._listenerIdentityIds.get(identity);
      if (!id) {
        id = ++this._listenerIdentitySequence;
        this._listenerIdentityIds.set(identity, id);
      }
      const label = typeof identity === 'function' ? identity.name : identity.constructor?.name;
      source = `${typeof identity === 'function' ? 'fn' : 'obj'}:${label || 'anonymous'}#${id}`;
    } else source = String(identity);
    return `${eventName}|${source}|${options.owner || ''}|${options.once === true ? 'once' : 'many'}|${Number(options.priority) || 0}`;
  }

  _recordFailure(phase, details, error, required = false) {
    const record = { phase, ...details, error: safeError(error), required: required === true };
    this.registrationReport.failed.push(record);
    log(this.logger, required ? 'error' : 'warn', `[EventsServiceProvider] ${phase} failed:`, error?.message || error);
    if (required || this.settings.failFast) throw error;
    return record;
  }

  _safeDefinition(definition) {
    if (typeof definition === 'function') return definition.name || '[Function]';
    if (typeof definition === 'string') return definition;
    return cloneForPublic(definition);
  }

  _logBootSummary() {
    const report = this.registrationReport;
    log(
      this.logger,
      this.state === 'ready' ? 'info' : 'warn',
      `[EventsServiceProvider] ${this.state}: profile=${this.settings.profile}, `
        + `listeners=${report.loaded.length}, subscribers=${report.subscribers.length}, `
        + `subsystems=${report.subsystems.length}, failed=${report.failed.length}, `
        + `duration=${report.durationMs.toFixed(2)}ms`,
    );
  }

  health() {
    if (!this.settings.enabled) {
      return Object.freeze({ ok: true, ready: true, state: 'disabled', reasons: Object.freeze([]), checkedAt: Date.now() });
    }
    const reasons = [];
    const events = this._events;
    const dispatcher = events?.health?.() || null;
    if (!events) reasons.push('dispatcher_missing');
    if (dispatcher?.ok === false) reasons.push(...(dispatcher.reasons || ['dispatcher_unhealthy']));
    if (this.state === 'failed') reasons.push('provider_failed');
    if (this.state === 'closing' || this.state === 'closed') reasons.push(`provider_${this.state}`);
    if (this.registrationReport.failed.some((entry) => entry.required)) reasons.push('required_registration_failed');
    if (!this._backgroundSuppressed && this.settings.bridge?.redis?.required === true && !this._bridge?.ready) reasons.push('required_bridge_not_ready');
    if (!this._backgroundSuppressed && this.settings.durable?.required === true && !this._outboxPublisher) reasons.push('required_durable_publisher_missing');
    if (!this._backgroundSuppressed && this.settings.fabric?.required === true && this._fabric?.health?.().ready !== true) reasons.push('required_fabric_not_ready');
    if (this.settings.persistence?.required === true && !this._rawMongoSource()) reasons.push('required_persistence_source_missing');
    if (!this._backgroundSuppressed && this.settings.queue?.worker?.required === true && !this._durableWorker?.snapshot?.().running) reasons.push('required_durable_worker_not_ready');
    const result = Object.freeze({
      ok: reasons.length === 0,
      ready: reasons.length === 0 && ['ready', 'degraded', 'booting', 'registered'].includes(this.state),
      state: this.state,
      reasons: Object.freeze(Array.from(new Set(reasons))),
      dispatcher,
      fabric: this._fabric?.health?.() || null,
      bridge: this._bridge?.health?.() || null,
      durableWorker: this._durableWorker?.snapshot?.() || null,
      persistence: Object.freeze({
        driver: this.settings.persistence?.driver || 'memory',
        rawmongoAvailable: !!this._rawMongoSource(),
        outbox: this._outboxStore?.snapshot?.() || null,
        inbox: this._inbox?.snapshot?.() || null,
        jobs: this._jobStore?.snapshot?.() || null,
      }),
      registration: Object.freeze({
        loaded: this.registrationReport.loaded.length,
        subscribers: this.registrationReport.subscribers.length,
        failed: this.registrationReport.failed.length,
        requiredFailed: this.registrationReport.failed.filter((entry) => entry.required).length,
      }),
      checkedAt: Date.now(),
    });
    this.lastHealth = result;
    return result;
  }

  async doctor() {
    const findings = [];
    const config = this.settings;
    const events = this._events;
    const bus = events?.configuration?.value || config.bus;

    if (config.hardened && bus.listeners?.maxTotal === 0) {
      findings.push({ level: 'error', code: 'EVENTS_UNBOUNDED_LISTENERS', message: 'Production listener total is unbounded.' });
    }
    if (config.hardened && bus.history?.maxEntriesPerEvent > 0 && bus.history?.maxEventNames === 0) {
      findings.push({ level: 'error', code: 'EVENTS_UNBOUNDED_HISTORY_NAMES', message: 'Production replay history has no event-name ceiling.' });
    }
    if (config.hardened && bus.history?.clonePolicy === 'reference' && bus.history?.maxEntriesPerEvent > 0) {
      findings.push({ level: 'warning', code: 'EVENTS_REFERENCE_HISTORY', message: 'Production replay history retains mutable references.' });
    }
    if (config.hardened && config.dynamicRegistration && !events?.registrationsFrozen?.()) {
      findings.push({ level: 'warning', code: 'EVENTS_DYNAMIC_REGISTRATION', message: 'Listener registration remains mutable in production.' });
    }
    if (config.bridge?.redis?.enabled && Number(config.bridge.redis.protocol?.publishVersion || 2) >= 2 && !config.bridge.redis.protocol?.secret) {
      findings.push({ level: config.bridge.redis.required ? 'error' : 'warning', code: 'EVENTS_BRIDGE_UNSIGNED', message: 'Redis bridge protocol v2 has no signing secret.' });
    }
    if (config.durable?.enabled && !this._outboxPublisher) {
      findings.push({ level: config.durable.required ? 'error' : 'warning', code: 'EVENTS_DURABLE_TRANSPORT_MISSING', message: 'Durable events are enabled without a publisher transport.' });
    }
    if (config.hardened && config.durable?.enabled && this._outboxStore instanceof MemoryOutboxStore && config.durable.allowMemoryInProduction !== true) {
      findings.push({ level: 'warning', code: 'EVENTS_MEMORY_OUTBOX', message: 'The production outbox is memory-backed and will not survive process loss.' });
    }
    if (config.fabric?.enabled === true && !this._fabric) {
      findings.push({ level: config.fabric?.required === true ? 'error' : 'warning', code: 'EVENTS_FABRIC_NOT_CREATED', message: 'Universal Event Fabric is enabled but has not been created.' });
    }
    if (config.hardened && config.fabric?.enabled === true && this._fabric && this._fabric.transports?.all?.().some((transport) => transport.capabilities?.().remote === true) && !this._fabric.cryptoProvider) {
      findings.push({ level: 'error', code: 'EVENTS_REMOTE_UNSIGNED', message: 'Remote Event Fabric transports are enabled without a signing key.' });
    }
    if (config.hardened && config.fabric?.enabled === true && this._fabric?.profile?.allowUnknownEvents === false && this._fabric?.definitions?.size === 0) {
      findings.push({ level: 'warning', code: 'EVENTS_DEFINITION_REGISTRY_EMPTY', message: 'The hardened Event Fabric rejects unknown events but has no registered event definitions.' });
    }
    if (config.persistence?.driver === 'rawmongo' && !this._rawMongoSource()) {
      findings.push({ level: config.persistence?.required === true ? 'error' : 'warning', code: 'EVENTS_RAWMONGO_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'RawMongo event persistence is configured but no RawMongo binding is available.' });
    }
    if (config.hardened && config.persistence?.driver === 'memory' && (config.durable?.enabled || config.sourcing?.enabled || config.workflows?.enabled)) {
      findings.push({ level: 'warning', code: 'EVENTS_MEMORY_PERSISTENCE', message: 'A durable subsystem is configured with process-local memory persistence.' });
    }
    if (config.queue?.worker?.enabled === true && !this._jobStore) {
      findings.push({ level: config.queue?.worker?.required === true ? 'error' : 'warning', code: 'EVENTS_JOB_STORE_MISSING', message: 'The durable event worker is enabled without a persistent job store.' });
    }
    for (const failure of this.registrationReport.failed) {
      findings.push({
        level: failure.required ? 'error' : 'warning',
        code: 'EVENTS_REGISTRATION_FAILURE',
        message: `${failure.phase || 'registration'} failed: ${failure.error?.message || 'unknown error'}`,
      });
    }

    const health = this.health();
    const result = Object.freeze({
      ok: health.ok && !findings.some((finding) => finding.level === 'error'),
      state: this.state,
      health,
      findings: Object.freeze(findings),
      snapshot: this.snapshot(),
    });
    this.lastDoctor = result;
    return result;
  }

  metrics() { return this._events?.metrics?.() || null; }
  prometheus(prefix) { return this._events?.prometheus?.(prefix) || ''; }
  registration() { return freezePublic(cloneForPublic(this.registrationReport)); }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: this.state,
      enabled: this.settings.enabled,
      profile: this.settings.profile,
      environment: this.settings.environment,
      registeredAt: this.registeredAt,
      bootStartedAt: this.bootStartedAt,
      readyAt: this.readyAt,
      closedAt: this.closedAt,
      lastError: safeError(this.lastError),
      health: this.health(),
      registration: this.registration(),
      events: this._events?.snapshot?.() || null,
      fabric: this._fabric?.snapshot?.() || null,
      definitions: this._fabric?.definitions?.snapshot?.() || null,
      transports: this._fabric?.transports?.snapshot?.() || null,
      resources: this._fabric?.resources?.snapshot?.() || null,
      flightRecorder: this._fabric?.flightRecorder?.snapshot?.() || null,
      studio: this._studio ? { readOnly: this._studio.readOnly, allowMutations: this._studio.allowMutations, server: this._studioServer?.address?.() || null } : null,
      bridge: this._bridge?.snapshot?.() || null,
      broadcasting: this._broadcast?.snapshot?.() || null,
      outbox: this._outbox?.snapshot?.() || null,
      outboxPublisher: this._outboxPublisher?.snapshot?.() || null,
      inbox: this._inbox?.snapshot?.() || null,
      queue: this._queue?.snapshot?.() || null,
      jobStore: this._jobStore?.snapshot?.() || null,
      durableWorker: this._durableWorker?.snapshot?.() || null,
      scheduler: this._scheduler?.snapshot?.() || null,
      workflows: this._workflows?.snapshot?.() || null,
      eventStore: this._eventStore?.snapshot?.() || null,
      projections: this._projections?.snapshot?.() || null,
    });
  }

  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await this.close(); }
}

/* Service provider                                                           */

export class EventsServiceProvider {
  static priority = 2;
  static dependencies = ['app'];

  constructor(app) {
    this.app = app;
    this.manager = null;
    this.settings = null;
    this._registered = false;
  }

  register() {
    if (this._registered) return this;
    const app = this.app;
    const config = safeResolve(app, 'config', {});
    const settings = normalizeEventsProviderSettings(config);
    const logger = resolveLogger(app);

    let manager = hasBinding(app, 'events.manager') ? safeResolve(app, 'events.manager', null) : null;
    if (manager && !(manager instanceof RawNodeEventsManager)) {
      const valid = typeof manager.boot === 'function' && typeof manager.close === 'function' && typeof manager.dispatcher === 'function';
      if (!valid) {
        throw providerError(
          'Existing [events.manager] binding does not implement the RawNode events manager contract',
          'EVENTS_PROVIDER_MANAGER_CONFLICT',
        );
      }
    }
    if (!manager) manager = new RawNodeEventsManager(app, logger, settings);
    this.manager = manager;
    this.settings = settings;

    const registerBinding = (key, factory, kind = 'singleton') => {
      const created = bindIfAbsent(app, kind, key, factory);
      manager.markOwnedBinding?.(key, created);
      return created;
    };

    registerBinding('events.manager', () => manager);
    registerBinding('events.settings', () => publicSettings(settings));
    registerBinding('events.config', () => publicSettings(settings));

    registerBinding('events.schemas', () => manager.schemas());
    registerBinding('events.codecs', () => manager.codecs());
    registerBinding('events', () => manager.dispatcher());

    if (settings.registerAliases) {
      registerBinding('event', () => safeResolve(app, 'events', null) || manager.dispatcher());
      registerBinding('event.bus', () => safeResolve(app, 'events', null) || manager.dispatcher());
      registerBinding('event.dispatcher', () => safeResolve(app, 'events', null) || manager.dispatcher());
    }

    registerBinding('events.fabric', () => manager.fabric());
    registerBinding('events.definitions', () => manager.fabric().definitions);
    registerBinding('events.transports', () => manager.fabric().transports);
    registerBinding('events.transport.router', () => manager.fabric().router);
    registerBinding('events.resources', () => manager.fabric().resources);
    registerBinding('events.middleware', () => manager.fabric().middleware);
    registerBinding('events.gateway', () => manager.fabric().gateway);
    registerBinding('events.channels', () => manager.fabric().authorizer);
    registerBinding('events.flight-recorder', () => manager.fabric().flightRecorder);
    registerBinding('events.requests', () => manager.fabric().requests);
    registerBinding('events.studio', () => manager.studio());
    registerBinding('events.studio.server', () => manager.studioServer());
    registerBinding('events.durable.transport', () => manager.fabric().outboxPublisherTransport());

    registerBinding('events.bridge.redis', () => manager.bridge());
    registerBinding('events.broadcast', () => manager.broadcastManager());
    registerBinding('events.outbox.store', () => manager.outboxStore());
    registerBinding('events.outbox', () => manager.outbox());
    registerBinding('events.outbox.publisher', () => manager.outboxPublisher());
    registerBinding('events.queue', () => manager.queue());
    registerBinding('events.inbox', () => manager.inbox());
    registerBinding('events.jobs.store', () => manager.jobStore());
    registerBinding('events.jobs.worker', () => manager.durableWorker());
    registerBinding('events.scheduler', () => manager.scheduler());
    registerBinding('events.workflows.store', () => manager.workflowStore());
    registerBinding('events.workflows', () => manager.workflows());
    registerBinding('events.store', () => manager.eventStore());
    registerBinding('events.projections.checkpoints', () => manager.projectionCheckpoints());
    registerBinding('events.projections', () => manager.projections());

    registerBinding('events.health', () => () => manager.health());
    registerBinding('events.inspect', () => (eventName) => safeResolve(app, 'events')?.inspect?.(eventName));
    registerBinding('events.metrics', () => () => manager.metrics());
    registerBinding('events.prometheus', () => (prefix) => manager.prometheus(prefix));
    registerBinding('events.registration', () => () => manager.registration());
    registerBinding('events.doctor', () => () => manager.doctor());
    registerBinding('events.factory', () => (options = {}) => new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ ...settings.bus, ...options, logger }));
    registerBinding('events.fabric.factory', () => (options = {}) => new NodeEventFabric({
      dispatcher: options.dispatcher || new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ ...settings.bus, ...(options.bus || {}), logger }),
      profile: options.profile || settings.profile,
      ...options,
    }));
    registerBinding('events.publish', () => (eventOrOperation, payload, options) => manager.fabric().publish(eventOrOperation, payload, options));
    registerBinding('events.request', () => (eventOrOperation, payload, options) => manager.fabric().request(eventOrOperation, payload, options));
    registerBinding('events.inbound', () => (envelope, context) => manager.fabric().inbound(envelope, context));

    if (settings.registerCommands) this._registerCommands(registerBinding);
    this._bindHelpers();
    this._registered = true;
    return this;
  }

  _registerCommands(registerBinding = null) {
    const add = registerBinding || ((key, factory) => {
      const created = bindIfAbsent(this.app, 'singleton', key, factory);
      this.manager?.markOwnedBinding?.(key, created);
      return created;
    });
    for (const [key, Command] of EVENT_COMMANDS || []) {
      add(key, () => new Command(this.app));
      tag(this.app, key, COMMAND_TAG);
    }
    const key = 'command.events.provider.status';
    add(key, () => new EventsProviderStatusCommand(this.app));
    tag(this.app, key, COMMAND_TAG);
  }

  _bindHelpers() {
    const app = this.app;
    if (typeof app.events !== 'function') app.events = () => app.resolve('events');
    if (typeof app.event !== 'function') app.event = (eventOrName, ...args) => app.resolve('events').dispatch(eventOrName, ...args);
    if (typeof app.dispatch !== 'function') app.dispatch = (eventOrName, ...args) => app.resolve('events').dispatch(eventOrName, ...args);
    if (typeof app.dispatchAsync !== 'function') app.dispatchAsync = (eventOrName, ...args) => app.resolve('events').dispatchAsync(eventOrName, ...args);
    if (typeof app.dispatchDeferred !== 'function') app.dispatchDeferred = (eventOrName, ...args) => app.resolve('events').dispatchDeferred(eventOrName, ...args);
    if (typeof app.eventFabric !== 'function') app.eventFabric = () => app.resolve('events.fabric');
    if (typeof app.eventOperation !== 'function') app.eventOperation = (eventName, payload) => app.resolve('events.fabric').event(eventName, payload);
    if (typeof app.publishEvent !== 'function') app.publishEvent = (eventOrOperation, payload, options) => app.resolve('events.fabric').publish(eventOrOperation, payload, options);
    if (typeof app.requestEvent !== 'function') app.requestEvent = (eventOrOperation, payload, options) => app.resolve('events.fabric').request(eventOrOperation, payload, options);
    if (typeof app.handleEventRequest !== 'function') app.handleEventRequest = (eventName, handler, options) => app.resolve('events.fabric').handleRequest(eventName, handler, options);
    if (typeof app.defineEvent !== 'function') app.defineEvent = (definition, options) => app.resolve('events.fabric').define(definition, options);
    if (typeof app.eventHealth !== 'function') app.eventHealth = () => this.manager.health();
  }

  async boot(context = {}) {
    if (!this._registered) this.register();
    return this.manager.boot(context);
  }

  async teardown() {
    return this.manager?.close?.();
  }

  async tearDown() {
    return this.teardown();
  }
}

/** Existing applications import the singular provider name. */
export class EventServiceProvider extends EventsServiceProvider {}

/** Explicit RawNode-prefixed alias for package and framework integrations. */
export const RawNodeEventsServiceProvider = EventsServiceProvider;

export default EventServiceProvider;

'use strict';

import { compileMatcherList, matchesAny } from '../support/glob.js';

export class EventRecorder {
  constructor(dispatcher = null, options = {}) {
    this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 10_000);
    this.allow = compileMatcherList(options.allow || []);
    this.deny = compileMatcherList(options.deny || []);
    this.records = [];
    this.handle = null;
    this.dropped = 0;
    if (dispatcher && options.autoStart !== false) this.start();
  }

  start(dispatcher = this.dispatcher) {
    if (this.handle) return this;
    if (!dispatcher) throw new TypeError('EventRecorder requires a dispatcher');
    this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
    const listener = (eventName, ...args) => this.record(eventName, args, dispatcher.getContext?.());
    if (typeof dispatcher.subscribeAny === 'function') {
      this.handle = dispatcher.subscribeAny(listener, {
        priority: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
        owner: 'rawnode:events:test-recorder',
        tags: ['testing', 'recorder'],
      });
    } else {
      dispatcher.onAny(listener, { priority: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER });
      this.handle = { dispose: () => dispatcher.offAny?.(listener) };
    }
    return this;
  }

  record(eventName, args = [], context = null) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    if (this.allow.length && !matchesAny(this.allow, name)) return false;
    if (this.deny.length && matchesAny(this.deny, name)) return false;
    if (this.records.length >= this.maxItems) { this.records.shift(); this.dropped++; }
    this.records.push({ eventName: name, args: Array.isArray(args) ? args : [args], context: context ? { ...context } : null, ts: Date.now() });
    return true;
  }

  all(eventName = null) {
    return (eventName == null ? this.records : this.records.filter((record) => record.eventName === String(eventName))).slice();
  }
  count(eventName = null) { return this.all(eventName).length; }
  has(eventName, predicate = null) {
    return this.records.some((record) => record.eventName === String(eventName) && (!predicate || predicate(...record.args, record)));
  }
  last(eventName = null) { const records = this.all(eventName); return records.at(-1) || null; }
  clear() { const count = this.records.length; this.records.length = 0; return count; }
  stop() { this.handle?.dispose?.(); this.handle = null; return this; }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ count: this.records.length, dropped: this.dropped, records: Object.freeze(this.records.slice()) }); }
  [Symbol.dispose]() { this.stop(); }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { this.stop(); }
}

export default EventRecorder;

'use strict';

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

function sourceRecords(source) {
  if (Array.isArray(source)) return source;
  if (typeof source?.all === 'function') return source.all();
  if (Array.isArray(source?.records)) return source.records;
  throw new TypeError('Event assertion source must be an EventRecorder or record array');
}

export function assertDispatched(source, eventName, predicate = null, message = null) {
  const records = sourceRecords(source);
  const match = records.find((record) => record.eventName === String(eventName) && (!predicate || predicate(...record.args, record)));
  assert.ok(match, message || `Expected event "${eventName}" to be dispatched`);
  return match;
}

export function assertNotDispatched(source, eventName, predicate = null, message = null) {
  const records = sourceRecords(source);
  const match = records.find((record) => record.eventName === String(eventName) && (!predicate || predicate(...record.args, record)));
  assert.equal(match, undefined, message || `Expected event "${eventName}" not to be dispatched`);
  return true;
}

export function assertDispatchedTimes(source, eventName, expected, message = null) {
  const count = sourceRecords(source).filter((record) => record.eventName === String(eventName)).length;
  assert.equal(count, expected, message || `Expected event "${eventName}" ${expected} time(s), received ${count}`);
  return true;
}

export function assertDispatchOrder(source, eventNames, message = null) {
  const actual = sourceRecords(source).map((record) => record.eventName);
  let cursor = 0;
  for (const name of actual) if (name === eventNames[cursor]) cursor++;
  assert.equal(cursor, eventNames.length, message || `Expected dispatch order ${eventNames.join(' -> ')}, received ${actual.join(' -> ')}`);
  return true;
}

export class EventAssertions {
  constructor(source) { this.source = source; }
  dispatched(name, predicate, message) { return assertDispatched(this.source, name, predicate, message); }
  notDispatched(name, predicate, message) { return assertNotDispatched(this.source, name, predicate, message); }
  dispatchedTimes(name, count, message) { return assertDispatchedTimes(this.source, name, count, message); }
  order(names, message) { return assertDispatchOrder(this.source, names, message); }
}

export default EventAssertions;

'use strict';

export class MemoryEventTransport {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 100_000);
    this.messages = [];
    this.listeners = new Map();
    this.closed = false;
    this.stats = { published: 0, broadcasts: 0, delivered: 0, dropped: 0 };
  }

  async publish(eventName, payload, options = {}) {
    if (this.closed) throw new Error('MemoryEventTransport is closed');
    const message = { eventName: String(eventName), payload, options, ts: Date.now() };
    this._append(message);
    this.stats.published++;
    for (const listener of this.listeners.get(message.eventName) || []) {
      await listener(payload, message);
      this.stats.delivered++;
    }
    for (const listener of this.listeners.get('*') || []) {
      await listener(message.eventName, payload, message);
      this.stats.delivered++;
    }
    return message;
  }

  async publishEnvelope(envelope, options = {}) { return this.publish(envelope.event, envelope, options); }

  async broadcast(envelope, options = {}) {
    this.stats.broadcasts++;
    return this.publish(envelope.event, envelope, options);
  }

  subscribe(eventName, listener) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    let bucket = this.listeners.get(name);
    if (!bucket) this.listeners.set(name, bucket = new Set());
    bucket.add(listener);
    const dispose = () => bucket.delete(listener);
    return { dispose, unsubscribe: dispose, off: dispose, [Symbol.dispose]: dispose };
  }

  all(eventName = null) { return (eventName == null ? this.messages : this.messages.filter((message) => message.eventName === String(eventName))).slice(); }
  clear() { const count = this.messages.length; this.messages.length = 0; return count; }
  _append(message) {
    if (this.messages.length >= this.maxItems) { this.messages.shift(); this.stats.dropped++; }
    this.messages.push(message);
  }
  async close() { this.closed = true; this.listeners.clear(); return this.snapshot(); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ closed: this.closed, messages: this.messages.length, listeners: this.listeners.size, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
}

export default MemoryEventTransport;

'use strict';

import { AdvancedEventDispatcher } from '../AdvancedEventDispatcher.js';
import { DispatchReport } from '../core/DispatchReport.js';
import { EventRecorder } from './EventRecorder.js';
import { EventAssertions } from './EventAssertions.js';
import { compileMatcherList, matchesAny } from '../support/glob.js';

export class FakeEventBus extends AdvancedEventDispatcher {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    super(options);
    this.fakeMatchers = compileMatcherList(options.fake || []);
    this.exceptMatchers = compileMatcherList(options.except || []);
    this.recorder = new EventRecorder(null, { maxItems: options.maxRecords || 100_000, autoStart: false });
    this.assertions = new EventAssertions(this.recorder);
  }

  fake(patterns = ['**']) { this.fakeMatchers = compileMatcherList(Array.isArray(patterns) ? patterns : [patterns]); return this; }
  except(patterns = []) { this.exceptMatchers = compileMatcherList(Array.isArray(patterns) ? patterns : [patterns]); return this; }
  restore() { this.fakeMatchers = []; this.exceptMatchers = []; return this; }

  _isFaked(eventOrName) {
    const name = this._peekEventName(eventOrName);
    if (this.exceptMatchers.length && matchesAny(this.exceptMatchers, name)) return false;
    return this.fakeMatchers.length > 0 && matchesAny(this.fakeMatchers, name);
  }

  _recordFake(eventOrName, args) {
    const resolved = this._resolveDispatchInput(eventOrName, args);
    this.recorder.record(resolved.name, resolved.finalArgs, this.getContext());
    return resolved;
  }

  dispatch(eventOrName, ...args) {
    if (!this._isFaked(eventOrName)) return super.dispatch(eventOrName, ...args);
    this._recordFake(eventOrName, args);
    return undefined;
  }

  dispatchAsync(eventOrName, ...args) {
    if (!this._isFaked(eventOrName)) return super.dispatchAsync(eventOrName, ...args);
    this._recordFake(eventOrName, args);
    return Promise.resolve(undefined);
  }

  dispatchWithReport(eventOrName, ...args) {
    if (!this._isFaked(eventOrName)) return super.dispatchWithReport(eventOrName, ...args);
    const resolved = this._recordFake(eventOrName, args);
    return new DispatchReport(resolved.name, { mode: 'fake', context: this.getContext() }).complete(0);
  }

  assertDispatched(...args) { return this.assertions.dispatched(...args); }
  assertNotDispatched(...args) { return this.assertions.notDispatched(...args); }
  assertDispatchedTimes(...args) { return this.assertions.dispatchedTimes(...args); }
}

export default FakeEventBus;

'use strict';

import { base64Decode, base64Encode, toUint8Array } from '../../universal/support/safe.js';

export class WebEventCrypto {
  constructor(options = {}) { this.keys = new Map(); this.primaryKeyId = options.primaryKeyId || null; for (const key of options.keys || []) this.addKey(key); if (options.secret) this.addKey({ id: options.keyId || 'events-primary', secret: options.secret, primary: true }); }
  addKey(input) { const id = String(input.id || input.keyId || input.kid || 'events-key'); const secret = input.secret ?? input.key; if (secret == null) throw new TypeError(`Event crypto key '${id}' requires secret.`); this.keys.set(id, { id, secret, algorithm: input.algorithm || 'hmac-sha256' }); if (input.primary === true || !this.primaryKeyId) this.primaryKeyId = id; return this; }
  async sign(bytes, options = {}) { const key = this._key(options.keyId); const cryptoKey = await importHmacKey(key.secret, ['sign']); const signature = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', cryptoKey, toUint8Array(bytes))); return { keyId: key.id, algorithm: 'hmac-sha256', signature: base64Encode(signature) }; }
  async verify(bytes, signature, options = {}) { try { const key = this._key(options.keyId); const cryptoKey = await importHmacKey(key.secret, ['verify']); return await crypto.subtle.verify('HMAC', cryptoKey, base64Decode(signature), toUint8Array(bytes)); } catch { return false; } }
  _key(id = null) { const key = this.keys.get(String(id || this.primaryKeyId)); if (!key) throw Object.assign(new Error(`Unknown event crypto key '${id || this.primaryKeyId}'.`), { code: 'EVENT_CRYPTO_KEY_UNKNOWN' }); return key; }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ primaryKeyId: this.primaryKeyId, keys: [...this.keys.values()].map(({ secret, ...value }) => value) }); }
}
async function importHmacKey(secret, usages) { if (!globalThis.crypto?.subtle) throw Object.assign(new Error('Web Crypto is unavailable.'), { code: 'EVENT_WEB_CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE' }); return crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', toUint8Array(secret), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, usages); }
export default WebEventCrypto;

'use strict';

import { ListenerRegistry } from '../core/ListenerRegistry.js';
import { ListenerScope } from '../core/ListenerScope.js';
import { SubscriptionBuilder } from '../core/SubscriptionBuilder.js';
import { normalizeEventName, computeWildcardEvents } from '../support/glob.js';
import { ExplicitEventContextManager } from '../universal/context/ExplicitEventContextManager.js';

/** Browser-safe dispatcher with the same exact → wildcard → pattern → any plan. */
export class BrowserEventDispatcher {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.profile = options.profile || 'compat';
    this.normalizeDot = options.normalizeDot === true;
    this.errorPolicy = options.errorPolicy || 'isolate';
    this.closed = false;
    this.accepting = true;
    this.registry = new ListenerRegistry({
      maxListenersPerEvent: options.maxListenersPerEvent ?? options.listeners?.maxPerEvent ?? 5_000,
      maxListenersTotal: options.maxListenersTotal ?? options.listeners?.maxTotal ?? 0,
      maxPatternListeners: options.maxPatternListeners ?? options.listeners?.maxPatterns ?? 5_000,
      maxListenersPerPattern: options.maxListenersPerPattern ?? options.listeners?.maxPerPattern ?? 5_000,
      maxAnyListeners: options.maxAnyListeners ?? options.listeners?.maxAny ?? 5_000,
      planCacheMax: options.planCacheMax ?? options.listeners?.planCacheMax ?? 1_024,
    });
    this._registry = this.registry;
    this._listeners = this.registry.exact;
    this._patternListeners = this.registry.patterns;
    this._anyListeners = this.registry.any;
    this.contexts = options.contexts || new ExplicitEventContextManager(options.context || {});
    this.historyLimit = Math.max(0, Number(options.historyLimit ?? options.history?.maxEntriesPerEvent) || 0);
    this.history = new Map();
    this.historyEventLimit = Math.max(0, Number(options.historyEventLimit ?? options.history?.maxEventNames) || 1_024);
    this.maxHistoryPayloadBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxHistoryPayloadBytes ?? options.history?.maxPayloadBytes) || 256 * 1024);
    this.pending = new Set();
    this.statsValue = { dispatches: 0, asyncDispatches: 0, listenersInvoked: 0, errors: 0, promisesObserved: 0, historyRecorded: 0 };
  }

  emit(event, ...args) { return this.dispatch(event, ...args); }
  addListener(event, listener, options) { return this.on(event, listener, options); }
  removeListener(event, listener) { return this.off(event, listener); }
  eventNames() { return [...this.registry.exact.keys()]; }
  listeners(event) { return (this.registry.exact.get(this._name(event)) || []).filter((entry) => entry.active).map((entry) => entry.fn); }
  listenerCount(event = null) { if (event == null) return this.registry.total; const name = this._name(event); return name === '*' ? this.registry.any.length : (this.registry.exact.get(name) || []).filter((entry) => entry.active).length; }
  removeAllListeners(event = null) { this.registry.clear(event == null ? null : this._name(event)); return this; }

  createContext(meta = {}) { return this.contexts.create(meta); }
  getContext() { return this.contexts.get(); }
  getContextId() { return this.contexts.id(); }
  run(context, operation) { return this.contexts.run(context, operation); }
  runIfMissing(meta, operation) { return this.contexts.runIfMissing(meta, operation); }
  enter(context) { return this.contexts.enter(context); }
  bind(operation) { return this.contexts.bind(operation); }
  childContext(meta = {}) { return this.contexts.child(meta); }

  subscribe(event, listener, options = {}) { this._assertOpen(); const name = this._name(event); const { handle } = this.registry.addExact(name, listener, options); this._bindSignal(handle, options.signal); if (options.replay) this.replay(name, listener, typeof options.replay === 'object' ? options.replay : {}); return handle; }
  on(event, listener, options = {}) { this.subscribe(event, listener, options); return this; }
  once(event, listener, options = {}) { this.subscribe(event, listener, { ...options, once: true }); return this; }
  subscribePattern(pattern, listener, options = {}) { this._assertOpen(); const { handle } = this.registry.addPattern(this._name(pattern), listener, options); this._bindSignal(handle, options.signal); return handle; }
  onPattern(pattern, listener, options = {}) { this.subscribePattern(pattern, listener, options); return this; }
  subscribeAny(listener, options = {}) { this._assertOpen(); const { handle } = this.registry.addAny(listener, options); this._bindSignal(handle, options.signal); return handle; }
  onAny(listener, options = {}) { this.subscribeAny(listener, options); return this; }
  off(event, listener) { return this.registry.removeExact(this._name(event), listener); }
  offPattern(pattern, listener) { return this.registry.removePattern(this._name(pattern), listener); }
  offAny(listener) { return this.registry.removeAny(listener); }
  subscribeTo(event) { return new SubscriptionBuilder(this, 'exact', this._name(event)); }
  subscribeToPattern(pattern) { return new SubscriptionBuilder(this, 'pattern', this._name(pattern)); }
  subscribeToAny() { return new SubscriptionBuilder(this, 'any', '*'); }
  scope(owner) { return new ListenerScope(this, owner); }
  removeOwner(owner) { return this.registry.removeOwner(owner); }
  removeTag(tag) { return this.registry.removeTag(tag); }
  listenerManifest() { return this.registry.manifest(); }
  hasListeners(event) { const name = this._name(event); return this.registry.hasPotential(name, computeWildcardEvents(name)); }
  willDispatchTo(event) { const name = this._name(event); return this.registry.willDispatchTo(name, computeWildcardEvents(name)); }
  inspect(event) { const name = this._name(event); const plan = this.registry.plan(name, computeWildcardEvents(name)); return deepFreeze({ eventName: name, exactStages: plan.exactStages.map((stage) => ({ eventName: stage.eventName, listeners: stage.entries.map((entry) => this.registry.describeEntry(entry)) })), patterns: plan.patterns.map((entry) => this.registry.describeEntry(entry)), any: plan.any.map((entry) => this.registry.describeEntry(entry)) }); }

  dispatch(event, ...args) {
    this._assertDispatch();
    const name = this._name(event);
    const plan = this.registry.plan(name, computeWildcardEvents(name));
    this._record(name, args);
    this.statsValue.dispatches++;
    for (const stage of plan.exactStages) for (const entry of stage.entries) this._invokeSync(entry, args, name, false);
    for (const entry of plan.patterns) this._invokeSync(entry, [name, ...args], name, true);
    for (const entry of plan.any) this._invokeSync(entry, [name, ...args], name, true);
    return undefined;
  }

  async dispatchAsync(event, ...args) {
    this._assertDispatch();
    const name = this._name(event);
    const plan = this.registry.plan(name, computeWildcardEvents(name));
    this._record(name, args);
    this.statsValue.asyncDispatches++;
    for (const stage of plan.exactStages) for (const entry of stage.entries) await this._invokeAsync(entry, args, name, false);
    for (const entry of plan.patterns) await this._invokeAsync(entry, [name, ...args], name, true);
    for (const entry of plan.any) await this._invokeAsync(entry, [name, ...args], name, true);
    return undefined;
  }

  async dispatchParallel(event, ...args) {
    this._assertDispatch();
    const name = this._name(event); const plan = this.registry.plan(name, computeWildcardEvents(name)); this._record(name, args);
    const tasks = [];
    for (const stage of plan.exactStages) for (const entry of stage.entries) tasks.push(this._invokeAsync(entry, args, name, false));
    for (const entry of plan.patterns) tasks.push(this._invokeAsync(entry, [name, ...args], name, true));
    for (const entry of plan.any) tasks.push(this._invokeAsync(entry, [name, ...args], name, true));
    return Promise.allSettled(tasks);
  }

  dispatchDeferred(event, ...args) { const context = this.getContext(); queueMicrotask(() => { try { this.run(context, () => this.dispatch(event, ...args)); } catch (error) { this._handleError(error, event, null); } }); return true; }

  waitFor(event, options = {}) {
    const name = this._name(event); const timeoutMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.timeoutMs ?? options.timeout) || 0);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      let timer;
      const cleanup = () => { clearTimeout(timer); handle?.dispose?.(); options.signal?.removeEventListener?.('abort', aborted); };
      const aborted = () => { cleanup(); reject(options.signal.reason || Object.assign(new Error('Event wait aborted.'), { code: 'EVENT_ABORTED' })); };
      const handle = this.subscribe(name, (...args) => { cleanup(); try { resolve(options.map ? options.map(...args) : args.length <= 1 ? args[0] : args); } catch (error) { reject(error); } }, { once: true });
      if (timeoutMs) timer = setTimeout(() => { cleanup(); reject(Object.assign(new Error(`Timed out waiting for '${name}'.`), { code: 'EVENT_WAIT_TIMEOUT', timeoutMs })); }, timeoutMs);
      if (options.signal) { if (options.signal.aborted) aborted(); else options.signal.addEventListener('abort', aborted, { once: true }); }
    });
  }

  iterate(event, options = {}) {
    const queue = []; const waiters = []; const maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 1_000); let closed = false;
    const handle = this.subscribe(event, (...args) => { const value = args.length <= 1 ? args[0] : args; const waiter = waiters.shift(); if (waiter) waiter.resolve({ value, done: false }); else { if (queue.length >= maxItems) queue.shift(); queue.push(value); } });
    const close = () => { if (closed) return; closed = true; handle.dispose(); for (const waiter of waiters.splice(0)) waiter.resolve({ value: undefined, done: true }); };
    options.signal?.addEventListener?.('abort', close, { once: true });
    return { [Symbol.asyncIterator]() { return this; }, next() { if (queue.length) return Promise.resolve({ value: queue.shift(), done: false }); if (closed) return Promise.resolve({ value: undefined, done: true }); return new Promise((resolve, reject) => waiters.push({ resolve, reject })); }, return() { close(); return Promise.resolve({ value: undefined, done: true }); }, close };
  }

  getHistory(event, options = {}) { const values = (this.history.get(this._name(event)) || []).slice(); return options.limit ? values.slice(-Math.max(1, Number(options.limit))) : values; }
  getHistoryAll() { return Object.fromEntries([...this.history].map(([name, values]) => [name, values.slice()])); }
  clearHistory(event = null) { if (event == null) { const count = this.history.size; this.history.clear(); return count; } return this.history.delete(this._name(event)); }
  replay(event, listener, options = {}) { const entries = this.getHistory(event, options); for (const record of entries) { try { const value = listener(...record.args); if (value?.then) this._observe(value, event, null); } catch (error) { this._handleError(error, event, null); } } return entries.length; }
  freezeRegistrations() { this.registry.freeze(); return this; }
  unfreezeRegistrations() { this.registry.unfreeze(); return this; }
  registrationsFrozen() { return this.registry.registrationFrozen; }
  health() { return deepFreeze({ ok: !this.closed, ready: this.accepting && !this.closed, state: this.closed ? 'closed' : this.accepting ? 'ready' : 'draining', listeners: this.registry.total, pending: this.pending.size, stats: { ...this.statsValue } }); }
  metrics() { return deepFreeze({ ...this.statsValue }); }
  stats() { return this.health(); }
  snapshot() { return deepFreeze({ ...this.health(), context: this.contexts.snapshot(), history: { events: this.history.size, limit: this.historyLimit }, registrationsFrozen: this.registrationsFrozen() }); }
  async flush() { await Promise.allSettled([...this.pending]); return this.snapshot(); }
  async drain() { this.accepting = false; return this.flush(); }
  async close() { if (this.closed) return this.snapshot(); this.accepting = false; await this.flush(); this.registry.clear(); this.history.clear(); this.closed = true; return this.snapshot(); }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await this.close(); }

  _name(event) { return assertEventName(normalizeEventName(String(event), this.normalizeDot)); }
  _assertOpen() { if (this.closed || !this.accepting) throw Object.assign(new Error('Browser event dispatcher is closed.'), { code: 'EVENT_CLOSED' }); }
  _assertDispatch() { if (this.closed) throw Object.assign(new Error('Browser event dispatcher is closed.'), { code: 'EVENT_CLOSED' }); }
  _bindSignal(handle, signal) { if (!signal) return; if (signal.aborted) handle.dispose(); else signal.addEventListener('abort', () => handle.dispose(), { once: true }); }
  _claim(entry) { return entry.once ? this.registry.claimOnce(entry) : entry.active; }
  _invokeSync(entry, args, eventName) { if (!entry.active || entry.paused || !this._claim(entry)) return; this.statsValue.listenersInvoked++; try { const value = entry.fn(...args); if (value?.then) this._observe(value, eventName, entry); } catch (error) { this._handleError(error, eventName, entry); if ((entry.errorPolicy || this.errorPolicy) === 'fail-fast') throw error; } }
  async _invokeAsync(entry, args, eventName) { if (!entry.active || entry.paused || !this._claim(entry)) return; this.statsValue.listenersInvoked++; try { return await timeout(Promise.resolve(entry.fn(...args)), entry.timeoutMs, { code: 'EVENT_LISTENER_TIMEOUT' }); } catch (error) { this._handleError(error, eventName, entry); if ((entry.errorPolicy || this.errorPolicy) === 'fail-fast') throw error; return undefined; } }
  _observe(promise, eventName, entry) { this.statsValue.promisesObserved++; let tracked; tracked = Promise.resolve(promise).catch((error) => this._handleError(error, eventName, entry)).finally(() => this.pending.delete(tracked)); this.pending.add(tracked); }
  _handleError(error, eventName, entry) { this.statsValue.errors++; if (eventName !== 'listener:error' && this.hasListeners('listener:error')) { try { this.dispatch('listener:error', error, { eventName, listener: entry ? this.registry.describeEntry(entry) : null }); return; } catch {} } globalThis.console?.error?.(`[RawNode Events] listener error on '${eventName}'`, error); }
  _record(eventName, args) { if (!this.historyLimit) return; if (!this.history.has(eventName) && this.history.size >= this.historyEventLimit) this.history.delete(this.history.keys().next().value); const list = this.history.get(eventName) || []; const payload = cloneSafe(args, { maxDepth: 12, maxKeys: 2_000, maxStringBytes: this.maxHistoryPayloadBytes || 64 * 1024 }); list.push(deepFreeze({ eventName, at: Date.now(), args: payload, context: cloneSafe(this.getContext(), { maxDepth: 8, maxKeys: 256 }) })); while (list.length > this.historyLimit) list.shift(); this.history.set(eventName, list); this.statsValue.historyRecorded++; }
}

export default BrowserEventDispatcher;

'use strict';

import { safeError } from '../universal/support/safe.js';

export class BrowserLifecycleAdapter {
  constructor(fabric, options = {}) { this.fabric = fabric; this.window = options.window || globalThis.window || null; this.document = options.document || globalThis.document || null; this.captureErrors = options.captureErrors === true; this.listeners = []; this.started = false; }
  start() {
    if (this.started) return this; this.started = true;
    this._listen(this.window, 'online', () => this._emit('browser:online', { online: true }));
    this._listen(this.window, 'offline', () => this._emit('browser:offline', { online: false }));
    this._listen(this.window, 'focus', () => this._emit('browser:focus', {}));
    this._listen(this.window, 'blur', () => this._emit('browser:blur', {}));
    this._listen(this.window, 'pageshow', (event) => this._emit('browser:page:shown', { persisted: event.persisted === true }));
    this._listen(this.window, 'pagehide', (event) => this._emit('browser:page:hidden', { persisted: event.persisted === true }));
    this._listen(this.window, 'popstate', (event) => this._emit('browser:history:popstate', { state: event.state }));
    this._listen(this.window, 'hashchange', (event) => this._emit('browser:history:hashchange', { oldURL: event.oldURL, newURL: event.newURL }));
    this._listen(this.document, 'visibilitychange', () => this._emit(`browser:visibility:${this.document.visibilityState}`, { state: this.document.visibilityState, hidden: this.document.hidden === true }));
    if (this.captureErrors) {
      this._listen(this.window, 'error', (event) => this._emit('browser:error', { message: event.message || null, filename: event.filename || null, line: event.lineno || null, column: event.colno || null, error: safeError(event.error) }));
      this._listen(this.window, 'unhandledrejection', (event) => this._emit('browser:promise:unhandled', { reason: safeError(event.reason) }));
    }
    this._emit('browser:lifecycle:started', { online: globalThis.navigator?.onLine ?? null, visibility: this.document?.visibilityState || null });
    return this;
  }
  _listen(target, name, listener, options = {}) { if (!target?.addEventListener) return; target.addEventListener(name, listener, options); this.listeners.push([target, name, listener, options]); }
  _emit(name, payload) { try { this.fabric.dispatch(name, payload); } catch {} }
  close() { for (const [target, name, listener, options] of this.listeners.splice(0)) target.removeEventListener?.(name, listener, options); this.started = false; }
  snapshot() { return { started: this.started, listeners: this.listeners.length, captureErrors: this.captureErrors, online: globalThis.navigator?.onLine ?? null, visibility: this.document?.visibilityState || null }; }
}
export default BrowserLifecycleAdapter;

'use strict';

import { cloneSafe, deepFreeze } from '../universal/support/safe.js';

export class DomEventTargetAdapter {
  constructor(fabric, target = null, options = {}) { this.fabric = fabric; this.defaultTarget = target || globalThis.document || null; this.maxSnapshotBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxSnapshotBytes) || 64 * 1024); this.listeners = new Set(); }
  target(target = this.defaultTarget) { return new BoundDomEventTarget(this, target); }
  listen(type, options, listener = null) { if (typeof options === 'function') { listener = options; options = {}; } return this._listen(this.defaultTarget, type, options || {}, listener); }
  _listen(target, type, options, listener) {
    if (!target?.addEventListener) throw new TypeError('DOM EventTarget is unavailable.');
    if (typeof listener !== 'function') throw new TypeError('DOM event listener must be a function.');
    const name = String(type);
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const signal = linkSignal(options.signal, controller);
    const record = { target, name, controller, options, listener: null };
    const handler = (nativeEvent) => {
      const matched = options.selector ? delegatedTarget(nativeEvent, target, options.selector) : nativeEvent.target || target;
      if (!matched) return;
      if (options.prevent === true || options.preventDefault === true) nativeEvent.preventDefault?.();
      if (options.stop === true || options.stopPropagation === true) nativeEvent.stopPropagation?.();
      if (options.stopImmediate === true) nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation?.();
      const snapshot = snapshotDomEvent(nativeEvent, matched, options);
      const context = Object.freeze({ nativeEvent, target: matched, currentTarget: target, snapshot, signal: controller.signal, fabric: this.fabric });
      const value = listener(context);
      if (options.eventName) {
        const semantic = typeof options.map === 'function' ? options.map(context) : options.payload !== undefined ? options.payload : snapshot;
        if (options.publish === true) void this.fabric.event(options.eventName).payload(semantic).meta({ source: 'dom', domType: name }).publish({ ...(options.publishOptions || {}), localEcho: options.localEcho === true });
        else this.fabric.dispatch(options.eventName, semantic);
      }
      return value;
    };
    record.listener = handler;
    target.addEventListener(name, handler, { capture: options.capture === true, passive: options.passive === true, once: options.once === true, signal: controller.signal });
    const dispose = () => { if (!this.listeners.delete(record)) return false; controller.abort('dom-listener-disposed'); try { target.removeEventListener(name, handler, { capture: options.capture === true }); } catch {} return true; };
    record.dispose = dispose; this.listeners.add(record);
    return Object.freeze({ dispose, unsubscribe: dispose, target, type: name, signal: controller.signal, [Symbol.dispose]: dispose });
  }
  close() { for (const record of [...this.listeners]) record.dispose(); this.listeners.clear(); }
  snapshot() { return deepFreeze({ listeners: this.listeners.size, entries: [...this.listeners].map((entry) => ({ type: entry.name, selector: entry.options.selector || null, capture: entry.options.capture === true, passive: entry.options.passive === true, semanticEvent: entry.options.eventName || null })) }); }
}

export class BoundDomEventTarget {
  constructor(adapter, target) { this.adapter = adapter; this.value = target; }
  listen(type, options, listener = null) { if (typeof options === 'function') return this.adapter._listen(this.value, type, {}, options); return this.adapter._listen(this.value, type, options || {}, listener); }
  on(type, listener, options = {}) { return this.adapter._listen(this.value, type, options, listener); }
  once(type, listener, options = {}) { return this.adapter._listen(this.value, type, { ...options, once: true }, listener); }
}

export function snapshotDomEvent(event, target = event?.target, options = {}) {
  const allowedData = Array.isArray(options.dataAttributes) ? options.dataAttributes : [];
  const detail = event?.detail == null ? null : cloneSafe(event.detail, { maxDepth: 6, maxKeys: 256, maxArrayItems: 64, maxStringBytes: 4_096 });
  const output = {
    type: String(event?.type || ''),
    timeStamp: Number(event?.timeStamp) || Date.now(),
    bubbles: event?.bubbles === true,
    cancelable: event?.cancelable === true,
    composed: event?.composed === true,
    defaultPrevented: event?.defaultPrevented === true,
    key: event?.key || null,
    code: event?.code || null,
    repeat: event?.repeat === true,
    button: Number.isFinite(event?.button) ? event.button : null,
    buttons: Number.isFinite(event?.buttons) ? event.buttons : null,
    clientX: Number.isFinite(event?.clientX) ? event.clientX : null,
    clientY: Number.isFinite(event?.clientY) ? event.clientY : null,
    pointerType: event?.pointerType || null,
    modifiers: { alt: event?.altKey === true, ctrl: event?.ctrlKey === true, meta: event?.metaKey === true, shift: event?.shiftKey === true },
    target: target ? { id: target.id || null, name: target.getAttribute?.('name') || null, tag: target.tagName?.toLowerCase?.() || null, role: target.getAttribute?.('role') || null, type: target.getAttribute?.('type') || null, value: options.includeValue === true ? safeValue(target.value) : undefined, checked: typeof target.checked === 'boolean' ? target.checked : undefined, data: Object.fromEntries(allowedData.map((key) => [key, target.dataset?.[key]]).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined)) } : null,
    detail,
  };
  return deepFreeze(output);
}
function delegatedTarget(event, root, selector) { for (const node of event.composedPath?.() || []) if (node?.matches?.(selector) && (node === root || root?.contains?.(node) || root === globalThis.document || root === globalThis.window)) return node; return event.target?.closest?.(selector) || null; }
function linkSignal(signal, controller) { if (!signal) return controller.signal; if (signal.aborted) controller.abort(signal.reason); else signal.addEventListener('abort', () => controller.abort(signal.reason), { once: true }); return controller.signal; }

'use strict';

import { resolveEventCompatibilityProfile } from '../compatibility/CompatibilityProfile.js';
import { UniversalEventFabric } from '../universal/UniversalEventFabric.js';
import { BrowserEventDispatcher } from './BrowserEventDispatcher.js';
import { BrowserRuntimeAdapter } from './runtime/BrowserRuntimeAdapter.js';
import { WebEventCrypto } from './crypto/WebEventCrypto.js';

import { BrowserLifecycleAdapter } from './BrowserLifecycleAdapter.js';

  BroadcastChannelEventTransport,
  DomCustomEventTransport,
  LiveEventTransport,
  MessagePortEventTransport,
  ServiceWorkerEventTransport,
  WebSocketEventTransport,
} from './transports/index.js';

/** Complete RawNode Universal Event Fabric runtime for windows and workers. */
export class BrowserEventFabric extends UniversalEventFabric {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    const profile = resolveEventCompatibilityProfile(options.profile || options.configuration?.profile || 'compat', options.compatibilityOverrides || {});
    const browser = { ...profile.browser, ...(options.browser || {}) };
    const runtime = options.runtime || new BrowserRuntimeAdapter(options.runtimeOptions || {});
    const dispatcher = options.dispatcher || new BrowserEventDispatcher({
      profile: profile.name,
      normalizeDot: options.normalizeDot === true,
      errorPolicy: options.errorPolicy || (profile.name === 'compat' ? 'isolate' : 'fail-fast'),
      listeners: options.listeners,
      history: options.history,
      context: options.context,
    });
    const cryptoProvider = options.cryptoProvider || createCrypto(options.crypto || options.security || {});
    const transportList = [
      ...(options.transportList || []),
      ...createBrowserTransports({ ...options, browser, profile }),
    ];
    super({
      ...options,
      profile,
      runtime,
      dispatcher,
      cryptoProvider,
      transportList,
      ownTransports: true,
      application: options.application || globalThis.RawNode?.application || null,
      nodeId: options.nodeId || browser.tabId || readTabId(),
    });
    this.browserOptions = Object.freeze(browser);
    this.dom = options.domAdapter || new DomEventTargetAdapter(this, options.document || globalThis.document || null, options.dom || {});
    this.lifecycle = options.lifecycleAdapter || new BrowserLifecycleAdapter(this, {
      ...browser,
      ...(options.lifecycle || {}),
      captureErrors: options.lifecycle?.captureErrors ?? browser.captureErrors,
    });
    this.integrations = options.integrationManager || new BrowserIntegrationManager(this, {
      ...(options.integrations || {}),
      live: options.integrations?.live ?? options.liveIntegration,
      sdspa: options.integrations?.sdspa ?? options.sdspaIntegration,
      reactive: options.integrations?.reactive ?? options.reactiveIntegration,
      view: options.integrations?.view ?? options.viewIntegration,
    });
    this.exposed = false;
  }

  async start(context = {}) {
    await super.start(context);
    if (this.browserOptions.captureLifecycle !== false) this.lifecycle.start();
    if (context.startIntegrations !== false) await this.integrations.start();
    if (this.browserOptions.exposeGlobal !== false) this.exposeGlobal({ replace: context.replaceGlobal === true });
    this.dispatch('events:fabric:browser:started', { profile: this.profile.name, runtime: this.runtime.name, transports: this.transports.names() });
    return this;
  }

  exposeGlobal(options = {}) {
    const root = globalThis.RawNode ||= {};
    const lower = globalThis.rawnode ||= root;
    const key = this.browserOptions.globalKey || 'events';
    root.eventFabric = this;
    root.EventFabric = this;
    root.Events = root.Events || {};
    root.Events.fabric = this;
    root.Events.dispatcher = this.dispatcher;
    root.Events.createContext = (meta) => this.createContext(meta);
    root.Events.target = (target) => this.target(target);
    if (options.replace === true || root[key] == null) root[key] = this.dispatcher;
    if (options.replace === true || lower[key] == null) lower[key] = root[key];
    lower.eventFabric = this;
    this.exposed = true;
    return this;
  }

  target(target = globalThis.document) { return this.dom.target(target); }
  listen(type, options, listener) { return this.dom.listen(type, options, listener); }
  async installIntegrations(options = {}) { await this.integrations.install(options); return this; }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      ...super.snapshot(),
      browser: {
        exposed: this.exposed,
        options: this.browserOptions,
        dom: this.dom.snapshot(),
        lifecycle: this.lifecycle.snapshot(),
        integrations: this.integrations.snapshot(),
      },
    });
  }

  async close(options = {}) {
    try { await this.integrations.close(); } catch {}
    try { this.lifecycle.close(); } catch {}
    try { this.dom.close(); } catch {}
    const snapshot = await super.close(options);
    if (this.exposed) {
      const root = globalThis.RawNode;
      if (root?.eventFabric === this) delete root.eventFabric;
      if (root?.EventFabric === this) delete root.EventFabric;
      if (root?.Events?.fabric === this) delete root.Events.fabric;
      if (globalThis.rawnode?.eventFabric === this) delete globalThis.rawnode.eventFabric;
    }
    this.exposed = false;
    return snapshot;
  }
}

export function createBrowserEventFabric(options = {}) { return new BrowserEventFabric(options); }

function createCrypto(options) {
  if (!options || (!options.secret && !Array.isArray(options.keys))) return null;
  return new WebEventCrypto(options);
}

function createBrowserTransports(options) {
  const transports = [];
  const browser = options.browser || {};
  if (browser.crossTab === true && typeof globalThis.BroadcastChannel === 'function') {
    transports.push(new BroadcastChannelEventTransport({ ...(object(options.crossTab)), channelName: options.crossTab?.channelName || browser.channelName }));
  }
  if ((browser.bridgeDomEvents === true || options.domTransport === true || typeof options.domTransport === 'object') && globalThis.document) {
    transports.push(new DomCustomEventTransport({ ...(object(options.domTransport)), target: options.domTransport?.target || globalThis.document }));
  }
  if ((browser.serviceWorker === true || options.serviceWorker === true || typeof options.serviceWorker === 'object') && (globalThis.navigator?.serviceWorker || globalThis.clients)) {
    transports.push(new ServiceWorkerEventTransport(object(options.serviceWorker)));
  }
  if (options.socket) transports.push(new WebSocketEventTransport(options.socket, object(options.websocket)));
  const live = options.liveRuntime || globalThis.RawNodeLive || globalThis.RawNode?.live || null;
  if (live && options.liveTransport !== false) transports.push(new LiveEventTransport(live, object(options.liveTransport)));
  for (const entry of options.messagePorts || []) {
    const port = entry?.port || entry;
    if (port) transports.push(new MessagePortEventTransport(port, entry?.port ? entry : {}));
  }
  return transports;
}
function object(value) { return value && typeof value === 'object' ? value : {}; }
function readTabId() {
  try {
    const key = 'rawnode.events.tabId';
    let value = globalThis.sessionStorage?.getItem?.(key);
    if (!value) { value = globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() || `tab-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`; globalThis.sessionStorage?.setItem?.(key, value); }
    return value;
  } catch { return globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() || `browser-${Date.now()}`; }
}
