'use strict';

import { LiveEventsBridge } from './LiveEventsBridge.js';
import { SdspaEventsBridge } from './SdspaEventsBridge.js';
import { ReactiveEventsBridge } from './ReactiveEventsBridge.js';
import { ViewEventsBridge } from './ViewEventsBridge.js';

export class BrowserIntegrationManager {
  constructor(fabric, options = {}) {
    this.fabric = fabric;
    this.options = options;
    this.integrations = new Map();
    this.started = false;
    this.register('live', options.live === false ? null : new LiveEventsBridge(fabric, object(options.live)));
    this.register('sdspa', options.sdspa === false ? null : new SdspaEventsBridge(fabric, object(options.sdspa)));
    this.register('reactive', options.reactive === false ? null : new ReactiveEventsBridge(fabric, object(options.reactive)));
    this.register('view', options.view === false ? null : new ViewEventsBridge(fabric, object(options.view)));
    for (const integration of options.integrations || []) this.register(integration.id || integration.name, integration);
  }
  register(id, integration, options = {}) {
    if (!integration) return this;
    const key = String(id || integration.id || integration.constructor?.name || '').trim();
    if (!key) throw new TypeError('Browser integration requires an id.');
    if (this.integrations.has(key) && options.replace !== true) throw Object.assign(new Error(`Browser event integration already exists: ${key}`), { code: 'EVENT_BROWSER_INTEGRATION_DUPLICATE' });
    this.integrations.set(key, integration);
    return this;
  }
  async install(options = {}) {
    const entries = Array.isArray(options)
      ? options
      : Array.isArray(options.integrations)
        ? options.integrations
        : [];
    for (const integration of entries) {
      if (!integration) continue;
      this.register(integration.id || integration.name, integration, {
        replace: options.replace === true || integration.replace === true,
      });
    }
    if (options.start !== false) await this.start();
    return this;
  }

  async start() {
    if (this.started) return this;
    for (const integration of this.integrations.values()) await integration.start?.();
    this.started = true;
    return this;
  }
  async close() {
    for (const integration of [...this.integrations.values()].reverse()) await integration.close?.();
    this.started = false;
    return this.snapshot();
  }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ started: this.started, integrations: Object.fromEntries([...this.integrations].map(([id, integration]) => [id, integration.snapshot?.() || { id, started: null }])) }); }
}

'use strict';

const BRIDGE_MARK = Symbol.for('rawnode.events.live.bridge');

/**
 * Mirrors RawNode Live lifecycle events into the Universal Event Fabric without
 * replacing LiveLifecycleBus or changing any existing listener semantics.
 */
export class LiveEventsBridge {
  constructor(fabric, options = {}) {
    if (!fabric) throw new TypeError('LiveEventsBridge requires an event fabric.');
    this.fabric = fabric;
    this.runtime = options.runtime || globalThis.RawNodeLive || globalThis.rawnodeLive || globalThis.RawNode?.live || globalThis.rawnode?.live || null;
    this.prefix = options.prefix || '';
    this.include = compileList(options.include || ['**']);
    this.exclude = compileList(options.exclude || ['rawnode:event']);
    this.mirrorToLive = options.mirrorToLive === true;
    this.started = false;
    this.forwarding = 0;
    this.off = null;
    this.reverseHandle = null;
    this.stats = { received: 0, forwarded: 0, reverseForwarded: 0, ignored: 0, errors: 0 };
  }

  start() {
    if (this.started) return this;
    const lifecycle = this.runtime?.Browser?.lifecycle || this.runtime?.browser?.lifecycle || this.runtime?.lifecycle || null;
    if (!lifecycle?.on) return this;
    this.started = true;
    const handler = (payload, envelope = {}) => {
      const name = String(envelope.event || envelope.name || payload?.event || 'live:event');
      if (payload?.[BRIDGE_MARK] || !this.accepts(name)) { this.stats.ignored++; return; }
      this.stats.received++;
      this.forwarding++;
      try {
        const eventName = this.prefix ? `${this.prefix}${name}` : name;
        const value = this.fabric.dispatchAsync(eventName, payload, {
          context: { source: { runtime: 'browser', integration: 'live' }, nativeEvent: envelope },
        });
        Promise.resolve(value).then(() => { this.stats.forwarded++; }, () => { this.stats.errors++; });
      } finally { this.forwarding--; }
    };
    this.off = lifecycle.on('*', handler, { priority: -10_000 });

    if (this.mirrorToLive && this.fabric.dispatcher?.subscribeAny) {
      this.reverseHandle = this.fabric.dispatcher.subscribeAny((name, payload) => {
        if (this.forwarding || !this.accepts(name)) return;
        const mirrored = markPayload(payload);
        this.stats.reverseForwarded++;
        return lifecycle.emit?.(name, mirrored, { clone: false });
      }, { tag: 'rawnode-events:live-bridge', priority: -10_000 });
    }
    return this;
  }

  accepts(name) {
    return this.include.some((match) => match(name)) && !this.exclude.some((match) => match(name));
  }

  close() {
    try { this.off?.(); } catch {}
    try { this.reverseHandle?.dispose?.(); } catch {}
    this.off = null;
    this.reverseHandle = null;
    this.started = false;
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({ id: 'live', available: !!this.runtime, started: this.started, mirrorToLive: this.mirrorToLive, stats: { ...this.stats } });
  }
}

function markPayload(payload) {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return { value: payload, [BRIDGE_MARK]: true };
  try { return Object.assign(Array.isArray(payload) ? [...payload] : { ...payload }, { [BRIDGE_MARK]: true }); }
  catch { return { value: payload, [BRIDGE_MARK]: true }; }
}
function compileList(patterns) { return (Array.isArray(patterns) ? patterns : [patterns]).map((pattern) => compileGlob(String(pattern))); }
function compileGlob(pattern) {
  if (pattern === '*' || pattern === '**') return () => true;
  const source = pattern.split('**').map((part) => part.split('*').map(escape).join('[^:]*')).join('.*');
  const regex = new RegExp(`^${source}$`);
  return (value) => regex.test(String(value));
}
function escape(value) { return value.replace(/[|\\{}()[\]^$+?.]/g, '\\$&'); }
export default LiveEventsBridge;

'use strict';

const DEFAULT_EVENTS = Object.freeze([
  'sdspa:navigation:before', 'sdspa:navigation:started', 'sdspa:navigation:fetched',
  'sdspa:navigation:validated', 'sdspa:assets:prepared', 'sdspa:page:leaving',
  'sdspa:dom:committed', 'sdspa:page:activating', 'sdspa:navigation:ready',
  'sdspa:navigation:cancelled', 'sdspa:navigation:error',
]);
const MARK = '__rawnodeUniversalEventFabric';

/** Preserve SDSPA CustomEvents while exposing them on the canonical event bus. */
export class SdspaEventsBridge {
  constructor(fabric, options = {}) {
    if (!fabric) throw new TypeError('SdspaEventsBridge requires an event fabric.');
    this.fabric = fabric;
    this.document = options.document || globalThis.document || null;
    this.events = Object.freeze([...(options.events || DEFAULT_EVENTS)]);
    this.mirrorToDocument = options.mirrorToDocument === true;
    this.listeners = [];
    this.reverse = [];
    this.started = false;
    this.stats = { received: 0, forwarded: 0, reverseForwarded: 0, ignored: 0, errors: 0 };
  }
  start() {
    if (this.started || !this.document?.addEventListener) return this;
    this.started = true;
    for (const name of this.events) {
      const listener = (event) => {
        if (event?.detail?.[MARK]) { this.stats.ignored++; return; }
        this.stats.received++;
        Promise.resolve(this.fabric.dispatchAsync(name, event?.detail, {
          context: { source: { runtime: 'browser', integration: 'sdspa' }, nativeEvent: event },
        })).then(() => { this.stats.forwarded++; }, () => { this.stats.errors++; });
      };
      this.document.addEventListener(name, listener);
      this.listeners.push([name, listener]);
      if (this.mirrorToDocument && this.fabric.dispatcher?.subscribe) {
        const handle = this.fabric.dispatcher.subscribe(name, (payload) => {
          if (typeof CustomEvent !== 'function') return;
          const detail = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? { ...payload, [MARK]: true } : { value: payload, [MARK]: true };
          this.stats.reverseForwarded++;
          this.document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(name, { detail }));
        }, { tag: 'rawnode-events:sdspa-bridge', priority: -10_000 });
        this.reverse.push(handle);
      }
    }
    return this;
  }
  close() {
    for (const [name, listener] of this.listeners) this.document?.removeEventListener?.(name, listener);
    for (const handle of this.reverse) handle?.dispose?.();
    this.listeners = [];
    this.reverse = [];
    this.started = false;
    return this.snapshot();
  }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ id: 'sdspa', available: !!this.document, started: this.started, events: this.events.length, mirrorToDocument: this.mirrorToDocument, stats: { ...this.stats } }); }
}

'use strict';

const PATCH = Symbol.for('rawnode.events.reactive.patch');

/**
 * Reversibly instruments the existing Reactive EventBus. It never changes the
 * return value, listener order, error handling, or synchronous behavior of the
 * original emit()/emitAsync() methods.
 */
export class ReactiveEventsBridge {
  constructor(fabric, options = {}) {
    if (!fabric) throw new TypeError('ReactiveEventsBridge requires an event fabric.');
    this.fabric = fabric;
    this.runtime = options.runtime || globalThis.RawNode?.reactive || globalThis.rawnode?.reactive || globalThis.RawNodeReactive || null;
    this.bus = options.bus || locateBus(this.runtime);
    this.prefix = options.prefix || '';
    this.started = false;
    this.depth = 0;
    this.stats = { emitted: 0, asyncEmitted: 0, forwarded: 0, errors: 0 };
  }
  start() {
    if (this.started || !this.bus || this.bus[PATCH]) return this;
    const emit = typeof this.bus.emit === 'function' ? this.bus.emit.bind(this.bus) : null;
    const emitAsync = typeof this.bus.emitAsync === 'function' ? this.bus.emitAsync.bind(this.bus) : null;
    if (!emit && !emitAsync) return this;
    const bridge = this;
    const descriptor = { emit, emitAsync };
    Object.defineProperty(this.bus, PATCH, { value: descriptor, configurable: true });
    if (emit) this.bus.emit = function patchedReactiveEmit(name, ...args) {
      const result = emit(name, ...args);
      bridge.stats.emitted++;
      bridge.forward(name, args);
      return result;
    };
    if (emitAsync) this.bus.emitAsync = async function patchedReactiveEmitAsync(name, ...args) {
      const result = await emitAsync(name, ...args);
      bridge.stats.asyncEmitted++;
      await bridge.forward(name, args, true);
      return result;
    };
    this.started = true;
    return this;
  }
  forward(name, args, awaitResult = false) {
    if (this.depth) return undefined;
    this.depth++;
    try {
      const eventName = this.prefix ? `${this.prefix}${name}` : String(name);
      const payload = args.length <= 1 ? args[0] : args;
      const operation = this.fabric.dispatchAsync(eventName, payload, { context: { source: { runtime: 'browser', integration: 'reactive' } } });
      if (awaitResult) return Promise.resolve(operation).then((value) => { this.stats.forwarded++; return value; }, (error) => { this.stats.errors++; throw error; }).finally(() => { this.depth--; });
      Promise.resolve(operation).then(() => { this.stats.forwarded++; }, () => { this.stats.errors++; });
      return operation;
    } finally { if (!awaitResult) this.depth--; }
  }
  close() {
    const original = this.bus?.[PATCH];
    if (original) {
      if (original.emit) this.bus.emit = original.emit;
      if (original.emitAsync) this.bus.emitAsync = original.emitAsync;
      try { delete this.bus[PATCH]; } catch {}
    }
    this.started = false;
    return this.snapshot();
  }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ id: 'reactive', available: !!this.bus, started: this.started, stats: { ...this.stats } }); }
}
function locateBus(runtime) {
  const candidates = [runtime?.events, runtime?.eventBus, runtime?.bus, runtime?.lifecycle, runtime];
  return candidates.find((value) => value && (typeof value.emit === 'function' || typeof value.emitAsync === 'function')) || null;
}
export default ReactiveEventsBridge;

'use strict';

const OBJECT_OVERHEAD = 8;
const ACCESSOR_OVERHEAD = 8;
const FUNCTION_FALLBACK = 'function';
const ERROR_NAME_FALLBACK = 'Error';

/**
 * Estimate a value's retained byte footprint without serializing it.
 *
 * This utility is intentionally defensive because event payloads can contain
 * callable proxies, framework facades, host objects, accessors, circular
 * references, and revoked proxies. Size estimation must never execute user
 * getters or escape as an infrastructure exception.
 */
export function approximateByteSize(value, options = {}) {
  const maximum = normalizeMaximum(options.maximum);
  const maxDepth = positiveInteger(options.maxDepth, 32);
  const maxItems = positiveInteger(options.maxItems, 100_000);
  const seen = new WeakSet();
  let items = 0;

  function visit(current, depth) {
    if (items++ > maxItems) return maximum;

    try {
      return visitUnsafe(current, depth);
    } catch {
      /*
       * Fail closed. Callers normally pass `limit + 1` as maximum, so an
       * uninspectable value is rejected as oversized instead of crashing the
       * application request that emitted the event.
       */
      return maximum;
    }
  }

  function visitUnsafe(current, depth) {
    if (current == null) return 4;

    switch (typeof current) {
      case 'string':
        return utf8Bytes(current);

      case 'number':
        return 8;

      case 'bigint':
        return utf8Bytes(current.toString()) + 1;

      case 'boolean':
        return 4;

      case 'undefined':
        return 0;

      case 'symbol':
        return utf8Bytes(safeSymbolText(current));

      case 'function':
        return utf8Bytes(safeFunctionName(current));

      default:
        break;
    }

    if (Buffer.isBuffer(current)) return current.byteLength;
    if (current instanceof Uint8Array) return current.byteLength;
    if (current instanceof ArrayBuffer) return current.byteLength;
    if (typeof SharedArrayBuffer !== 'undefined' && current instanceof SharedArrayBuffer) {
      return current.byteLength;
    }
    if (current instanceof Date) return 24;
    if (current instanceof RegExp) {
      return boundedAdd(
        utf8Bytes(safeStringProperty(current, 'source', '')),
        utf8Bytes(safeStringProperty(current, 'flags', '')),
        maximum,
      );
    }
    if (current instanceof Error) {
      return boundedAdd(
        utf8Bytes(safeStringProperty(current, 'name', ERROR_NAME_FALLBACK)),
        utf8Bytes(safeStringProperty(current, 'message', '')),
        maximum,
      );
    }

    if (depth >= maxDepth) return OBJECT_OVERHEAD;
    if (seen.has(current)) return OBJECT_OVERHEAD;
    seen.add(current);

    let total = OBJECT_OVERHEAD;
    const add = (bytes) => {
      total += bytes;
      if (total >= maximum) total = maximum;
      return total < maximum;
    };

    if (Array.isArray(current)) {
      const length = safeArrayLength(current);

      for (let index = 0; index < length; index++) {
        let item;
        try {
          item = current[index];
        } catch {
          item = '[ReadError]';
        }

        if (!add(visit(item, depth + 1))) break;
      }

      return total;
    }

    if (current instanceof Set) {
      try {
        for (const item of current) {
          if (!add(visit(item, depth + 1))) break;
        }
      } catch {
        return maximum;
      }

      return total;
    }

    if (current instanceof Map) {
      try {
        for (const [key, item] of current) {
          if (!add(visit(key, depth + 1))) break;
          if (!add(visit(item, depth + 1))) break;
        }
      } catch {
        return maximum;
      }

      return total;
    }

    let keys;
    try {
      keys = Object.keys(current);
    } catch {
      return maximum;
    }

    for (const key of keys) {
      if (!add(utf8Bytes(key))) break;

      let descriptor;
      try {
        descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(current, key);
      } catch {
        return maximum;
      }

      if (!descriptor) continue;

      /*
       * Never invoke accessors while measuring an event. Getters can perform
       * I/O, mutate state, throw, or expose secrets. Count the accessor as a
       * bounded opaque slot instead.
       */
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(descriptor, 'value')) {
        if (!add(ACCESSOR_OVERHEAD)) break;
        continue;
      }

      if (!add(visit(descriptor.value, depth + 1))) break;
    }

    return total;
  }

  return Math.min(maximum, visit(value, 0));
}

export function normalizeByteLimit(value, fallback = Infinity) {
  if (value === Infinity) return Infinity;
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(number) && number >= 0 ? number : fallback;
}

export function normalizePositiveInteger(value, fallback, { allowZero = false } = {}) {
  const number = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(number)) return fallback;
  if (allowZero ? number < 0 : number < 1) return fallback;
  return number;
}

function safeFunctionName(value) {
  return safeStringProperty(value, 'name', FUNCTION_FALLBACK);
}

function safeStringProperty(target, key, fallback = '') {
  try {
    const value = Reflect.get(target, key);
    return typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0
      ? value
      : fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

function safeSymbolText(value) {
  try {
    return String(value);
  } catch {
    return 'Symbol';
  }
}

function safeArrayLength(value) {
  try {
    const length = Number(value.length);
    return Number.isSafeInteger(length) && length >= 0 ? length : 0;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}

function utf8Bytes(value) {
  return Buffer.byteLength(
    typeof value === 'string' ? value : '',
    'utf8',
  );
}

function positiveInteger(value, fallback) {
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(number) && number > 0 ? number : fallback;
}

function normalizeMaximum(value) {
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(number) && number > 0
    ? number
    : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
}

function boundedAdd(left, right, maximum) {
  return Math.min(maximum, left + right);
}

export function estimateValueBytes(value, options = {}) {
  return approximateByteSize(value, options);
}

'use strict';

export function createLogger(logger) {
  const target = logger && typeof logger === 'object' ? logger : console;
  const bind = (name, fallback = null) => {
    if (typeof target[name] === 'function') return target[name].bind(target);
    if (fallback && typeof target[fallback] === 'function') return target[fallback].bind(target);
    return () => {};
  };
  return Object.freeze({
    debug: bind('debug'),
    info: bind('info', 'log'),
    warn: bind('warn', 'log'),
    error: bind('error', 'log'),
  });
}

'use strict';

export function isPromiseLike(value) {
  return !!value && (typeof value === 'object' || typeof value === 'function') && typeof value.then === 'function';
}

export function abortError(message = 'Operation aborted') {
  const error = new Error(message);
  error.name = 'AbortError';
  error.code = 'EVENT_ABORTED';
  return error;
}

export function timeoutError(ms) {
  const error = new Error(`Operation timed out after ${ms}ms`);
  error.name = 'TimeoutError';
  error.code = 'EVENT_TIMEOUT';
  error.timeoutMs = ms;
  return error;
}

export async function raceWithSignal(value, options = {}) {
  const signal = options.signal;
  const timeoutMs = Number(options.timeoutMs) || 0;
  if (signal?.aborted) throw abortError();
  if (!signal && timeoutMs <= 0) return await value;

  let timer = null;
  let onAbort = null;
  const controls = [];
  if (signal) {
    controls.push(new Promise((_, reject) => {
      onAbort = () => reject(abortError());
      signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    }));
  }
  if (timeoutMs > 0) {
    controls.push(new Promise((_, reject) => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => reject(timeoutError(timeoutMs)), timeoutMs);
      if (options.unrefTimer !== false) timer.unref?.();
    }));
  }
  try { return await Promise.race([Promise.resolve(value), ...controls]); }
  finally {
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    if (onAbort) signal?.removeEventListener?.('abort', onAbort);
  }
}

export function deferred() {
  let resolve;
  let reject;
  const promise = new Promise((res, rej) => { resolve = res; reject = rej; });
  return { promise, resolve, reject };
}

FILE PATH: ./support/ApplicationModuleResolver.js

'use strict';

import path from 'node:path';
import { createRequire, isBuiltin } from 'node:module';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const REQUIRE_CACHE = new Map();

function safeCall(callback, fallback = null) {
  try {
    const value = callback();
    return value === undefined || value === null ? fallback : value;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

/** Resolve the framework application root without coupling Events to Foundation. */
export function applicationRoot(app = null) {
  const candidates = [
    typeof app?.basePath === 'function' ? safeCall(() => app.basePath()) : null,
    typeof app?.rootPath === 'function' ? safeCall(() => app.rootPath()) : null,
    typeof app?.path === 'function' ? safeCall(() => app.path()) : null,
    typeof app?.rootPath === 'string' ? app.rootPath : null,
    typeof app?.basePath === 'string' ? app.basePath : null,
    typeof app?.root === 'string' ? app.root : null,
    process.cwd(),
  ];

  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    if (typeof candidate === 'string' && candidate.trim()) return path.resolve(candidate);
  }
  return path.resolve(process.cwd());
}

/**
 * Create a resolver whose package scope is the framework root rather than the
 * standalone `src/events/package.json` boundary.
 */
export function applicationRequire(app = null) {
  const root = applicationRoot(app);
  let resolver = REQUIRE_CACHE.get(root);
  if (!resolver) {
    resolver = createRequire(path.join(root, 'package.json'));
    REQUIRE_CACHE.set(root, resolver);
  }
  return resolver;
}

export function resolveApplicationSpecifier(app, specifier) {
  const spec = String(specifier || '').trim();
  if (!spec) throw applicationImportError(spec, applicationRoot(app), null, null, 'EVENTS_APPLICATION_IMPORT_EMPTY');
  return applicationRequire(app).resolve(spec);
}

/**
 * Import application modules from the application package scope.
 *
 * `#` package-import aliases are resolved from the framework root. Relative
 * references remain application-root-relative for compatibility. Bare package
 * references keep normal Node.js resolution semantics.
 */
export async function importApplicationModule(app, specifier, options = {}) {
  const spec = String(specifier || '').trim();
  const root = applicationRoot(app);
  if (!spec) throw applicationImportError(spec, root, null, null, 'EVENTS_APPLICATION_IMPORT_EMPTY');

  if (spec.startsWith('node:') || spec.startsWith('file:') || spec.startsWith('data:')) {
    return await import(spec);
  }

  if (spec.startsWith('#')) {
    let applicationError = null;
    try {
      const resolved = resolveApplicationSpecifier(app, spec);
      return await importResolved(resolved);
    } catch (error) {
      applicationError = error;
    }

    // Preserve package-local private imports for standalone rawnode-events use.
    if (options.fallbackToCurrentPackage !== false) {
      try {
        return await import(spec);
      } catch (packageError) {
        throw applicationImportError(
          spec,
          root,
          applicationError,
          packageError,
          'EVENTS_APPLICATION_IMPORT_UNRESOLVED',
        );
      }
    }

    throw applicationImportError(
      spec,
      root,
      applicationError,
      null,
      'EVENTS_APPLICATION_IMPORT_UNRESOLVED',
    );
  }

  if (path.isAbsolute(spec) || spec.startsWith('.')) {
    const absolute = path.isAbsolute(spec) ? spec : path.resolve(root, spec);
    return await import(pathToFileURL(absolute).href);
  }

  return await import(spec);
}

export function clearApplicationModuleResolverCache() {
  REQUIRE_CACHE.clear();
}

async function importResolved(resolved) {
  const target = String(resolved || '');
  if (target.startsWith('node:') || target.startsWith('file:') || target.startsWith('data:')) {
    return await import(target);
  }
  if (isBuiltin(target)) return await import(target.startsWith('node:') ? target : `node:${target}`);
  if (path.isAbsolute(target)) return await import(pathToFileURL(target).href);
  return await import(target);
}

function applicationImportError(specifier, root, applicationError, packageError, code) {
  const message = code === 'EVENTS_APPLICATION_IMPORT_EMPTY'
    ? 'Application module reference is empty.'
    : `Unable to resolve application module '${specifier}' from RawNode root '${root}'.`;
  const error = new Error(message, { cause: applicationError || packageError || undefined });
  error.name = 'EventApplicationImportError';
  error.code = code;
  error.details = {
    specifier: specifier || null,
    applicationRoot: root,
    applicationResolution: applicationError ? {
      name: applicationError.name || 'Error',
      code: applicationError.code || null,
      message: applicationError.message || String(applicationError),
    } : null,
    packageResolution: packageError ? {
      name: packageError.name || 'Error',
      code: packageError.code || null,
      message: packageError.message || String(packageError),
    } : null,
  };
  return error;
}

export default importApplicationModule;

'use strict';

export function normalizeEventName(name, normalizeDot = false) {
  if (typeof name !== 'string') return name;
  let value = name;
  const first = value.charCodeAt(0);
  const last = value.charCodeAt(value.length - 1);
  if (first <= 32 || last <= 32) value = value.trim();
  if (!value) return value;
  if (normalizeDot && value.includes('.')) value = value.replaceAll('.', ':');
  return value.includes('::') ? value.replace(/:{2,}/g, ':') : value;
}

export function computeWildcardEvents(eventName) {
  const value = String(eventName);
  let index = value.lastIndexOf(':');
  if (index <= 0) return [];
  const output = [];
  while (index > 0) {
    output.push(`${value.slice(0, index)}:*`);
    index = value.lastIndexOf(':', index - 1);
  }
  return output;
}

export function globPrefix(glob) {
  const value = String(glob);
  let index = 0;
  for (; index < value.length; index++) {
    const character = value[index];
    if (character === '*' || character === '?') break;
  }
  return value.slice(0, index);
}


export function firstStaticSegment(glob) {
  const first = String(glob ?? '').split(':', 1)[0] || '';
  return first.includes('*') || first.includes('?') || !first ? '*' : first;
}

export function globStaticRoot(glob) {
  const value = String(glob);
  const first = value.split(':', 1)[0] || '';
  return first.includes('*') || first.includes('?') ? null : first;
}

export function globToRegExp(glob) {
  const value = String(glob);
  let source = '^';

  for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index++) {
    const character = value[index];

    if (character === '*') {
      if (value[index + 1] === '*') {
        source += '.*';
        index++;
      } else {
        source += '[^:]*';
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (character === '?') {
      source += '[^:]';
      continue;
    }

    if ('\\.^$|()[]{}+'.includes(character)) source += `\\${character}`;
    else source += character;
  }

  source += '$';
  return new RegExp(source);
}

export function compileMatcherList(patterns) {
  if (!Array.isArray(patterns)) return [];
  return patterns
    .filter((pattern) => typeof pattern === 'string' && pattern.length > 0)
    .map((pattern) => Object.freeze({
      raw: pattern,
      prefix: globPrefix(pattern),
      root: globStaticRoot(pattern),
      regex: globToRegExp(pattern),
    }));
}

export function matchesAny(matchers, eventName) {
  if (!Array.isArray(matchers) || matchers.length === 0) return false;
  for (const matcher of matchers) {
    if (matcher.prefix && !eventName.startsWith(matcher.prefix)) continue;
    if (matcher.regex.test(eventName)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function isPattern(value) {
  const string = String(value ?? '');
  return string.includes('*') || string.includes('?');
}

'use strict';

/** Bounded TTL idempotency inbox for at-least-once consumers. */
export class MemoryEventInbox {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 100_000);
    this.ttlMs = Math.max(1, Number(options.ttlMs) || 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    this.entries = new Map();
    this.inFlight = new Map();
    this.stats = { accepted: 0, duplicates: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, evicted: 0 };
  }

  has(id, now = Date.now()) {
    const key = String(id);
    const expiresAt = this.entries.get(key);
    if (expiresAt == null) return false;
    if (expiresAt <= now) { this.entries.delete(key); return false; }
    return true;
  }

  async run(id, handler, options = {}) {
    const key = String(id || '');
    if (!key) throw new TypeError('Inbox id is required');
    if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Inbox handler must be a function');
    if (this.has(key)) { this.stats.duplicates++; return { accepted: false, duplicate: true }; }
    if (this.inFlight.has(key)) { this.stats.duplicates++; return this.inFlight.get(key); }

    const operation = (async () => {
      this.stats.accepted++;
      try {
        const value = await handler();
        this.remember(key, options.ttlMs);
        this.stats.completed++;
        return { accepted: true, duplicate: false, value };
      } catch (error) {
        this.stats.failed++;
        throw error;
      } finally {
        this.inFlight.delete(key);
      }
    })();
    this.inFlight.set(key, operation);
    return operation;
  }

  remember(id, ttlMs = this.ttlMs) {
    const now = Date.now();
    this.entries.set(String(id), now + Math.max(1, Number(ttlMs) || this.ttlMs));
    this._evict(now);
    return this;
  }

  _evict(now = Date.now()) {
    for (const [id, expiresAt] of this.entries) {
      if (expiresAt <= now) { this.entries.delete(id); this.stats.evicted++; }
    }
    while (this.entries.size > this.maxItems) {
      const id = this.entries.keys().next().value;
      this.entries.delete(id);
      this.stats.evicted++;
    }
  }

  clear() { this.entries.clear(); this.inFlight.clear(); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ items: this.entries.size, inFlight: this.inFlight.size, maxItems: this.maxItems, ttlMs: this.ttlMs, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
}

export default MemoryEventInbox;

'use strict';

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { MemoryOutboxStore } from './MemoryOutboxStore.js';
import { shallowEventContext } from '../context/EventContext.js';

export class EventOutbox {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.store = options.store || new MemoryOutboxStore(options.memory || options);
    this.dispatcher = options.dispatcher || null;
    this.schemaRegistry = options.schemaRegistry || null;
    this.nodeId = options.nodeId || `${process.pid}`;
    this.defaultMaxAttempts = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxAttempts) || 10);
  }

  async enqueue(eventOrName, args = [], options = {}) {
    const eventObject = typeof eventOrName === 'object' && eventOrName !== null ? eventOrName : null;
    const eventName = eventObject
      ? String(eventObject.constructor?.eventName || eventObject.eventName || eventObject.constructor?.name || 'Event')
      : String(eventOrName);
    const payloadArgs = eventObject ? [eventObject, ...(Array.isArray(args) ? args : [args])] : (Array.isArray(args) ? args : [args]);
    const version = Math.max(1, Number(options.version || eventObject?.version) || 1);

    if (this.schemaRegistry?.has?.(eventName, version) && eventObject?.payload !== undefined) {
      this.schemaRegistry.validate(eventName, version, eventObject.payload, { phase: 'outbox' });
    }

    const context = options.context || this.dispatcher?.getContext?.() || eventObject?.ctx || null;
    return this.store.append({
      id: options.id || eventObject?.id || randomUUID(),
      event: eventName,
      version,
      args: payloadArgs,
      context: shallowEventContext(context),
      headers: options.headers,
      idempotencyKey: options.idempotencyKey,
      maxAttempts: options.maxAttempts || this.defaultMaxAttempts,
      availableAt: options.availableAt,
      meta: { nodeId: this.nodeId, ...(options.meta || {}) },
    });
  }

  async dispatchAfterCommit(transaction, eventOrName, args = [], options = {}) {
    if (!transaction || typeof transaction.afterCommit !== 'function') {
      throw new TypeError('dispatchAfterCommit requires a transaction exposing afterCommit(callback)');
    }
    let result;
    transaction.afterCommit(async () => { result = await this.enqueue(eventOrName, args, options); });
    return { scheduled: true, get result() { return result; } };
  }

  snapshot() { return this.store.snapshot?.() || null; }
  close() { return this.store.close?.(); }
}

export default EventOutbox;

'use strict';

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { EventTransportError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

function sleep(ms, signal, unref = true) {
  if (signal?.aborted) return Promise.reject(signal.reason || new Error('Aborted'));
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let settled = false;
    const cleanup = () => signal?.removeEventListener?.('abort', abort);
    const finish = (fn, value) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      cleanup();
      fn(value);
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => finish(resolve), Math.max(0, ms));
    if (unref) timer.unref?.();
    const abort = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      finish(reject, signal.reason || new Error('Aborted'));
    };
    signal?.addEventListener?.('abort', abort, { once: true });
  });
}

async function awaitPublication(transport, eventName, args, options) {
  const admission = await transport.publish(eventName, args, options);
  if (admission?.accepted === false) {
    throw new EventTransportError('Outbox transport rejected publication', {
      code: admission.code || 'EVENT_OUTBOX_TRANSPORT_REJECTED',
      details: admission,
    });
  }
  if (admission?.promise && typeof admission.promise.then === 'function') {
    const delivery = await admission.promise;
    if (delivery?.published === false || delivery?.accepted === false) {
      throw new EventTransportError('Outbox transport did not publish the event', {
        code: delivery.code || 'EVENT_OUTBOX_TRANSPORT_NOT_PUBLISHED',
        details: delivery,
      });
    }
    return delivery;
  }
  return admission;
}

export class OutboxPublisher {
  constructor(store, transport, options = {}) {
    if (!store || typeof store.claim !== 'function') throw new TypeError('OutboxPublisher requires an outbox store');
    if (!transport || typeof transport.publish !== 'function') throw new TypeError('OutboxPublisher requires a publish-capable transport');
    this.store = store;
    this.transport = transport;
    this.owner = options.owner || `outbox-${process.pid}-${randomUUID()}`;
    this.batchSize = Math.max(1, Number(options.batchSize) || 100);
    this.concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(options.concurrency) || 8);
    this.leaseMs = Math.max(1000, Number(options.leaseMs) || 30_000);
    this.pollMs = Math.max(1, Number(options.pollMs) || 250);
    this.retryBaseMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.retryBaseMs) || 250);
    this.retryMaxMs = Math.max(this.retryBaseMs, Number(options.retryMaxMs) || 30_000);
    this.jitter = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(options.jitter) || 0.2));
    this.unrefTimers = options.unrefTimers !== false;
    this.running = false;
    this.controller = null;
    this.loopPromise = null;
    this.active = new Set();
    this.stats = { cycles: 0, claimed: 0, published: 0, failed: 0, deadLettered: 0, transportErrors: 0 };
  }

  async runOnce(options = {}) {
    const records = await this.store.claim({
      owner: this.owner,
      leaseMs: this.leaseMs,
      limit: options.limit || this.batchSize,
      now: options.now,
    });
    this.stats.cycles++;
    this.stats.claimed += records.length;
    if (!records.length) return { claimed: 0, published: 0, failed: 0 };

    let cursor = 0;
    let published = 0;
    let failed = 0;
    const worker = async () => {
      while (cursor < records.length) {
        const record = records[cursor++];
        try {
          await awaitPublication(this.transport, record.event, record.args, {
            id: record.id,
            version: record.version,
            context: record.context,
            headers: record.headers,
            durable: true,
            meta: record.meta,
          });
          await this.store.complete(record.id, {
            owner: this.owner,
            fencingToken: record.fencingToken,
          });
          this.stats.published++;
          published++;
        } catch (error) {
          this.stats.transportErrors++;
          const retryAfterMs = this._retryDelay(record.attempts + 1);
          const updated = await this.store.fail(record.id, error, {
            owner: this.owner,
            fencingToken: record.fencingToken,
            retryAfterMs,
          });
          this.stats.failed++;
          failed++;
          if (updated.status === 'dead') this.stats.deadLettered++;
        }
      }
    };
    const workers = Array.from({ length: Math.min(this.concurrency, records.length) }, () => {
      let tracked;
      tracked = worker().finally(() => this.active.delete(tracked));
      this.active.add(tracked);
      return tracked;
    });
    await Promise.all(workers);
    return { claimed: records.length, published, failed };
  }

  _retryDelay(attempt) {
    const exponential = Math.min(this.retryMaxMs, this.retryBaseMs * (2 ** Math.max(0, attempt - 1)));
    if (!this.jitter) return exponential;
    const spread = exponential * this.jitter;
    return Math.max(0, Math.round(exponential - spread + Math.random() * spread * 2));
  }

  start() {
    if (this.running) return this;
    this.running = true;
    this.controller = new AbortController();
    this.loopPromise = this._loop(this.controller.signal).finally(() => { this.running = false; this.loopPromise = null; });
    return this;
  }

  async _loop(signal) {
    while (!signal.aborted) {
      const result = await this.runOnce();
      if (!result.claimed) {
        try { await sleep(this.pollMs, signal, this.unrefTimers); }
        catch { break; }
      }
    }
  }

  async flush(options = {}) {
    const maxCycles = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxCycles) || 10_000);
    let cycles = 0;
    let total = 0;
    while (cycles++ < maxCycles) {
      const result = await this.runOnce();
      total += result.published;
      if (!result.claimed) return { drained: true, published: total, cycles };
      if (result.failed && options.stopOnFailure !== false) return { drained: false, published: total, cycles, failed: result.failed };
    }
    throw new EventTransportError('Outbox flush cycle limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_OUTBOX_FLUSH_LIMIT' });
  }

  async stop(options = {}) {
    this.controller?.abort(new Error('Outbox publisher stopped'));
    if (options.drain === true) await this.flush(options);
    try { await this.loopPromise; } catch {}
    await Promise.allSettled([...this.active]);
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({ running: this.running, owner: this.owner, active: this.active.size, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }), store: this.store.snapshot?.() || null });
  }

  async close(options = {}) { return this.stop(options); }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await this.close(); }
}

export default OutboxPublisher;

'use strict';

import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';
import { EventAdmissionError } from '../errors/EventError.js';
import { estimateValueBytes } from '../support/size.js';

function cloneRecord(record) {
  return record ? { ...record, args: record.args?.slice?.() || [], context: record.context ? { ...record.context } : null, headers: record.headers ? { ...record.headers } : null } : null;
}

/** Bounded in-memory reference implementation for the durable outbox contract. */
export class MemoryOutboxStore extends EventEmitter {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    super();
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 100_000);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxBytes) || 128 * 1024 * 1024);
    this.overflow = options.overflow || 'reject';
    this.defaultMaxAttempts = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxAttempts) || 10);
    this.records = new Map();
    this.order = [];
    this.idempotency = new Map();
    this.bytes = 0;
    this.sequence = 0;
    this.stats = { appended: 0, claimed: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, deadLettered: 0, duplicates: 0, rejected: 0, pruned: 0 };
  }

  async append(input) {
    const id = String(input?.id || `outbox-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${(++this.sequence).toString(36)}`);
    const idempotencyKey = input?.idempotencyKey == null ? null : String(input.idempotencyKey);
    if (idempotencyKey && this.idempotency.has(idempotencyKey)) {
      this.stats.duplicates++;
      return { inserted: false, duplicate: true, record: cloneRecord(this.records.get(this.idempotency.get(idempotencyKey))) };
    }
    if (this.records.has(id)) {
      this.stats.duplicates++;
      return { inserted: false, duplicate: true, record: cloneRecord(this.records.get(id)) };
    }

    const now = Number(input?.createdAt) || Date.now();
    const record = {
      id,
      event: String(input?.event || ''),
      version: Math.max(1, Number(input?.version) || 1),
      args: Array.isArray(input?.args) ? input.args.slice() : [],
      context: input?.context && typeof input.context === 'object' ? { ...input.context } : null,
      headers: input?.headers && typeof input.headers === 'object' ? { ...input.headers } : null,
      idempotencyKey,
      status: 'pending',
      attempts: 0,
      maxAttempts: Math.max(1, Number(input?.maxAttempts) || this.defaultMaxAttempts),
      availableAt: Number(input?.availableAt) || now,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      leaseOwner: null,
      leaseUntil: 0,
      publishedAt: 0,
      lastError: null,
      meta: input?.meta && typeof input.meta === 'object' ? { ...input.meta } : null,
    };
    record.bytes = estimateValueBytes(record);
    this._admit(record.bytes);

    this.records.set(id, record);
    this.order.push(id);
    if (idempotencyKey) this.idempotency.set(idempotencyKey, id);
    this.bytes += record.bytes;
    this.stats.appended++;
    this.emit('available', cloneRecord(record));
    return { inserted: true, duplicate: false, record: cloneRecord(record) };
  }

  _admit(bytes) {
    while (this.records.size >= this.maxItems || this.bytes + bytes > this.maxBytes) {
      if (this.overflow !== 'drop-completed') {
        this.stats.rejected++;
        throw new EventAdmissionError('Outbox capacity exceeded', {
          code: 'EVENT_OUTBOX_CAPACITY', details: { bytes, maxItems: this.maxItems, maxBytes: this.maxBytes },
        });
      }
      const removable = this.order.find((id) => ['published', 'dead'].includes(this.records.get(id)?.status));
      if (!removable) {
        this.stats.rejected++;
        throw new EventAdmissionError('Outbox capacity exceeded and no completed record can be pruned', { code: 'EVENT_OUTBOX_CAPACITY' });
      }
      this.remove(removable);
    }
  }

  async claim(options = {}) {
    const now = Number(options.now) || Date.now();
    const owner = String(options.owner || `worker-${process.pid}`);
    const leaseMs = Math.max(1, Number(options.leaseMs) || 30_000);
    const limit = Math.max(1, Number(options.limit) || 100);
    const claimed = [];

    for (const id of this.order) {
      if (claimed.length >= limit) break;
      const record = this.records.get(id);
      if (!record) continue;
      const expiredLease = record.status === 'processing' && record.leaseUntil > 0 && record.leaseUntil <= now;
      const available = (record.status === 'pending' || record.status === 'failed' || expiredLease) && record.availableAt <= now;
      if (!available) continue;
      record.status = 'processing';
      record.leaseOwner = owner;
      record.leaseUntil = now + leaseMs;
      record.updatedAt = now;
      claimed.push(cloneRecord(record));
    }
    this.stats.claimed += claimed.length;
    return claimed;
  }

  async complete(id, options = {}) {
    const record = this._owned(id, options.owner);
    const now = Number(options.now) || Date.now();
    record.status = 'published';
    record.publishedAt = now;
    record.updatedAt = now;
    record.leaseOwner = null;
    record.leaseUntil = 0;
    record.lastError = null;
    this.stats.completed++;
    return cloneRecord(record);
  }

  async fail(id, error, options = {}) {
    const record = this._owned(id, options.owner);
    const now = Number(options.now) || Date.now();
    record.attempts++;
    record.updatedAt = now;
    record.leaseOwner = null;
    record.leaseUntil = 0;
    record.lastError = {
      name: error?.name || 'Error',
      message: error?.message || String(error || 'Outbox publish failed'),
      code: error?.code,
      at: now,
    };
    if (record.attempts >= record.maxAttempts || options.deadLetter === true) {
      record.status = 'dead';
      record.availableAt = 0;
      this.stats.deadLettered++;
    } else {
      record.status = 'failed';
      record.availableAt = now + Math.max(0, Number(options.retryAfterMs) || 0);
      this.stats.failed++;
      this.emit('available', cloneRecord(record));
    }
    return cloneRecord(record);
  }

  async release(id, options = {}) {
    const record = this._owned(id, options.owner);
    record.status = 'pending';
    record.leaseOwner = null;
    record.leaseUntil = 0;
    record.availableAt = Number(options.availableAt) || Date.now();
    record.updatedAt = Date.now();
    this.emit('available', cloneRecord(record));
    return cloneRecord(record);
  }

  _owned(id, owner) {
    const record = this.records.get(String(id));
    if (!record) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Outbox record not found: ${id}`, { code: 'EVENT_OUTBOX_NOT_FOUND' });
    if (owner != null && record.leaseOwner && record.leaseOwner !== String(owner)) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Outbox lease is owned by ${record.leaseOwner}`, { code: 'EVENT_OUTBOX_LEASE_OWNER' });
    }
    return record;
  }

  get(id) { return cloneRecord(this.records.get(String(id))); }
  all(options = {}) {
    let records = this.order.map((id) => this.records.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
    if (options.status) records = records.filter((record) => record.status === String(options.status));
    if (options.event) records = records.filter((record) => record.event === String(options.event));
    const limit = Math.max(0, Number(options.limit) || 0);
    if (limit) records = records.slice(-limit);
    return records.map(cloneRecord);
  }

  remove(id) {
    const key = String(id);
    const record = this.records.get(key);
    if (!record) return false;
    this.records.delete(key);
    if (record.idempotencyKey) this.idempotency.delete(record.idempotencyKey);
    this.bytes = Math.max(0, this.bytes - (record.bytes || 0));
    const index = this.order.indexOf(key);
    if (index !== -1) this.order.splice(index, 1);
    this.stats.pruned++;
    return true;
  }

  prune(options = {}) {
    const before = Number(options.before) || Date.now();
    const statuses = new Set(options.statuses || ['published', 'dead']);
    let removed = 0;
    for (const id of [...this.order]) {
      const record = this.records.get(id);
      if (record && statuses.has(record.status) && record.updatedAt <= before && this.remove(id)) removed++;
    }
    return removed;
  }

  snapshot() {
    const status = Object.create(null);
    for (const record of this.records.values()) status[record.status] = (status[record.status] || 0) + 1;
    return Object.freeze({
      items: this.records.size,
      bytes: this.bytes,
      maxItems: this.maxItems,
      maxBytes: this.maxBytes,
      status: Object.freeze(status),
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }

  close() { this.removeAllListeners(); }
}

export default MemoryOutboxStore;

'use strict';

import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { array, collection, duplicate, matched, publicDocument, safeError, value } from './support.js';

/** Atomic lease-based outbox backed by RawMongo. */
export class RawMongoOutboxStore extends EventEmitter {
  constructor(source, options = {}) {
    super();
    this.source = source;
    this.options = options;
    this.name = options.collection || 'events_outbox';
    this.collection = collection(source, this.name, options);
    this.defaultMaxAttempts = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxAttempts) || 10);
    this.owner = options.owner || `${process.pid}:${randomUUID()}`;
    this.stats = { appended: 0, duplicates: 0, claimed: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, deadLettered: 0, released: 0, pruned: 0, leaseLost: 0 };
  }
  async append(input = {}) {
    const now = new Date(Number(input.createdAt) || Date.now());
    const document = {
      _id: String(input.id || randomUUID()), event: String(input.event || ''), version: Math.max(1, Number(input.version) || 1),
      args: Array.isArray(input.args) ? input.args : [], context: input.context || null, headers: input.headers || null,
      idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey == null ? null : String(input.idempotencyKey), status: 'pending', attempts: 0,
      maxAttempts: Math.max(1, Number(input.maxAttempts) || this.defaultMaxAttempts), availableAt: new Date(Number(input.availableAt) || now.getTime()),
      createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, leaseOwner: null, leaseUntil: null, fencingToken: 0,
      publishedAt: null, lastError: null, meta: input.meta || null,
    };
    try { await this.collection.insertOne(document, writeOptions(input)); this.stats.appended++; this.emit('available', publicDocument(document)); return { inserted: true, duplicate: false, record: publicDocument(document) }; }
    catch (error) {
      if (!duplicate(error)) throw error;
      this.stats.duplicates++;
      const existing = document.idempotencyKey ? await this.collection.findOne({ idempotencyKey: document.idempotencyKey }) : await this.collection.findOne({ _id: document._id });
      return { inserted: false, duplicate: true, record: publicDocument(existing) };
    }
  }
  async claim(options = {}) {
    const now = new Date(Number(options.now) || Date.now());
    const owner = String(options.owner || this.owner);
    const leaseUntil = new Date(now.getTime() + Math.max(1, Number(options.leaseMs) || 30_000));
    const limit = Math.max(1, Number(options.limit) || 100);
    const claimed = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < limit; index++) {
      const result = await this.collection.findOneAndUpdate({
        availableAt: { $lte: now },
        $or: [
          { status: { $in: ['pending', 'failed'] } },
          { status: 'processing', leaseUntil: { $lte: now } },
        ],
      }, { $set: { status: 'processing', leaseOwner: owner, leaseUntil, updatedAt: now }, $inc: { fencingToken: 1 } }, { sort: { availableAt: 1, createdAt: 1 }, returnDocument: 'after', ...writeOptions(options) });
      const record = value(result);
      if (!record) break;
      claimed.push(publicDocument(record));
    }
    this.stats.claimed += claimed.length;
    return claimed;
  }
  async complete(id, options = {}) {
    const now = new Date(Number(options.now) || Date.now()); const owner = options.owner || this.owner;
    const result = await this.collection.findOneAndUpdate(
      ownedFilter(id, owner, options.fencingToken),
      { $set: { status: 'published', publishedAt: now, updatedAt: now, leaseOwner: null, leaseUntil: null, lastError: null } },
      { returnDocument: 'after', ...writeOptions(options) },
    );
    const record = value(result); if (!record) return this._leaseLost(id); this.stats.completed++; return publicDocument(record);
  }
  async fail(id, error, options = {}) {
    const current = await this.collection.findOne({ _id: String(id) });
    if (!current) throw outboxError(`Outbox record not found: ${id}`, 'EVENT_OUTBOX_NOT_FOUND');
    const now = new Date(Number(options.now) || Date.now()); const attempts = Number(current.attempts || 0) + 1;
    const dead = options.deadLetter === true || attempts >= Number(current.maxAttempts || this.defaultMaxAttempts);
    const owner = options.owner || this.owner;
    const result = await this.collection.findOneAndUpdate(ownedFilter(id, owner, options.fencingToken), {
      $set: { status: dead ? 'dead' : 'failed', attempts, availableAt: dead ? null : new Date(now.getTime() + Math.max(0, Number(options.retryAfterMs) || 0)), updatedAt: now, leaseOwner: null, leaseUntil: null, lastError: safeError(error) },
    }, { returnDocument: 'after', ...writeOptions(options) });
    const record = value(result); if (!record) return this._leaseLost(id); if (dead) this.stats.deadLettered++; else { this.stats.failed++; this.emit('available', publicDocument(record)); } return publicDocument(record);
  }
  async release(id, options = {}) {
    const owner = options.owner || this.owner; const now = new Date();
    const result = await this.collection.findOneAndUpdate(
      ownedFilter(id, owner, options.fencingToken),
      { $set: { status: 'pending', leaseOwner: null, leaseUntil: null, availableAt: new Date(Number(options.availableAt) || now.getTime()), updatedAt: now } },
      { returnDocument: 'after', ...writeOptions(options) },
    );
    const record = value(result); if (!record) return this._leaseLost(id); this.stats.released++; this.emit('available', publicDocument(record)); return publicDocument(record);
  }
  async renew(id, options = {}) {
    const owner = options.owner || this.owner;
    const leaseUntil = new Date(Date.now() + Math.max(1, Number(options.leaseMs) || 30_000));
    const result = await this.collection.updateOne(
      ownedFilter(id, owner, options.fencingToken),
      { $set: { leaseUntil, updatedAt: new Date() } },
      writeOptions(options),
    );
    if (!matched(result)) this._leaseLost(id);
    return true;
  }
  async get(id) { return publicDocument(await this.collection.findOne({ _id: String(id) })); }
  async all(options = {}) { const filter = {}; if (options.status) filter.status = String(options.status); if (options.event) filter.event = String(options.event); let cursor = this.collection.find(filter); cursor = cursor.sort?.({ createdAt: 1 }) || cursor; if (options.limit) cursor = cursor.limit?.(Math.max(1, Number(options.limit))) || cursor; return (await array(cursor)).map(publicDocument); }
  async remove(id) { const result = await this.collection.deleteOne({ _id: String(id) }); return Number(result?.deletedCount ?? result?.n ?? 0) > 0; }
  async prune(options = {}) { const result = await this.collection.deleteMany({ status: { $in: options.statuses || ['published', 'dead'] }, updatedAt: { $lte: new Date(Number(options.before) || Date.now()) } }, { ...writeOptions(options), intent: 'events-outbox-prune', allowAll: true }); const count = Number(result?.deletedCount ?? result?.n ?? 0); this.stats.pruned += count; return count; }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ driver: 'rawmongo', collection: this.name, owner: this.owner, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
  close() { this.removeAllListeners(); }
  _leaseLost(id) { this.stats.leaseLost++; throw outboxError(`Outbox lease was lost for ${id}.`, 'EVENT_OUTBOX_LEASE_LOST'); }
}
function ownedFilter(id, owner, fencingToken = null) {
  return {
    _id: String(id),
    status: 'processing',
    ...(owner ? { leaseOwner: String(owner) } : {}),
    ...(fencingToken == null ? {} : { fencingToken: Number(fencingToken) }),
  };
}
function writeOptions(options) { return options.session ? { session: options.session } : {}; }
function outboxError(message, code) { return Object.assign(new Error(message), { name: 'EventOutboxError', code, retryable: code === 'EVENT_OUTBOX_LEASE_LOST' }); }
export default RawMongoOutboxStore;

'use strict';

import { collection, duplicate, publicDocument, safeError } from './support.js';

/** Persistent idempotency inbox for effectively-once event handlers. */
export class RawMongoEventInbox {
  constructor(source, options = {}) {
    this.source = source;
    this.options = options;
    this.name = options.collection || 'events_inbox';
    this.collection = collection(source, this.name, options);
    this.ttlMs = Math.max(1, Number(options.ttlMs) || 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    this.processingTtlMs = Math.max(1_000, Number(options.processingTtlMs) || 5 * 60 * 1000);
    this.owner = options.owner || `${process.pid}`;
    this.inFlight = new Map();
    this.stats = { accepted: 0, duplicates: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, reclaimed: 0 };
  }
  async has(id, now = Date.now()) {
    const record = await this.collection.findOne({ _id: String(id), status: 'completed', expiresAt: { $gt: new Date(now) } });
    return !!record;
  }
  async run(id, handler, options = {}) {
    const key = String(id || '');
    if (!key) throw new TypeError('Inbox id is required.');
    if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Inbox handler must be a function.');
    if (this.inFlight.has(key)) { this.stats.duplicates++; return this.inFlight.get(key); }
    const operation = this._run(key, handler, options).finally(() => this.inFlight.delete(key));
    this.inFlight.set(key, operation);
    return operation;
  }
  async _run(key, handler, options) {
    const now = new Date();
    const processingUntil = new Date(now.getTime() + Math.max(1_000, Number(options.processingTtlMs) || this.processingTtlMs));
    const record = { _id: key, status: 'processing', owner: String(options.owner || this.owner), handler: options.handlerId || null, eventId: options.eventId || key, idempotencyKey: options.idempotencyKey || key, context: options.context || null, attempts: 1, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, processingUntil, expiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + Math.max(1, Number(options.ttlMs) || this.ttlMs)) };
    try { await this.collection.insertOne(record, writeOptions(options)); }
    catch (error) {
      if (!duplicate(error)) throw error;
      const existing = await this.collection.findOne({ _id: key });
      if (existing?.status === 'completed' && new Date(existing.expiresAt).getTime() > Date.now()) { this.stats.duplicates++; return { accepted: false, duplicate: true, record: publicDocument(existing), value: existing.result }; }
      if (existing?.status === 'processing' && new Date(existing.processingUntil || 0).getTime() > Date.now()) { this.stats.duplicates++; return { accepted: false, duplicate: true, inFlight: true, record: publicDocument(existing) }; }
      const claimed = await this.collection.findOneAndUpdate({
        _id: key,
        $and: [
          { $or: [{ status: { $ne: 'completed' } }, { expiresAt: { $lte: now } }] },
          { $or: [{ processingUntil: { $lte: now } }, { processingUntil: null }, { processingUntil: { $exists: false } }] },
        ],
      }, { $set: { ...record, createdAt: existing?.createdAt || now }, $inc: { attempts: 1 } }, { returnDocument: 'after', ...writeOptions(options) });
      if (!(claimed?.value || claimed?.document || claimed)) { this.stats.duplicates++; return { accepted: false, duplicate: true }; }
      this.stats.reclaimed++;
    }
    this.stats.accepted++;
    try {
      const value = await handler();
      await this.collection.updateOne({ _id: key, status: 'processing', owner: String(options.owner || this.owner) }, { $set: { status: 'completed', result: options.storeResult === false ? null : safeResult(value), completedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date(), processingUntil: null, expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + Math.max(1, Number(options.ttlMs) || this.ttlMs)) } }, writeOptions(options));
      this.stats.completed++;
      return { accepted: true, duplicate: false, value };
    } catch (error) {
      this.stats.failed++;
      if (options.rememberFailure === true) await this.collection.updateOne({ _id: key }, { $set: { status: 'failed', lastError: safeError(error), updatedAt: new Date(), processingUntil: null } }, writeOptions(options));
      else await this.collection.deleteOne({ _id: key, status: 'processing', owner: String(options.owner || this.owner) }, writeOptions(options));
      throw error;
    }
  }
  async remember(id, ttlMs = this.ttlMs, options = {}) { const now = new Date(); await this.collection.updateOne({ _id: String(id) }, { $set: { status: 'completed', completedAt: now, updatedAt: now, expiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + Math.max(1, Number(ttlMs) || this.ttlMs)) }, $setOnInsert: { createdAt: now, attempts: 0 } }, { upsert: true, ...writeOptions(options) }); return this; }
  async clear(options = {}) { const result = await this.collection.deleteMany(options.filter || {}, { ...writeOptions(options), intent: 'events-inbox-clear', allowAll: true }); return Number(result?.deletedCount ?? result?.n ?? 0); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ driver: 'rawmongo', collection: this.name, owner: this.owner, inFlight: this.inFlight.size, ttlMs: this.ttlMs, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
}
function safeResult(value) { if (value == null || ['string', 'number', 'boolean'].includes(typeof value)) return value; try { return structuredClone(value); } catch { return null; } }
function writeOptions(options) { return options.session ? { session: options.session } : {}; }
export default RawMongoEventInbox;

'use strict';

export class DurableEventWorker {
  constructor(store, options = {}) { if (!store?.claim) throw new TypeError('DurableEventWorker requires a durable job store.'); this.store = store; this.handlers = new Map(); this.concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(options.concurrency) || 8); this.pollMs = Math.max(10, Number(options.pollMs) || 250); this.leaseMs = Math.max(1_000, Number(options.leaseMs) || 30_000); this.renewMs = Math.max(250, Number(options.renewMs) || Math.floor(this.leaseMs / 3)); this.controller = null; this.workers = []; this.stats = { processed: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, missingHandlers: 0 }; }
  register(name, handler, options = {}) { const key = String(name); if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Durable job handler must be a function.'); if (this.handlers.has(key) && options.replace !== true) throw Object.assign(new Error(`Durable job handler already exists: ${key}`), { code: 'EVENT_JOB_HANDLER_DUPLICATE' }); this.handlers.set(key, handler); return this; }
  async start() { if (this.controller) return this; this.controller = new AbortController(); this.workers = Array.from({ length: this.concurrency }, (_, index) => this._loop(index, this.controller.signal)); return this; }
  async _loop(index, signal) { while (!signal.aborted) { const job = await this.store.claim({ leaseMs: this.leaseMs }).catch(() => null); if (!job) { await delay(this.pollMs, signal); continue; } await this._run(job, index, signal); } }
  async _run(job, workerId, signal) { this.stats.processed++; const handler = this.handlers.get(job.name); if (!handler) { this.stats.missingHandlers++; await this.store.fail(job.id, Object.assign(new Error(`No handler for durable job '${job.name}'.`), { code: 'EVENT_JOB_HANDLER_MISSING' }), { fencingToken: job.fencingToken, deadLetter: true }); return; } let timer; try { timer = setInterval(() => void this.store.renew(job.id, { leaseMs: this.leaseMs, fencingToken: job.fencingToken }).catch(() => {}), this.renewMs); timer.unref?.(); const value = await handler(job.payload, { job, workerId, signal, store: this.store }); await this.store.complete(job.id, value, { fencingToken: job.fencingToken }); this.stats.completed++; } catch (error) { await this.store.fail(job.id, error, { fencingToken: job.fencingToken }); this.stats.failed++; } finally { clearInterval(timer); } }
  async close() { if (!this.controller) return this.snapshot(); this.controller.abort(); await Promise.allSettled(this.workers); this.controller = null; this.workers = []; return this.snapshot(); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ running: !!this.controller, concurrency: this.concurrency, handlers: this.handlers.size, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }), store: this.store.snapshot?.() || null }); }
}
function delay(ms, signal) { return new Promise((resolve) => { const timer = setTimeout(resolve, ms); timer.unref?.(); signal?.addEventListener?.('abort', () => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(); }, { once: true }); }); }
export default DurableEventWorker;

'use strict';

export function resolveDatabase(source, options = {}) {
  if (!source) throw new TypeError('RawMongo persistence requires a database, client, manager, or collection resolver.');
  if (typeof options.databaseResolver === 'function') return options.databaseResolver(source, options);
  if (typeof source.collection === 'function') return source;
  const name = options.database || options.dbName || options.connection || undefined;
  if (typeof source.db === 'function') return source.db(name);
  if (typeof source.database === 'function') return source.database(name);
  if (source.client && typeof source.client.db === 'function') return source.client.db(name);
  if (source.connection && typeof source.connection.collection === 'function') return source.connection;
  throw new TypeError('Unable to resolve a RawMongo database from the supplied source.');
}
export function collection(source, name, options = {}) {
  if (typeof options.collectionResolver === 'function') return options.collectionResolver(source, name, options);
  const db = resolveDatabase(source, options);
  const value = db.collection?.(name) || db.getCollection?.(name);
  if (!value) throw new TypeError(`RawMongo collection '${name}' is unavailable.`);
  return value;
}
export async function transaction(source, operation, options = {}) {
  if (options.session) return operation(options.session);
  if (typeof options.transaction === 'function') return options.transaction((session) => operation(session), options.transactionOptions || {});
  const candidates = [source, source?.client, source?.db?.client, source?.connection?.client].filter(Boolean);
  for (const target of candidates) {
    if (typeof target.withTransaction === 'function') return target.withTransaction((session) => operation(session), options.transactionOptions || {});
  }
  if (options.requireTransactions === true) throw Object.assign(new Error('RawMongo transactions are required for this event persistence operation.'), { code: 'EVENT_STORE_TRANSACTION_REQUIRED' });
  return operation(null);
}
export function value(result) {
  if (result == null) return null;
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(result, 'value')) return result.value;
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(result, 'document')) return result.document;
  return result;
}
export function matched(result) { return Number(result?.matchedCount ?? result?.modifiedCount ?? result?.n ?? result?.nModified ?? 0) > 0; }
export function duplicate(error) { return error?.code === 11000 || /duplicate key|E11000/i.test(error?.message || ''); }
export async function array(cursor) { if (!cursor) return []; if (Array.isArray(cursor)) return cursor; if (typeof cursor.toArray === 'function') return await cursor.toArray(); const output = []; if (cursor[Symbol.asyncIterator]) for await (const item of cursor) output.push(item); return output; }
export function clone(value, seen = new WeakMap()) {
  if (value == null || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
  if (seen.has(value)) return seen.get(value);
  if (value instanceof Date) return new Date(value);
  if (value instanceof Error) return { name: value.name, message: value.message, code: value.code || null };
  if (Array.isArray(value)) { const output = []; seen.set(value, output); for (const child of value) output.push(clone(child, seen)); return output; }
  const output = {}; seen.set(value, output); for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) output[key] = clone(child, seen); return output;
}
export function publicDocument(document) { if (!document) return null; const output = clone(document); if (output._id != null && output.id == null) output.id = String(output._id); return output; }
export function safeError(error) { return { name: error?.name || 'Error', code: error?.code || null, message: error?.message || String(error), at: new Date() }; }

'use strict';

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { array, collection, matched, publicDocument, safeError, value } from './support.js';

export class RawMongoJobStore {
  constructor(source, options = {}) { this.name = options.collection || 'events_jobs'; this.collection = collection(source, this.name, options); this.owner = options.owner || `${process.pid}:${randomUUID()}`; this.defaultMaxAttempts = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxAttempts) || 5); this.stats = { enqueued: 0, claimed: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, retried: 0, deadLettered: 0, cancelled: 0, leaseLost: 0 }; }
  async enqueue(name, payload, options = {}) { const now = new Date(); const document = { _id: String(options.id || randomUUID()), name: String(name), payload, status: 'queued', priority: Number(options.priority) || 0, attempts: 0, maxAttempts: Math.max(1, Number(options.maxAttempts ?? options.attempts) || this.defaultMaxAttempts), availableAt: new Date(Number(options.availableAt) || now.getTime() + Math.max(0, Number(options.delayMs) || 0)), timeoutMs: Math.max(0, Number(options.timeoutMs) || 0), context: options.context || null, meta: options.meta || null, tenantId: options.tenantId || null, partitionKey: options.partitionKey || null, leaseOwner: null, leaseUntil: null, fencingToken: 0, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, completedAt: null, lastError: null }; await this.collection.insertOne(document, writeOptions(options)); this.stats.enqueued++; return publicDocument(document); }
  async claim(options = {}) { const now = new Date(); const owner = String(options.owner || this.owner); const result = await this.collection.findOneAndUpdate({ availableAt: { $lte: now }, $or: [{ status: { $in: ['queued', 'failed'] } }, { status: 'processing', leaseUntil: { $lte: now } }], ...(options.partitionKey == null ? {} : { partitionKey: options.partitionKey }) }, { $set: { status: 'processing', leaseOwner: owner, leaseUntil: new Date(now.getTime() + Math.max(1, Number(options.leaseMs) || 30_000)), updatedAt: now }, $inc: { attempts: 1, fencingToken: 1 } }, { sort: { priority: -1, availableAt: 1, createdAt: 1 }, returnDocument: 'after', ...writeOptions(options) }); const job = value(result); if (job) this.stats.claimed++; return publicDocument(job); }
  async complete(id, resultValue = null, options = {}) { const owner = String(options.owner || this.owner); const result = await this.collection.findOneAndUpdate({ _id: String(id), status: 'processing', leaseOwner: owner, ...(options.fencingToken == null ? {} : { fencingToken: options.fencingToken }) }, { $set: { status: 'completed', result: options.storeResult === false ? null : resultValue, completedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date(), leaseOwner: null, leaseUntil: null, lastError: null } }, { returnDocument: 'after', ...writeOptions(options) }); const job = value(result); if (!job) this._lost(id); this.stats.completed++; return publicDocument(job); }
  async fail(id, error, options = {}) { const job = await this.collection.findOne({ _id: String(id) }); if (!job) throw jobError(`Job not found: ${id}`, 'EVENT_JOB_NOT_FOUND'); const attempts = Number(job.attempts) || 1; const dead = options.deadLetter === true || attempts >= Number(job.maxAttempts || this.defaultMaxAttempts); const result = await this.collection.findOneAndUpdate({ _id: String(id), status: 'processing', leaseOwner: String(options.owner || this.owner), ...(options.fencingToken == null ? {} : { fencingToken: options.fencingToken }) }, { $set: { status: dead ? 'dead' : 'failed', availableAt: dead ? null : new Date(Date.now() + retryAfter(options.retryAfterMs, attempts, options)), updatedAt: new Date(), leaseOwner: null, leaseUntil: null, lastError: safeError(error) } }, { returnDocument: 'after', ...writeOptions(options) }); const updated = value(result); if (!updated) this._lost(id); if (dead) this.stats.deadLettered++; else { this.stats.failed++; this.stats.retried++; } return publicDocument(updated); }
  async renew(id, options = {}) { const result = await this.collection.updateOne({ _id: String(id), status: 'processing', leaseOwner: String(options.owner || this.owner), ...(options.fencingToken == null ? {} : { fencingToken: options.fencingToken }) }, { $set: { leaseUntil: new Date(Date.now() + Math.max(1, Number(options.leaseMs) || 30_000)), updatedAt: new Date() } }, writeOptions(options)); if (!matched(result)) this._lost(id); return true; }
  async cancel(id, reason = 'cancelled', options = {}) { const result = await this.collection.updateOne({ _id: String(id), status: { $in: ['queued', 'failed'] } }, { $set: { status: 'cancelled', cancelledAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date(), cancelReason: String(reason) } }, writeOptions(options)); const ok = matched(result); if (ok) this.stats.cancelled++; return ok; }
  async get(id) { return publicDocument(await this.collection.findOne({ _id: String(id) })); }
  async list(options = {}) { const filter = {}; if (options.status) filter.status = String(options.status); if (options.name) filter.name = String(options.name); if (options.tenantId != null) filter.tenantId = options.tenantId; let cursor = this.collection.find(filter); cursor = cursor.sort?.({ createdAt: -1 }) || cursor; if (options.limit) cursor = cursor.limit?.(Math.max(1, Number(options.limit))) || cursor; return (await array(cursor)).map(publicDocument); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ driver: 'rawmongo', collection: this.name, owner: this.owner, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
  _lost(id) { this.stats.leaseLost++; throw jobError(`Job lease lost: ${id}`, 'EVENT_JOB_LEASE_LOST'); }
}
function retryAfter(value, attempt, options) { return value == null ? retryDelay(attempt, options) : Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0); }
function retryDelay(attempt, options) { const base = Math.max(1, Number(options.retryBaseMs) || 250); const maximum = Math.max(base, Number(options.retryMaxMs) || 60_000); const value = Math.min(maximum, base * (2 ** Math.min(20, Math.max(0, attempt - 1)))); return Math.min(maximum, value + Math.floor(Math.random() * Math.max(1, value * 0.2))); }
function writeOptions(options) { return options.session ? { session: options.session } : {}; }
function jobError(message, code) { return Object.assign(new Error(message), { name: 'EventJobError', code, retryable: code === 'EVENT_JOB_LEASE_LOST' }); }
export default RawMongoJobStore;
