'use strict';

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

function parsePart(part, minimum, maximum) {
  const values = new Set();
  for (const token of String(part).split(',')) {
    const [rangeToken, stepToken] = token.split('/');
    const step = Math.max(1, Number(stepToken) || 1);
    let start = minimum;
    let end = maximum;
    if (rangeToken !== '*') {
      if (rangeToken.includes('-')) [start, end] = rangeToken.split('-').map(Number);
      else start = end = Number(rangeToken);
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(start) || !Number.isInteger(end) || start < minimum || end > maximum || start > end) throw new TypeError(`Invalid cron field: ${part}`);
    for (let value = start; value <= end; value += step) values.add(value);
  }
  return values;
}

export function compileCron(expression) {
  const fields = String(expression || '').trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (fields.length !== 5) throw new TypeError('Cron expression must contain five fields: minute hour day month weekday');
  const [minute, hour, day, month, weekday] = fields;
  const spec = {
    minute: parsePart(minute, 0, 59),
    hour: parsePart(hour, 0, 23),
    day: parsePart(day, 1, 31),
    month: parsePart(month, 1, 12),
    weekday: parsePart(weekday, 0, 6),
  };
  return (date) => spec.minute.has(date.getMinutes()) && spec.hour.has(date.getHours()) && spec.day.has(date.getDate()) && spec.month.has(date.getMonth() + 1) && spec.weekday.has(date.getDay());
}

export class EventScheduler {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.dispatcher = options.dispatcher || null;
    this.queue = options.queue || null;
    this.entries = new Map();
    this.timer = null;
    this.closed = false;
    this.stats = { scheduled: 0, fired: 0, skipped: 0, errors: 0, cancelled: 0 };
  }

  every(intervalMs, task, options = {}) {
    const interval = Math.max(1, Number(intervalMs) || 0);
    return this._add({ ...options, task, type: 'interval', intervalMs: interval, nextAt: Number(options.startAt) || Date.now() + interval });
  }

  at(date, task, options = {}) {
    const timestamp = date instanceof Date ? date.getTime() : Number(date);
    if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp)) throw new TypeError('Scheduled date is invalid');
    return this._add({ ...options, task, type: 'once', nextAt: timestamp });
  }

  cron(expression, task, options = {}) {
    const matcher = compileCron(expression);
    return this._add({ ...options, task, type: 'cron', expression: String(expression), matcher, nextAt: this._nextCron(matcher, Date.now()) });
  }

  event(eventName, args = [], options = {}) {
    const task = () => this.dispatcher?.dispatchAsync?.(eventName, ...(Array.isArray(args) ? args : [args]));
    return options.cron ? this.cron(options.cron, task, options) : options.at ? this.at(options.at, task, options) : this.every(options.everyMs, task, options);
  }

  _add(input) {
    if (this.closed) throw new Error('EventScheduler is closed');
    if (typeof input.task !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Scheduled task must be a function');
    const entry = {
      id: input.id || randomUUID(),
      name: input.name || input.id || input.type,
      type: input.type,
      task: input.task,
      nextAt: input.nextAt,
      intervalMs: input.intervalMs || 0,
      expression: input.expression || null,
      matcher: input.matcher || null,
      overlap: input.overlap === true,
      running: false,
      enabled: input.enabled !== false,
      runs: 0,
      maxRuns: Math.max(0, Number(input.maxRuns) || 0),
      lastRunAt: 0,
      lastError: null,
    };
    this.entries.set(entry.id, entry);
    this.stats.scheduled++;
    this._arm();
    return Object.freeze({ id: entry.id, cancel: () => this.cancel(entry.id), pause: () => this.pause(entry.id), resume: () => this.resume(entry.id) });
  }

  _nextCron(matcher, after) {
    const date = new Date(after);
    date.setSeconds(0, 0);
    date.setMinutes(date.getMinutes() + 1);
    const maximum = 366 * 24 * 60;
    for (let index = 0; index < maximum; index++, date.setMinutes(date.getMinutes() + 1)) if (matcher(date)) return date.getTime();
    throw new Error('Cron expression has no occurrence within one year');
  }

  _arm() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer);
    this.timer = null;
    const enabled = Array.from(this.entries.values()).filter((entry) => entry.enabled);
    if (!enabled.length) return;
    const nextAt = Math.min(...enabled.map((entry) => entry.nextAt));
    this.timer = setTimeout(() => { this.timer = null; void this._tick(); }, Math.max(1, nextAt - Date.now()));
    this.timer.unref?.();
  }

  async _tick(now = Date.now()) {
    const due = Array.from(this.entries.values()).filter((entry) => entry.enabled && entry.nextAt <= now);
    for (const entry of due) {
      if (entry.running && !entry.overlap) { this.stats.skipped++; this._advance(entry, now); continue; }
      entry.running = true;
      entry.lastRunAt = now;
      entry.runs++;
      this.stats.fired++;
      this._advance(entry, now);
      const execute = async () => {
        try {
          if (this.queue) await this.queue.enqueue(entry.name, null, { handler: entry.task });
          else await entry.task({ id: entry.id, name: entry.name, run: entry.runs, scheduledAt: now });
          entry.lastError = null;
        } catch (error) { entry.lastError = error; this.stats.errors++; }
        finally { entry.running = false; if (entry.maxRuns && entry.runs >= entry.maxRuns) this.cancel(entry.id); }
      };
      void execute();
    }
    this._arm();
  }

  _advance(entry, now) {
    if (entry.type === 'once') { entry.enabled = false; return; }
    if (entry.type === 'interval') {
      do { entry.nextAt += entry.intervalMs; } while (entry.nextAt <= now);
      return;
    }
    entry.nextAt = this._nextCron(entry.matcher, now);
  }

  cancel(id) { const removed = this.entries.delete(String(id)); if (removed) this.stats.cancelled++; this._arm(); return removed; }
  pause(id) { const entry = this.entries.get(String(id)); if (!entry) return false; entry.enabled = false; this._arm(); return true; }
  resume(id) { const entry = this.entries.get(String(id)); if (!entry) return false; entry.enabled = true; if (entry.nextAt <= Date.now()) entry.nextAt = entry.type === 'interval' ? Date.now() + entry.intervalMs : entry.type === 'cron' ? this._nextCron(entry.matcher, Date.now()) : Date.now(); this._arm(); return true; }
  list() { return Array.from(this.entries.values()).map(({ task, matcher, lastError, ...entry }) => ({ ...entry, lastError: lastError ? { name: lastError.name, message: lastError.message } : null })); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ closed: this.closed, entries: this.entries.size, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
  close() { this.closed = true; if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer); this.timer = null; this.entries.clear(); }
  [Symbol.dispose]() { this.close(); }
}

export default EventScheduler;

'use strict';

// src/events/Broadcastable.js

export const Broadcastable = (Base) => class extends Base {
  shouldBroadcast() { return true; }
  broadcastChannel() { return 'global'; }
  broadcastChannels() {
    const channel = this.broadcastChannel();
    return Array.isArray(channel) ? channel : [channel];
  }
  broadcastAs() { return this.constructor.name; }
  broadcastWith() { return this.payload; }
  broadcastWhen() { return true; }
  broadcastNow() { return false; }

  toBroadcastEnvelope() {
    return {
      event: this.broadcastAs(),
      channels: this.broadcastChannels(),
      payload: this.broadcastWith(),
      id: this.id,
      timestamp: this.timestamp,
      meta: this.meta ? { ...this.meta } : null,
    };
  }
};

export default Broadcastable;

'use strict';

export class EventError extends Error {
  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, options.cause ? { cause: options.cause } : undefined);
    this.name = options.name || new.target.name || 'EventError';
    this.code = options.code || 'EVENT_ERROR';
    this.details = options.details ?? null;
    this.eventName = options.eventName ?? null;
  }
}

export class EventConfigurationError extends EventError {
  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventConfigurationError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_CONFIGURATION_ERROR' });
  }
}

export class EventAdmissionError extends EventError {
  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventAdmissionError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_ADMISSION_REJECTED' });
  }
}

export class EventTimeoutError extends EventError {
  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventTimeoutError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_TIMEOUT' });
    this.timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? null;
  }
}

export class EventAbortError extends EventError {
  constructor(message = 'Event operation aborted.', options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventAbortError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_ABORTED' });
  }
}

export class EventClosedError extends EventError {
  constructor(message = 'Event subsystem is closed.', options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventClosedError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_CLOSED' });
  }
}

  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventTransportError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_ERROR' });
  }
}

  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventStoreError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_STORE_ERROR' });
  }
}

export class EventConcurrencyError extends EventStoreError {
  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventConcurrencyError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT' });
    this.expectedVersion = options.expectedVersion ?? null;
    this.actualVersion = options.actualVersion ?? null;
    this.streamId = options.streamId ?? null;
  }

'use strict';

import { AdvancedEventDispatcher } from '../AdvancedEventDispatcher.js';
import { resolveEventCompatibilityProfile } from '../compatibility/CompatibilityProfile.js';
import { UniversalEventFabric } from '../universal/UniversalEventFabric.js';
import { NodeRuntimeAdapter } from './runtime/NodeRuntimeAdapter.js';
import { NodeEventCrypto } from './crypto/NodeEventCrypto.js';
import {
  IpcEventTransport,
  RawNodeTcpEventTransport,
  RawNodeUdpEventTransport,
  RawNodeWebSocketEventTransport,
  RedisPubSubEventTransport,
  RedisStreamsEventTransport,
} from './transports/index.js';

export class NodeEventFabric extends UniversalEventFabric {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    const profile = resolveEventCompatibilityProfile(options.profile || options.configuration?.profile || 'compat', options.compatibilityOverrides || {});
    const dispatcher = options.dispatcher || new AdvancedEventDispatcher({
      profile: profile.name,
      ...(options.bus || {}),
      context: options.context,
      metrics: options.dispatcherMetrics,
      diagnostics: options.dispatcherDiagnostics,
    });
    const runtime = options.runtime || new NodeRuntimeAdapter(options.runtimeOptions || {});
    const cryptoProvider = options.cryptoProvider || createCrypto(options.crypto || options.security || {});
    super({
      ...options,
      profile,
      dispatcher,
      runtime,
      cryptoProvider,
      transportList: [...(options.transportList || []), ...createNodeTransports(options)],
      ownTransports: true,
      application: options.application || options.app?.name || process.env.APP_NAME || null,
      nodeId: options.nodeId || process.env.RAWNODE_NODE_ID || runtime.id,
    });
    this.expose = options.exposeGlobal === true || options.global === true;
    this.globalKey = options.globalKey || 'events';
    this.ownsDispatcher = !options.dispatcher;
  }

  async start(context = {}) {
    await super.start(context);
    if (this.expose) this.exposeGlobal();
    this.dispatch('events:fabric:node:started', { profile: this.profile.name, runtime: this.runtime.id, transports: this.transports.names() });
    return this;
  }

  exposeGlobal() {
    if (globalThis[this.globalKey] == null || globalThis[this.globalKey] === this.dispatcher) globalThis[this.globalKey] = this.dispatcher;
    globalThis.RawNode ||= {};
    globalThis.RawNode.events = globalThis[this.globalKey];
    globalThis.RawNode.eventFabric = this;
    return this;
  }

  async close(options = {}) {
    const snapshot = await super.close(options);
    if (globalThis.RawNode?.eventFabric === this) delete globalThis.RawNode.eventFabric;
    if (this.ownsDispatcher && options.closeDispatcher !== false) await this.dispatcher.close?.(options);
    this.cryptoProvider?.close?.();
    return snapshot;
  }
}

export function createNodeEventFabric(options = {}) { return new NodeEventFabric(options); }

function createCrypto(options) {
  if (!options || (!options.secret && !Array.isArray(options.keys))) return null;
  return new NodeEventCrypto(options);
}

function createNodeTransports(options) {
  const output = [];
  if (options.redis && options.redisPubSub !== false) output.push(new RedisPubSubEventTransport(options.redis, object(options.redisPubSub)));
  if (options.redis && options.redisStreams) output.push(new RedisStreamsEventTransport(options.redis, object(options.redisStreams)));
  if (options.websocket || options.ws) output.push(new RawNodeWebSocketEventTransport(options.websocket || options.ws, object(options.websocketTransport)));
  if (options.tcp) output.push(new RawNodeTcpEventTransport(options.tcp, object(options.tcpTransport)));
  if (options.udp) output.push(new RawNodeUdpEventTransport(options.udp, object(options.udpTransport)));
  if (options.ipc === true) output.push(new IpcEventTransport(process, {}));
  else if (options.ipc && typeof options.ipc === 'object') output.push(new IpcEventTransport(options.ipc.endpoint || options.ipc, options.ipc.endpoint ? options.ipc : {}));
  return output;
}
function object(value) { return value && typeof value === 'object' ? value : {}; }
export default NodeEventFabric;

'use strict';

import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';

export class NodeEventCrypto {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.keys = new Map();
    this.primaryKeyId = options.primaryKeyId || null;
    for (const key of options.keys || []) this.addKey(key);
    if (options.secret) this.addKey({ id: options.keyId || 'events-primary', secret: options.secret, primary: true });
  }
  addKey(input = {}) {
    const id = String(input.id || input.keyId || input.kid || 'events-key');
    const secret = input.secret ?? input.key;
    if (secret == null) throw new TypeError(`Event crypto key '${id}' requires secret.`);
    const value = Buffer.isBuffer(secret) ? Buffer.from(secret) : Buffer.from(String(secret));
    if (value.length < Math.max(1, Number(input.minimumBytes) || 16)) throw Object.assign(new Error(`Event crypto key '${id}' is too short.`), { code: 'EVENT_CRYPTO_KEY_TOO_SHORT' });
    this.keys.set(id, { id, secret: value, algorithm: input.algorithm || 'hmac-sha256', createdAt: input.createdAt || null, expiresAt: input.expiresAt || null });
    if (input.primary === true || !this.primaryKeyId) this.primaryKeyId = id;
    return this;
  }
  sign(bytes, options = {}) {
    const key = this._key(options.keyId);
    return { keyId: key.id, algorithm: 'hmac-sha256', signature: createHmac('sha256', key.secret).update(bytes).digest('base64url') };
  }
  verify(bytes, signature, options = {}) {
    try {
      const expected = Buffer.from(this.sign(bytes, options).signature, 'base64url');
      const supplied = Buffer.from(String(signature), 'base64url');
      return supplied.length === expected.length && timingSafeEqual(supplied, expected);
    } catch { return false; }
  }
  rotate(input) { return this.addKey({ ...input, primary: true }); }
  _key(id = null) {
    const key = this.keys.get(String(id || this.primaryKeyId));
    if (!key) throw Object.assign(new Error(`Unknown event crypto key '${id || this.primaryKeyId}'.`), { code: 'EVENT_CRYPTO_KEY_UNKNOWN' });
    if (key.expiresAt && new Date(key.expiresAt).getTime() <= Date.now()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`Event crypto key '${key.id}' has expired.`), { code: 'EVENT_CRYPTO_KEY_EXPIRED' });
    return key;
  }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ primaryKeyId: this.primaryKeyId, keys: [...this.keys.values()].map(({ secret, ...value }) => ({ ...value, bytes: secret.length })) }); }
  close() { for (const key of this.keys.values()) key.secret.fill(0); this.keys.clear(); }
}
export default NodeEventCrypto;

'use strict';

import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';
import { EventTransport } from '../../universal/transport/EventTransport.js';
import { EventDeliveryResult, EventDeliveryState } from '../../universal/delivery/EventDelivery.js';
import { timeout } from '../../universal/support/safe.js';

export class RawNodeWebSocketEventTransport extends EventTransport {
  constructor(target, options = {}) {
    super(options.id || 'websocket', { ...options, capabilities: { remote: true, ordered: true, orderedByPartition: true, acknowledged: true, durable: false, fanout: true, binary: true, requestReply: true, server: true, maxPacketBytes: Number(options.maxPacketBytes) || 1024 * 1024, ...(options.capabilities || {}) } });
    if (!target) throw new TypeError('RawNodeWebSocketEventTransport requires a RawNode WS target.');
    this.target = target;
    this.eventName = options.eventName || 'rawnode:event';
    this.publishOperation = typeof options.publish === 'function' ? options.publish : null;
    this.receivers = new Set();
    this.ackTimeoutMs = Math.max(1, Number(options.ackTimeoutMs) || 15_000);
    this.owned = options.owned === true;
  }
  async start() {
    if (this.state === 'started') return this;
    await super.start();
    const handler = this._handler ||= (payload, peer, ack) => this._receive(payload, peer, ack);
    if (typeof this.target.on === 'function') this.target.on(this.eventName, handler);
    else this.target.addEventListener?.('message', this._nativeHandler ||= (event) => this._receiveNative(event));
    return this;
  }
  subscribe(receiver) { this.receivers.add(receiver); return () => this.receivers.delete(receiver); }
  _receive(payload, peer = null, ack = null) {
    const envelope = payload?.envelope || payload;
    if (!envelope?.name) return;
    this.stats.received++;
    for (const receiver of this.receivers) Promise.resolve(receiver(envelope, { transport: this, remote: true, peer, acknowledge: ack })).then((value) => { if (typeof ack === 'function') ack({ ok: true, value }); }, (error) => { if (typeof ack === 'function') ack({ ok: false, error: { code: error?.code || null, message: error?.message || String(error) } }); this._error(error); });
  }
  _receiveNative(event) { try { const value = typeof event.data === 'string' ? JSON.parse(event.data) : event.data; if (value?.event === this.eventName || value?.__rawnodeEventFabric) this._receive(value.envelope || value.payload || value); } catch (error) { this.stats.rejected++; this._error(error); } }
  async publish(envelope, options = {}) {
    await this.start();
    const raw = envelope.encode?.() || JSON.stringify(envelope);
    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(raw);
    if (this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes > 0 && bytes > this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes) return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_PACKET_TOO_LARGE', reason: 'packet-too-large' });
    try {
      let value; let acknowledged = false;
      if (this.publishOperation) value = await this.publishOperation(envelope, { ...options, target: this.target, transport: this });
      else if ((options.requireAcknowledgement === true || options.ack === true) && typeof this.target.emitWithAck === 'function') { value = await timeout(this.target.emitWithAck(this.eventName, envelope, options), options.timeoutMs || this.ackTimeoutMs, { code: 'EVENT_WEBSOCKET_ACK_TIMEOUT' }); acknowledged = true; }
      else if (options.channel && typeof this.target.to === 'function') value = this.target.to(options.channel).emit(this.eventName, envelope);
      else if (typeof this.target.broadcast?.emit === 'function' && options.broadcast === true) value = this.target.broadcast.emit(this.eventName, envelope);
      else if (typeof this.target.emit === 'function') value = this.target.emit(this.eventName, envelope);
      else if (typeof this.target.send === 'function') value = this.target.send(raw);
      else return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_WEBSOCKET_PUBLISH_UNSUPPORTED', reason: 'publish-unsupported' });
      if (value === false) return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_WEBSOCKET_NOT_ADMITTED', reason: 'transport-rejected', retryable: true });
      this.stats.published++; this.stats.bytesOut += bytes;
      return EventDeliveryResult.accepted({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: acknowledged ? EventDeliveryState.ACKNOWLEDGED : EventDeliveryState.SENT, acknowledged, value });
    } catch (error) { this._error(error); return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: EventDeliveryState.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, code: error.code || 'EVENT_WEBSOCKET_PUBLISH_FAILED', reason: error.message, retryable: true, error }); }
  }
  async close() { try { this.target.off?.(this.eventName, this._handler); this.target.removeEventListener?.('message', this._nativeHandler); if (this.owned) await this.target.close?.(); } catch {} this.receivers.clear(); return super.close(); }
}
export default RawNodeWebSocketEventTransport;

'use strict';

import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';
import { EventTransport } from '../../universal/transport/EventTransport.js';
import { EventDeliveryResult, EventDeliveryState } from '../../universal/delivery/EventDelivery.js';

export class RawNodeUdpEventTransport extends EventTransport {
  constructor(target, options = {}) {
    super(options.id || 'udp', { ...options, capabilities: { remote: true, ordered: false, orderedByPartition: false, acknowledged: false, durable: false, fanout: true, binary: true, requestReply: false, server: true, maxPacketBytes: Number(options.maxPacketBytes) || 60 * 1024, ...(options.capabilities || {}) } });
    if (!target) throw new TypeError('RawNodeUdpEventTransport requires a RawNode UDP target.');
    this.target = target;
    this.eventName = options.eventName || 'rawnode:event';
    this.publishOperation = typeof options.publish === 'function' ? options.publish : null;
    this.decode = typeof options.decode === 'function' ? options.decode : defaultDecode;
    this.encode = typeof options.encode === 'function' ? options.encode : defaultEncode;
    this.destination = options.destination || null;
    this.receivers = new Set();
    this.owned = options.owned === true;
  }
  async start() { if (this.state === 'started') return this; await super.start(); this._eventHandler ||= (payload, peer) => this._receive(payload, peer); this._messageHandler ||= (payload, peer) => this._receiveRaw(payload, peer); this.target.on?.(this.eventName, this._eventHandler); if (this.options.rawMessages === true) this.target.on?.('message', this._messageHandler); return this; }
  subscribe(receiver) { this.receivers.add(receiver); return () => this.receivers.delete(receiver); }
  _receive(payload, peer = null) { const envelope = payload?.envelope || payload; if (!envelope?.name) return; this.stats.received++; for (const receiver of this.receivers) Promise.resolve(receiver(envelope, { transport: this, remote: true, peer })).catch((error) => this._error(error)); }
  _receiveRaw(payload, peer) { try { const message = this.decode(payload, peer); if (message?.event === this.eventName || message?.__rawnodeEventFabric) this._receive(message.envelope || message.payload || message, peer); } catch (error) { this.stats.rejected++; this._error(error); } }
  async publish(envelope, options = {}) {
    await this.start(); const payload = this.encode({ __rawnodeEventFabric: true, event: this.eventName, envelope }); const bytes = payload.byteLength ?? Buffer.byteLength(payload);
    if (this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes > 0 && bytes > this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes) return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_PACKET_TOO_LARGE', reason: 'packet-too-large' });
    const destination = options.destination || this.destination || {};
    try {
      let value;
      if (this.publishOperation) value = await this.publishOperation(envelope, { ...options, payload, target: this.target, transport: this });
      else if (typeof this.target.sendEvent === 'function') value = await this.target.sendEvent(this.eventName, envelope, destination);
      else if (typeof this.target.emitTo === 'function') value = await this.target.emitTo(destination, this.eventName, envelope);
      else if (typeof this.target.send === 'function' && destination.port) value = await sendDatagram(this.target, payload, destination.port, destination.address || destination.host || '127.0.0.1');
      else return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_UDP_DESTINATION_REQUIRED', reason: 'destination-required' });
      if (value === false) return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_UDP_NOT_ADMITTED', reason: 'transport-rejected', retryable: true });
      this.stats.published++; this.stats.bytesOut += bytes;
      return EventDeliveryResult.accepted({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: EventDeliveryState.SENT, value });
    } catch (error) { this._error(error); return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: EventDeliveryState.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, code: error.code || 'EVENT_UDP_PUBLISH_FAILED', reason: error.message, retryable: true, error }); }
  }
  async close() { try { this.target.off?.(this.eventName, this._eventHandler); this.target.off?.('message', this._messageHandler); if (this.owned) await this.target.close?.(); } catch {} this.receivers.clear(); return super.close(); }
}
function defaultEncode(value) { return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value)); }
function defaultDecode(value) { return JSON.parse(Buffer.isBuffer(value) || value instanceof Uint8Array ? Buffer.from(value).toString('utf8') : String(value)); }
function sendDatagram(target, payload, port, address) { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const accepted = target.send(payload, port, address, (error) => error ? reject(error) : resolve(true)); if (accepted === false) resolve(false); }); }
export default RawNodeUdpEventTransport;

'use strict';

import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';
import { EventTransport } from '../../universal/transport/EventTransport.js';
import { EventDeliveryResult, EventDeliveryState } from '../../universal/delivery/EventDelivery.js';

export class RedisPubSubEventTransport extends EventTransport {
  constructor(client, options = {}) {
    super(options.id || 'redis-pubsub', { ...options, capabilities: { remote: true, ordered: false, acknowledged: false, durable: false, fanout: true, binary: false, requestReply: true, server: true, maxPacketBytes: Number(options.maxPacketBytes) || 1024 * 1024, ...(options.capabilities || {}) } });
    if (!client) throw new TypeError('RedisPubSubEventTransport requires a Redis client.');
    this.client = client;
    this.channel = options.channel || 'rawnode:events:v3';
    this.receivers = new Set();
    this.subscription = null;
    this.owned = options.owned === true;
  }
  async start() {
    if (this.state === 'started') return this;
    await super.start();
    const handler = this._handler ||= (message, channel) => this._receive(message, channel);
    this.subscription = await this.client.subscribe(this.channel, handler, { serial: true, ...(this.options.subscribe || {}) });
    await this.subscription?.ready?.();
    return this;
  }
  subscribe(receiver) { if (typeof receiver !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Redis event receiver must be a function.'); this.receivers.add(receiver); return () => this.receivers.delete(receiver); }
  _receive(message, channel = this.channel) {
    try {
      const raw = Buffer.isBuffer(message) || message instanceof Uint8Array ? Buffer.from(message).toString('utf8') : String(message);
      const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(raw);
      if (this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes > 0 && bytes > this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes) { this.stats.rejected++; return; }
      const envelope = JSON.parse(raw);
      this.stats.received++; this.stats.bytesIn += bytes;
      for (const receiver of this.receivers) Promise.resolve(receiver(envelope, { transport: this, channel, remote: true })).catch((error) => this._error(error));
    } catch (error) { this.stats.rejected++; this._error(error); }
  }
  async publish(envelope) {
    await this.start();
    const raw = envelope.encode?.() || JSON.stringify(envelope);
    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(raw);
    if (this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes > 0 && bytes > this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes) return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_PACKET_TOO_LARGE', reason: 'packet-too-large' });
    try {
      const receivers = await this.client.publish(this.channel, raw);
      this.stats.published++; this.stats.bytesOut += bytes;
      return EventDeliveryResult.accepted({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: EventDeliveryState.SENT, value: { receivers } });
    } catch (error) { this._error(error); return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: EventDeliveryState.FAILED, code: error.code || 'EVENT_REDIS_PUBLISH_FAILED', reason: error.message, retryable: true, error }); }
  }
  async close() {
    try { if (this.subscription?.unsubscribe) await this.subscription.unsubscribe(); else await this.client.unsubscribe?.(this.channel, this._handler); } catch {}
    this.subscription = null; this.receivers.clear();
    if (this.owned) await this.client.close?.();
    return super.close();
  }
}
export default RedisPubSubEventTransport;

'use strict';

import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';
import { EventTransport } from '../../universal/transport/EventTransport.js';
import { EventDeliveryResult, EventDeliveryState } from '../../universal/delivery/EventDelivery.js';

export class RawNodeTcpEventTransport extends EventTransport {
  constructor(target, options = {}) {
    super(options.id || 'tcp', { ...options, capabilities: { remote: true, ordered: true, orderedByPartition: true, acknowledged: options.acknowledged !== false, durable: false, fanout: true, binary: true, requestReply: true, server: true, maxPacketBytes: Number(options.maxPacketBytes) || 4 * 1024 * 1024, ...(options.capabilities || {}) } });
    if (!target) throw new TypeError('RawNodeTcpEventTransport requires a RawNode TCP target.');
    this.target = target;
    this.eventName = options.eventName || 'rawnode:event';
    this.publishOperation = typeof options.publish === 'function' ? options.publish : null;
    this.receivers = new Set();
    this.owned = options.owned === true;
  }
  async start() { if (this.state === 'started') return this; await super.start(); this._handler ||= (payload, connection, ack) => this._receive(payload, connection, ack); this.target.on?.(this.eventName, this._handler); this.target.onEvent?.(this.eventName, this._handler); return this; }
  subscribe(receiver) { this.receivers.add(receiver); return () => this.receivers.delete(receiver); }
  _receive(payload, connection = null, ack = null) { const envelope = payload?.envelope || payload; if (!envelope?.name) return; this.stats.received++; for (const receiver of this.receivers) Promise.resolve(receiver(envelope, { transport: this, remote: true, connection, acknowledge: ack })).then((value) => ack?.({ ok: true, value }), (error) => { ack?.({ ok: false, error: { code: error?.code || null, message: error?.message || String(error) } }); this._error(error); }); }
  async publish(envelope, options = {}) {
    await this.start(); const raw = envelope.encode?.() || JSON.stringify(envelope); const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(raw);
    if (this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes > 0 && bytes > this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes) return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_PACKET_TOO_LARGE', reason: 'packet-too-large' });
    try {
      let value;
      if (this.publishOperation) value = await this.publishOperation(envelope, { ...options, target: this.target, transport: this });
      else if (typeof this.target.sendEvent === 'function') value = await this.target.sendEvent(this.eventName, envelope, options);
      else if (options.connection?.emit) value = options.connection.emit(this.eventName, envelope);
      else if (options.connection?.send) value = options.connection.send(raw);
      else if (options.room && typeof this.target.to === 'function') value = this.target.to(options.room).emit(this.eventName, envelope);
      else if (typeof this.target.broadcast === 'function') value = await this.target.broadcast(this.eventName, envelope, options);
      else if (typeof this.target.emit === 'function') value = this.target.emit(this.eventName, envelope);
      else if (typeof this.target.send === 'function') value = this.target.send(raw, options);
      else return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_TCP_PUBLISH_UNSUPPORTED', reason: 'publish-unsupported' });
      if (value === false) return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_TCP_NOT_ADMITTED', reason: 'transport-rejected', retryable: true });
      this.stats.published++; this.stats.bytesOut += bytes;
      const acknowledged = value?.acknowledged === true || value?.acked === true;
      return EventDeliveryResult.accepted({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: acknowledged ? EventDeliveryState.ACKNOWLEDGED : EventDeliveryState.SENT, acknowledged, value });
    } catch (error) { this._error(error); return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: EventDeliveryState.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, code: error.code || 'EVENT_TCP_PUBLISH_FAILED', reason: error.message, retryable: true, error }); }
  }
  async close() { try { this.target.off?.(this.eventName, this._handler); this.target.offEvent?.(this.eventName, this._handler); if (this.owned) await this.target.close?.(); } catch {} this.receivers.clear(); return super.close(); }
}
export default RawNodeTcpEventTransport;

'use strict';

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer';
import { EventTransport } from '../../universal/transport/EventTransport.js';
import { EventDeliveryResult, EventDeliveryState } from '../../universal/delivery/EventDelivery.js';

function method(client, ...names) { for (const name of names) if (typeof client?.[name] === 'function') return client[name].bind(client); return null; }
function delay(ms, signal, unref = false) { return new Promise((resolve) => { const timer = setTimeout(resolve, ms); if (unref) timer.unref?.(); signal?.addEventListener?.('abort', () => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(); }, { once: true }); }); }

export class RedisStreamsEventTransport extends EventTransport {
  constructor(client, options = {}) {
    super(options.id || 'redis-streams', { ...options, capabilities: { remote: true, ordered: true, orderedByPartition: true, acknowledged: true, durable: true, fanout: false, binary: false, requestReply: true, server: true, maxPacketBytes: Number(options.maxPacketBytes) || 1024 * 1024, ...(options.capabilities || {}) } });
    if (!client) throw new TypeError('RedisStreamsEventTransport requires a Redis client.');
    this.client = client;
    this.stream = options.stream || 'rawnode:events:v3';
    this.deadLetterStream = options.deadLetterStream || `${this.stream}:dead`;
    this.group = options.group || 'rawnode-events';
    this.consumer = options.consumer || `${process.pid}-${randomUUID()}`;
    this.maxLength = Math.max(100, Number(options.maxLength) || 100_000);
    this.maxAttempts = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxAttempts) || 5);
    this.blockMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.blockMs) || 5_000);
    this.batchSize = Math.max(1, Number(options.batchSize) || 100);
    this.pollErrorDelayMs = Math.max(10, Number(options.pollErrorDelayMs) || 250);
    this.autoConsume = options.autoConsume !== false;
    this.unrefTimers = options.unrefTimers === true;
    this.receivers = new Set();
    this.controller = null;
    this.loop = null;
  }
  async ensureGroup() {
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xgroup', 'xGroup');
    if (!fn) throw Object.assign(new Error('Redis client does not expose XGROUP.'), { code: 'EVENT_REDIS_XGROUP_MISSING' });
    try { await fn('CREATE', this.stream, this.group, '0', 'MKSTREAM'); }
    catch (error) { if (!/BUSYGROUP/i.test(error?.message || '')) throw error; }
  }
  async start() {
    if (this.state === 'started') return this;
    await this.ensureGroup();
    await super.start();
    if (this.autoConsume && !this.loop) {
      this.controller = new AbortController();
      this.loop = this._consume(this.controller.signal).finally(() => { this.loop = null; });
    }
    return this;
  }
  subscribe(receiver) { if (typeof receiver !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Redis Streams receiver must be a function.'); this.receivers.add(receiver); return () => this.receivers.delete(receiver); }
  async publish(envelope) {
    await this.start();
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xadd', 'xAdd');
    if (!fn) return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_REDIS_XADD_MISSING', reason: 'xadd-missing' });
    const raw = envelope.encode?.() || JSON.stringify(envelope);
    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(raw);
    if (this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes > 0 && bytes > this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes) return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_PACKET_TOO_LARGE', reason: 'packet-too-large' });
    try {
      const id = await fn(this.stream, 'MAXLEN', '~', this.maxLength, '*', 'id', String(envelope.id), 'envelope', raw, 'attempt', String(envelope.delivery?.attempt || 1), 'createdAt', String(Date.now()));
      this.stats.published++; this.stats.bytesOut += bytes;
      return EventDeliveryResult.accepted({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: EventDeliveryState.PERSISTED, persisted: true, acknowledged: true, value: { id, stream: this.stream } });
    } catch (error) { this._error(error); return EventDeliveryResult.rejected({ transport: this.id, eventId: envelope.id, state: EventDeliveryState.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, code: error.code || 'EVENT_REDIS_STREAM_PUBLISH_FAILED', reason: error.message, retryable: true, error }); }
  }
  async _consume(signal) {
    while (!signal.aborted) {
      try {
        const messages = await this.read();
        for (const message of messages) await this._handle(message);
      } catch (error) {
        if (signal.aborted) break;
        this._error(error);
        this.state = 'started';
        await delay(this.pollErrorDelayMs, signal, this.unrefTimers);
      }
    }
  }
  async read(options = {}) {
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xreadgroup', 'xReadGroup');
    if (!fn) throw Object.assign(new Error('Redis client does not expose XREADGROUP.'), { code: 'EVENT_REDIS_XREADGROUP_MISSING' });
    const result = await fn('GROUP', this.group, this.consumer, 'COUNT', options.count || this.batchSize, 'BLOCK', options.blockMs ?? this.blockMs, 'STREAMS', this.stream, '>');
    return normalize(result);
  }
  async _handle(message) {
    const raw = message.fields.envelope || message.fields.payload;
    try {
      if (Buffer.byteLength(String(raw || '')) > this.capabilities().maxPacketBytes) throw Object.assign(new Error('Redis event envelope exceeds maximum bytes.'), { code: 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_PACKET_TOO_LARGE' });
      const envelope = JSON.parse(String(raw));
      for (const receiver of this.receivers) await receiver(envelope, { transport: this, remote: true, stream: this.stream, messageId: message.id });
      await this.ack(message.id);
      this.stats.received++; this.stats.bytesIn += Buffer.byteLength(String(raw));
    } catch (error) { await this.fail(message, error); }
  }
  async ack(...ids) { const fn = method(this.client, 'xack', 'xAck'); if (!fn || !ids.flat().length) return 0; return Number(await fn(this.stream, this.group, ...ids.flat())) || 0; }
  async fail(message, error) {
    const attempt = Math.max(1, Number(message.fields.attempt) || 1) + 1;
    if (attempt >= this.maxAttempts) { await this.deadLetter(message, error); await this.ack(message.id); return { deadLettered: true, attempt }; }
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xadd', 'xAdd');
    if (fn) await fn(this.stream, 'MAXLEN', '~', this.maxLength, '*', 'id', String(message.fields.id || randomUUID()), 'envelope', String(message.fields.envelope || ''), 'attempt', String(attempt), 'createdAt', String(Date.now()));
    await this.ack(message.id);
    return { retry: true, attempt };
  }
  async deadLetter(message, error) { const fn = method(this.client, 'xadd', 'xAdd'); if (fn) await fn(this.deadLetterStream, 'MAXLEN', '~', this.maxLength, '*', 'sourceId', String(message.id), 'envelope', String(message.fields.envelope || ''), 'error', String(error?.stack || error?.message || error), 'failedAt', String(Date.now())); }
  async close() { this.controller?.abort(); if (this.loop) await this.loop; this.controller = null; this.receivers.clear(); return super.close(); }
}
function normalize(result) {
  if (!Array.isArray(result)) return [];
  const output = [];
  for (const stream of result) {
    const entries = Array.isArray(stream) ? stream[1] : stream?.messages || [];
    for (const entry of entries || []) {
      const id = Array.isArray(entry) ? entry[0] : entry.id;
      const raw = Array.isArray(entry) ? entry[1] : entry.message || entry.fields;
      const fields = {};
      if (Array.isArray(raw)) for (let index = 0; index < raw.length; index += 2) fields[String(raw[index])] = raw[index + 1];
      else Object.assign(fields, raw || {});
      output.push({ id, fields });
    }
  }
  return output;
}
export default RedisStreamsEventTransport;

'use strict';

/**
 * Minimal event-sourced aggregate base. Subclasses implement `apply<EventName>`
 * methods or override applyEvent(event, replaying).
 */
export class AggregateRoot {
  constructor(id = null) {
    this.id = id;
    this.version = 0;
    this._uncommittedEvents = [];
  }

  record(event) {
    if (!event || typeof event !== 'object') throw new TypeError('AggregateRoot.record expects an event object');
    this.applyEvent(event, false);
    this._uncommittedEvents.push(event);
    return this;
  }

  applyEvent(event, replaying = false) {
    const eventName = event.eventName || event.constructor?.eventName || event.constructor?.name || 'Event';
    const method = `apply${String(eventName).split(/[:.\-_/]+/).filter(Boolean).map(capitalize).join('')}`;
    if (typeof this[method] === 'function') this[method](event.payload ?? event, event);
    else if (typeof this.apply === 'function' && this.apply !== AggregateRoot.prototype.apply) this.apply(event, replaying);
    this.version++;
    return this;
  }

  loadFromHistory(events = []) {
    this._uncommittedEvents.length = 0;
    this.version = 0;
    for (const record of events) {
      const event = record?.eventObject || record?.event || record;
      this.applyEvent(event, true);
      if (record?.streamVersion != null) this.version = Number(record.streamVersion);
    }
    return this;
  }

  uncommittedEvents() { return this._uncommittedEvents.slice(); }
  hasUncommittedEvents() { return this._uncommittedEvents.length > 0; }
  markCommitted() { this._uncommittedEvents.length = 0; return this; }

  toSnapshot() {
    const state = {};
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(this)) {
      if (key === '_uncommittedEvents') continue;
      state[key] = clone(value);
    }
    return Object.freeze({ id: this.id, version: this.version, state });
  }

  restoreSnapshot(snapshot) {
    if (!snapshot || typeof snapshot !== 'object') throw new TypeError('Aggregate snapshot is required');
    Object.assign(this, clone(snapshot.state || {}));
    this.id = snapshot.id ?? this.id;
    this.version = Math.max(0, Number(snapshot.version) || 0);
    this._uncommittedEvents = [];
    return this;
  }
}

function capitalize(value) { return value ? value[0].toUpperCase() + value.slice(1) : ''; }
function clone(value) {
  try { return structuredClone(value); } catch {}
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(clone);
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
  if (value instanceof Date) return new Date(value);
  const output = {};
  for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) output[key] = clone(child);
  return output;
}

export default AggregateRoot;

'use strict';

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { estimateValueBytes } from '../support/size.js';
import { EventAdmissionError, EventConcurrencyError, EventStoreError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

function clone(value) {
  try { return structuredClone(value); } catch {}
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(clone);
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
  if (value instanceof Date) return new Date(value);
  if (value instanceof Error) return { name: value.name, message: value.message, code: value.code };
  const output = {};
  for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) output[key] = clone(child);
  return output;
}

function normalizeEvent(event, options = {}) {
  const eventObject = event && typeof event === 'object' ? event : null;
  const eventName = options.eventName || eventObject?.eventName || eventObject?.constructor?.eventName || eventObject?.constructor?.name || 'Event';
  return {
    eventName: String(eventName),
    eventVersion: Math.max(1, Number(options.eventVersion ?? eventObject?.version) || 1),
    payload: clone(options.payload !== undefined ? options.payload : eventObject?.payload !== undefined ? eventObject.payload : event),
    eventObject: eventObject ? clone(eventObject) : null,
  };
}

/** Bounded in-memory event store with optimistic concurrency and snapshots. */
export class MemoryEventStore {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxStreams = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxStreams) || 100_000);
    this.maxEvents = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxEvents) || 1_000_000);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxBytes) || 256 * 1024 * 1024);
    this.maxEventBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxEventBytes) || 4 * 1024 * 1024);
    this.streams = new Map();
    this.snapshots = new Map();
    this.subscribers = new Set();
    this.events = 0;
    this.bytes = 0;
    this.globalPosition = 0;
    this.closed = false;
    this.stats = { appended: 0, reads: 0, conflicts: 0, rejected: 0, snapshots: 0, subscriberErrors: 0 };
  }

  version(streamId) { return this.streams.get(String(streamId))?.length || 0; }

  async append(streamId, events, options = {}) {
    if (this.closed) throw new EventStoreError('Event store is closed', { code: 'EVENT_STORE_CLOSED' });
    const id = String(streamId || '').trim();
    if (!id) throw new TypeError('streamId is required');
    const input = Array.isArray(events) ? events : [events];
    if (!input.length) return { streamId: id, version: this.version(id), records: [] };

    const existing = this.streams.get(id) || [];
    const actualVersion = existing.length;
    const expectedVersion = options.expectedVersion;
    if (expectedVersion !== undefined && expectedVersion !== null && expectedVersion !== 'any' && Number(expectedVersion) !== actualVersion) {
      this.stats.conflicts++;
      throw new EventConcurrencyError(`Expected stream ${id} at version ${expectedVersion}, found ${actualVersion}`, {
        streamId: id,
        expectedVersion: Number(expectedVersion),
        actualVersion,
      });
    }
    if (!this.streams.has(id) && this.streams.size >= this.maxStreams) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Event store stream limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_STORE_STREAM_LIMIT' });
    }
    if (this.events + input.length > this.maxEvents) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Event store event limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_STORE_EVENT_LIMIT' });
    }

    const timestamp = Date.now();
    const records = [];
    let additionalBytes = 0;
    for (let index = 0; index < input.length; index++) {
      const normalized = normalizeEvent(input[index], options.events?.[index] || {});
      const record = {
        id: String(options.ids?.[index] || normalized.eventObject?.id || randomUUID()),
        streamId: id,
        streamVersion: actualVersion + index + 1,
        globalPosition: this.globalPosition + index + 1,
        eventName: normalized.eventName,
        eventVersion: normalized.eventVersion,
        payload: normalized.payload,
        eventObject: normalized.eventObject,
        metadata: clone(options.metadata || normalized.eventObject?.meta || null),
        correlationId: options.correlationId || normalized.eventObject?.correlationId || null,
        causationId: options.causationId || normalized.eventObject?.causationId || null,
        tenantId: options.tenantId || normalized.eventObject?.tenantId || null,
        occurredAt: Number(options.occurredAt || normalized.eventObject?.timestamp) || timestamp,
        recordedAt: timestamp,
      };
      const bytes = estimateValueBytes(record, { maximum: this.maxEventBytes + 1 });
      if (bytes > this.maxEventBytes) {
        this.stats.rejected++;
        throw new EventAdmissionError('Event store record exceeds maxEventBytes', { code: 'EVENT_STORE_RECORD_BYTES', details: { bytes, maximum: this.maxEventBytes } });
      }
      record.bytes = bytes;
      additionalBytes += bytes;
      records.push(Object.freeze(record));
    }
    if (this.bytes + additionalBytes > this.maxBytes) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Event store byte limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_STORE_BYTES' });
    }

    const stream = existing.slice();
    stream.push(...records);
    this.streams.set(id, stream);
    this.events += records.length;
    this.bytes += additionalBytes;
    this.globalPosition += records.length;
    this.stats.appended += records.length;
    await this._notify(records);
    return { streamId: id, version: stream.length, records: records.map(publicRecord) };
  }

  async commit(aggregate, options = {}) {
    if (!aggregate || typeof aggregate.uncommittedEvents !== 'function') throw new TypeError('commit expects an AggregateRoot-like object');
    const events = aggregate.uncommittedEvents();
    const expectedVersion = Math.max(0, Number(aggregate.version) - events.length);
    const result = await this.append(options.streamId || aggregate.id, events, { ...options, expectedVersion: options.expectedVersion ?? expectedVersion });
    aggregate.markCommitted?.();
    aggregate.version = result.version;
    return result;
  }

  read(streamId, options = {}) {
    const stream = this.streams.get(String(streamId)) || [];
    const fromVersion = Math.max(1, Number(options.fromVersion) || 1);
    const toVersion = options.toVersion == null ? Infinity : Math.max(fromVersion, Number(options.toVersion) || Infinity);
    const limit = Math.max(0, Number(options.limit) || 0);
    let records = stream.filter((record) => record.streamVersion >= fromVersion && record.streamVersion <= toVersion);
    if (limit) records = records.slice(0, limit);
    this.stats.reads += records.length;
    return records.map(publicRecord);
  }

  readAll(options = {}) {
    const fromPosition = Math.max(1, Number(options.fromPosition) || 1);
    const limit = Math.max(0, Number(options.limit) || 0);
    let records = [];
    for (const stream of this.streams.values()) {
      for (const record of stream) if (record.globalPosition >= fromPosition) records.push(record);
    }
    records.sort((left, right) => left.globalPosition - right.globalPosition);
    if (options.eventName) records = records.filter((record) => record.eventName === String(options.eventName));
    if (options.tenantId != null) records = records.filter((record) => record.tenantId === options.tenantId);
    if (limit) records = records.slice(0, limit);
    this.stats.reads += records.length;
    return records.map(publicRecord);
  }

  async *iterate(options = {}) {
    const batchSize = Math.max(1, Number(options.batchSize) || 1000);
    let position = Math.max(1, Number(options.fromPosition) || 1);
    while (true) {
      const batch = this.readAll({ ...options, fromPosition: position, limit: batchSize });
      if (!batch.length) return;
      for (const record of batch) { yield record; position = record.globalPosition + 1; }
      if (batch.length < batchSize) return;
      await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
    }
  }

  subscribe(listener) {
    if (typeof listener !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Event store subscriber must be a function');
    this.subscribers.add(listener);
    return () => this.subscribers.delete(listener);
  }

  async _notify(records) {
    for (const listener of this.subscribers) {
      try { await listener(records.map(publicRecord)); }
      catch { this.stats.subscriberErrors++; }
    }
  }

  async saveSnapshot(streamId, snapshot) {
    const id = String(streamId);
    const version = Number(snapshot?.version);
    if (!Number.isInteger(version) || version < 0 || version > this.version(id)) throw new EventStoreError('Invalid snapshot version', { code: 'EVENT_STORE_SNAPSHOT_VERSION' });
    this.snapshots.set(id, Object.freeze({ ...clone(snapshot), streamId: id, savedAt: Date.now() }));
    this.stats.snapshots++;
    return this.getSnapshot(id);
  }

  getSnapshot(streamId) { const snapshot = this.snapshots.get(String(streamId)); return snapshot ? clone(snapshot) : null; }
  deleteSnapshot(streamId) { return this.snapshots.delete(String(streamId)); }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      closed: this.closed,
      streams: this.streams.size,
      events: this.events,
      bytes: this.bytes,
      globalPosition: this.globalPosition,
      snapshots: this.snapshots.size,
      subscribers: this.subscribers.size,
      limits: Object.freeze({ maxStreams: this.maxStreams, maxEvents: this.maxEvents, maxBytes: this.maxBytes, maxEventBytes: this.maxEventBytes }),
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }

  close() { this.closed = true; this.subscribers.clear(); return this.snapshot(); }
}

function publicRecord(record) {
  const { bytes, ...value } = record;
  return clone(value);
}

export default MemoryEventStore;

'use strict';

import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { EventAdmissionError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

export class MemoryProjectionCheckpointStore {
  constructor() { this.values = new Map(); }
  async get(name) { return this.values.get(String(name)) || 0; }
  async set(name, position) { this.values.set(String(name), Math.max(0, Number(position) || 0)); return position; }
  async clear(name = null) { if (name == null) this.values.clear(); else this.values.delete(String(name)); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(this.values)); }
}

/** Projection runner with checkpoints, selective handlers and cooperative rebuilds. */
export class ProjectionManager {
  constructor(eventStore, options = {}) {
    if (!eventStore || typeof eventStore.readAll !== 'function') throw new TypeError('ProjectionManager requires an event store');
    this.eventStore = eventStore;
    this.checkpoints = options.checkpoints || new MemoryProjectionCheckpointStore();
    this.projections = new Map();
    this.maxProjections = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxProjections) || 1000);
    this.batchSize = Math.max(1, Number(options.batchSize) || 1000);
    this.budgetMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.budgetMs) || 5);
    this.stats = { registered: 0, processed: 0, rebuilds: 0, failures: 0 };
  }

  register(name, handlers, options = {}) {
    const key = String(name || '').trim();
    if (!key) throw new TypeError('Projection name is required');
    if (this.projections.has(key) && options.replace !== true) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Projection already exists: ${key}`, { code: 'EVENT_PROJECTION_DUPLICATE' });
    if (!this.projections.has(key) && this.projections.size >= this.maxProjections) throw new EventAdmissionError('Projection limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_PROJECTION_LIMIT' });
    const normalized = typeof handlers === 'function' ? { '*': handlers } : handlers;
    if (!normalized || typeof normalized !== 'object') throw new TypeError('Projection handlers must be a function or event-name map');
    for (const handler of Object.values(normalized)) if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Projection handler must be a function');
    this.projections.set(key, Object.freeze({ name: key, handlers: { ...normalized }, reset: typeof options.reset === 'function' ? options.reset : null }));
    this.stats.registered++;
    return this;
  }

  unregister(name) { return this.projections.delete(String(name)); }

  async project(name, options = {}) {
    const projection = this.projections.get(String(name));
    if (!projection) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Projection not found: ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_PROJECTION_UNKNOWN' });
    const fromPosition = options.fromPosition ?? (await this.checkpoints.get(projection.name, { tenantId: options.tenantId })) + 1;
    const records = await this.eventStore.readAll({ fromPosition, limit: options.limit || this.batchSize, tenantId: options.tenantId });
    for (const record of records) await this._apply(projection, record, options);
    return { name: projection.name, processed: records.length, position: records.at(-1)?.globalPosition || fromPosition - 1 };
  }

  async rebuild(name, options = {}) {
    const projection = this.projections.get(String(name));
    if (!projection) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Projection not found: ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_PROJECTION_UNKNOWN' });
    await projection.reset?.({ name: projection.name, tenantId: options.tenantId });
    await this.checkpoints.clear(projection.name, { tenantId: options.tenantId });
    this.stats.rebuilds++;
    let processed = 0;
    let sliceStarted = performance.now();
    for await (const record of this.eventStore.iterate({ fromPosition: 1, batchSize: options.batchSize || this.batchSize, tenantId: options.tenantId })) {
      await this._apply(projection, record, options);
      processed++;
      if (this.budgetMs > 0 && performance.now() - sliceStarted >= this.budgetMs) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
        sliceStarted = performance.now();
      }
    }
    return { name: projection.name, processed, position: await this.checkpoints.get(projection.name, { tenantId: options.tenantId }) };
  }

  async _apply(projection, record, options) {
    const handler = projection.handlers[record.eventName] || projection.handlers['*'];
    try {
      if (handler) await handler(record.payload, record, options);
      await this.checkpoints.set(projection.name, record.globalPosition, { tenantId: options.tenantId });
      this.stats.processed++;
    } catch (error) {
      this.stats.failures++;
      throw error;
    }
  }

  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ projections: this.projections.size, checkpoints: this.checkpoints.snapshot?.() || null, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
}

export default ProjectionManager;

'use strict';

// src/events/ProtocolEvent.js

import { Event } from './Event.js';

function connectionDescriptor(connection) {
  if (!connection || typeof connection !== 'object') return null;
  return {
    id: connection.id ?? connection.connectionId ?? null,
    remoteAddress: connection.remoteAddress ?? connection.socket?.remoteAddress ?? null,
    remotePort: connection.remotePort ?? connection.socket?.remotePort ?? null,
    localAddress: connection.localAddress ?? connection.socket?.localAddress ?? null,
    localPort: connection.localPort ?? connection.socket?.localPort ?? null,
  };
}

export class ProtocolEvent extends Event {
  constructor(payload = {}, meta = {}) {
    super(payload, meta);
    this.protocol = meta.protocol || 'app';
    this.connection = meta.connection || null;
    this.transport = meta.transport || null;
    this.connectionMeta = meta.connectionMeta || connectionDescriptor(this.connection);
  }

  toJSON() {
    return {
      ...super.toJSON(),
      protocol: this.protocol,
      transport: this.transport,
      connection: this.connectionMeta,
    };
  }
}

export default ProtocolEvent;

'use strict';

import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { AdvancedEventDispatcher } from '../AdvancedEventDispatcher.js';

export class EventsBenchCommand {
  constructor(app = null) {
    this.app = app;
    this.signature = 'events:bench {--iterations=100000}';
    this.description = 'Run the built-in zero-dependency event-dispatch microbenchmark.';
  }

  async handle(options = {}) {
    const iterations = Math.max(1, Math.min(10_000_000, Number(options.iterations) || 100_000));
    const bus = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ profile: 'compat' });
    let sink = 0;
    bus.on('bench:exact', (value) => { sink += value; });
    for (let index = 0; index < 10_000; index++) bus.dispatch('bench:exact', 1);
    const started = performance.now();
    for (let index = 0; index < iterations; index++) bus.dispatch('bench:exact', 1);
    const durationMs = performance.now() - started;
    await bus.close();
    return {
      iterations,
      durationMs,
      opsPerSecond: durationMs ? iterations / durationMs * 1000 : Infinity,
      nsPerDispatch: durationMs ? durationMs * 1e6 / iterations : 0,
      sink,
    };
  }
}

export default EventsBenchCommand;

FILE PATH: ./console/run.js

'use strict';

import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import defaultConfig from '../../../config/events.js';
import { AdvancedEventDispatcher } from '../AdvancedEventDispatcher.js';
import { EventConfiguration } from '../config/EventConfiguration.js';
import { createEventEnvelope, validateEventEnvelope } from '../serialization/EventEnvelope.js';

function parse(argv) {
  const args = [];
  const options = Object.create(null);
  for (let index = 0; index < argv.length; index++) {
    const value = argv[index];
    if (!value.startsWith('--')) { args.push(value); continue; }
    const equal = value.indexOf('=');
    if (equal !== -1) { options[value.slice(2, equal)] = value.slice(equal + 1); continue; }
    const name = value.slice(2);
    const next = argv[index + 1];
    if (next !== undefined && !next.startsWith('--')) { options[name] = next; index++; }
    else options[name] = true;
  }
  return { args, options };
}

function bool(value, fallback = false) {
  if (value == null) return fallback;
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
  return ['1', 'true', 'yes', 'on'].includes(String(value).toLowerCase());
}

function output(value, options = {}) {
  if (options.json || typeof value !== 'string') process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\n`);
  else process.stdout.write(`${value}\n`);
}

function usage() {
  return [
    'RawNode Events enterprise CLI',
    '',
    '  rawnode-events doctor [--profile production] [--json]',
    '  rawnode-events config [--profile compat|production] [--json]',
    '  rawnode-events bench [--iterations 250000] [--patterns 0] [--json]',
    '  rawnode-events envelope:create <event> [--secret value] [--json]',
    '  rawnode-events envelope:check <json> [--secret value] [--json]',
    '  rawnode-events help',
    '',
    'The framework-integrated commands events:list, events:inspect, events:stats,',
    'events:history, events:replay and events:bridge:* are registered by EventServiceProvider.',
  ].join('\n');
}

function busOptions(profile, options = {}) {
  const source = defaultConfig.bus || {};
  const normalizedProfile = String(profile || 'compat').toLowerCase();
  const strictNames = process.env.EVENTS_STRICT_NAMES == null
    ? ['production', 'strict', 'enterprise'].includes(normalizedProfile)
    : source.security?.strictNames === true;
  return {
    ...source,
    profile: normalizedProfile,
    security: { ...(source.security || {}), strictNames },
    metrics: { ...(source.metrics || {}), enabled: true },
    diagnostics: { ...(source.diagnostics || {}), enabled: bool(options.diagnostics, false) },
  };
}

async function doctor(options) {
  const profile = String(options.profile || defaultConfig.profile || 'production');
  const bus = new AdvancedEventDispatcher(busOptions(profile, options));
  try {
    const configuration = bus.configuration.toJSON();
    const findings = [];
    if (profile === 'production') {
      if (!configuration.listeners.maxTotal) findings.push({ level: 'error', code: 'EVENTS_LISTENERS_UNBOUNDED' });
      if (!configuration.deferred.maxItems || !configuration.deferred.maxBytes) findings.push({ level: 'error', code: 'EVENTS_DEFERRED_UNBOUNDED' });
      if (configuration.history.maxEntriesPerEvent > 0 && (!configuration.history.maxEventNames || !configuration.history.maxBytes)) findings.push({ level: 'error', code: 'EVENTS_HISTORY_UNBOUNDED' });
      if (configuration.logEvents) findings.push({ level: 'warning', code: 'EVENTS_PAYLOAD_LOGGING_ENABLED' });
    }
    bus.on('doctor:probe', () => true, { owner: 'events:doctor' });
    const report = bus.dispatchWithReport('doctor:probe');
    const health = bus.health();
    return {
      ok: health.ok !== false && report.errorCount === 0 && !findings.some((item) => item.level === 'error'),
      profile,
      node: process.version,
      zeroDependencies: true,
      health,
      probe: report.toJSON?.() || report,
      findings,
      configuration,
    };
  } finally {
    await bus.close();
  }
}

async function bench(options) {
  const iterations = Math.max(1, Math.min(10_000_000, Number(options.iterations) || 250_000));
  const patternCount = Math.max(0, Math.min(100_000, Number(options.patterns) || 0));
  const bus = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ profile: 'compat', metrics: false, historyLimit: 0 });
  let sink = 0;
  bus.on('bench:exact', (value) => { sink += value; });
  for (let index = 0; index < patternCount; index++) bus.onPattern(`bench:${index}:**`, () => {});
  for (let index = 0; index < 10_000; index++) bus.dispatch('bench:exact', 1);
  const started = performance.now();
  for (let index = 0; index < iterations; index++) bus.dispatch('bench:exact', 1);
  const elapsedMs = performance.now() - started;
  await bus.close();
  return {
    scenario: 'exact-dispatch',
    iterations,
    patternCount,
    elapsedMs,
    operationsPerSecond: elapsedMs ? Math.round(iterations / elapsedMs * 1000) : Infinity,
    nanosecondsPerDispatch: elapsedMs ? Math.round(elapsedMs * 1e6 / iterations) : 0,
    sink,
  };
}

export async function runCli(argv = process.argv.slice(2)) {
  const { args, options } = parse(argv);
  const command = args.shift() || 'help';
  if (command === 'help' || command === '--help' || bool(options.help)) {
    output(usage(), options);
    return 0;
  }
  if (command === 'doctor') {
    const result = await doctor(options);
    output(result, options);
    return result.ok ? 0 : 2;
  }
  if (command === 'config') {
    const profile = String(options.profile || defaultConfig.profile || 'compat');
    output(new EventConfiguration(busOptions(profile, options)).toJSON(), options);
    return 0;
  }
  if (command === 'bench') {
    output(await bench(options), options);
    return 0;
  }
  if (command === 'envelope:check') {
    if (!args[0]) throw new Error('envelope:check requires a JSON envelope');
    const parsed = JSON.parse(args[0]);
    const result = validateEventEnvelope(parsed, { secret: options.secret || undefined });
    output(result, options);
    return result.ok ? 0 : 2;
  }
  if (command === 'envelope:create') {
    if (!args[0]) throw new Error('envelope:create requires an event name');
    output(createEventEnvelope(args[0], [], { secret: options.secret || undefined }), options);
    return 0;
  }
  throw new Error(`Unknown RawNode Events command: ${command}`);
}

export default runCli;

'use strict';

import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

function resolve(app, key, fallback = null) {
  try { return app?.resolve?.(key) ?? fallback; } catch { return fallback; }
}

function eventBus(app) {
  const events = resolve(app, 'events');
  if (!events) throw new Error('RawNode events service is not available');
  return events;
}

export class EventsListCommand {
  constructor(app) { this.app = app; this.signature = 'events:list'; this.description = 'List event listeners by event, pattern, owner, priority, and tag.'; }
  async handle(options = {}) {
    let listeners = eventBus(this.app).listenerManifest?.() || [];
    if (options.owner) listeners = listeners.filter((entry) => entry.owner === String(options.owner));
    if (options.tag) listeners = listeners.filter((entry) => entry.tags?.includes(String(options.tag)));
    if (options.event) listeners = listeners.filter((entry) => entry.eventName === String(options.event) || entry.pattern === String(options.event));
    return { count: listeners.length, listeners };
  }
}

export class EventsInspectCommand {
  constructor(app) { this.app = app; this.signature = 'events:inspect {event}'; this.description = 'Explain exactly which listeners would receive an event.'; }
  async handle(eventName) {
    if (!eventName) throw new Error('events:inspect requires an event name');
    return eventBus(this.app).inspect(String(eventName));
  }
}

export class EventsDoctorCommand {
  constructor(app) { this.app = app; this.signature = 'events:doctor'; this.description = 'Check event-bus bounds, listener registry, diagnostics, bridge, and durable delivery health.'; }
  async handle() {
    const events = eventBus(this.app);
    const health = events.health?.() || { ok: true };
    const snapshot = events.snapshot?.() || null;
    const bridge = resolve(this.app, 'events.bridge.redis');
    const outboxPublisher = resolve(this.app, 'events.outbox.publisher');
    const findings = [];
    const config = events.configuration?.value || {};

    if (config.profile === 'production' && !config.listeners?.maxTotal) findings.push({ level: 'error', code: 'EVENTS_UNBOUNDED_LISTENERS', message: 'Production listener total is unbounded.' });
    if (config.profile === 'production' && config.history?.maxEntriesPerEvent > 0 && !config.history?.maxEventNames) findings.push({ level: 'error', code: 'EVENTS_UNBOUNDED_HISTORY_NAMES', message: 'Production replay history has no event-name ceiling.' });
    if (config.profile === 'production' && config.deferred?.maxItems === 0) findings.push({ level: 'warning', code: 'EVENTS_UNBOUNDED_DEFERRED', message: 'Deferred queue is unbounded.' });
    if (bridge?.required && !bridge.ready) findings.push({ level: 'error', code: 'EVENTS_BRIDGE_NOT_READY', message: `Required Redis bridge is ${bridge.state}.` });
    if (events.listenerManifest?.().some((entry) => !entry.owner)) findings.push({ level: 'info', code: 'EVENTS_OWNERLESS_LISTENERS', message: 'Some listeners have no lifecycle owner.' });

    return {
      ok: health.ok !== false && !findings.some((finding) => finding.level === 'error'),
      health,
      snapshot,
      bridge: bridge?.snapshot?.() || null,
      outbox: outboxPublisher?.snapshot?.() || resolve(this.app, 'events.outbox')?.snapshot?.() || null,
      findings,
    };
  }
}

export class EventsStatsCommand {

export class EventsBridgeTestCommand {

  async handle(options = {}) {

    const id = randomUUID();
    const admission = bridge.publish(options.event || 'events:bridge:probe', [{ id, timestamp: Date.now() }], {
      id,
      ttlMs: Number(options.ttlMs) || 10_000,
      headers: { probe: true },

export class EventsBenchCommand {
  constructor(app) { this.app = app; this.signature = 'events:bench'; this.description = 'Run a dependency-free event-dispatch microbenchmark.'; }
  async handle(options = {}) {
    const iterations = Math.max(1, Math.min(10_000_000, Number(options.iterations) || 250_000));
    const events = eventBus(this.app);
    let sink = 0;
    const eventName = `events:bench:${randomUUID()}`;
    const handle = events.subscribe(eventName, (value) => { sink += value; }, { owner: 'events:bench' });
    const started = performance.now();
    for (let index = 0; index < iterations; index++) events.dispatch(eventName, 1);
    const elapsedMs = performance.now() - started;
    handle.dispose();
    return { iterations, elapsedMs, operationsPerSecond: elapsedMs ? Math.round(iterations / elapsedMs * 1000) : Infinity, sink };
  }
}

'use strict';

export class EventsDoctorCommand {
  constructor(app) {
    this.app = app;
    this.signature = 'events:doctor {--json}';
    this.description = 'Inspect event-bus health, bounds, bridge state, schemas, and production readiness.';
  }

  async handle() {
    const bus = this.app?.resolve?.('events');
    if (!bus) return { ok: false, errors: ['Events dispatcher is not registered'], warnings: [] };
    const snapshot = bus.snapshot?.() || null;
    const config = bus.configuration?.toJSON?.() || bus.configuration?.value || null;
    const warnings = [];
    const errors = [];
    if (config?.profile === 'production') {
      if (!config.listeners?.maxTotal) warnings.push('listeners.maxTotal is unbounded');
      if (!config.deferred?.maxItems) warnings.push('deferred.maxItems is unbounded');
      if (!config.deferred?.maxBytes) warnings.push('deferred.maxBytes is unbounded');
      if (config.history?.maxEntriesPerEvent > 0 && !config.history?.maxBytes) warnings.push('history is enabled without a byte ceiling');
      if (config.logEvents && bus._logPayloads) warnings.push('event payload logging is enabled in production');
    }
    const health = bus.health?.();
    if (health && !health.ok) errors.push(...health.reasons);
    const schemas = this.app?.resolve?.('events.schemas')?.manifest?.() || [];
    return {
      ok: errors.length === 0,
      profile: config?.profile || 'unknown',
      health,
      snapshot,
      schemas: { count: schemas.length, contracts: schemas },
      warnings,
      errors,
    };
  }
}

export default EventsDoctorCommand;

'use strict';

// src/events/EventRegistry.js
// Lightweight provider-facing registry. Ascending priority remains the default
// because that is the historical EventRegistry contract; use priorityOrder:'desc'
// to align it with AdvancedEventDispatcher execution.

export class EventRegistry {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.map = new Map();
    this.priorityOrder = options.priorityOrder === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
    this._sequence = 0;
    this._owners = new Map();
  }

  listen(eventName, handler, priority = 10, options = {}) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    const entry = {
      id: ++this._sequence,
      handler,
      priority: Number(priority) || 0,
      owner: options.owner == null ? null : String(options.owner),
      tags: Array.isArray(options.tags) ? options.tags.map(String) : [],
    };
    const entries = this.map.get(name) || [];
    entries.push(entry);
    entries.sort((left, right) => {
      const priorityOrder = this.priorityOrder === 'desc'
        ? right.priority - left.priority
        : left.priority - right.priority;
      return priorityOrder || left.id - right.id;
    });
    this.map.set(name, entries);
    if (entry.owner) {
      let ids = this._owners.get(entry.owner);
      if (!ids) this._owners.set(entry.owner, ids = new Set());
      ids.add(entry.id);
    }
    // Historical EventRegistry.listen() returned undefined. Keep that exact
    // contract; use add()/subscribe() for fluent or disposable registration.
    return undefined;
  }

  add(eventName, handler, priority = 10, options = {}) {
    this.listen(eventName, handler, priority, options);
    return this;
  }

  subscribe(eventName, handler, priority = 10, options = {}) {
    this.listen(eventName, handler, priority, options);
    const id = this._sequence;
    return Object.freeze({
      id,
      dispose: () => this.removeById(id),
      off: () => this.removeById(id),
      [Symbol.dispose]: () => this.removeById(id),
    });
  }

  getListeners(eventName) { return this.map.get(String(eventName)) || []; }
  has(eventName) { return this.getListeners(eventName).length > 0; }
  eventNames() { return Array.from(this.map.keys()); }

  removeById(id) {
    for (const [eventName, entries] of this.map) {
      const index = entries.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === id);
      if (index === -1) continue;
      const [entry] = entries.splice(index, 1);
      if (!entries.length) this.map.delete(eventName);
      if (entry.owner) {
        const ids = this._owners.get(entry.owner);
        ids?.delete(entry.id);
        if (ids?.size === 0) this._owners.delete(entry.owner);
      }
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  removeOwner(owner) {
    const ids = Array.from(this._owners.get(String(owner)) || []);
    let removed = 0;
    for (const id of ids) if (this.removeById(id)) removed++;
    return removed;
  }

  clear(eventName = null) {
    if (eventName == null) {
      const count = Array.from(this.map.values()).reduce((sum, entries) => sum + entries.length, 0);
      this.map.clear();
      this._owners.clear();
      return count;
    }
    const entries = this.map.get(String(eventName)) || [];
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const ids = entry.owner ? this._owners.get(entry.owner) : null;
      ids?.delete(entry.id);
      if (ids?.size === 0) this._owners.delete(entry.owner);
    }
    this.map.delete(String(eventName));
    return entries.length;
  }

  registerSubscriber(SubscriberClass, options = {}) {
    const subscribed = SubscriberClass?.getSubscribedEvents?.();
    if (!subscribed) return undefined;
    const defaultPriority = Number(SubscriberClass.priority ?? options.priority ?? 10) || 0;

    for (const [eventName, definition] of Object.entries(subscribed)) {
      if (typeof definition === 'string') {
        this.listen(eventName, { subscriber: SubscriberClass, method: definition }, defaultPriority, options);
        continue;
      }
      if (Array.isArray(definition)) {
        const [method, priority = defaultPriority] = definition;
        this.listen(eventName, { subscriber: SubscriberClass, method }, priority, options);
        continue;
      }
      if (definition && typeof definition === 'object') {
        this.listen(
          eventName,
          { subscriber: SubscriberClass, method: definition.method || definition.handle },
          definition.priority ?? defaultPriority,
          { ...options, owner: definition.owner ?? options.owner, tags: definition.tags ?? options.tags },
        );
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  subscriber(SubscriberClass, options = {}) {
    this.registerSubscriber(SubscriberClass, options);
    return this;
  }

  manifest() {
    const output = [];
    for (const [eventName, entries] of this.map) {
      for (const entry of entries) output.push({ eventName, ...entry });
    }
    return output;
  }
}

export default EventRegistry;
