================================================
FILE PATH: ./src/events/broadcasting/BroadcastManager.js

'use strict';

import { compileMatcherList, matchesAny } from '../support/glob.js';
import { EventTransportError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

function isDispatcher(value) {
  return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && (
    typeof value.subscribeAny === 'function' || typeof value.onAny === 'function'
  );
}

function asArray(value) { return Array.isArray(value) ? value : value == null ? [] : [value]; }

export class BroadcastManager {
  constructor(dispatcherOrOptions = null, maybeOptions = {}) {
    this.dispatcher = isDispatcher(dispatcherOrOptions) ? dispatcherOrOptions : null;
    const options = this.dispatcher ? maybeOptions : (dispatcherOrOptions || {});
    this.transports = new Map();
    this.allow = compileMatcherList(options.allow || []);
    this.deny = compileMatcherList(options.deny || []);
    this.errorPolicy = options.errorPolicy || 'isolate';
    this.defaultChannel = options.defaultChannel || 'global';
    this.handle = null;
    this.started = false;
    this.stats = { considered: 0, broadcast: 0, deliveries: 0, skipped: 0, errors: 0 };
    for (const [name, transport] of Object.entries(options.adapters || options.transports || {})) {
      this.register(name, transport);
    }
  }

  setDispatcher(dispatcher) {
    if (!isDispatcher(dispatcher)) throw new TypeError('BroadcastManager requires an event dispatcher');
    this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
    return this;
  }

  register(name, transport, options = {}) {
    const key = String(name || '').trim();
    if (!key) throw new TypeError('Broadcast transport name is required');
    if (!transport || (
      typeof transport.broadcast !== 'function' &&
      typeof transport.publish !== 'function' &&
      typeof transport.emit !== 'function'
    )) {
      throw new TypeError('Broadcast transport must expose broadcast(), publish(), or emit()');
    }
    if (this.transports.has(key) && options.replace !== true) throw new Error(`Broadcast transport already exists: ${key}`);
    this.transports.set(key, { transport, options: { ...options } });
    return this;
  }

  unregister(name) { return this.transports.delete(String(name)); }

  start(dispatcher = this.dispatcher) {
    if (this.started) return this;
    this.setDispatcher(dispatcher);
    const listener = (eventName, eventObject) => {
      if (!eventObject || typeof eventObject !== 'object') return;
      void this.broadcast(eventObject, this.dispatcher.getContext?.(), { eventName }).catch(() => {});
    };
    if (typeof this.dispatcher.subscribeAny === 'function') {
      this.handle = this.dispatcher.subscribeAny(listener, {
        priority: -900,
        owner: 'rawnode:events:broadcast-manager',
        tags: ['broadcast'],
      });
    } else {
      this.dispatcher.onAny(listener, { priority: -900 });
      this._legacyListener = listener;
    }
    this.started = true;
    return this;
  }

  async broadcast(eventObject, context = null, options = {}) {
    if (!eventObject || typeof eventObject !== 'object') throw new TypeError('BroadcastManager.broadcast expects an event object');
    const eventName = String(options.eventName || eventObject.eventName || eventObject.constructor?.eventName || eventObject.constructor?.name || 'Event');
    this.stats.considered++;
    if (this.allow.length && !matchesAny(this.allow, eventName)) return this._skip('allow');
    if (this.deny.length && matchesAny(this.deny, eventName)) return this._skip('deny');
    if (typeof eventObject.shouldBroadcast === 'function' && eventObject.shouldBroadcast() !== true) return this._skip('shouldBroadcast');
    if (typeof eventObject.broadcastWhen === 'function' && await eventObject.broadcastWhen(context, options) === false) return this._skip('condition');

    const envelope = typeof eventObject.toBroadcastEnvelope === 'function'
      ? eventObject.toBroadcastEnvelope()
      : {
          event: typeof eventObject.broadcastAs === 'function' ? eventObject.broadcastAs() : eventName,
          channels: resolveChannels(eventObject, this.defaultChannel),
          payload: typeof eventObject.broadcastWith === 'function' ? eventObject.broadcastWith() : eventObject.payload ?? eventObject,
          id: eventObject.id,
          timestamp: eventObject.timestamp,
          meta: eventObject.meta ? { ...eventObject.meta } : null,
        };
    envelope.channels = asArray(envelope.channels).map(String).filter(Boolean);
    if (!envelope.channels.length) envelope.channels = [this.defaultChannel];

    const selected = options.transports ? new Set(asArray(options.transports).map(String)) : null;
    const deliveries = [];
    for (const [name, record] of this.transports) {
      if (selected && !selected.has(name)) continue;
      try {
        const value = await invoke(record.transport, envelope, {
          ...record.options,
          ...options,
          context,
          transportName: name,
          eventObject,
        });
        deliveries.push({ transport: name, status: 'fulfilled', value });
        this.stats.deliveries++;
      } catch (error) {
        this.stats.errors++;
        deliveries.push({ transport: name, status: 'rejected', error });
        if (options.errorPolicy === 'fail-fast' || this.errorPolicy === 'fail-fast') {
          throw new EventTransportError(`Broadcast transport "${name}" failed`, {
            code: 'EVENT_BROADCAST_FAILED',
            cause: error,
            details: { transport: name, eventName },
          });
        }
      }
    }
    this.stats.broadcast++;
    return { broadcast: true, event: envelope.event, channels: envelope.channels, envelope, deliveries };
  }

  _skip(reason) {
    this.stats.skipped++;
    return { broadcast: false, reason, deliveries: [] };
  }

  async stop() {
    this.handle?.dispose?.();
    if (this._legacyListener) this.dispatcher?.offAny?.(this._legacyListener);
    this.handle = null;
    this._legacyListener = null;
    this.started = false;
    return this;
  }

  async close(options = {}) {
    await this.stop();
    if (options.closeTransports !== false) {
      for (const { transport } of this.transports.values()) {
        try {
          if (typeof transport.close === 'function') await transport.close();
          else if (typeof transport.dispose === 'function') await transport.dispose();
        } catch (error) {
          this.stats.errors++;
          if (this.errorPolicy === 'fail-fast') throw error;
        }
      }
    }
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      started: this.started,
      transports: Object.freeze(Array.from(this.transports.keys())),
      errorPolicy: this.errorPolicy,
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }

  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await this.close(); }
}

function resolveChannels(eventObject, fallback) {
  if (typeof eventObject.broadcastChannels === 'function') return asArray(eventObject.broadcastChannels());
  if (typeof eventObject.broadcastChannel === 'function') return asArray(eventObject.broadcastChannel());
  return [fallback];
}

async function invoke(transport, envelope, options) {
  if (typeof transport.broadcast === 'function') return transport.broadcast(envelope, options);
  if (typeof transport.publish === 'function') return transport.publish(envelope.event, envelope, options);
  return transport.emit(envelope.event, envelope, options);
}

export default BroadcastManager;

'use strict';

import { AsyncLocalStorage } from 'node:async_hooks';
import { createEventContext } from './EventContext.js';

function defaultIdFactory() {
  const pid = process.pid.toString(36);
  const boot = Date.now().toString(36);
  let sequence = 0;
  return () => {
    sequence = (sequence + 1) >>> 0;
    return `${pid}-${boot}-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${sequence.toString(36)}-${((Math.random() * 0xfffff) | 0).toString(36)}`;
  };
}

export class EventContextManager {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.enabled = options.enabled !== false;
    this.storage = this.enabled ? new AsyncLocalStorage() : null;
    this.idFactory = typeof options.idFactory === 'function' ? options.idFactory : defaultIdFactory();
    this.closed = false;
  }

  create(meta = {}) { return createEventContext(meta, this.get(), this.idFactory); }
  get() { return this.storage?.getStore?.() || null; }
  id() { return this.get()?.id ?? null; }

  run(context, fn) {
    if (typeof fn !== 'function') throw new TypeError('EventContextManager.run expects a function');
    if (!this.storage || !context) return fn();
    return this.storage.run(context, fn);
  }

  runIfMissing(meta, fn) {
    return this.get() ? fn() : this.run(this.create(meta), fn);
  }

  enter(context) { if (this.storage && context) this.storage.enterWith(context); }

  bind(fn, context = this.get()) {
    if (typeof fn !== 'function') throw new TypeError('EventContextManager.bind expects a function');
    if (!this.storage || !context) return fn;
    const storage = this.storage;
    return function boundEventContext(...args) {
      return storage.run(context, () => Reflect.apply(fn, this, args));
    };
  }

  close() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this.closed = true;
    this.storage?.disable?.();
  }
}

export default EventContextManager;

'use strict';

export function createEventContext(meta = {}, parent = null, idFactory = null) {
  const id = meta.id ?? (typeof idFactory === 'function' ? idFactory() : null);
  const parentId = meta.parentId ?? parent?.id ?? null;
  const correlationId = meta.correlationId ?? parent?.correlationId ?? parent?.id ?? id;
  const context = {
    ...meta,
    id,
    parentId,
    correlationId,
    causationId: meta.causationId ?? parent?.id ?? parentId,
    transport: meta.transport ?? parent?.transport ?? 'internal',
    tenantId: meta.tenantId ?? parent?.tenantId ?? null,
    actorId: meta.actorId ?? parent?.actorId ?? null,
    traceId: meta.traceId ?? parent?.traceId ?? null,
    spanId: meta.spanId ?? null,
    requestId: meta.requestId ?? parent?.requestId ?? null,
    source: meta.source ?? parent?.source ?? null,
    remote: meta.remote === true,
    originTransport: meta.originTransport ?? parent?.originTransport ?? null,
    originNode: meta.originNode ?? parent?.originNode ?? null,
    envelopeId: meta.envelopeId ?? parent?.envelopeId ?? null,
    hop: Math.max(0, Number(meta.hop ?? parent?.hop ?? 0) || 0),
    ts: meta.ts ?? Date.now(),
    headers: meta.headers && typeof meta.headers === 'object' ? { ...meta.headers } : (parent?.headers || null),
  };
  return context;
}

export function shallowEventContext(context) {
  if (!context || typeof context !== 'object') return null;
  return {
    id: context.id ?? null,
    parentId: context.parentId ?? null,
    correlationId: context.correlationId ?? null,
    causationId: context.causationId ?? null,
    transport: context.transport ?? null,
    tenantId: context.tenantId ?? null,
    actorId: context.actorId ?? null,
    traceId: context.traceId ?? null,
    spanId: context.spanId ?? null,
    requestId: context.requestId ?? null,
    source: context.source ?? null,
    remote: context.remote === true,
    originTransport: context.originTransport ?? null,
    originNode: context.originNode ?? null,
    envelopeId: context.envelopeId ?? null,
    hop: context.hop ?? 0,
  };
}

'use strict';

export class ListenerHandle {
  constructor(target, id) {
    this.target = target;
    this.dispatcher = target;
    this.id = Number(id);
  }

  _entry() {
    return this.target?.getEntry?.(this.id)
      || this.target?._registry?.getEntry?.(this.id)
      || null;
  }

  get active() { return this._entry()?.active === true; }
  get paused() { return this._entry()?.paused === true; }
  get metadata() {
    const entry = this._entry();
    if (!entry) return null;
    if (typeof this.target?.describeEntry === 'function') return this.target.describeEntry(entry);
    if (typeof this.target?._listenerMetadata === 'function') return this.target._listenerMetadata(this.id);
    return this.target?._registry?.describeEntry?.(entry) || null;
  }

  describe() { return this.metadata; }

  pause() {
    if (typeof this.target?.pause === 'function') this.target.pause(this.id);
    else if (typeof this.target?._setListenerPaused === 'function') this.target._setListenerPaused(this.id, true);
    else this.target?._registry?.pause?.(this.id);
    return this;
  }

  resume() {
    if (typeof this.target?.resume === 'function') this.target.resume(this.id);
    else if (typeof this.target?._setListenerPaused === 'function') this.target._setListenerPaused(this.id, false);
    else this.target?._registry?.resume?.(this.id);
    return this;
  }

  dispose() {
    if (typeof this.target?.removeById === 'function') return this.target.removeById(this.id) === true;
    if (typeof this.target?._disposeListenerById === 'function') return this.target._disposeListenerById(this.id) === true;
    return this.target?._registry?.removeById?.(this.id) === true;
  }

  unsubscribe() { return this.dispose(); }
  off() { return this.dispose(); }

  toJSON() {
    return Object.freeze({ id: this.id, active: this.active, paused: this.paused, ...(this.metadata || {}) });
  }

  [Symbol.dispose]() { this.dispose(); }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { this.dispose(); }
}

export default ListenerHandle;

'use strict';

export class ListenerScope {
  constructor(dispatcher, owner) {
    this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
    this.owner = String(owner || `scope:${Date.now()}`);
    this.handles = new Set();
    this.closed = false;
  }

  _track(handle) {
    if (handle) this.handles.add(handle);
    return handle;
  }

  subscribe(eventName, listener, options = {}) { return this._track(this.dispatcher.subscribe(eventName, listener, { ...options, owner: options.owner || this.owner })); }
  on(eventName, listener, options = {}) { this.subscribe(eventName, listener, options); return this; }
  once(eventName, listener, options = {}) { this.subscribe(eventName, listener, { ...options, once: true }); return this; }
  pattern(pattern, listener, options = {}) { return this._track(this.dispatcher.subscribePattern(pattern, listener, { ...options, owner: options.owner || this.owner })); }
  onPattern(pattern, listener, options = {}) { this.pattern(pattern, listener, options); return this; }
  any(listener, options = {}) { return this._track(this.dispatcher.subscribeAny(listener, { ...options, owner: options.owner || this.owner })); }
  onAny(listener, options = {}) { this.any(listener, options); return this; }

  pause() { for (const handle of this.handles) handle.pause(); return this; }
  resume() { for (const handle of this.handles) handle.resume(); return this; }

  dispose() {
    if (this.closed) return 0;
    this.closed = true;
    let removed = 0;
    for (const handle of this.handles) if (handle.dispose()) removed++;
    this.handles.clear();
    return removed;
  }

  [Symbol.dispose]() { this.dispose(); }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { this.dispose(); }
}

export default ListenerScope;

'use strict';

export class SubscriptionBuilder {
  constructor(dispatcher, kind, expression) {
    this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
    this.kind = kind;
    this.expression = expression;
    this.options = Object.create(null);
  }

  priority(value) { this.options.priority = Number(value) || 0; return this; }
  prepend(value = true) { this.options.prepend = value !== false; return this; }
  once(value = true) { this.options.once = value !== false; return this; }
  replay(value = true) { this.options.replay = value; return this; }
  replayConsumesOnce(value = true) { this.options.replayConsumesOnce = value !== false; return this; }
  owner(value) { this.options.owner = value == null ? null : String(value); return this; }
  tag(...values) {
    const tags = values.flat().filter((value) => value != null).map(String);
    this.options.tags = [...(this.options.tags || []), ...tags];
    return this;
  }
  timeout(value) { this.options.timeoutMs = Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0); return this; }
  errorPolicy(value) { this.options.errorPolicy = value; return this; }
  meta(value) { this.options.meta = value; return this; }
  paused(value = true) { this.options.paused = value !== false; return this; }
  when(condition) { this.options.condition = condition; return this; }

  listen(listener) {
    if (this.options.condition === false) return null;
    if (typeof this.options.condition === 'function' && this.options.condition() === false) return null;
    if (this.kind === 'pattern') return this.dispatcher.subscribePattern(this.expression, listener, this.options);
    if (this.kind === 'any') return this.dispatcher.subscribeAny(listener, this.options);
    return this.dispatcher.subscribe(this.expression, listener, this.options);
  }

  handle(listener) { return this.listen(listener); }
  using(listener) { return this.listen(listener); }
}

export default SubscriptionBuilder;

'use strict';

import { computeWildcardEvents, firstStaticSegment, globPrefix, globToRegExp } from '../support/glob.js';
import { ListenerHandle } from './ListenerHandle.js';
import { EventAdmissionError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

const DEFAULT_MAX = 5000;

function finiteLimit(value, fallback) {
  if (value === 0) return 0;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= 0 ? Math.trunc(parsed) : fallback;
}

function compareEntries(left, right) {
  if (left.priority !== right.priority) return right.priority - left.priority;
  return left.order - right.order;
}

function insertSorted(bucket, entry) {
  let low = 0;
  let high = bucket.length;
  while (low < high) {
    const middle = (low + high) >>> 1;
    if (compareEntries(entry, bucket[middle]) < 0) high = middle;
    else low = middle + 1;
  }
  bucket.splice(low, 0, entry);
}

export class ListenerRegistry {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.exact = new Map();
    this.patterns = [];
    this.any = [];
    this.entries = new Map();
    this.patternIndex = new Map();
    this.ownerIndex = new Map();
    this.tagIndex = new Map();
    this.patternCounts = new Map();

    this.sequence = 0;
    this.total = 0;
    this.generation = 0;
    this.registrationFrozen = false;

    const compatibilityLimit = finiteLimit(options.maxListenersPerEvent, DEFAULT_MAX);
    this.limits = Object.freeze({
      maxListenersPerEvent: compatibilityLimit,
      maxListenersTotal: finiteLimit(options.maxListenersTotal, 0),
      maxPatternListeners: finiteLimit(options.maxPatternListeners, compatibilityLimit),
      maxListenersPerPattern: finiteLimit(options.maxListenersPerPattern, compatibilityLimit),
      maxAnyListeners: finiteLimit(options.maxAnyListeners, compatibilityLimit),
    });

    this.planCacheMax = Math.max(0, finiteLimit(options.planCacheMax, 1024));
    this.planCache = new Map();
  }

  _nextId() { this.sequence = (this.sequence + 1) >>> 0 || 1; return this.sequence; }

  _touch() {
    this.generation = (this.generation + 1) >>> 0;
    this.planCache.clear();
  }

  _assertMutable() {
    if (this.registrationFrozen) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Listener registration is frozen.', { code: 'EVENT_LISTENER_REGISTRY_FROZEN' });
    }
  }

  _assertTotal() {
    this._assertMutable();
    const max = this.limits.maxListenersTotal;
    if (max && this.total >= max) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Exceeded maxListenersTotal (${max}).`, { code: 'EVENT_LISTENER_TOTAL_LIMIT' });
    }
  }

  _assertBucket(bucket, label, max = this.limits.maxListenersPerEvent) {
    if (max && bucket.length >= max) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Exceeded listener limit (${max}) for "${label}".`, {
        code: 'EVENT_LISTENER_BUCKET_LIMIT',
        details: { label, maximum: max },
      });
    }
  }

  _entry(kind, key, fn, options = {}) {
    if (typeof fn !== 'function') throw new TypeError(`Listener for "${key ?? '*'}" must be a function`);
    const id = this._nextId();
    const prepend = options.prepend === true;
    const tags = Array.from(new Set((Array.isArray(options.tags) ? options.tags : options.tag ? [options.tag] : []).map(String)));
    return {
      id,
      kind,
      key,
      fn,
      once: options.once === true,
      prepend,
      priority: Number(options.priority ?? 0) || 0,
      order: prepend ? -id : id,
      meta: options.meta ?? null,
      owner: options.owner == null ? null : String(options.owner),
      tags,
      timeoutMs: Math.max(0, Number(options.timeoutMs) || 0),
      errorPolicy: options.errorPolicy || null,
      active: true,
      paused: options.paused === true,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    };
  }

  _index(entry) {
    this.entries.set(entry.id, entry);
    if (entry.owner) {
      let ids = this.ownerIndex.get(entry.owner);
      if (!ids) this.ownerIndex.set(entry.owner, ids = new Set());
      ids.add(entry.id);
    }
    for (const tag of entry.tags) {
      let ids = this.tagIndex.get(tag);
      if (!ids) this.tagIndex.set(tag, ids = new Set());
      ids.add(entry.id);
    }
    this.total++;
    this._touch();
    return new ListenerHandle(this, entry.id);
  }

  addExact(eventName, fn, options = {}) {
    this._assertTotal();
    const bucket = this.exact.get(eventName) || [];
    this._assertBucket(bucket, eventName);
    const entry = this._entry('exact', eventName, fn, options);
    insertSorted(bucket, entry);
    this.exact.set(eventName, bucket);
    return { entry, handle: this._index(entry) };
  }

  addPattern(pattern, fn, options = {}) {
    this._assertTotal();
    this._assertBucket(this.patterns, pattern, this.limits.maxPatternListeners);
    const count = this.patternCounts.get(pattern) || 0;
    const perPattern = this.limits.maxListenersPerPattern;
    if (perPattern && count >= perPattern) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Exceeded maxListenersPerPattern (${perPattern}) for "${pattern}".`, {
        code: 'EVENT_PATTERN_LISTENER_LIMIT',
      });
    }
    const entry = Object.assign(this._entry('pattern', pattern, fn, options), {
      pattern,
      prefix: globPrefix(pattern),
      regex: globToRegExp(pattern),
      segment: firstStaticSegment(pattern),
    });
    insertSorted(this.patterns, entry);
    let indexed = this.patternIndex.get(entry.segment);
    if (!indexed) this.patternIndex.set(entry.segment, indexed = new Set());
    indexed.add(entry);
    this.patternCounts.set(pattern, count + 1);
    return { entry, handle: this._index(entry) };
  }

  addAny(fn, options = {}) {
    this._assertTotal();
    this._assertBucket(this.any, '*', this.limits.maxAnyListeners);
    const entry = this._entry('any', '*', fn, options);
    insertSorted(this.any, entry);
    return { entry, handle: this._index(entry) };
  }

  getEntry(id) { return this.entries.get(Number(id)) || null; }

  describeEntry(entry) {
    return Object.freeze({
      id: entry.id,
      kind: entry.kind,
      eventName: entry.kind === 'exact' ? entry.key : null,
      pattern: entry.kind === 'pattern' ? entry.pattern : null,
      priority: entry.priority,
      once: entry.once,
      prepend: entry.prepend,
      active: entry.active,
      paused: entry.paused,
      owner: entry.owner,
      tags: entry.tags.slice(),
      timeoutMs: entry.timeoutMs,
      errorPolicy: entry.errorPolicy,
      meta: entry.meta,
      listener: entry.fn,
      listenerName: entry.fn.name || '(anonymous)',
      createdAt: entry.createdAt,
    });
  }

  _unindex(entry) {
    this.entries.delete(entry.id);
    if (entry.owner) {
      const ids = this.ownerIndex.get(entry.owner);
      ids?.delete(entry.id);
      if (ids?.size === 0) this.ownerIndex.delete(entry.owner);
    }
    for (const tag of entry.tags) {
      const ids = this.tagIndex.get(tag);
      ids?.delete(entry.id);
      if (ids?.size === 0) this.tagIndex.delete(tag);
    }
    entry.active = false;
    this.total = Math.max(0, this.total - 1);
    this._touch();
  }

  removeById(id) {
    const entry = this.entries.get(Number(id));
    if (!entry || !entry.active) return false;
    if (entry.kind === 'exact') {
      const bucket = this.exact.get(entry.key);
      if (bucket) {
        const index = bucket.indexOf(entry);
        if (index !== -1) bucket.splice(index, 1);
        if (bucket.length === 0) this.exact.delete(entry.key);
      }
    } else if (entry.kind === 'pattern') {
      const index = this.patterns.indexOf(entry);
      if (index !== -1) this.patterns.splice(index, 1);
      const indexed = this.patternIndex.get(entry.segment);
      indexed?.delete(entry);
      if (indexed?.size === 0) this.patternIndex.delete(entry.segment);
      const count = (this.patternCounts.get(entry.pattern) || 1) - 1;
      if (count <= 0) this.patternCounts.delete(entry.pattern);
      else this.patternCounts.set(entry.pattern, count);
    } else {
      const index = this.any.indexOf(entry);
      if (index !== -1) this.any.splice(index, 1);
    }
    this._unindex(entry);
    return true;
  }

  claimOnce(entry) {
    if (!entry.once) return entry.active;
    if (!entry.active) return false;
    return this.removeById(entry.id);
  }

  removeExact(eventName, fn) {
    const bucket = this.exact.get(eventName);
    if (!bucket) return false;
    const entry = bucket.find((candidate) => candidate.fn === fn && candidate.active);
    return entry ? this.removeById(entry.id) : false;
  }

  removePattern(pattern, fn) {
    const entry = this.patterns.find((candidate) => candidate.pattern === pattern && candidate.fn === fn && candidate.active);
    return entry ? this.removeById(entry.id) : false;
  }

  removeAny(fn) {
    const entry = this.any.find((candidate) => candidate.fn === fn && candidate.active);
    return entry ? this.removeById(entry.id) : false;
  }

  pause(id) {
    const entry = this.getEntry(id);
    if (!entry || entry.paused) return false;
    entry.paused = true;
    this._touch();
    return true;
  }

  resume(id) {
    const entry = this.getEntry(id);
    if (!entry || !entry.paused) return false;
    entry.paused = false;
    this._touch();
    return true;
  }

  removeOwner(owner) {
    const ids = Array.from(this.ownerIndex.get(String(owner)) || []);
    let removed = 0;
    for (const id of ids) if (this.removeById(id)) removed++;
    return removed;
  }

  removeTag(tag) {
    const ids = Array.from(this.tagIndex.get(String(tag)) || []);
    let removed = 0;
    for (const id of ids) if (this.removeById(id)) removed++;
    return removed;
  }

  clear(eventName = null) {
    if (eventName != null) {
      const bucket = Array.from(this.exact.get(eventName) || []);
      for (const entry of bucket) this.removeById(entry.id);
      return bucket.length;
    }
    const ids = Array.from(this.entries.keys());
    for (const id of ids) this.removeById(id);
    return ids.length;
  }

  _patternCandidates(eventName) {
    const segment = String(eventName).split(':', 1)[0];
    const output = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const key of [segment, '*']) {
      const entries = this.patternIndex.get(key);
      if (!entries) continue;
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (seen.has(entry.id)) continue;
        seen.add(entry.id);
        if (!entry.active || entry.paused) continue;
        if (entry.prefix && !eventName.startsWith(entry.prefix)) continue;
        if (entry.regex.test(eventName)) output.push(entry);
      }
    }
    output.sort(compareEntries);
    return output;
  }

  plan(eventName, wildcardNames = null) {
    const cached = this.planCache.get(eventName);
    if (cached && cached.generation === this.generation) {
      // Dispatch plans are immutable and invalidated by registry generation.
      // A cache hit therefore needs no delete/reinsert LRU churn on the hot path.
      return cached.plan;
    }
    const resolvedWildcards = wildcardNames || computeWildcardEvents(eventName);
    const exactStages = [eventName, ...resolvedWildcards].map((name) => ({
      eventName: name,
      entries: (this.exact.get(name) || []).filter((entry) => entry.active && !entry.paused).slice(),
    }));
    const plan = Object.freeze({
      eventName,
      wildcardNames: Object.freeze(resolvedWildcards.slice()),
      exactStages,
      patterns: this._patternCandidates(eventName),
      any: this.any.filter((entry) => entry.active && !entry.paused).slice(),
    });
    if (this.planCacheMax > 0) {
      this.planCache.set(eventName, { generation: this.generation, plan });
      while (this.planCache.size > this.planCacheMax) this.planCache.delete(this.planCache.keys().next().value);
    }
    return plan;
  }

  hasPotential(eventName, wildcardNames = []) {
    if (this.exact.has(eventName)) return true;
    for (const name of wildcardNames) if (this.exact.has(name)) return true;
    return this.patterns.length > 0 || this.any.length > 0;
  }

  willDispatchTo(eventName, wildcardNames = []) {
    const plan = this.plan(eventName, wildcardNames);
    return plan.exactStages.some((stage) => stage.entries.length) || plan.patterns.length > 0 || plan.any.length > 0;
  }

  freeze() { this.registrationFrozen = true; return this; }
  unfreeze() { this.registrationFrozen = false; return this; }

  manifest() {
    return Array.from(this.entries.values())
      .filter((entry) => entry.active)
      .sort((left, right) => left.id - right.id)
      .map((entry) => this.describeEntry(entry));
  }
}

export default ListenerRegistry;

'use strict';

export class DispatchReport {
  constructor(eventName, options = {}) {
    this.eventName = eventName;
    this.mode = options.mode || 'sequential';
    this.startedAt = options.startedAt || Date.now();
    this.completedAt = null;
    this.durationMs = 0;
    this.matched = 0;
    this.invoked = 0;
    this.skipped = 0;
    this.results = [];
    this.errors = [];
    this.aborted = false;
    this.timedOut = false;
    this.stopped = false;
    this.stopValue = undefined;
    this.context = options.context || null;
  }

  complete(durationMs) {
    this.durationMs = Number(durationMs) || 0;
    this.completedAt = Date.now();
    return this;
  }

  finish(durationMs) { return this.complete(durationMs); }

  get ok() { return this.errors.length === 0 && !this.aborted && !this.timedOut; }
  get errorCount() { return this.errors.length; }

  toJSON() {
    return {
      eventName: this.eventName,
      mode: this.mode,
      startedAt: this.startedAt,
      completedAt: this.completedAt,
      durationMs: this.durationMs,
      matched: this.matched,
      invoked: this.invoked,
      skipped: this.skipped,
      results: this.results,
      errors: this.errors,
      aborted: this.aborted,
      timedOut: this.timedOut,
      stopped: this.stopped,
      stopValue: this.stopValue,
      context: this.context,
      ok: this.ok,
    };
  }
}

'use strict';

import { deferred, abortError } from '../support/async.js';

export class AsyncEventIterator {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 1024);
    this.overflow = options.overflow || 'drop-oldest';
    this.queue = [];
    this.waiters = [];
    this.closed = false;
    this.error = null;
    this.handle = null;
    this.signal = options.signal || null;
    this.onAbort = null;
    if (this.signal) {
      this.onAbort = () => this.fail(abortError());
      if (this.signal.aborted) this.onAbort();
      else this.signal.addEventListener('abort', this.onAbort, { once: true });
    }
  }

  attach(handle) { this.handle = handle; return this; }

  push(value) {
    if (this.closed) return false;
    const waiter = this.waiters.shift();
    if (waiter) { waiter.resolve({ value, done: false }); return true; }
    if (this.queue.length >= this.maxItems) {
      if (this.overflow === 'drop-newest') return false;
      if (this.overflow === 'reject') {
        this.fail(new Error('Event iterator queue capacity exceeded'));
        return false;
      }
      this.queue.shift();
    }
    this.queue.push(value);
    return true;
  }

  next() {
    if (this.queue.length) return Promise.resolve({ value: this.queue.shift(), done: false });
    if (this.error) return Promise.reject(this.error);
    if (this.closed) return Promise.resolve({ value: undefined, done: true });
    const waiter = deferred();
    this.waiters.push(waiter);
    return waiter.promise;
  }

  return() { this.close(); return Promise.resolve({ value: undefined, done: true }); }
  throw(error) { this.fail(error); return Promise.reject(error); }

  close() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this.closed = true;
    this.handle?.dispose?.();
    this.handle = null;
    if (this.onAbort) this.signal?.removeEventListener?.('abort', this.onAbort);
    for (const waiter of this.waiters) waiter.resolve({ value: undefined, done: true });
    this.waiters.length = 0;
  }

  fail(error) {
    if (this.closed) return;
    this.error = error || new Error('Event iterator failed');
    this.closed = true;
    this.handle?.dispose?.();
    this.handle = null;
    if (this.onAbort) this.signal?.removeEventListener?.('abort', this.onAbort);
    for (const waiter of this.waiters) waiter.reject(this.error);
    this.waiters.length = 0;
  }

  [Symbol.asyncIterator]() { return this; }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { this.close(); }
}

export default AsyncEventIterator;

'use strict';

import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { deferred } from '../support/async.js';
import { estimateValueBytes } from '../support/size.js';
import { EventAdmissionError, EventClosedError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

const VALID_OVERFLOW = new Set(['reject', 'drop-newest', 'drop-oldest', 'coalesce']);

export class DeferredEventScheduler {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxItems ?? 0) || 0);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxBytes ?? 0) || 0);
    this.maxInFlight = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxInFlight ?? 1) || 1);
    this.budgetMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.budgetMs ?? 4) || 0);
    this.maxPerSlice = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxPerSlice ?? 256) || 256);
    this.overflow = VALID_OVERFLOW.has(options.overflow) ? options.overflow : 'reject';
    this.awaitTasks = options.awaitTasks === true;
    this.unrefTimers = options.unrefTimers === true;
    this.sizeOf = typeof options.sizeOf === 'function' ? options.sizeOf : (item) => estimateValueBytes(item?.metadata ?? item);
    this.onDiagnostic = typeof options.onDiagnostic === 'function' ? options.onDiagnostic : null;

    this.queue = [];
    this.head = 0;
    this.bytes = 0;
    this.inFlight = 0;
    this.scheduled = false;
    this.accepting = true;
    this.closed = false;
    this.flushWaiters = new Set();
    this.coalesced = new Map();
    this.stats = { accepted: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, rejected: 0, dropped: 0, highWaterItems: 0, highWaterBytes: 0, slices: 0, yields: 0 };
  }

  get length() { return this.queue.length - this.head; }
  get idle() { return this.length === 0 && this.inFlight === 0; }

  schedule(task, options = {}) {
    if (typeof task !== 'function') throw new TypeError('DeferredEventScheduler.schedule expects a function');
    if (this.closed) throw new EventClosedError('Deferred event scheduler is closed');
    if (!this.accepting) throw new EventAdmissionError('Deferred event scheduler is draining', { code: 'EVENT_SCHEDULER_DRAINING' });

    const completion = deferred();
    const item = {
      task,
      metadata: options.metadata || null,
      key: options.key == null ? null : String(options.key),
      bytes: Math.max(0, Number(options.bytes) || this.sizeOf({ metadata: options.metadata })),
      completion,
      awaitTask: options.awaitTask === true,
      acceptedAt: Date.now(),
    };

    const admission = this._admit(item);
    if (!admission.accepted) {
      const error = new EventAdmissionError(`Deferred event rejected: ${admission.reason}`, {
        code: 'EVENT_DEFERRED_REJECTED',
        details: admission,
      });
      completion.reject(error);
      completion.promise.catch(() => {});
      return { ...admission, promise: completion.promise };
    }

    this.stats.accepted++;
    this.stats.highWaterItems = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterItems, this.length);
    this.stats.highWaterBytes = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterBytes, this.bytes);
    this._ensureScheduled(true);
    return { accepted: true, promise: completion.promise, item };
  }

  _fits(item) {
    if (this.maxItems && this.length >= this.maxItems) return false;
    if (this.maxBytes && this.bytes + item.bytes > this.maxBytes) return false;
    return true;
  }

  _admit(item) {
    if (item.key && this.overflow === 'coalesce') {
      const existing = this.coalesced.get(item.key);
      if (existing) {
        const nextBytes = this.bytes - existing.bytes + item.bytes;
        if (this.maxBytes && nextBytes > this.maxBytes) {
          this.stats.rejected++;
          return { accepted: false, reason: 'item-too-large', items: this.length, bytes: this.bytes };
        }
        existing.task = item.task;
        existing.metadata = item.metadata;
        this.bytes += item.bytes - existing.bytes;
        existing.bytes = item.bytes;
        existing.completion.resolve({ coalesced: true });
        existing.completion = item.completion;
        return { accepted: true, coalesced: true };
      }
    }

    if (!this._fits(item)) {
      if (this.overflow === 'drop-oldest') {
        while (!this._fits(item) && this.length > 0) {
          const dropped = this._shift();
          if (!dropped) break;
          this.stats.dropped++;
          dropped.completion.reject(new EventAdmissionError('Deferred event dropped by overflow policy', { code: 'EVENT_DEFERRED_DROPPED' }));
          dropped.completion.promise.catch(() => {});
        }
      } else if (this.overflow === 'drop-newest' || this.overflow === 'coalesce') {
        this.stats.dropped++;
        return { accepted: false, reason: 'drop-newest', items: this.length, bytes: this.bytes };
      } else {
        this.stats.rejected++;
        return { accepted: false, reason: 'capacity', items: this.length, bytes: this.bytes };
      }
    }

    if (!this._fits(item)) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      return { accepted: false, reason: 'item-too-large', items: this.length, bytes: this.bytes };
    }

    this.queue.push(item);
    this.bytes += item.bytes;
    if (item.key) this.coalesced.set(item.key, item);
    return { accepted: true };
  }

  _shift() {
    while (this.head < this.queue.length) {
      const item = this.queue[this.head++];
      if (!item) continue;
      this.bytes = Math.max(0, this.bytes - item.bytes);
      if (item.key && this.coalesced.get(item.key) === item) this.coalesced.delete(item.key);
      if (this.head > 4096 && this.head > this.queue.length / 2) {
        this.queue = this.queue.slice(this.head);
        this.head = 0;
      }
      return item;
    }
    this.queue.length = 0;
    this.head = 0;
    return null;
  }

  _ensureScheduled(microtask = false) {
    if (this.scheduled || this.closed) return;
    this.scheduled = true;
    if (microtask) queueMicrotask(() => this._runSlice());
    else {
      const immediate = setImmediate(() => this._runSlice());
      if (this.unrefTimers) immediate.unref?.();
    }
  }

  _runSlice() {
    this.scheduled = false;
    if (this.closed) return this._resolveFlush();
    this.stats.slices++;
    const started = performance.now();
    let processed = 0;

    while (this.length > 0 && this.inFlight < this.maxInFlight) {
      const item = this._shift();
      if (!item) break;
      processed++;
      this.inFlight++;
      let result;
      let threw = false;
      try { result = item.task(); }
      catch (error) { threw = true; this._settle(item, error); }

      if (threw) {
        if (processed >= this.maxPerSlice || (this.budgetMs > 0 && performance.now() - started >= this.budgetMs)) break;
        continue;
      }

      if (result && typeof result.then === 'function') {
        if (this.awaitTasks || item.awaitTask) {
          Promise.resolve(result).then(
            (value) => this._settle(item, null, value),
            (error) => this._settle(item, error),
          );
        } else {
          Promise.resolve(result).catch((error) => this.onDiagnostic?.('task:error', { error, metadata: item.metadata }));
          this._settle(item, null, undefined);
        }
      } else if (this.inFlight > 0 && item.completion) {
        this._settle(item, null, result);
      }

      if (processed >= this.maxPerSlice || (this.budgetMs > 0 && performance.now() - started >= this.budgetMs)) break;
    }

    if (this.length > 0) {
      this.stats.yields++;
      this._ensureScheduled(false);
    }
    this._resolveFlush();
  }

  _settle(item, error, value) {
    this.inFlight = Math.max(0, this.inFlight - 1);
    if (error) {
      this.stats.failed++;
      item.completion.reject(error);
      item.completion.promise.catch(() => {});
      this.onDiagnostic?.('task:error', { error, metadata: item.metadata });
    } else {
      this.stats.completed++;
      item.completion.resolve(value);
    }
    if (this.length > 0) this._ensureScheduled(false);
    this._resolveFlush();
  }

  flush() {
    if (this.idle) return Promise.resolve(this.snapshot());
    const waiter = deferred();
    this.flushWaiters.add(waiter);
    return waiter.promise;
  }

  _resolveFlush() {
    if (!this.idle) return;
    const snapshot = this.snapshot();
    for (const waiter of this.flushWaiters) waiter.resolve(snapshot);
    this.flushWaiters.clear();
  }

  async drain() {
    this.accepting = false;
    return this.flush();
  }

  async close(options = {}) {
    if (this.closed) return this.snapshot();
    this.accepting = false;
    if (options.force !== true) await this.flush();
    while (this.length) {
      const item = this._shift();
      if (!item) break;
      item.completion.reject(new EventClosedError('Deferred event scheduler closed'));
      item.completion.promise.catch(() => {});
    }
    this.closed = true;
    this._resolveFlush();
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      accepting: this.accepting,
      closed: this.closed,
      queuedItems: this.length,
      queuedBytes: this.bytes,
      inFlight: this.inFlight,
      limits: Object.freeze({ maxItems: this.maxItems, maxBytes: this.maxBytes, maxInFlight: this.maxInFlight, overflow: this.overflow }),
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }
}

export default DeferredEventScheduler;

'use strict';

import { EventConfigurationError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

    deferred: { maxItems: 100_000, maxBytes: 64 * 1024 * 1024, maxInFlight: 32, budgetMs: 4, maxPerSlice: 256, overflow: 'drop-oldest', awaitTasks: false },
    metrics: { enabled: true, maxSeries: 2048, slowMs: 25, prefix: 'rawnode_events' },
    context: { enabled: true },
    diagnostics: { enabled: false, historyLimit: 256, maxHistoryBytes: 4 * 1024 * 1024, publishChannel: true },
    contracts: { autoValidate: false },
    broadcasting: { enabled: false, auto: false, errorPolicy: 'isolate', defaultChannel: 'global' },
    security: {
      strictNames: true,
      maxEventNameBytes: 512,
      maxSegments: 32,
      maxPatternBytes: 4096,
      maxDispatchPayloadBytes: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
      maxContextBytes: 64 * 1024,
      blockControlChars: true,

      namespaceDeny: null,
    },
    dispatch: { errorPolicy: 'isolate' },
    lifecycle: { shutdownTimeoutMs: 30_000, forceOnTimeout: true },
  }),

const ENUMS = Object.freeze({
  'history.clonePolicy': new Set(['reference', 'shallow', 'serialized']),
  'deferred.overflow': new Set(['reject', 'drop-newest', 'drop-oldest', 'coalesce']),
  'dispatch.errorPolicy': new Set(['isolate', 'collect', 'fail-fast']),
});

function object(value) { return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value : {}; }
function number(value, fallback, minimum = 0) {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= minimum ? parsed : fallback;
}
function merge(base, override) {
  const output = { ...base };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(object(override))) {
    output[key] = value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) && base[key] && typeof base[key] === 'object'
      ? merge(base[key], value)
      : value;
  }
  return output;
}
function deepFreeze(value) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Object.isFrozen(value)) return value;
  const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  if (!Array.isArray(value) && prototype !== Object.prototype && prototype !== null) return value;
  for (const item of Object.values(value)) deepFreeze(item);
  Object.freeze(value);
  return value;
}

export class EventConfiguration {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    const requestedProfile = String(options.profile || 'compat').toLowerCase();
    const profile = requestedProfile === 'enterprise' || requestedProfile === 'strict'
      ? 'production'
      : requestedProfile;
    if (!PROFILES[profile]) throw new EventConfigurationError(`Unknown events profile: ${profile}`);
    const selected = merge(PROFILES[profile], options);

    selected.profile = profile;
    selected.normalizeDot = options.normalizeDot === true;
    selected.logEvents = options.logEvents === true;
    selected.logger = options.logger || console;

    selected.listeners = merge(selected.listeners, object(options.listeners));
    selected.listeners.maxPerEvent = number(options.maxListenersPerEvent ?? selected.listeners.maxPerEvent, selected.listeners.maxPerEvent);
    selected.listeners.maxTotal = number(options.maxListenersTotal ?? selected.listeners.maxTotal, selected.listeners.maxTotal);
    selected.listeners.maxPatterns = number(options.maxPatternListeners ?? selected.listeners.maxPatterns, selected.listeners.maxPatterns);
    selected.listeners.maxPerPattern = number(options.maxListenersPerPattern ?? selected.listeners.maxPerPattern, selected.listeners.maxPerPattern);
    selected.listeners.maxAny = number(options.maxAnyListeners ?? selected.listeners.maxAny, selected.listeners.maxAny);
    selected.listeners.planCacheMax = number(options.planCacheMax ?? selected.listeners.planCacheMax, selected.listeners.planCacheMax);

    selected.history = merge(selected.history, object(options.history));
    selected.history.maxEntriesPerEvent = number(options.historyLimit ?? selected.history.maxEntriesPerEvent, selected.history.maxEntriesPerEvent);
    selected.history.maxEventNames = number(options.maxHistoryEvents ?? options.historyMaxEventNames ?? selected.history.maxEventNames, selected.history.maxEventNames);
    selected.history.maxEntriesTotal = number(options.maxHistoryEntries ?? selected.history.maxEntriesTotal, selected.history.maxEntriesTotal);
    selected.history.maxBytes = number(options.maxHistoryBytes ?? selected.history.maxBytes, selected.history.maxBytes);
    selected.history.maxPayloadBytes = number(options.maxHistoryPayloadBytes ?? selected.history.maxPayloadBytes, selected.history.maxPayloadBytes);
    selected.history.ttlMs = number(options.historyTtlMs ?? selected.history.ttlMs, selected.history.ttlMs);
    selected.history.allow = options.historyAllow ?? selected.history.allow ?? null;
    selected.history.deny = options.historyDeny ?? selected.history.deny ?? null;

    selected.metrics = merge(selected.metrics, object(options.metrics));
    if (options.metrics === true) selected.metrics.enabled = true;
    selected.metrics.enabled = selected.metrics.enabled === true;
    selected.metrics.slowMs = number(selected.metrics.slowMs, 0);
    selected.metrics.maxSeries = Math.max(1, number(selected.metrics.maxSeries, 2048, 1));

    selected.context = merge(selected.context, object(options.context));
    selected.diagnostics = merge(selected.diagnostics, object(options.diagnostics));
    selected.contracts = merge(selected.contracts, object(options.contracts));
    selected.broadcasting = merge(selected.broadcasting, object(options.broadcasting));
    selected.deferred = merge(selected.deferred, object(options.deferred));
    selected.security = merge(selected.security, object(options.security));
    selected.dispatch = merge(selected.dispatch, object(options.dispatch));
    selected.lifecycle = merge(selected.lifecycle, object(options.lifecycle));
    selected.lifecycle.shutdownTimeoutMs = number(options.shutdownTimeoutMs ?? selected.lifecycle.shutdownTimeoutMs, selected.lifecycle.shutdownTimeoutMs);
    selected.lifecycle.forceOnTimeout = options.forceOnShutdownTimeout ?? selected.lifecycle.forceOnTimeout;

    this._validate(selected);
    this.value = deepFreeze(selected);
  }

  _validate(value) {
    for (const [path, accepted] of Object.entries(ENUMS)) {
      const current = path.split('.').reduce((target, key) => target?.[key], value);
      if (!accepted.has(current)) throw new EventConfigurationError(`Invalid ${path}: ${current}`, { code: 'EVENT_CONFIGURATION_ENUM' });
    }
    for (const [name, current] of Object.entries(value.listeners)) {
      if (name.startsWith('max') || name.endsWith('Max')) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(Number(current)) || Number(current) < 0) throw new EventConfigurationError(`listeners.${name} must be non-negative`);
      }
    }
    if (value.history.maxEntriesPerEvent > 0 && value.history.maxEventNames === 0 && value.profile === 'production') {
      throw new EventConfigurationError('Production history requires a positive maxEventNames bound');
    }
  }

  get(path, fallback = undefined) {
    const value = String(path).split('.').reduce((target, key) => target?.[key], this.value);
    return value === undefined ? fallback : value;
  }

  toJSON() { return this.value; }
  static profiles() { return Object.keys(PROFILES); }
}

export default EventConfiguration;

'use strict';

import { compileMatcherList, matchesAny } from '../support/glob.js';
import { estimateValueBytes } from '../support/size.js';
import { EventAdmissionError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

const CONTROL = /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\u009f]/;

export class EventSecurityPolicy {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.strictNames = options.strictNames === true;
    this.maxEventNameBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxEventNameBytes) || 0);
    this.maxSegments = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxSegments) || 0);
    this.maxPatternBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxPatternBytes) || 0);
    this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxDispatchPayloadBytes) || 0);
    this.maxContextBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxContextBytes) || 0);
    this.blockControlChars = options.blockControlChars === true;
    this.allow = compileMatcherList(options.namespaceAllow || options.allow);
    this.deny = compileMatcherList(options.namespaceDeny || options.deny);
    this.nameValidationActive = this.strictNames || this.blockControlChars || this.maxEventNameBytes > 0 || this.maxSegments > 0 || this.allow.length > 0 || this.deny.length > 0;
    this.dispatchValidationActive = this.nameValidationActive || this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes > 0 || this.maxContextBytes > 0;
  }

  validateName(name, options = {}) {
    if (!this.nameValidationActive) return true;
    if (typeof name !== 'string' || !name) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Event name must be a non-empty string', { code: 'EVENT_NAME_INVALID' });
    }
    if (this.blockControlChars && CONTROL.test(name)) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Event name contains control characters', { code: 'EVENT_NAME_CONTROL_CHARS' });
    }
    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(name);
    const maximum = options.pattern ? this.maxPatternBytes || this.maxEventNameBytes : this.maxEventNameBytes;
    if (maximum && bytes > maximum) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event ${options.pattern ? 'pattern' : 'name'} exceeds ${maximum} bytes`, {
        code: options.pattern ? 'EVENT_PATTERN_MAX_BYTES' : 'EVENT_NAME_MAX_BYTES',
        details: { bytes, maximum },
      });
    }
    const segments = name.split(':').length;
    if (this.maxSegments && segments > this.maxSegments) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event name exceeds ${this.maxSegments} segments`, {
        code: 'EVENT_NAME_MAX_SEGMENTS',
        details: { segments, maximum: this.maxSegments },
      });
    }
    if (this.allow.length && !matchesAny(this.allow, name)) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event name is outside the allowed namespaces: ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_NAMESPACE_NOT_ALLOWED' });
    }
    if (this.deny.length && matchesAny(this.deny, name)) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event namespace is denied: ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_NAMESPACE_DENIED' });
    }
    return true;
  }

  validatePattern(pattern) {
    return this.validateName(pattern, { pattern: true });
  }

  validateDispatch(eventName, args, context = null, options = {}) {
    if (!this.dispatchValidationActive) return true;
    if (options.skipName !== true) this.validateName(eventName);
    if (this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes) {
      const bytes = estimateValueBytes(args, { maximum: this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes + 1 });
      if (bytes > this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes) {
        throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event payload exceeds ${this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes} bytes`, {
          code: 'EVENT_PAYLOAD_MAX_BYTES',
          details: { eventName, bytes, maximum: this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes },
        });
      }
    }
    if (this.maxContextBytes && context) {
      const bytes = estimateValueBytes(context, { maximum: this.maxContextBytes + 1 });
      if (bytes > this.maxContextBytes) {
        throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event context exceeds ${this.maxContextBytes} bytes`, {
          code: 'EVENT_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES',
          details: { eventName, bytes, maximum: this.maxContextBytes },
        });
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      maxEventNameBytes: this.maxEventNameBytes,
      strictNames: this.strictNames,
      maxSegments: this.maxSegments,
      maxPatternBytes: this.maxPatternBytes,
      maxDispatchPayloadBytes: this.maxDispatchPayloadBytes,
      maxContextBytes: this.maxContextBytes,
      blockControlChars: this.blockControlChars,
      allow: Object.freeze(this.allow.map((matcher) => matcher.raw)),
      deny: Object.freeze(this.deny.map((matcher) => matcher.raw)),
    });
  }
}

export default EventSecurityPolicy;

'use strict';

// src/events/Event.js

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

export class Event {
  constructor(payload = {}, options = {}) {
    this.payload = payload;
    this.timestamp = Number(options.timestamp) || Date.now();
    this.id = options.id || randomUUID();
    this.version = Math.max(1, Number(options.version) || Number(this.constructor.version) || 1);
    this.meta = options.meta && typeof options.meta === 'object' ? { ...options.meta } : {};
  }

  get eventName() {
    return this.constructor.eventName || this.constructor.name;
  }

  get occurredAt() { return new Date(this.timestamp); }
  get correlationId() { return this.meta.correlationId ?? this.ctx?.correlationId ?? null; }
  get causationId() { return this.meta.causationId ?? this.ctx?.causationId ?? null; }
  get tenantId() { return this.meta.tenantId ?? this.ctx?.tenantId ?? null; }

  withMeta(meta = {}) {
    if (meta && typeof meta === 'object') Object.assign(this.meta, meta);
    return this;
  }

  shouldBroadcast() { return false; }
  broadcastAs() { return this.constructor.name; }

  toJSON() {
    return {
      id: this.id,
      eventName: this.eventName,
      version: this.version,
      timestamp: this.timestamp,
      occurredAt: this.occurredAt.toISOString(),
      payload: this.payload,
      meta: { ...this.meta },
    };
  }
}

export default Event;

'use strict';

const TRANSITIONS = Object.freeze({
  idle: new Set(['disabled', 'starting', 'closed']),
  disabled: new Set(['starting', 'closed']),
  starting: new Set(['ready', 'failed', 'stopping']),
  ready: new Set(['degraded', 'stopping', 'failed']),
  degraded: new Set(['ready', 'stopping', 'failed']),
  failed: new Set(['starting', 'stopping', 'closed']),
  stopping: new Set(['stopped', 'failed']),
  stopped: new Set(['starting', 'closed']),
  closed: new Set(),
});

export class BridgeStateMachine {
  constructor() { this.state = 'idle'; this.changedAt = Date.now(); this.lastError = null; }

  transition(next, error = null) {
    if (next === this.state) return this.state;
    if (!TRANSITIONS[this.state]?.has(next)) throw new Error(`Invalid bridge state transition: ${this.state} -> ${next}`);
    this.state = next;
    this.changedAt = Date.now();
    if (error) this.lastError = error;
    return this.state;
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: this.state,
      changedAt: this.changedAt,
      lastError: this.lastError ? { name: this.lastError.name, message: this.lastError.message, code: this.lastError.code } : null,
    });
  }
}

export default BridgeStateMachine;

'use strict';
export { RedisEventBridge } from '../RedisEventBridge.js';

================================================
FILE PATH: ./src/events/bridge/RedisStreamTransport.js
================================================

'use strict';

import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

import { SafeJsonCodec } from '../serialization/SafeJsonCodec.js';
import { createEventEnvelope, validateEventEnvelope } from '../serialization/EventEnvelope.js';
import { EventTransportError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

function method(client, ...names) {
  for (const name of names) if (typeof client?.[name] === 'function') return client[name].bind(client);
  return null;
}

function sleep(ms, unref = false) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(resolve, Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0));
    if (unref) timer.unref?.();
  });
}

export class RedisStreamTransport extends EventEmitter {
  constructor(client, options = {}) {
    super();
    if (!client) throw new TypeError('Redis client is required');
    this.client = client;
    this.stream = options.stream || 'rawnode:events:durable';
    this.deadLetterStream = options.deadLetterStream || `${this.stream}:dead`;
    this.group = options.group || 'rawnode-events';
    this.consumer = options.consumer || `${process.pid}-${randomUUID()}`;
    this.nodeId = options.nodeId || this.consumer;
    this.namespace = options.namespace || 'default';
    this.maxLength = Math.max(100, Number(options.maxLength) || 100_000);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(1024, Number(options.maxBytes) || 1024 * 1024);
    this.maxAttempts = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxAttempts) || 5);
    this.blockMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.blockMs) || 5000);
    this.batchSize = Math.max(1, Number(options.batchSize) || 100);
    this.retryDelayMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.retryDelayMs) || 250);
    this.pollErrorDelayMs = Math.max(10, Number(options.pollErrorDelayMs) || 250);
    this.claimIdleMs = Math.max(1000, Number(options.claimIdleMs) || 30_000);
    this.claimCount = Math.max(1, Number(options.claimCount) || this.batchSize);
    this.secret = options.secret || null;
    this.acceptUnsignedV1 = options.acceptUnsignedV1 !== false;
    this.maxAgeMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxAgeMs) || 0);
    this.unrefTimers = options.unrefTimers === true;
    this.codec = options.codec || new SafeJsonCodec({ maxBytes: this.maxBytes });
    this.state = 'idle';
    this._controller = null;
    this._loopPromise = null;
    this._handler = null;
    this.stats = {
      published: 0,
      publishBytes: 0,
      read: 0,
      decoded: 0,
      handled: 0,
      acked: 0,
      retried: 0,
      claimed: 0,
      deadLettered: 0,
      expired: 0,
      invalid: 0,
      handlerErrors: 0,
      pollErrors: 0,
    };
  }

  async ensureGroup() {
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xgroup', 'xGroup');
    if (!fn) throw new EventTransportError('Redis client does not expose XGROUP', { code: 'EVENT_STREAM_XGROUP_MISSING' });
    try {
      await fn('CREATE', this.stream, this.group, '0', 'MKSTREAM');
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      if (/BUSYGROUP/i.test(error?.message || '')) return true;
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async publish(eventName, args = [], options = {}) {
    const envelope = createEventEnvelope(eventName, args, {
      ...options,
      nodeId: options.nodeId || this.nodeId,
      namespace: options.namespace || this.namespace,
      secret: options.secret || this.secret,
    });
    return this.publishEnvelope(envelope, options);
  }

  async publishEnvelope(envelope, options = {}) {
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xadd', 'xAdd');
    if (!fn) throw new EventTransportError('Redis client does not expose XADD', { code: 'EVENT_STREAM_XADD_MISSING' });
    const encoded = this.codec.encode(envelope, { maxBytes: this.maxBytes });
    const attempt = Math.max(0, Number(options.attempt) || 0);
    const availableAt = Math.max(0, Number(options.availableAt) || 0);
    const id = await fn(
      this.stream, 'MAXLEN', '~', this.maxLength, '*',
      'id', String(envelope.id || randomUUID()),
      'envelope', encoded.text,
      'attempt', String(attempt),
      'createdAt', String(envelope.ts || Date.now()),
      'availableAt', String(availableAt),
    );
    this.stats.published++;
    this.stats.publishBytes += encoded.bytes;
    return { id, envelopeId: envelope.id, persisted: true, stream: this.stream, attempt };
  }

  async read(options = {}) {
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xreadgroup', 'xReadGroup');
    if (!fn) throw new EventTransportError('Redis client does not expose XREADGROUP', { code: 'EVENT_STREAM_XREADGROUP_MISSING' });
    const result = await fn(
      'GROUP', this.group, this.consumer,
      'COUNT', options.count || this.batchSize,
      'BLOCK', options.blockMs ?? this.blockMs,
      'STREAMS', this.stream, options.id || '>',
    );
    const messages = this._normalize(result);
    this.stats.read += messages.length;
    return messages;
  }

  decode(message, options = {}) {
    try {
      const raw = message?.fields?.envelope || message?.fields?.payload || '';
      if (Buffer.byteLength(String(raw)) > this.maxBytes) {
        this.stats.invalid++;
        return { ok: false, reason: 'maxBytes', code: 'EVENT_STREAM_MAX_BYTES', message };
      }
      const envelope = this.codec.parse(raw);
      const validation = validateEventEnvelope(envelope, {
        namespace: options.namespace || this.namespace,
        secret: options.secret || this.secret,
        acceptUnsignedV1: options.acceptUnsignedV1 ?? this.acceptUnsignedV1,
        maxAgeMs: options.maxAgeMs ?? this.maxAgeMs,
      });
      if (!validation.ok) {
        if (validation.code === 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_EXPIRED') this.stats.expired++;
        else this.stats.invalid++;
        return { ...validation, message };
      }
      this.stats.decoded++;
      return { ok: true, envelope: validation.envelope, message };
    } catch (error) {
      this.stats.invalid++;
      return { ok: false, error, reason: error.message, message };
    }
  }

  async ack(...ids) {
    const values = ids.flat().filter(Boolean);
    if (!values.length) return 0;
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xack', 'xAck');
    if (!fn) return 0;
    const count = Number(await fn(this.stream, this.group, ...values)) || 0;
    this.stats.acked += count;
    return count;
  }

  async fail(message, error, options = {}) {
    const attempt = Number(message?.fields?.attempt || 0) + 1;
    if (attempt >= this.maxAttempts || options.deadLetter === true) {
      await this.deadLetter(message, error);
      await this.ack(message.id);
      return { deadLettered: true, attempt };
    }

    let envelope;
    try { envelope = this.codec.parse(message?.fields?.envelope || ''); }
    catch { envelope = null; }
    if (!envelope) {
      await this.deadLetter(message, error);
      await this.ack(message.id);
      return { deadLettered: true, attempt, invalid: true };
    }

    if (this.retryDelayMs > 0) await sleep(this.retryDelayMs, this.unrefTimers);
    const published = await this.publishEnvelope(envelope, { attempt });
    await this.ack(message.id);
    this.stats.retried++;
    return { retry: true, attempt, published };
  }

  async deadLetter(message, error) {
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xadd', 'xAdd');
    if (!fn) throw new EventTransportError('Redis client does not expose XADD', { code: 'EVENT_STREAM_XADD_MISSING' });
    await fn(
      this.deadLetterStream, 'MAXLEN', '~', this.maxLength, '*',
      'sourceId', String(message?.id || ''),
      'envelope', String(message?.fields?.envelope || ''),
      'attempt', String(message?.fields?.attempt || '0'),
      'error', String(error?.stack || error?.message || error || ''),
      'failedAt', String(Date.now()),
    );
    this.stats.deadLettered++;
    return true;
  }

  async recoverPending(options = {}) {
    const fn = method(this.client, 'xautoclaim', 'xAutoClaim');
    if (!fn) return [];
    const result = await fn(
      this.stream,
      this.group,
      this.consumer,
      options.minIdleMs || this.claimIdleMs,
      options.start || '0-0',
      'COUNT', options.count || this.claimCount,
    );
    // Redis variants return [nextId, entries, deletedIds] or an object.
    const entries = Array.isArray(result) ? result[1] : result?.messages || result?.entries || [];
    const normalized = this._normalize([[this.stream, entries]]);
    this.stats.claimed += normalized.length;
    return normalized;
  }

  async consumeOnce(handler = this._handler, options = {}) {
    if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new TypeError('RedisStreamTransport.consumeOnce expects a handler function');
    const recovered = options.recover === false ? [] : await this.recoverPending(options).catch(() => []);
    const messages = recovered.length ? recovered : await this.read(options);
    const results = [];
    for (const message of messages) {
      const availableAt = Number(message.fields.availableAt || 0);
      if (availableAt > Date.now()) {
        results.push({ message, deferred: true });
        continue;
      }
      const decoded = this.decode(message, options);
      if (!decoded.ok) {
        await this.deadLetter(message, decoded.error || new Error(decoded.reason || 'Invalid event envelope'));
        await this.ack(message.id);
        results.push({ message, ok: false, invalid: true, reason: decoded.reason });
        continue;
      }
      try {
        const value = await handler(decoded.envelope, message, this);
        await this.ack(message.id);
        this.stats.handled++;
        results.push({ message, envelope: decoded.envelope, ok: true, value });
      } catch (error) {
        this.stats.handlerErrors++;
        const retry = await this.fail(message, error);
        results.push({ message, envelope: decoded.envelope, ok: false, error, ...retry });
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  async start(handler, options = {}) {
    if (this.state === 'running') return this;
    if (this.state === 'closed') throw new EventTransportError('Redis stream transport is closed', { code: 'EVENT_STREAM_CLOSED' });
    if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new TypeError('RedisStreamTransport.start expects a handler function');
    this._handler = handler;
    await this.ensureGroup();
    this.state = 'running';
    this._controller = new AbortController();
    this._loopPromise = this._consumeLoop(options).finally(() => {
      if (this.state !== 'closed') this.state = 'stopped';
      this._loopPromise = null;
    });
    this.emit('started', this.snapshot());
    return this;
  }

  async _consumeLoop(options) {
    while (!this._controller.signal.aborted) {
      try {
        const results = await this.consumeOnce(this._handler, options);
        if (results.length) this.emit('batch', results);
      } catch (error) {
        if (this._controller.signal.aborted) break;
        this.stats.pollErrors++;
        if (this.listenerCount('error')) this.emit('error', error);
        else this.emit('transportError', error);
        await sleep(this.pollErrorDelayMs, this.unrefTimers);
      }
    }
  }

  async stop() {
    if (!this._loopPromise) {
      if (this.state !== 'closed') this.state = 'stopped';
      return this.snapshot();
    }
    this.state = 'stopping';
    this._controller?.abort();
    await this._loopPromise;
    this.state = 'stopped';
    this.emit('stopped', this.snapshot());
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  async close() {
    if (this.state === 'closed') return this.snapshot();
    await this.stop();
    this.state = 'closed';
    this.removeAllListeners();
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  _normalize(result) {
    if (!Array.isArray(result)) return [];
    const output = [];
    for (const stream of result) {
      const entries = Array.isArray(stream) ? stream[1] : stream?.messages || [];
      for (const entry of entries || []) {
        const id = Array.isArray(entry) ? entry[0] : entry.id;
        const raw = Array.isArray(entry) ? entry[1] : entry.message || entry.fields;
        const fields = {};
        if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
          for (let index = 0; index < raw.length; index += 2) fields[String(raw[index])] = raw[index + 1];
        } else Object.assign(fields, raw || {});
        output.push({ id, fields });
      }
    }
    return output;
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: this.state,
      stream: this.stream,
      deadLetterStream: this.deadLetterStream,
      group: this.group,
      consumer: this.consumer,
      namespace: this.namespace,
      limits: Object.freeze({ maxLength: this.maxLength, maxBytes: this.maxBytes, maxAttempts: this.maxAttempts }),
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }

  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await this.close(); }
}

export default RedisStreamTransport;

'use strict';

export class PublishQueue {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 10_000);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxBytes) || 16 * 1024 * 1024);
    this.overflow = options.overflow || 'drop-oldest';
    this.items = [];
    this.head = 0;
    this.bytes = 0;
    this.stats = { accepted: 0, rejected: 0, dropped: 0, highWaterItems: 0, highWaterBytes: 0 };
  }

  get length() { return this.items.length - this.head; }

  push(item) {
    if (item.bytes > this.maxBytes) { this.stats.rejected++; return { accepted: false, reason: 'item-too-large' }; }
    while (this.length >= this.maxItems || this.bytes + item.bytes > this.maxBytes) {
      if (this.overflow === 'drop-oldest') {
        const dropped = this.shift();
        if (!dropped) break;
        this.stats.dropped++;
        dropped.onDrop?.('overflow');
      } else {
        if (this.overflow === 'drop-newest') this.stats.dropped++;
        else this.stats.rejected++;
        return { accepted: false, reason: this.overflow === 'drop-newest' ? 'drop-newest' : 'capacity' };
      }
    }
    this.items.push(item);
    this.bytes += item.bytes;
    this.stats.accepted++;
    this.stats.highWaterItems = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterItems, this.length);
    this.stats.highWaterBytes = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterBytes, this.bytes);
    return { accepted: true };
  }

  unshift(item) {
    if (item.bytes > this.maxBytes) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      item.onDrop?.('item-too-large');
      return { accepted: false, reason: 'item-too-large' };
    }
    while (this.length >= this.maxItems || this.bytes + item.bytes > this.maxBytes) {
      const dropped = this.shift();
      if (!dropped) break;
      this.stats.dropped++;
      dropped.onDrop?.('overflow');
    }
    if (this.length >= this.maxItems || this.bytes + item.bytes > this.maxBytes) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      item.onDrop?.('capacity');
      return { accepted: false, reason: 'capacity' };
    }
    const remaining = this.items.slice(this.head);
    this.items = [item, ...remaining];
    this.head = 0;
    this.bytes += item.bytes;
    this.stats.accepted++;
    this.stats.highWaterItems = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterItems, this.length);
    this.stats.highWaterBytes = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterBytes, this.bytes);
    return { accepted: true };
  }

  shift() {
    while (this.head < this.items.length) {
      const item = this.items[this.head++];
      if (!item) continue;
      this.bytes = Math.max(0, this.bytes - item.bytes);
      if (this.head > 4096 && this.head > this.items.length / 2) {
        this.items = this.items.slice(this.head);
        this.head = 0;
      }
      return item;
    }
    this.items.length = 0;
    this.head = 0;
    return null;
  }

  clear(reason = 'cleared') {
    let count = 0;
    while (this.length) {
      const item = this.shift();
      if (!item) break;
      count++;
      item.onDrop?.(reason);
    }
    return count;
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      items: this.length,
      bytes: this.bytes,
      maxItems: this.maxItems,
      maxBytes: this.maxBytes,
      overflow: this.overflow,
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }
}

export default PublishQueue;

'use strict';

export class SeenMessageWindow {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems ?? options.limit) || 50_000);
    this.ttlMs = Math.max(1, Number(options.ttlMs) || 60_000);
    this.map = new Map();
    this.queue = [];
    this.head = 0;
    this.stats = { remembered: 0, duplicate: 0, expired: 0, evicted: 0 };
  }

  has(id, now = Date.now()) {
    const expiresAt = this.map.get(id);
    if (expiresAt == null) return false;
    if (expiresAt <= now) {
      this.map.delete(id);
      this.stats.expired++;
      return false;
    }
    this.stats.duplicate++;
    return true;
  }

  remember(id, now = Date.now()) {
    const expiresAt = now + this.ttlMs;
    this.map.set(id, expiresAt);
    this.queue.push({ id, expiresAt });
    this.stats.remembered++;
    this.prune(now);
    while (this.map.size > this.maxItems) {
      const marker = this.queue[this.head++];
      if (!marker) break;
      if (this.map.get(marker.id) === marker.expiresAt) {
        this.map.delete(marker.id);
        this.stats.evicted++;
      }
    }
    this._compact();
    return this;
  }

  prune(now = Date.now(), budget = 1024) {
    let checked = 0;
    while (this.head < this.queue.length && checked++ < budget) {
      const marker = this.queue[this.head];
      const current = this.map.get(marker.id);
      if (current !== marker.expiresAt) { this.head++; continue; }
      if (marker.expiresAt > now) break;
      this.head++;
      this.map.delete(marker.id);
      this.stats.expired++;
    }
    this._compact();
  }

  _compact() {
    if (this.head > 4096 && this.head > this.queue.length / 2) {
      this.queue = this.queue.slice(this.head);
      this.head = 0;
    }
  }

  clear() { this.map.clear(); this.queue.length = 0; this.head = 0; }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ size: this.map.size, maxItems: this.maxItems, ttlMs: this.ttlMs, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
}

export default SeenMessageWindow;
