'use strict';

import { EventConfigurationError, EventAdmissionError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

function positiveVersion(value) {
  const version = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(version) || version < 1) throw new TypeError('Event schema version must be a positive safe integer');
  return version;
}

function normalizeDefinition(definition = {}) {
  if (typeof definition === 'function') return { validate: definition };
  if (!definition || typeof definition !== 'object') throw new TypeError('Event schema definition must be an object or validator function');
  return { ...definition };
}

/** Versioned contracts, validators, and sequential upcasters for persisted events. */
export class EventSchemaRegistry {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.events = new Map();
    this.maxEvents = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxEvents) || 10_000);
    this.maxVersionsPerEvent = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxVersionsPerEvent) || 100);
    this.frozen = false;
  }

  register(eventName, version, definition = {}, options = {}) {
    if (this.frozen) throw new EventConfigurationError('Event schema registry is frozen', { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_REGISTRY_FROZEN' });
    const name = String(eventName || '').trim();
    if (!name) throw new TypeError('Event schema name is required');
    const normalizedVersion = positiveVersion(version);
    if (!this.events.has(name) && this.events.size >= this.maxEvents) {
      throw new EventConfigurationError('Event schema registry event limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_EVENT_LIMIT' });
    }
    let versions = this.events.get(name);
    if (!versions) this.events.set(name, versions = new Map());
    if (!versions.has(normalizedVersion) && versions.size >= this.maxVersionsPerEvent) {
      throw new EventConfigurationError(`Version limit exceeded for ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_VERSION_LIMIT' });
    }
    if (versions.has(normalizedVersion) && options.replace !== true) {
      throw new EventConfigurationError(`Event schema already registered: ${name}@${normalizedVersion}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_DUPLICATE' });
    }
    const record = normalizeDefinition(definition);
    versions.set(normalizedVersion, Object.freeze({
      eventName: name,
      version: normalizedVersion,
      validate: typeof record.validate === 'function' ? record.validate : null,
      upcast: typeof record.upcast === 'function' ? record.upcast : null,
      downcast: typeof record.downcast === 'function' ? record.downcast : null,
      schema: record.schema ?? null,
      deprecated: record.deprecated === true,
      description: record.description ? String(record.description) : '',
      meta: record.meta && typeof record.meta === 'object' ? Object.freeze({ ...record.meta }) : null,
    }));
    return this;
  }

  define(eventName, version = 1) {
    const definition = { validate: null, upcast: null, downcast: null, schema: null, deprecated: false, description: '', meta: null };
    const builder = {
      validate: (fn) => { definition.validate = fn; return builder; },
      upcast: (fn) => { definition.upcast = fn; return builder; },
      downcast: (fn) => { definition.downcast = fn; return builder; },
      schema: (value) => { definition.schema = value; return builder; },
      deprecated: (value = true) => { definition.deprecated = value !== false; return builder; },
      describe: (value) => { definition.description = String(value); return builder; },
      meta: (value) => { definition.meta = value; return builder; },
      register: (options) => { this.register(eventName, version, definition, options); return this; },
    };
    return builder;
  }

  has(eventName, version = null) {
    const versions = this.events.get(String(eventName));
    return version == null ? !!versions?.size : versions?.has(Number(version)) === true;
  }

  get(eventName, version = null) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    const versions = this.events.get(name);
    if (!versions?.size) return null;
    const selected = version == null ? this.latestVersion(name) : positiveVersion(version);
    return versions.get(selected) || null;
  }

  latestVersion(eventName) {
    const versions = this.events.get(String(eventName));
    if (!versions?.size) return null;
    let latest = 0;
    for (const version of versions.keys()) latest = Math.max(latest, version);
    return latest;
  }

  validate(eventName, version, payload, context = {}) {
    const contract = this.get(eventName, version);
    if (!contract) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Unknown event contract: ${eventName}@${version}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN', eventName });
    if (!contract.validate) return { ok: true, payload };
    let result;
    try { result = contract.validate(payload, { eventName: String(eventName), version: contract.version, ...context }); }
    catch (cause) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event contract validation failed: ${eventName}@${version}`, {
        code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION', eventName, cause,
      });
    }
    if (result && typeof result.then === 'function') {
      throw new EventConfigurationError('Async event validator used through validate(); call validateAsync()', { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_ASYNC_VALIDATOR' });
    }
    if (result === false || result?.ok === false) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(result?.message || `Event payload rejected by ${eventName}@${version}`, {
        code: result?.code || 'EVENT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION', eventName, details: result?.details,
      });
    }
    return { ok: true, payload: result?.payload ?? payload, contract };
  }

  async validateAsync(eventName, version, payload, context = {}) {
    const contract = this.get(eventName, version);
    if (!contract) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Unknown event contract: ${eventName}@${version}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN', eventName });
    if (!contract.validate) return { ok: true, payload, contract };
    let result;
    try { result = await contract.validate(payload, { eventName: String(eventName), version: contract.version, ...context }); }
    catch (cause) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Event contract validation failed: ${eventName}@${version}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION', eventName, cause });
    }
    if (result === false || result?.ok === false) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(result?.message || `Event payload rejected by ${eventName}@${version}`, {
        code: result?.code || 'EVENT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION', eventName, details: result?.details,
      });
    }
    return { ok: true, payload: result?.payload ?? payload, contract };
  }

  upcast(eventName, fromVersion, payload, targetVersion = null, context = {}) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    let version = positiveVersion(fromVersion);
    const target = targetVersion == null ? this.latestVersion(name) : positiveVersion(targetVersion);
    if (!target) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Unknown event contract: ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN', eventName: name });
    if (target < version) return this.downcast(name, version, payload, target, context);
    let value = payload;
    while (version < target) {
      const contract = this.get(name, version);
      if (!contract?.upcast) {
        throw new EventAdmissionError(`Missing upcaster for ${name}@${version} -> ${version + 1}`, {
          code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_UPCASTER_MISSING', eventName: name,
        });
      }
      value = contract.upcast(value, { eventName: name, fromVersion: version, toVersion: version + 1, ...context });
      if (value && typeof value.then === 'function') {
        throw new EventConfigurationError('Async upcaster used through upcast(); call upcastAsync()', { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_ASYNC_UPCASTER' });
      }
      version++;
    }
    return { eventName: name, version, payload: value };
  }

  async upcastAsync(eventName, fromVersion, payload, targetVersion = null, context = {}) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    let version = positiveVersion(fromVersion);
    const target = targetVersion == null ? this.latestVersion(name) : positiveVersion(targetVersion);
    if (!target) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Unknown event contract: ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN', eventName: name });
    let value = payload;
    while (version < target) {
      const contract = this.get(name, version);
      if (!contract?.upcast) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Missing upcaster for ${name}@${version}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_UPCASTER_MISSING', eventName: name });
      value = await contract.upcast(value, { eventName: name, fromVersion: version, toVersion: version + 1, ...context });
      version++;
    }
    return { eventName: name, version, payload: value };
  }

  downcast(eventName, fromVersion, payload, targetVersion, context = {}) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    let version = positiveVersion(fromVersion);
    const target = positiveVersion(targetVersion);
    let value = payload;
    while (version > target) {
      const contract = this.get(name, version);
      if (!contract?.downcast) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Missing downcaster for ${name}@${version}`, { code: 'EVENT_SCHEMA_DOWNCASTER_MISSING', eventName: name });
      value = contract.downcast(value, { eventName: name, fromVersion: version, toVersion: version - 1, ...context });
      version--;
    }
    return { eventName: name, version, payload: value };
  }

  freeze() { this.frozen = true; return this; }
  unfreeze() { this.frozen = false; return this; }
  eventNames() { return Array.from(this.events.keys()).sort(); }
  manifest() {
    return this.eventNames().flatMap((eventName) => Array.from(this.events.get(eventName).values())
      .sort((a, b) => a.version - b.version)
      .map((record) => ({ ...record, validate: !!record.validate, upcast: !!record.upcast, downcast: !!record.downcast })));
  }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ frozen: this.frozen, events: this.events.size, contracts: this.manifest().length }); }
}

export default EventSchemaRegistry;

'use strict';

import { EventConfigurationError, EventTransportError } from '../errors/EventError.js';
import { SafeJsonCodec } from './SafeJsonCodec.js';

export class EventCodecRegistry {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.codecs = new Map();
    this.defaultName = String(options.default || 'json');
    this.maxCodecs = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxCodecs) || 1000);
    this.frozen = false;
    this.register('json', options.jsonCodec || new SafeJsonCodec(options.json || {}));
    for (const [name, codec] of Object.entries(options.codecs || {})) this.register(name, codec, { replace: true });
  }

  register(name, codec, options = {}) {
    if (this.frozen) throw new EventConfigurationError('Event codec registry is frozen', { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_REGISTRY_FROZEN' });
    const key = String(name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!key) throw new TypeError('Codec name is required');
    if (!codec || typeof codec.encode !== 'function' || typeof codec.parse !== 'function') {
      throw new TypeError('Event codec must expose encode() and parse()');
    }
    if (this.codecs.has(key) && options.replace !== true) {
      throw new EventConfigurationError(`Event codec already exists: ${key}`, { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_DUPLICATE' });
    }
    if (!this.codecs.has(key) && this.codecs.size >= this.maxCodecs) {
      throw new EventConfigurationError('Event codec registry limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_LIMIT' });
    }
    this.codecs.set(key, codec);
    return this;
  }

  unregister(name) {
    if (this.frozen) throw new EventConfigurationError('Event codec registry is frozen', { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_REGISTRY_FROZEN' });
    const key = String(name).toLowerCase();
    if (key === this.defaultName) throw new EventConfigurationError('Cannot remove the active default event codec');
    return this.codecs.delete(key);
  }

  has(name) { return this.codecs.has(String(name).toLowerCase()); }

  get(name = this.defaultName) {
    const key = String(name || this.defaultName).toLowerCase();
    const codec = this.codecs.get(key);
    if (!codec) throw new EventTransportError(`Unknown event codec: ${key}`, { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_UNKNOWN' });
    return codec;
  }

  use(name) { this.get(name); this.defaultName = String(name).toLowerCase(); return this; }
  encode(value, options = {}, name = this.defaultName) { return this.get(name).encode(value, options); }
  parse(value, options = {}, name = this.defaultName) { return this.get(name).parse(value, options); }
  freeze() { this.frozen = true; return this; }
  unfreeze() { this.frozen = false; return this; }
  names() { return Array.from(this.codecs.keys()); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ default: this.defaultName, frozen: this.frozen, codecs: Object.freeze(this.names()), limits: Object.freeze({ maxCodecs: this.maxCodecs }) }); }
}

export default EventCodecRegistry;

'use strict';

import { EventTransportError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

const DEFAULT_REDACT = /^(?:password|passwd|secret|token|authorization|cookie|set-cookie|api[-_]?key|private[-_]?key)$/i;
const TYPED_ARRAYS = Object.freeze({
  Uint8Array,
  Uint8ClampedArray,
  Int8Array,
  Uint16Array,
  Int16Array,
  Uint32Array,
  Int32Array,
  Float32Array,
  Float64Array,
  BigInt64Array: globalThis.BigInt64Array,
  BigUint64Array: globalThis.BigUint64Array,
});

function safeSet(target, key, value) {
  if (key === '__proto__' || key === 'constructor' || key === 'prototype') {
    Object.defineProperty(target, key, { value, enumerable: true, configurable: true, writable: true });
  } else target[key] = value;
}

function truncateUtf8(value, maxBytes) {
  if (!maxBytes || Buffer.byteLength(value) <= maxBytes) return value;
  const buffer = Buffer.from(value);
  return `${buffer.subarray(0, Math.max(0, maxBytes - 3)).toString('utf8')}...`;
}

function shouldRedact(key, rules) {
  if (DEFAULT_REDACT.test(key)) return true;
  for (const rule of rules) {
    if (typeof rule === 'string' && rule === key) return true;
    if (rule instanceof RegExp && rule.test(key)) return true;
    if (typeof rule === 'function' && rule(key)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export class SafeJsonCodec {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.options = Object.freeze({
      maxDepth: Math.max(1, Number(options.maxDepth) || 32),
      maxKeys: Math.max(1, Number(options.maxKeys) || 100_000),
      maxStringBytes: Math.max(16, Number(options.maxStringBytes) || 2 * 1024 * 1024),
      maxBytes: Math.max(0, Number(options.maxBytes) || 0),
      getterPolicy: options.getterPolicy || 'skip',
      circularPolicy: options.circularPolicy || 'marker',
      unsupportedPolicy: options.unsupportedPolicy || 'marker',
      redact: options.redact !== false,
      redactWith: options.redactWith || '[redacted]',
      redactKeys: Array.isArray(options.redactKeys) ? options.redactKeys.slice() : [],
      reconstruct: options.reconstruct !== false,
    });
  }

  sanitize(input, overrides = {}) {
    const options = { ...this.options, ...overrides };
    const seen = new WeakMap();
    let keyCount = 0;
    let truncated = false;

    const visit = (value, depth, path) => {
      if (value === null) return null;
      if (value === undefined) return { __rnType: 'Undefined' };
      const type = typeof value;
      if (type === 'string') {
        const output = truncateUtf8(value, options.maxStringBytes);
        if (output !== value) truncated = true;
        return output;
      }
      if (type === 'number' || type === 'boolean') return value;
      if (type === 'bigint') return { __rnType: 'BigInt', value: value.toString() };
      if (type === 'symbol') return options.unsupportedPolicy === 'omit' ? undefined : `[Symbol:${value.description || ''}]`;
      if (type === 'function') return options.unsupportedPolicy === 'omit' ? undefined : `[Function:${value.name || 'anonymous'}]`;

      if (Buffer.isBuffer(value)) return { __rnType: 'Buffer', value: value.toString('base64') };
      if (value instanceof Uint8Array) return { __rnType: value.constructor?.name || 'Uint8Array', value: Buffer.from(value.buffer, value.byteOffset, value.byteLength).toString('base64') };
      if (value instanceof Date) return { __rnType: 'Date', value: Number.isFinite(value.getTime()) ? value.toISOString() : null };
      if (value instanceof RegExp) return { __rnType: 'RegExp', source: value.source, flags: value.flags };
      if (value instanceof Error) {
        return {
          __rnType: 'Error',
          name: value.name,
          message: truncateUtf8(value.message || '', options.maxStringBytes),
          stack: truncateUtf8(value.stack || '', options.maxStringBytes),
          code: value.code,
          details: depth < options.maxDepth ? visit(value.details, depth + 1, `${path}.details`) : '[MaxDepth]',
        };
      }

      if (depth >= options.maxDepth) { truncated = true; return '[MaxDepth]'; }
      if (seen.has(value)) {
        if (options.circularPolicy === 'throw') throw new EventTransportError(`Circular value at ${path}`, { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_CIRCULAR' });
        if (options.circularPolicy === 'omit') return undefined;
        return `[Circular:${seen.get(value)}]`;
      }
      seen.set(value, path || '$');

      if (value instanceof Map) {
        const entries = [];
        for (const [key, item] of value) {
          if (++keyCount > options.maxKeys) { truncated = true; break; }
          entries.push([visit(key, depth + 1, `${path}.<key>`), visit(item, depth + 1, `${path}.<value>`)]);
        }
        return { __rnType: 'Map', value: entries };
      }
      if (value instanceof Set) {
        const entries = [];
        for (const item of value) {
          if (++keyCount > options.maxKeys) { truncated = true; break; }
          entries.push(visit(item, depth + 1, `${path}[]`));
        }
        return { __rnType: 'Set', value: entries };
      }

      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        const output = new Array(Math.min(value.length, options.maxKeys - keyCount));
        for (let index = 0; index < output.length; index++) {
          keyCount++;
          output[index] = visit(value[index], depth + 1, `${path}[${index}]`);
        }
        if (output.length < value.length) truncated = true;
        return output;
      }

      const output = Object.create(null);
      for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
        if (++keyCount > options.maxKeys) { truncated = true; break; }
        if (options.redact && shouldRedact(key, options.redactKeys)) {
          output[key] = options.redactWith;
          continue;
        }
        const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, key);
        if (descriptor?.get && options.getterPolicy !== 'invoke') {
          if (options.getterPolicy !== 'omit') output[key] = '[Getter]';
          continue;
        }
        let item;
        try { item = value[key]; }
        catch (error) { item = `[GetterError:${error?.message || error}]`; }
        const encoded = visit(item, depth + 1, path ? `${path}.${key}` : key);
        if (encoded !== undefined) output[key] = encoded;
      }
      return output;
    };

    return { value: visit(input, 0, '$'), truncated, keyCount };
  }

  encode(input, overrides = {}) {
    const options = { ...this.options, ...overrides };
    const sanitized = this.sanitize(input, options);
    let text;
    try { text = JSON.stringify(sanitized.value); }
    catch (cause) {
      throw new EventTransportError('Could not encode event payload', { code: 'EVENT_CODEC_ENCODE_FAILED', cause });
    }
    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(text);
    const maxBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxBytes) || 0);
    if (maxBytes && bytes > maxBytes) {
      throw new EventTransportError(`Encoded event payload exceeds ${maxBytes} bytes`, {
        code: 'EVENT_CODEC_MAX_BYTES',
        details: { bytes, maxBytes },
      });
    }
    return { text, bytes, truncated: sanitized.truncated, keyCount: sanitized.keyCount };
  }

  stringify(input, overrides = {}) { return this.encode(input, overrides).text; }

  parse(text, overrides = {}) {
    const options = { ...this.options, ...overrides };
    const value = JSON.parse(Buffer.isBuffer(text) ? text.toString('utf8') : String(text));
    return options.reconstruct === false ? value : this._reconstruct(value);
  }

  _reconstruct(value) {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((item) => this._reconstruct(item));
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
    const type = value.__rnType;
    if (type === 'Undefined') return undefined;
    if (type === 'BigInt') { try { return BigInt(value.value); } catch { return value.value; } }
    if (type === 'Buffer') return Buffer.from(value.value || '', 'base64');
    if (type === 'Date') return value.value ? new Date(value.value) : new Date(NaN);
    if (type === 'RegExp') return new RegExp(value.source || '', value.flags || '');
    if (type === 'Map') return new Map((value.value || []).map(([key, item]) => [this._reconstruct(key), this._reconstruct(item)]));
    if (type === 'Set') return new Set((value.value || []).map((item) => this._reconstruct(item)));
    if (type === 'Error') {
      const error = new Error(value.message || 'Event error');
      error.name = value.name || 'Error';
      error.stack = value.stack || error.stack;
      if (value.code !== undefined) error.code = value.code;
      if (value.details !== undefined) error.details = this._reconstruct(value.details);
      return error;
    }
    if (type && /Array$/.test(type) && typeof value.value === 'string') {
      const bytes = Buffer.from(value.value, 'base64');
      const Constructor = TYPED_ARRAYS[type];
      if (!Constructor || type === 'Uint8Array') return new Uint8Array(bytes);
      try {
        const owned = Uint8Array.from(bytes);
        return new Constructor(owned.buffer, 0, Math.floor(owned.byteLength / Constructor.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT));
      } catch { return new Uint8Array(bytes); }
    }
    const output = {};
    for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(value)) safeSet(output, key, this._reconstruct(item));
    return output;
  }
}

export default SafeJsonCodec;

'use strict';
export * from './SafeJsonCodec.js';
export * from './EventEnvelope.js';
export * from './EventCodecRegistry.js';

'use strict';

import { createHmac, randomUUID, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { EventTransportError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

export const EVENT_ENVELOPE_VERSION = 2;

const TYPED_ARRAY_NAMES = new Set([
  'Uint8Array', 'Uint8ClampedArray', 'Int8Array',
  'Uint16Array', 'Int16Array', 'Uint32Array', 'Int32Array',
  'Float32Array', 'Float64Array', 'BigInt64Array', 'BigUint64Array',
]);

function encodeString(value) {
  return JSON.stringify(String(value));
}

function numberToken(value) {
  if (Number.isNaN(value)) return 'd:NaN';
  if (value === Infinity) return 'd:+Infinity';
  if (value === -Infinity) return 'd:-Infinity';
  if (Object.is(value, -0)) return 'd:-0';
  return `d:${String(value)}`;
}

function taggedToken(value, state, depth, path) {
  const type = value?.__rnType;
  if (typeof type !== 'string') return null;

  switch (type) {
    case 'Undefined': return 'u';
    case 'BigInt': return `i:${String(value.value || '0')}`;
    case 'Buffer': return `x:Buffer:${String(value.value || '')}`;
    case 'Date': return `t:${encodeString(value.value || '')}`;
    case 'RegExp': return `g:${encodeString(value.source || '')}:${encodeString(value.flags || '')}`;
    case 'Map': {
      const entries = Array.isArray(value.value) ? value.value : [];
      return `m:[${entries.map((entry, index) => {
        const pair = Array.isArray(entry) ? entry : [undefined, undefined];
        return `${canonicalToken(pair[0], state, depth + 1, `${path}.map[${index}].key`)}=>${canonicalToken(pair[1], state, depth + 1, `${path}.map[${index}].value`)}`;
      }).join(',')}]`;
    }
    case 'Set': {
      const entries = Array.isArray(value.value) ? value.value : [];
      return `q:[${entries.map((entry, index) => canonicalToken(entry, state, depth + 1, `${path}.set[${index}]`)).join(',')}]`;
    }
    case 'Error':
      return `e:${canonicalToken({
        name: value.name || 'Error',
        message: value.message || '',
        stack: value.stack || '',
        code: value.code,
        details: value.details,
      }, state, depth + 1, `${path}.error`)}`;
    default:
      if (TYPED_ARRAY_NAMES.has(type) && typeof value.value === 'string') {
        return `x:${type}:${value.value}`;
      }
      return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Deterministic, type-aware canonicalization used only for signing.
 *
 * It intentionally does not depend on JSON.stringify so BigInt, Buffer, Error,
 * Date, Map, Set and typed arrays are valid envelope values. Object keys are
 * sorted, special numeric values are distinct, and cycles are represented by a
 * stable first-seen path. SafeJsonCodec tagged wire values canonicalize to the
 * same tokens as their reconstructed runtime counterparts.
 */
function canonicalToken(value, state, depth, path) {
  if (depth > state.maxDepth) return `z:${encodeString('[MaxDepth]')}`;
  if (value === null) return 'n';
  if (value === undefined) return 'u';

  const primitive = typeof value;
  if (primitive === 'string') return `s:${encodeString(value)}`;
  if (primitive === 'boolean') return value ? 'b:1' : 'b:0';
  if (primitive === 'number') return numberToken(value);
  if (primitive === 'bigint') return `i:${value.toString()}`;
  if (primitive === 'symbol') return `y:${encodeString(value.description || '')}`;
  if (primitive === 'function') return `f:${encodeString(value.name || 'anonymous')}`;

  const tagged = taggedToken(value, state, depth, path);
  if (tagged !== null) return tagged;

  if (Buffer.isBuffer(value)) return `x:Buffer:${value.toString('base64')}`;
  if (value instanceof Uint8Array) {
    const name = value.constructor?.name || 'Uint8Array';
    const bytes = Buffer.from(value.buffer, value.byteOffset, value.byteLength).toString('base64');
    return `x:${name}:${bytes}`;
  }
  if (value instanceof Date) {
    return `t:${encodeString(Number.isFinite(value.getTime()) ? value.toISOString() : '')}`;
  }
  if (value instanceof RegExp) return `g:${encodeString(value.source)}:${encodeString(value.flags)}`;
  if (value instanceof Error) {
    return `e:${canonicalToken({
      name: value.name || 'Error',
      message: value.message || '',
      stack: value.stack || '',
      code: value.code,
      details: value.details,
    }, state, depth + 1, `${path}.error`)}`;
  }

  if (state.seen.has(value)) return `r:${encodeString(state.seen.get(value))}`;
  state.seen.set(value, path);

  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return `a:${value.length}:[${value.map((entry, index) => canonicalToken(entry, state, depth + 1, `${path}[${index}]`)).join(',')}]`;
  }

  if (value instanceof Map) {
    const entries = [];
    let index = 0;
    for (const [key, entry] of value) {
      entries.push(`${canonicalToken(key, state, depth + 1, `${path}.map[${index}].key`)}=>${canonicalToken(entry, state, depth + 1, `${path}.map[${index}].value`)}`);
      index++;
    }
    return `m:[${entries.join(',')}]`;
  }

  if (value instanceof Set) {
    const entries = [];
    let index = 0;
    for (const entry of value) {
      entries.push(canonicalToken(entry, state, depth + 1, `${path}.set[${index++}]`));
    }
    return `q:[${entries.join(',')}]`;
  }

  const keys = Object.keys(value).sort();
  const entries = [];
  for (const key of keys) {
    let entry;
    try { entry = value[key]; }
    catch (error) { entry = `[GetterError:${error?.message || error}]`; }
    entries.push(`${encodeString(key)}:${canonicalToken(entry, state, depth + 1, `${path}.${key}`)}`);
  }
  return `o:{${entries.join(',')}}`;
}

export function canonicalizeEventEnvelope(envelope, options = {}) {
  const selected = {
    v: Number(envelope?.v) || 0,
    id: envelope?.id == null ? '' : String(envelope.id),
    node: envelope?.node == null ? '' : String(envelope.node),
    ts: Number(envelope?.ts) || 0,
    expiresAt: Number(envelope?.expiresAt) || 0,
    hop: Number(envelope?.hop) || 0,
    namespace: envelope?.namespace == null ? '' : String(envelope.namespace),
    event: envelope?.event == null ? '' : String(envelope.event),
    args: Array.isArray(envelope?.args) ? envelope.args : [],
    ctx: envelope?.ctx ?? null,
    headers: envelope?.headers ?? null,
  };
  return canonicalToken(selected, {
    seen: new WeakMap(),
    maxDepth: Math.max(8, Number(options.maxDepth) || 128),
  }, 0, '$');
}

export function signEventEnvelope(envelope, secret) {
  if (!secret) return null;
  return createHmac('sha256', secret)
    .update(canonicalizeEventEnvelope(envelope))
    .digest('base64url');
}

export function verifyEventEnvelopeSignature(envelope, secret) {
  if (!secret) return true;
  if (typeof envelope?.signature !== 'string' || !envelope.signature) return false;

  let expected;
  let actual;
  try {
    expected = Buffer.from(signEventEnvelope({ ...envelope, signature: undefined }, secret), 'base64url');
    actual = Buffer.from(envelope.signature, 'base64url');
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
  return expected.length === actual.length && expected.length > 0 && timingSafeEqual(expected, actual);
}

export function createEventEnvelope(eventName, args = [], options = {}) {
  const now = Number(options.ts) || Date.now();
  const envelope = {
    v: EVENT_ENVELOPE_VERSION,
    id: options.id || randomUUID(),
    node: String(options.nodeId || options.node || ''),
    ts: now,
    expiresAt: Number(options.expiresAt) || (Number(options.ttlMs) > 0 ? now + Number(options.ttlMs) : 0),
    hop: Math.max(0, Number(options.hop) || 0),
    namespace: options.namespace ? String(options.namespace) : 'default',
    event: String(eventName),
    args: Array.isArray(args) ? args : [args],
    ctx: options.context && typeof options.context === 'object' ? options.context : null,
    headers: options.headers && typeof options.headers === 'object' ? options.headers : null,
  };
  if (options.secret) envelope.signature = signEventEnvelope(envelope, options.secret);
  return envelope;
}

export function normalizeEventEnvelope(input) {
  if (!input || typeof input !== 'object') return null;
  if (Number(input.v) === 1) {
    return {
      v: 1,
      id: input.id,
      node: input.node,
      ts: input.ts,
      expiresAt: input.expiresAt || 0,
      hop: input.hop || 0,
      // Old v1 producers did not include a namespace. Preserve that absence so
      // a configured receiver can adopt its local namespace compatibly.
      namespace: input.namespace == null ? null : String(input.namespace),
      event: input.event,
      args: Array.isArray(input.args) ? input.args : [],
      ctx: input.ctx && typeof input.ctx === 'object' ? input.ctx : null,
      headers: input.headers && typeof input.headers === 'object' ? input.headers : null,
      signature: input.signature,
    };
  }
  return input;
}

export function validateEventEnvelope(input, options = {}) {
  const envelope = normalizeEventEnvelope(input);
  const fail = (reason, code = 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_INVALID') => ({ ok: false, reason, code, envelope });
  if (!envelope) return fail('Envelope must be an object');

  const version = Number(envelope.v);
  const acceptedVersions = options.acceptedVersions || [1, EVENT_ENVELOPE_VERSION];
  if (!acceptedVersions.includes(version)) return fail(`Unsupported envelope version ${envelope.v}`, 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_VERSION');
  if (typeof envelope.id !== 'string' || !envelope.id || Buffer.byteLength(envelope.id) > (options.maxIdBytes || 256)) return fail('Invalid envelope id');
  if (typeof envelope.node !== 'string' || !envelope.node || Buffer.byteLength(envelope.node) > (options.maxNodeBytes || 256)) return fail('Invalid origin node');
  if (typeof envelope.event !== 'string' || !envelope.event) return fail('Invalid event name');
  if (Buffer.byteLength(envelope.event) > (options.maxEventNameBytes || 512)) return fail('Event name is too large', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_EVENT_NAME_BYTES');
  if (!Array.isArray(envelope.args)) return fail('Envelope args must be an array');
  if (envelope.args.length > (options.maxArgs || 128)) return fail('Envelope has too many arguments', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_MAX_ARGS');

  const now = Number(options.now) || Date.now();
  const maxAgeMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxAgeMs) || 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(Number(envelope.ts))) return fail('Invalid envelope timestamp');
  if (maxAgeMs && now - Number(envelope.ts) > maxAgeMs) return fail('Envelope is too old', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_EXPIRED');
  if (Number(envelope.ts) - now > (Number(options.maxClockSkewMs) || 30_000)) return fail('Envelope timestamp is in the future', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_CLOCK_SKEW');
  if (Number(envelope.expiresAt) > 0 && now >= Number(envelope.expiresAt)) return fail('Envelope expired', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_EXPIRED');
  if ((Number(envelope.hop) || 0) > (Number(options.maxHops) || 4)) return fail('Envelope exceeded hop limit', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_HOPS');

  if (options.namespace) {
    if (version === 1 && envelope.namespace == null) {
      envelope.namespace = String(options.namespace);
    } else if (String(envelope.namespace || 'default') !== String(options.namespace)) {
      return fail('Envelope namespace mismatch', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_NAMESPACE');
    }
  }

  const unsignedLegacyAccepted = version === 1 && options.acceptUnsignedV1 !== false && !envelope.signature;
  if (options.secret && !unsignedLegacyAccepted && !verifyEventEnvelopeSignature(envelope, options.secret)) {
    return fail('Envelope signature is invalid', 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_SIGNATURE');
  }
  return { ok: true, envelope };
}

export function assertEventEnvelope(input, options = {}) {
  const result = validateEventEnvelope(input, options);
  if (!result.ok) {
    throw new EventTransportError(result.reason, {
      code: result.code,
      details: { envelopeId: result.envelope?.id },
    });
  }
  return result.envelope;
}

'use strict';

// src/events/EventName.js

import { normalizeEventName as normalize } from './support/glob.js';

export const RESERVED_EVENT_PREFIXES = Object.freeze(['internal', 'http', 'tcp', 'udp', 'ws', 'redis']);

export function validateEventName(name) {
  if (typeof name !== 'string') throw new TypeError('Event name must be a string');
  const [domain] = name.split(':');
  if (!domain || !name.includes(':')) throw new Error(`Invalid event name '${name}'`);
  if (RESERVED_EVENT_PREFIXES.includes(domain)) throw new Error(`Event namespace '${domain}' is reserved`);
  return true;
}

export function normalizeEventName(name, options = {}) {
  return normalize(name, options.normalizeDot === true);
}

export function parseEventName(name, options = {}) {
  const normalized = normalizeEventName(name, options);
  if (typeof normalized !== 'string' || !normalized) throw new TypeError('Event name must be a non-empty string');
  const segments = normalized.split(':');
  return Object.freeze({
    value: normalized,
    domain: segments[0] || null,
    subject: segments.length > 2 ? segments.slice(1, -1).join(':') : segments[1] || null,
    verb: segments.length > 1 ? segments.at(-1) : null,
    segments: Object.freeze(segments),
    reserved: RESERVED_EVENT_PREFIXES.includes(segments[0]),
  });
}

export function eventName(domain, subject, verb) {
  return [domain, subject, verb].flat().filter((value) => value != null && String(value).length).map(String).join(':');
}

export function isReservedEventName(name) {
  return RESERVED_EVENT_PREFIXES.includes(String(name).split(':', 1)[0]);
}

export function assertFrameworkEventName(name) {
  const parsed = parseEventName(name);
  if (!parsed.reserved) throw new Error(`Event namespace '${parsed.domain}' is not a framework-reserved namespace`);
  return true;
}

'use strict';

// src/events/EventDispatcher.js

import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';

export class EventDispatcher {
  constructor() {
    this.emitter = new EventEmitter();
    this.emitter.setMaxListeners(0);
  }

  // Historical return values are intentionally preserved (undefined).
  on(event, listener) { this.emitter.on(event, listener); }
  once(event, listener) { this.emitter.once(event, listener); }
  off(event, listener) { this.emitter.off(event, listener); }
  dispatch(event, ...args) { this.emitter.emit(event, ...args); }
  emit(event, ...args) { return this.dispatch(event, ...args); }

  subscribe(event, listener, options = {}) {
    if (options.once) this.emitter.once(event, listener);
    else this.emitter.on(event, listener);
    let active = true;
    const emitter = this.emitter;
    const dispose = () => {
      if (!active) return false;
      active = false;
      emitter.off(event, listener);
      return true;
    };
    return Object.freeze({ dispose, off: dispose, unsubscribe: dispose, [Symbol.dispose]: dispose });
  }

  listeners(event) { return this.emitter.listeners(event); }
  listenerCount(event) { return this.emitter.listenerCount(event); }
  eventNames() { return this.emitter.eventNames(); }
  removeAllListeners(event) { this.emitter.removeAllListeners(event); }
}

export default EventDispatcher;

'use strict';

// src/events/EventMetrics.js

import { formatPrometheusSnapshot } from './observability/PrometheusFormatter.js';

export class EventMetrics {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.stats = new Map();
    this.maxSeries = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxSeries) || 2048);
    this.prefix = options.prefix || 'rawnode_events';
  }

  record(event, duration, error = null) {
    const name = this.stats.has(event) || this.stats.size < this.maxSeries ? String(event) : '__overflow__';
    const record = this.stats.get(name) || {
      count: 0,
      failures: 0,
      totalTime: 0,
      minTime: Infinity,
      maxTime: 0,
      lastTime: 0,
    };
    const ms = Number(duration) || 0;
    record.count++;
    record.totalTime += ms;
    record.minTime = Math.min(record.minTime, ms);
    record.maxTime = Math.max(record.maxTime, ms);
    record.lastTime = ms;
    if (error) record.failures++;
    this.stats.set(name, record);
    return this;
  }

  reset() { this.stats.clear(); return this; }

  snapshot() {
    const output = {};
    for (const [event, record] of this.stats) {
      output[event] = {
        ...record,
        minTime: Number.isFinite(record.minTime) ? record.minTime : 0,
        averageTime: record.count ? record.totalTime / record.count : 0,
      };
    }
    return output;
  }

  prometheus(prefix = this.prefix) {
    const series = Object.entries(this.snapshot()).map(([eventName, record]) => ({
      eventName,
      count: record.count,
      errorCount: record.failures,
      totalMs: record.totalTime,
      minMs: record.minTime,
      maxMs: record.maxTime,
    }));
    return formatPrometheusSnapshot({ counters: {}, series, histogram: {} }, prefix);
  }
}

export default EventMetrics;

function parseConcurrency(value, fallback = Infinity) {
  if (value === Infinity) return Infinity;
