'use strict';

import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

import { AdvancedEventDispatcher } from '../AdvancedEventDispatcher.js';
import { RedisEventBridge } from '../RedisEventBridge.js';
import { BroadcastManager } from '../broadcasting/BroadcastManager.js';
import { EventSchemaRegistry } from '../contracts/EventSchemaRegistry.js';
import { EventCodecRegistry } from '../serialization/EventCodecRegistry.js';
import { EventOutbox } from '../durable/EventOutbox.js';
import { MemoryOutboxStore } from '../durable/MemoryOutboxStore.js';
import { OutboxPublisher } from '../durable/OutboxPublisher.js';
import { EventJobQueue } from '../queue/EventJobQueue.js';
import { EventScheduler } from '../queue/EventScheduler.js';
import { WorkflowEngine } from '../workflows/WorkflowEngine.js';
import { MemoryWorkflowStore } from '../workflows/MemoryWorkflowStore.js';
import { MemoryEventStore } from '../sourcing/MemoryEventStore.js';
import { ProjectionManager, MemoryProjectionCheckpointStore } from '../sourcing/ProjectionManager.js';
import { EVENT_COMMANDS } from '../console/EventCommands.js';

function isPlain(value) { return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value); }
function safeResolve(app, key, fallback = null) { try { return app?.resolve?.(key) ?? fallback; } catch { return fallback; } }
function hasBinding(app, key) {
  try { return !!(app?.container?.has?.(key) || app?.has?.(key) || app?.bound?.(key)); } catch { return false; }
}
function bind(app, kind, key, factory) {
  if (typeof app?.[kind] === 'function') return app[kind](key, factory);
  if (typeof app?.container?.[kind] === 'function') return app.container[kind](key, factory);
  if (typeof app?.bind === 'function') return app.bind(key, factory);
  throw new Error(`Application container cannot bind [${key}]`);
}
function tag(app, key, name) {
  try { app?.tag?.(key, name); return; } catch {}
  try { app?.container?.tag?.(key, name); } catch {}
}
function cfg(config, key, fallback = undefined) {
  try {
    if (typeof config?.get === 'function') {
      const value = config.get(key);
      return value === undefined ? fallback : value;
    }
  } catch {}
  const parts = String(key).split('.');
  let current = config;
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!current || typeof current !== 'object' || !(part in current)) return fallback;
    current = current[part];
  }
  return current;
}
function merge(...sources) {
  const output = {};
  for (const source of sources) {
    if (!isPlain(source)) continue;
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(source)) {
      if (isPlain(value) && isPlain(output[key])) output[key] = merge(output[key], value);
      else if (isPlain(value)) output[key] = merge(value);
      else if (Array.isArray(value)) output[key] = value.slice();
      else if (value !== undefined) output[key] = value;
    }
  }
  return output;
}

export class EventServiceProvider {
  static priority = 2;
  static dependencies = ['app'];

  constructor(app) {
    this.app = app;
    this.scope = null;
    this.listenerInstances = new Map();
    this.lifecycleCleanups = [];
    this.registrationReport = null;
    this.bridge = null;
    this.broadcastManager = null;
    this.outboxPublisher = null;
    this.queue = null;
    this.scheduler = null;
    this.workflows = null;
    this.eventStore = null;
    this.projections = null;
  }

  register() {
    const app = this.app;
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.schemas', () => new EventSchemaRegistry(this._config().contracts || {}));
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.codecs', () => new EventCodecRegistry(this._config().codecs || {}));
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events', () => {
      const configuration = this._config();
      const events = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({
        ...configuration.bus,
        profile: configuration.bus?.profile || configuration.profile || 'compat',
        logger: safeResolve(app, 'logger', console),
        schemaRegistry: safeResolve(app, 'events.schemas'),
        codecRegistry: safeResolve(app, 'events.codecs'),
      });
      if (configuration.global !== false) globalThis.events = events;
      return events;
    });
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.bridge.redis', () => new RedisEventBridge(app));
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.broadcast', () => new BroadcastManager(safeResolve(app, 'events'), this._config().broadcasting || {}));
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.outbox.store', () => new MemoryOutboxStore(this._config().durable?.memory || this._config().durable || {}));
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.outbox', () => new EventOutbox({
      ...(this._config().durable || {}),
      store: safeResolve(app, 'events.outbox.store'),
      dispatcher: safeResolve(app, 'events'),
      schemaRegistry: safeResolve(app, 'events.schemas'),
    }));
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.outbox.publisher', () => {
      const transport = safeResolve(app, 'events.durable.transport');
      return transport ? new OutboxPublisher(safeResolve(app, 'events.outbox.store'), transport, this._config().durable?.publisher || {}) : null;
    });
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.queue', () => {
      const queue = new EventJobQueue(this._config().queue || {});
      queue.register('dispatch', async (payload, context) => {
        const events = safeResolve(app, 'events');
        if (!events) throw new Error('Events dispatcher is unavailable');
        return events.run(payload?.context || context?.context || null, () => events.dispatchAsync(payload.eventName, ...(payload.args || [])));
      });
      this.queue = queue;
      return queue;
    });
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.scheduler', () => {
      const configuration = this._config().scheduler || {};
      const scheduler = new EventScheduler({
        ...configuration,
        dispatcher: safeResolve(app, 'events'),
        queue: configuration.queue === true ? safeResolve(app, 'events.queue') : null,
      });
      this.scheduler = scheduler;
      return scheduler;
    });
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.workflows.store', () => new MemoryWorkflowStore(this._config().workflows?.memory || {}));
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.workflows', () => {
      const workflows = new WorkflowEngine({
        ...(this._config().workflows || {}),
        dispatcher: safeResolve(app, 'events'),
        store: safeResolve(app, 'events.workflows.store'),
      });
      this.workflows = workflows;
      return workflows;
    });
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.store', () => {
      const eventStore = new MemoryEventStore(this._config().sourcing?.memory || this._config().sourcing || {});
      this.eventStore = eventStore;
      return eventStore;
    });
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.projections.checkpoints', () => new MemoryProjectionCheckpointStore());
    bind(app, 'singleton', 'events.projections', () => {
      const projections = new ProjectionManager(safeResolve(app, 'events.store'), {
        ...(this._config().sourcing?.projections || {}),
        checkpoints: safeResolve(app, 'events.projections.checkpoints'),
      });
      this.projections = projections;
      return projections;
    });

    for (const [key, Command] of EVENT_COMMANDS) {
      bind(app, 'singleton', key, () => new Command(app));
      tag(app, key, 'console.command');
    }
  }

  async boot() {
    const configuration = this._config();
    const events = safeResolve(this.app, 'events');
    if (!events) throw new Error('EventServiceProvider could not resolve events');
    this.scope = events.scope('provider:events');

    try {
      this.registrationReport = await this._registerConfiguration(events, configuration);
      this._forwardContainerLifecycle(events, configuration.lifecycle || {});

      this.broadcastManager = safeResolve(this.app, 'events.broadcast');
      if (configuration.broadcasting?.enabled) {
        events.setBroadcastManager(this.broadcastManager, { auto: configuration.broadcasting.auto === true });
        if (configuration.broadcasting.listen === true) this.broadcastManager.start(events);
      }

      this.bridge = safeResolve(this.app, 'events.bridge.redis');
      const bridgeEnabled = configuration.bridge?.redis?.enabled === true || process.env.EVENTS_REDIS === 'true';
      if (bridgeEnabled && process.env.APP_ENV !== 'test') {
        try { await this.bridge.start(configuration.bridge.redis); }
        catch (error) {
          if (configuration.bridge.redis.required === true || configuration.failFast === true) throw error;
          safeResolve(this.app, 'logger', console)?.error?.('[EventServiceProvider] Redis bridge start failed', error);
        }
      }

      if (configuration.durable?.enabled) {
        const outbox = safeResolve(this.app, 'events.outbox');
        events.setOutbox(outbox);
        this.outboxPublisher = safeResolve(this.app, 'events.outbox.publisher');
        if (this.outboxPublisher && configuration.durable.autoStart !== false) this.outboxPublisher.start();
      }

      this._attachEnterpriseSubsystems(events, configuration);

      const environment = process.env.APP_ENV || process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development';
      if (configuration.freezeListeners === true || (environment === 'production' && configuration.dynamicRegistration === false)) {
        events.freezeRegistrations({ contracts: true, codecs: true });
      }

      events.dispatch('events:ready', {
        listeners: this.registrationReport,
        bridge: this.bridge?.snapshot?.() || null,
        profile: events.configuration?.value?.profile,
      });
      return this.registrationReport;
    } catch (error) {
      this.scope?.dispose?.();
      this.scope = null;
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async teardown() {
    for (const cleanup of this.lifecycleCleanups.splice(0)) { try { cleanup(); } catch {} }
    this.scope?.dispose?.();
    this.scope = null;
    try { await this.outboxPublisher?.close?.(); } catch {}
    try { await this.bridge?.close?.(); } catch {}
    try { await this.broadcastManager?.close?.(); } catch {}
    const events = safeResolve(this.app, 'events');
    try { await events?.close?.({ closeBridge: false, closeBroadcasting: false }); } catch {}
    if (globalThis.events === events) delete globalThis.events;
    this.listenerInstances.clear();
    this.queue = null;
    this.scheduler = null;
    this.workflows = null;
    this.eventStore = null;
    this.projections = null;
  }

  _config() {
    const config = safeResolve(this.app, 'config', {});
    const root = cfg(config, 'events', {}) || {};
    const appEvents = cfg(config, 'app.events', {}) || {};
    const bus = merge(appEvents.bus || appEvents, root.bus || {});
    return merge(appEvents, root, { bus });
  }

  async _registerConfiguration(events, configuration) {
    const listeners = configuration.listeners || this._legacyListenerMap(configuration);
    const subscribers = Array.isArray(configuration.subscribers) ? configuration.subscribers : [];
    const report = { loaded: [], skipped: [], failed: [], subscribers: [] };

    for (const [eventName, definitions] of Object.entries(listeners || {})) {
      for (const definition of Array.isArray(definitions) ? definitions : [definitions]) {
        try {
          const resolved = await this._coerceListener(definition);
          if (!resolved.handler) { report.skipped.push({ eventName, definition, reason: 'unresolvable' }); continue; }
          const kind = this._listenerKind(eventName, resolved.options);
          const options = { owner: 'events:config', ...resolved.options };
          const handle = kind === 'any'
            ? this.scope.any(resolved.handler, options)
            : kind === 'pattern'
              ? this.scope.pattern(eventName, resolved.handler, options)
              : this.scope.subscribe(eventName, resolved.handler, options);
          report.loaded.push({ eventName, kind, listenerId: handle?.id, owner: options.owner, priority: options.priority || 0 });
        } catch (error) {
          report.failed.push({ eventName, definition: this._safeDefinition(definition), error: { name: error.name, message: error.message, code: error.code } });
          if (configuration.failFast === true) throw error;
        }
      }
    }

    for (const definition of subscribers) {
      try {
        const Subscriber = await this._resolveTarget(definition);
        const map = Subscriber?.getSubscribedEvents?.();
        if (!map) { report.skipped.push({ subscriber: this._safeDefinition(definition), reason: 'missing-getSubscribedEvents' }); continue; }
        const instance = this._instance(Subscriber);
        for (const [eventName, eventDefinition] of Object.entries(map)) {
          const normalized = typeof eventDefinition === 'string'
            ? { method: eventDefinition }
            : Array.isArray(eventDefinition)
              ? { method: eventDefinition[0], priority: eventDefinition[1] }
              : eventDefinition;
          const method = normalized?.method || normalized?.handle || 'handle';
          if (typeof instance?.[method] !== 'function') throw new Error(`Subscriber method missing: ${Subscriber.name}.${method}`);
          const handler = (...args) => instance[method](...args);
          const kind = this._listenerKind(eventName, normalized || {});
          const options = { ...normalized, owner: normalized?.owner || `subscriber:${Subscriber.name}` };
          const handle = kind === 'any' ? this.scope.any(handler, options) : kind === 'pattern' ? this.scope.pattern(eventName, handler, options) : this.scope.subscribe(eventName, handler, options);
          report.subscribers.push({ subscriber: Subscriber.name, eventName, method, listenerId: handle?.id });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        report.failed.push({ subscriber: this._safeDefinition(definition), error: { name: error.name, message: error.message, code: error.code } });
        if (configuration.failFast === true) throw error;
      }
    }
    return report;
  }

  _legacyListenerMap(configuration) {
    const reserved = new Set(['bus', 'bridge', 'broadcasting', 'durable', 'contracts', 'codecs', 'subscribers', 'profile', 'global', 'failFast']);
    const entries = Object.entries(configuration || {}).filter(([key, value]) => !reserved.has(key) && (Array.isArray(value) || typeof value === 'function' || typeof value === 'string'));
    return Object.fromEntries(entries);
  }

  _listenerKind(eventName, options = {}) {
    if (options.any === true || eventName === '*') return 'any';
    if (options.pattern === true) return 'pattern';
    const stars = (String(eventName).match(/\*/g) || []).length;
    if (String(eventName).includes('**') || String(eventName).includes('?')) return 'pattern';
    if (stars && !(stars === 1 && String(eventName).endsWith(':*'))) return 'pattern';
    return 'exact';
  }

  async _coerceListener(definition) {
    let target = definition;
    let method = null;
    const options = {};
    if (isPlain(definition) && (definition.listener || definition.use || definition.handler)) {
      target = definition.listener || definition.use || definition.handler;
      method = definition.method || null;
      for (const key of ['priority', 'prepend', 'once', 'replay', 'replayConsumesOnce', 'owner', 'tags', 'tag', 'timeoutMs', 'errorPolicy', 'meta', 'pattern', 'any', 'paused']) {
        if (definition[key] !== undefined) options[key] = definition[key];
      }
    }
    target = await this._resolveTarget(target, (parsed) => { method ||= parsed.method; });
    if (typeof target === 'function') {
      const selected = method || 'handle';
      if (target.prototype && typeof target.prototype[selected] === 'function') {
        const instance = this._instance(target);
        return { handler: (...args) => instance[selected](...args), options };
      }
      return { handler: target, options };
    }
    if (target && typeof target === 'object') {
      const selected = method || 'handle';
      if (typeof target[selected] === 'function') return { handler: (...args) => target[selected](...args), options };
    }
    return { handler: null, options };
  }

  async _resolveTarget(target, onParsed = null) {
    if (typeof target !== 'string') return target;
    const parsed = this._parseReference(target);
    onParsed?.(parsed);
    const module = await this._import(parsed.spec);
    return parsed.exportName ? module[parsed.exportName] : module.default || (Object.keys(module).length === 1 ? module[Object.keys(module)[0]] : null);
  }

  _parseReference(input) {
    let spec = String(input).trim();
    let method = null;
    let exportName = null;
    const at = spec.lastIndexOf('@');
    if (at > spec.lastIndexOf('/')) { method = spec.slice(at + 1); spec = spec.slice(0, at); }
    else {
      const dot = spec.lastIndexOf('.');
      if (dot > spec.lastIndexOf('/') && !/\.(?:js|mjs|cjs)$/.test(spec)) { method = spec.slice(dot + 1); spec = spec.slice(0, dot); }
    }
    const hash = spec.indexOf('#', 1);
    if (hash > 0) { exportName = spec.slice(hash + 1); spec = spec.slice(0, hash); }
    if (spec.startsWith('@listeners/')) spec = `#app/Listeners/${spec.slice('@listeners/'.length)}.js`;
    return { spec, method, exportName };
  }

  async _import(spec) {
    if (spec.startsWith('#') || (!spec.startsWith('.') && !path.isAbsolute(spec))) return import(spec);
    const base = typeof this.app?.basePath === 'function' ? this.app.basePath() : process.cwd();
    const absolute = path.isAbsolute(spec) ? spec : path.resolve(base, spec);
    return import(pathToFileURL(absolute).href);
  }

  _instance(Class) {
    if (this.listenerInstances.has(Class)) return this.listenerInstances.get(Class);
    let instance;
    try { instance = this.app?.make?.(Class); } catch {}
    if (!instance) {
      const dependencies = Array.isArray(Class.dependencies) ? Class.dependencies.map((key) => safeResolve(this.app, key)) : [];
      instance = new Class(...dependencies);
    }
    this.listenerInstances.set(Class, instance);
    return instance;
  }

  _forwardContainerLifecycle(events, options) {
    if (options.enabled === false) return;
    const container = this.app?.container || this.app;
    const attach = (name, handler) => {
      if (typeof container?.on !== 'function') return;
      container.on(name, handler);
      this.lifecycleCleanups.push(() => container.off?.(name, handler));
    };
    attach('bound', (serviceName, scope) => events.dispatch('container:bound', { serviceName, scope }));
    attach('resolving', (serviceName) => events.dispatch('container:resolving', { serviceName }));
    attach('resolved', (serviceName) => events.dispatch('container:resolved', { serviceName }));
    attach('failed', (serviceName, error) => events.dispatch('container:failed', { serviceName, error }));
    for (const [method, eventName] of [['onAllResolving', 'container:resolving'], ['onAllResolved', 'container:resolved'], ['onAllFailed', 'container:failed']]) {
      if (typeof container?.[method] !== 'function') continue;
      const listener = (...args) => events.dispatch(eventName, method === 'onAllFailed' ? { serviceName: args[0], error: args[1] } : { serviceName: args[0] });
      const off = container[method](listener);
      if (typeof off === 'function') this.lifecycleCleanups.push(off);
    }
  }

  _attachEnterpriseSubsystems(events, configuration) {
    const attach = (name, key, options = {}) => {
      if (options.enabled === false) return null;
      const subsystem = safeResolve(this.app, key);
      if (!subsystem) return null;
      events.registerSubsystem(name, subsystem, {
        required: options.required === true,
        closeOnShutdown: options.closeOnShutdown !== false,
        meta: { binding: key, ...(options.meta || {}) },
      });
      return subsystem;
    };

    if (configuration.queue?.enabled === true) this.queue = attach('queue', 'events.queue', configuration.queue);
    if (configuration.scheduler?.enabled === true) this.scheduler = attach('scheduler', 'events.scheduler', configuration.scheduler);
    if (configuration.workflows?.enabled === true) this.workflows = attach('workflows', 'events.workflows', configuration.workflows);
    if (configuration.sourcing?.enabled === true) {
      this.eventStore = attach('event-store', 'events.store', configuration.sourcing);
      this.projections = attach('projections', 'events.projections', configuration.sourcing.projections || {});
    }
    if (this.outboxPublisher) events.registerSubsystem('outbox-publisher', this.outboxPublisher, { closeOnShutdown: false, meta: { binding: 'events.outbox.publisher' } });
  }

  _safeDefinition(definition) {
    if (typeof definition === 'function') return definition.name || '[Function]';
    if (typeof definition === 'string') return definition;
    try { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(definition)); } catch { return String(definition); }
  }
}

export default EventServiceProvider;

'use strict';

import { compileMatcherList, matchesAny } from '../support/glob.js';

export class EventRecorder {
  constructor(dispatcher = null, options = {}) {
    this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 10_000);
    this.allow = compileMatcherList(options.allow || []);
    this.deny = compileMatcherList(options.deny || []);
    this.records = [];
    this.handle = null;
    this.dropped = 0;
    if (dispatcher && options.autoStart !== false) this.start();
  }

  start(dispatcher = this.dispatcher) {
    if (this.handle) return this;
    if (!dispatcher) throw new TypeError('EventRecorder requires a dispatcher');
    this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
    const listener = (eventName, ...args) => this.record(eventName, args, dispatcher.getContext?.());
    if (typeof dispatcher.subscribeAny === 'function') {
      this.handle = dispatcher.subscribeAny(listener, {
        priority: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
        owner: 'rawnode:events:test-recorder',
        tags: ['testing', 'recorder'],
      });
    } else {
      dispatcher.onAny(listener, { priority: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER });
      this.handle = { dispose: () => dispatcher.offAny?.(listener) };
    }
    return this;
  }

  record(eventName, args = [], context = null) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    if (this.allow.length && !matchesAny(this.allow, name)) return false;
    if (this.deny.length && matchesAny(this.deny, name)) return false;
    if (this.records.length >= this.maxItems) { this.records.shift(); this.dropped++; }
    this.records.push({ eventName: name, args: Array.isArray(args) ? args : [args], context: context ? { ...context } : null, ts: Date.now() });
    return true;
  }

  all(eventName = null) {
    return (eventName == null ? this.records : this.records.filter((record) => record.eventName === String(eventName))).slice();
  }
  count(eventName = null) { return this.all(eventName).length; }
  has(eventName, predicate = null) {
    return this.records.some((record) => record.eventName === String(eventName) && (!predicate || predicate(...record.args, record)));
  }
  last(eventName = null) { const records = this.all(eventName); return records.at(-1) || null; }
  clear() { const count = this.records.length; this.records.length = 0; return count; }
  stop() { this.handle?.dispose?.(); this.handle = null; return this; }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ count: this.records.length, dropped: this.dropped, records: Object.freeze(this.records.slice()) }); }
  [Symbol.dispose]() { this.stop(); }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { this.stop(); }
}

export default EventRecorder;

'use strict';

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

function sourceRecords(source) {
  if (Array.isArray(source)) return source;
  if (typeof source?.all === 'function') return source.all();
  if (Array.isArray(source?.records)) return source.records;
  throw new TypeError('Event assertion source must be an EventRecorder or record array');
}

export function assertDispatched(source, eventName, predicate = null, message = null) {
  const records = sourceRecords(source);
  const match = records.find((record) => record.eventName === String(eventName) && (!predicate || predicate(...record.args, record)));
  assert.ok(match, message || `Expected event "${eventName}" to be dispatched`);
  return match;
}

export function assertNotDispatched(source, eventName, predicate = null, message = null) {
  const records = sourceRecords(source);
  const match = records.find((record) => record.eventName === String(eventName) && (!predicate || predicate(...record.args, record)));
  assert.equal(match, undefined, message || `Expected event "${eventName}" not to be dispatched`);
  return true;
}

export function assertDispatchedTimes(source, eventName, expected, message = null) {
  const count = sourceRecords(source).filter((record) => record.eventName === String(eventName)).length;
  assert.equal(count, expected, message || `Expected event "${eventName}" ${expected} time(s), received ${count}`);
  return true;
}

export function assertDispatchOrder(source, eventNames, message = null) {
  const actual = sourceRecords(source).map((record) => record.eventName);
  let cursor = 0;
  for (const name of actual) if (name === eventNames[cursor]) cursor++;
  assert.equal(cursor, eventNames.length, message || `Expected dispatch order ${eventNames.join(' -> ')}, received ${actual.join(' -> ')}`);
  return true;
}

export class EventAssertions {
  constructor(source) { this.source = source; }
  dispatched(name, predicate, message) { return assertDispatched(this.source, name, predicate, message); }
  notDispatched(name, predicate, message) { return assertNotDispatched(this.source, name, predicate, message); }
  dispatchedTimes(name, count, message) { return assertDispatchedTimes(this.source, name, count, message); }
  order(names, message) { return assertDispatchOrder(this.source, names, message); }
}

export default EventAssertions;

'use strict';

export class MemoryEventTransport {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 100_000);
    this.messages = [];
    this.listeners = new Map();
    this.closed = false;
    this.stats = { published: 0, broadcasts: 0, delivered: 0, dropped: 0 };
  }

  async publish(eventName, payload, options = {}) {
    if (this.closed) throw new Error('MemoryEventTransport is closed');
    const message = { eventName: String(eventName), payload, options, ts: Date.now() };
    this._append(message);
    this.stats.published++;
    for (const listener of this.listeners.get(message.eventName) || []) {
      await listener(payload, message);
      this.stats.delivered++;
    }
    for (const listener of this.listeners.get('*') || []) {
      await listener(message.eventName, payload, message);
      this.stats.delivered++;
    }
    return message;
  }

  async publishEnvelope(envelope, options = {}) { return this.publish(envelope.event, envelope, options); }

  async broadcast(envelope, options = {}) {
    this.stats.broadcasts++;
    return this.publish(envelope.event, envelope, options);
  }

  subscribe(eventName, listener) {
    const name = String(eventName);
    let bucket = this.listeners.get(name);
    if (!bucket) this.listeners.set(name, bucket = new Set());
    bucket.add(listener);
    const dispose = () => bucket.delete(listener);
    return { dispose, unsubscribe: dispose, off: dispose, [Symbol.dispose]: dispose };
  }

  all(eventName = null) { return (eventName == null ? this.messages : this.messages.filter((message) => message.eventName === String(eventName))).slice(); }
  clear() { const count = this.messages.length; this.messages.length = 0; return count; }
  _append(message) {
    if (this.messages.length >= this.maxItems) { this.messages.shift(); this.stats.dropped++; }
    this.messages.push(message);
  }
  async close() { this.closed = true; this.listeners.clear(); return this.snapshot(); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ closed: this.closed, messages: this.messages.length, listeners: this.listeners.size, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
}

export default MemoryEventTransport;

'use strict';

import { AdvancedEventDispatcher } from '../AdvancedEventDispatcher.js';
import { DispatchReport } from '../core/DispatchReport.js';
import { EventRecorder } from './EventRecorder.js';
import { EventAssertions } from './EventAssertions.js';
import { compileMatcherList, matchesAny } from '../support/glob.js';

export class FakeEventBus extends AdvancedEventDispatcher {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    super(options);
    this.fakeMatchers = compileMatcherList(options.fake || []);
    this.exceptMatchers = compileMatcherList(options.except || []);
    this.recorder = new EventRecorder(null, { maxItems: options.maxRecords || 100_000, autoStart: false });
    this.assertions = new EventAssertions(this.recorder);
  }

  fake(patterns = ['**']) { this.fakeMatchers = compileMatcherList(Array.isArray(patterns) ? patterns : [patterns]); return this; }
  except(patterns = []) { this.exceptMatchers = compileMatcherList(Array.isArray(patterns) ? patterns : [patterns]); return this; }
  restore() { this.fakeMatchers = []; this.exceptMatchers = []; return this; }

  _isFaked(eventOrName) {
    const name = this._peekEventName(eventOrName);
    if (this.exceptMatchers.length && matchesAny(this.exceptMatchers, name)) return false;
    return this.fakeMatchers.length > 0 && matchesAny(this.fakeMatchers, name);
  }

  _recordFake(eventOrName, args) {
    const resolved = this._resolveDispatchInput(eventOrName, args);
    this.recorder.record(resolved.name, resolved.finalArgs, this.getContext());
    return resolved;
  }

  dispatch(eventOrName, ...args) {
    if (!this._isFaked(eventOrName)) return super.dispatch(eventOrName, ...args);
    this._recordFake(eventOrName, args);
    return undefined;
  }

  dispatchAsync(eventOrName, ...args) {
    if (!this._isFaked(eventOrName)) return super.dispatchAsync(eventOrName, ...args);
    this._recordFake(eventOrName, args);
    return Promise.resolve(undefined);
  }

  dispatchWithReport(eventOrName, ...args) {
    if (!this._isFaked(eventOrName)) return super.dispatchWithReport(eventOrName, ...args);
    const resolved = this._recordFake(eventOrName, args);
    return new DispatchReport(resolved.name, { mode: 'fake', context: this.getContext() }).complete(0);
  }

  assertDispatched(...args) { return this.assertions.dispatched(...args); }
  assertNotDispatched(...args) { return this.assertions.notDispatched(...args); }
  assertDispatchedTimes(...args) { return this.assertions.dispatchedTimes(...args); }
}

export default FakeEventBus;

'use strict';

const OBJECT_OVERHEAD = 8;
const ACCESSOR_OVERHEAD = 8;
const FUNCTION_FALLBACK = 'function';
const ERROR_NAME_FALLBACK = 'Error';

/**
 * Estimate a value's retained byte footprint without serializing it.
 *
 * This utility is intentionally defensive because event payloads can contain
 * callable proxies, framework facades, host objects, accessors, circular
 * references, and revoked proxies. Size estimation must never execute user
 * getters or escape as an infrastructure exception.
 */
export function approximateByteSize(value, options = {}) {
  const maximum = normalizeMaximum(options.maximum);
  const maxDepth = positiveInteger(options.maxDepth, 32);
  const maxItems = positiveInteger(options.maxItems, 100_000);
  const seen = new WeakSet();
  let items = 0;

  function visit(current, depth) {
    if (items++ > maxItems) return maximum;

    try {
      return visitUnsafe(current, depth);
    } catch {
      /*
       * Fail closed. Callers normally pass `limit + 1` as maximum, so an
       * uninspectable value is rejected as oversized instead of crashing the
       * application request that emitted the event.
       */
      return maximum;
    }
  }

  function visitUnsafe(current, depth) {
    if (current == null) return 4;

    switch (typeof current) {
      case 'string':
        return utf8Bytes(current);

      case 'number':
        return 8;

      case 'bigint':
        return utf8Bytes(current.toString()) + 1;

      case 'boolean':
        return 4;

      case 'undefined':
        return 0;

      case 'symbol':
        return utf8Bytes(safeSymbolText(current));

      case 'function':
        return utf8Bytes(safeFunctionName(current));

      default:
        break;
    }

    if (Buffer.isBuffer(current)) return current.byteLength;
    if (current instanceof Uint8Array) return current.byteLength;
    if (current instanceof ArrayBuffer) return current.byteLength;
    if (typeof SharedArrayBuffer !== 'undefined' && current instanceof SharedArrayBuffer) {
      return current.byteLength;
    }
    if (current instanceof Date) return 24;
    if (current instanceof RegExp) {
      return boundedAdd(
        utf8Bytes(safeStringProperty(current, 'source', '')),
        utf8Bytes(safeStringProperty(current, 'flags', '')),
        maximum,
      );
    }
    if (current instanceof Error) {
      return boundedAdd(
        utf8Bytes(safeStringProperty(current, 'name', ERROR_NAME_FALLBACK)),
        utf8Bytes(safeStringProperty(current, 'message', '')),
        maximum,
      );
    }

    if (depth >= maxDepth) return OBJECT_OVERHEAD;
    if (seen.has(current)) return OBJECT_OVERHEAD;
    seen.add(current);

    let total = OBJECT_OVERHEAD;
    const add = (bytes) => {
      total += bytes;
      if (total >= maximum) total = maximum;
      return total < maximum;
    };

    if (Array.isArray(current)) {
      const length = safeArrayLength(current);

      for (let index = 0; index < length; index++) {
        let item;
        try {
          item = current[index];
        } catch {
          item = '[ReadError]';
        }

        if (!add(visit(item, depth + 1))) break;
      }

      return total;
    }

    if (current instanceof Set) {
      try {
        for (const item of current) {
          if (!add(visit(item, depth + 1))) break;
        }
      } catch {
        return maximum;
      }

      return total;
    }

    if (current instanceof Map) {
      try {
        for (const [key, item] of current) {
          if (!add(visit(key, depth + 1))) break;
          if (!add(visit(item, depth + 1))) break;
        }
      } catch {
        return maximum;
      }

      return total;
    }

    let keys;
    try {
      keys = Object.keys(current);
    } catch {
      return maximum;
    }

    for (const key of keys) {
      if (!add(utf8Bytes(key))) break;

      let descriptor;
      try {
        descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(current, key);
      } catch {
        return maximum;
      }

      if (!descriptor) continue;

      /*
       * Never invoke accessors while measuring an event. Getters can perform
       * I/O, mutate state, throw, or expose secrets. Count the accessor as a
       * bounded opaque slot instead.
       */
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(descriptor, 'value')) {
        if (!add(ACCESSOR_OVERHEAD)) break;
        continue;
      }

      if (!add(visit(descriptor.value, depth + 1))) break;
    }

    return total;
  }

  return Math.min(maximum, visit(value, 0));
}

export function normalizeByteLimit(value, fallback = Infinity) {
  if (value === Infinity) return Infinity;
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(number) && number >= 0 ? number : fallback;
}

export function normalizePositiveInteger(value, fallback, { allowZero = false } = {}) {
  const number = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(number)) return fallback;
  if (allowZero ? number < 0 : number < 1) return fallback;
  return number;
}

function safeFunctionName(value) {
  return safeStringProperty(value, 'name', FUNCTION_FALLBACK);
}

function safeStringProperty(target, key, fallback = '') {
  try {
    const value = Reflect.get(target, key);
    return typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0
      ? value
      : fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

function safeSymbolText(value) {
  try {
    return String(value);
  } catch {
    return 'Symbol';
  }
}

function safeArrayLength(value) {
  try {
    const length = Number(value.length);
    return Number.isSafeInteger(length) && length >= 0 ? length : 0;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}

function utf8Bytes(value) {
  return Buffer.byteLength(
    typeof value === 'string' ? value : '',
    'utf8',
  );
}

function positiveInteger(value, fallback) {
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(number) && number > 0 ? number : fallback;
}

function normalizeMaximum(value) {
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(number) && number > 0
    ? number
    : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
}

function boundedAdd(left, right, maximum) {
  return Math.min(maximum, left + right);
}

export function estimateValueBytes(value, options = {}) {
  return approximateByteSize(value, options);
}

'use strict';

export function createLogger(logger) {
  const target = logger && typeof logger === 'object' ? logger : console;
  const bind = (name, fallback = null) => {
    if (typeof target[name] === 'function') return target[name].bind(target);
    if (fallback && typeof target[fallback] === 'function') return target[fallback].bind(target);
    return () => {};
  };
  return Object.freeze({
    debug: bind('debug'),
    info: bind('info', 'log'),
    warn: bind('warn', 'log'),
    error: bind('error', 'log'),
  });
}

'use strict';

export function isPromiseLike(value) {
  return !!value && (typeof value === 'object' || typeof value === 'function') && typeof value.then === 'function';
}

export function abortError(message = 'Operation aborted') {
  const error = new Error(message);
  error.name = 'AbortError';
  error.code = 'EVENT_ABORTED';
  return error;
}

export function timeoutError(ms) {
  const error = new Error(`Operation timed out after ${ms}ms`);
  error.name = 'TimeoutError';
  error.code = 'EVENT_TIMEOUT';
  error.timeoutMs = ms;
  return error;
}

export async function raceWithSignal(value, options = {}) {
  const signal = options.signal;
  const timeoutMs = Number(options.timeoutMs) || 0;
  if (signal?.aborted) throw abortError();
  if (!signal && timeoutMs <= 0) return await value;

  let timer = null;
  let onAbort = null;
  const controls = [];
  if (signal) {
    controls.push(new Promise((_, reject) => {
      onAbort = () => reject(abortError());
      signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    }));
  }
  if (timeoutMs > 0) {
    controls.push(new Promise((_, reject) => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => reject(timeoutError(timeoutMs)), timeoutMs);
      if (options.unrefTimer !== false) timer.unref?.();
    }));
  }
  try { return await Promise.race([Promise.resolve(value), ...controls]); }
  finally {
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
    if (onAbort) signal?.removeEventListener?.('abort', onAbort);
  }
}

export function deferred() {
  let resolve;
  let reject;
  const promise = new Promise((res, rej) => { resolve = res; reject = rej; });
  return { promise, resolve, reject };
}

'use strict';

export function normalizeEventName(name, normalizeDot = false) {
  if (typeof name !== 'string') return name;
  let value = name;
  const first = value.charCodeAt(0);
  const last = value.charCodeAt(value.length - 1);
  if (first <= 32 || last <= 32) value = value.trim();
  if (!value) return value;
  if (normalizeDot && value.includes('.')) value = value.replaceAll('.', ':');
  return value.includes('::') ? value.replace(/:{2,}/g, ':') : value;
}

export function computeWildcardEvents(eventName) {
  const value = String(eventName);
  let index = value.lastIndexOf(':');
  if (index <= 0) return [];
  const output = [];
  while (index > 0) {
    output.push(`${value.slice(0, index)}:*`);
    index = value.lastIndexOf(':', index - 1);
  }
  return output;
}

export function globPrefix(glob) {
  const value = String(glob);
  let index = 0;
  for (; index < value.length; index++) {
    const character = value[index];
    if (character === '*' || character === '?') break;
  }
  return value.slice(0, index);
}


export function firstStaticSegment(glob) {
  const first = String(glob ?? '').split(':', 1)[0] || '';
  return first.includes('*') || first.includes('?') || !first ? '*' : first;
}

export function globStaticRoot(glob) {
  const value = String(glob);
  const first = value.split(':', 1)[0] || '';
  return first.includes('*') || first.includes('?') ? null : first;
}

export function globToRegExp(glob) {
  const value = String(glob);
  let source = '^';

  for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index++) {
    const character = value[index];

    if (character === '*') {
      if (value[index + 1] === '*') {
        source += '.*';
        index++;
      } else {
        source += '[^:]*';
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (character === '?') {
      source += '[^:]';
      continue;
    }

    if ('\\.^$|()[]{}+'.includes(character)) source += `\\${character}`;
    else source += character;
  }

  source += '$';
  return new RegExp(source);
}

export function compileMatcherList(patterns) {
  if (!Array.isArray(patterns)) return [];
  return patterns
    .filter((pattern) => typeof pattern === 'string' && pattern.length > 0)
    .map((pattern) => Object.freeze({
      raw: pattern,
      prefix: globPrefix(pattern),
      root: globStaticRoot(pattern),
      regex: globToRegExp(pattern),
    }));
}

export function matchesAny(matchers, eventName) {
  if (!Array.isArray(matchers) || matchers.length === 0) return false;
  for (const matcher of matchers) {
    if (matcher.prefix && !eventName.startsWith(matcher.prefix)) continue;
    if (matcher.regex.test(eventName)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function isPattern(value) {
  const string = String(value ?? '');
  return string.includes('*') || string.includes('?');
}

'use strict';

/** Bounded TTL idempotency inbox for at-least-once consumers. */
export class MemoryEventInbox {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 100_000);
    this.ttlMs = Math.max(1, Number(options.ttlMs) || 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    this.entries = new Map();
    this.inFlight = new Map();
    this.stats = { accepted: 0, duplicates: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, evicted: 0 };
  }

  has(id, now = Date.now()) {
    const key = String(id);
    const expiresAt = this.entries.get(key);
    if (expiresAt == null) return false;
    if (expiresAt <= now) { this.entries.delete(key); return false; }
    return true;
  }

  async run(id, handler, options = {}) {
    const key = String(id || '');
    if (!key) throw new TypeError('Inbox id is required');
    if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Inbox handler must be a function');
    if (this.has(key)) { this.stats.duplicates++; return { accepted: false, duplicate: true }; }
    if (this.inFlight.has(key)) { this.stats.duplicates++; return this.inFlight.get(key); }

    const operation = (async () => {
      this.stats.accepted++;
      try {
        const value = await handler();
        this.remember(key, options.ttlMs);
        this.stats.completed++;
        return { accepted: true, duplicate: false, value };
      } catch (error) {
        this.stats.failed++;
        throw error;
      } finally {
        this.inFlight.delete(key);
      }
    })();
    this.inFlight.set(key, operation);
    return operation;
  }

  remember(id, ttlMs = this.ttlMs) {
    const now = Date.now();
    this.entries.set(String(id), now + Math.max(1, Number(ttlMs) || this.ttlMs));
    this._evict(now);
    return this;
  }

  _evict(now = Date.now()) {
    for (const [id, expiresAt] of this.entries) {
      if (expiresAt <= now) { this.entries.delete(id); this.stats.evicted++; }
    }
    while (this.entries.size > this.maxItems) {
      const id = this.entries.keys().next().value;
      this.entries.delete(id);
      this.stats.evicted++;
    }
  }

  clear() { this.entries.clear(); this.inFlight.clear(); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ items: this.entries.size, inFlight: this.inFlight.size, maxItems: this.maxItems, ttlMs: this.ttlMs, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
}

export default MemoryEventInbox;

'use strict';

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { MemoryOutboxStore } from './MemoryOutboxStore.js';
import { shallowEventContext } from '../context/EventContext.js';

export class EventOutbox {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.store = options.store || new MemoryOutboxStore(options.memory || options);
    this.dispatcher = options.dispatcher || null;
    this.schemaRegistry = options.schemaRegistry || null;
    this.nodeId = options.nodeId || `${process.pid}`;
    this.defaultMaxAttempts = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxAttempts) || 10);
  }

  async enqueue(eventOrName, args = [], options = {}) {
    const eventObject = typeof eventOrName === 'object' && eventOrName !== null ? eventOrName : null;
    const eventName = eventObject
      ? String(eventObject.constructor?.eventName || eventObject.eventName || eventObject.constructor?.name || 'Event')
      : String(eventOrName);
    const payloadArgs = eventObject ? [eventObject, ...(Array.isArray(args) ? args : [args])] : (Array.isArray(args) ? args : [args]);
    const version = Math.max(1, Number(options.version || eventObject?.version) || 1);

    if (this.schemaRegistry?.has?.(eventName, version) && eventObject?.payload !== undefined) {
      this.schemaRegistry.validate(eventName, version, eventObject.payload, { phase: 'outbox' });
    }

    const context = options.context || this.dispatcher?.getContext?.() || eventObject?.ctx || null;
    return this.store.append({
      id: options.id || eventObject?.id || randomUUID(),
      event: eventName,
      version,
      args: payloadArgs,
      context: shallowEventContext(context),
      headers: options.headers,
      idempotencyKey: options.idempotencyKey,
      maxAttempts: options.maxAttempts || this.defaultMaxAttempts,
      availableAt: options.availableAt,
      meta: { nodeId: this.nodeId, ...(options.meta || {}) },
    });
  }

  async dispatchAfterCommit(transaction, eventOrName, args = [], options = {}) {
    if (!transaction || typeof transaction.afterCommit !== 'function') {
      throw new TypeError('dispatchAfterCommit requires a transaction exposing afterCommit(callback)');
    }
    let result;
    transaction.afterCommit(async () => { result = await this.enqueue(eventOrName, args, options); });
    return { scheduled: true, get result() { return result; } };
  }

  snapshot() { return this.store.snapshot?.() || null; }
  close() { return this.store.close?.(); }
}

export default EventOutbox;

'use strict';

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { EventTransportError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

function sleep(ms, signal, unref = true) {
  if (signal?.aborted) return Promise.reject(signal.reason || new Error('Aborted'));
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let settled = false;
    const cleanup = () => signal?.removeEventListener?.('abort', abort);
    const finish = (fn, value) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      cleanup();
      fn(value);
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => finish(resolve), Math.max(0, ms));
    if (unref) timer.unref?.();
    const abort = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      finish(reject, signal.reason || new Error('Aborted'));
    };
    signal?.addEventListener?.('abort', abort, { once: true });
  });
}

async function awaitPublication(transport, eventName, args, options) {
  const admission = await transport.publish(eventName, args, options);
  if (admission?.accepted === false) {
    throw new EventTransportError('Outbox transport rejected publication', {
      code: admission.code || 'EVENT_OUTBOX_TRANSPORT_REJECTED',
      details: admission,
    });
  }
  if (admission?.promise && typeof admission.promise.then === 'function') {
    const delivery = await admission.promise;
    if (delivery?.published === false || delivery?.accepted === false) {
      throw new EventTransportError('Outbox transport did not publish the event', {
        code: delivery.code || 'EVENT_OUTBOX_TRANSPORT_NOT_PUBLISHED',
        details: delivery,
      });
    }
    return delivery;
  }
  return admission;
}

export class OutboxPublisher {
  constructor(store, transport, options = {}) {
    if (!store || typeof store.claim !== 'function') throw new TypeError('OutboxPublisher requires an outbox store');
    if (!transport || typeof transport.publish !== 'function') throw new TypeError('OutboxPublisher requires a publish-capable transport');
    this.store = store;
    this.transport = transport;
    this.owner = options.owner || `outbox-${process.pid}-${randomUUID()}`;
    this.batchSize = Math.max(1, Number(options.batchSize) || 100);
    this.concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(options.concurrency) || 8);
    this.leaseMs = Math.max(1000, Number(options.leaseMs) || 30_000);
    this.pollMs = Math.max(1, Number(options.pollMs) || 250);
    this.retryBaseMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.retryBaseMs) || 250);
    this.retryMaxMs = Math.max(this.retryBaseMs, Number(options.retryMaxMs) || 30_000);
    this.jitter = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(options.jitter) || 0.2));
    this.unrefTimers = options.unrefTimers !== false;
    this.running = false;
    this.controller = null;
    this.loopPromise = null;
    this.active = new Set();
    this.stats = { cycles: 0, claimed: 0, published: 0, failed: 0, deadLettered: 0, transportErrors: 0 };
  }

  async runOnce(options = {}) {
    const records = await this.store.claim({
      owner: this.owner,
      leaseMs: this.leaseMs,
      limit: options.limit || this.batchSize,
      now: options.now,
    });
    this.stats.cycles++;
    this.stats.claimed += records.length;
    if (!records.length) return { claimed: 0, published: 0, failed: 0 };

    let cursor = 0;
    let published = 0;
    let failed = 0;
    const worker = async () => {
      while (cursor < records.length) {
        const record = records[cursor++];
        try {
          await awaitPublication(this.transport, record.event, record.args, {
            id: record.id,
            version: record.version,
            context: record.context,
            headers: record.headers,
            durable: true,
            meta: record.meta,
          });
          await this.store.complete(record.id, { owner: this.owner });
          this.stats.published++;
          published++;
        } catch (error) {
          this.stats.transportErrors++;
          const retryAfterMs = this._retryDelay(record.attempts + 1);
          const updated = await this.store.fail(record.id, error, { owner: this.owner, retryAfterMs });
          this.stats.failed++;
          failed++;
          if (updated.status === 'dead') this.stats.deadLettered++;
        }
      }
    };
    const workers = Array.from({ length: Math.min(this.concurrency, records.length) }, () => {
      let tracked;
      tracked = worker().finally(() => this.active.delete(tracked));
      this.active.add(tracked);
      return tracked;
    });
    await Promise.all(workers);
    return { claimed: records.length, published, failed };
  }

  _retryDelay(attempt) {
    const exponential = Math.min(this.retryMaxMs, this.retryBaseMs * (2 ** Math.max(0, attempt - 1)));
    if (!this.jitter) return exponential;
    const spread = exponential * this.jitter;
    return Math.max(0, Math.round(exponential - spread + Math.random() * spread * 2));
  }

  start() {
    if (this.running) return this;
    this.running = true;
    this.controller = new AbortController();
    this.loopPromise = this._loop(this.controller.signal).finally(() => { this.running = false; this.loopPromise = null; });
    return this;
  }

  async _loop(signal) {
    while (!signal.aborted) {
      const result = await this.runOnce();
      if (!result.claimed) {
        try { await sleep(this.pollMs, signal, this.unrefTimers); }
        catch { break; }
      }
    }
  }

  async flush(options = {}) {
    const maxCycles = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxCycles) || 10_000);
    let cycles = 0;
    let total = 0;
    while (cycles++ < maxCycles) {
      const result = await this.runOnce();
      total += result.published;
      if (!result.claimed) return { drained: true, published: total, cycles };
      if (result.failed && options.stopOnFailure !== false) return { drained: false, published: total, cycles, failed: result.failed };
    }
    throw new EventTransportError('Outbox flush cycle limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_OUTBOX_FLUSH_LIMIT' });
  }

  async stop(options = {}) {
    this.controller?.abort(new Error('Outbox publisher stopped'));
    if (options.drain === true) await this.flush(options);
    try { await this.loopPromise; } catch {}
    await Promise.allSettled([...this.active]);
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({ running: this.running, owner: this.owner, active: this.active.size, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }), store: this.store.snapshot?.() || null });
  }

  async close(options = {}) { return this.stop(options); }
  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await this.close(); }
}

export default OutboxPublisher;

'use strict';

import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';
import { EventAdmissionError } from '../errors/EventError.js';
import { estimateValueBytes } from '../support/size.js';

function cloneRecord(record) {
  return record ? { ...record, args: record.args?.slice?.() || [], context: record.context ? { ...record.context } : null, headers: record.headers ? { ...record.headers } : null } : null;
}

/** Bounded in-memory reference implementation for the durable outbox contract. */
export class MemoryOutboxStore extends EventEmitter {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    super();
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 100_000);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxBytes) || 128 * 1024 * 1024);
    this.overflow = options.overflow || 'reject';
    this.defaultMaxAttempts = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxAttempts) || 10);
    this.records = new Map();
    this.order = [];
    this.idempotency = new Map();
    this.bytes = 0;
    this.sequence = 0;
    this.stats = { appended: 0, claimed: 0, completed: 0, failed: 0, deadLettered: 0, duplicates: 0, rejected: 0, pruned: 0 };
  }

  async append(input) {
    const id = String(input?.id || `outbox-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${(++this.sequence).toString(36)}`);
    const idempotencyKey = input?.idempotencyKey == null ? null : String(input.idempotencyKey);
    if (idempotencyKey && this.idempotency.has(idempotencyKey)) {
      this.stats.duplicates++;
      return { inserted: false, duplicate: true, record: cloneRecord(this.records.get(this.idempotency.get(idempotencyKey))) };
    }
    if (this.records.has(id)) {
      this.stats.duplicates++;
      return { inserted: false, duplicate: true, record: cloneRecord(this.records.get(id)) };
    }

    const now = Number(input?.createdAt) || Date.now();
    const record = {
      id,
      event: String(input?.event || ''),
      version: Math.max(1, Number(input?.version) || 1),
      args: Array.isArray(input?.args) ? input.args.slice() : [],
      context: input?.context && typeof input.context === 'object' ? { ...input.context } : null,
      headers: input?.headers && typeof input.headers === 'object' ? { ...input.headers } : null,
      idempotencyKey,
      status: 'pending',
      attempts: 0,
      maxAttempts: Math.max(1, Number(input?.maxAttempts) || this.defaultMaxAttempts),
      availableAt: Number(input?.availableAt) || now,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      leaseOwner: null,
      leaseUntil: 0,
      publishedAt: 0,
      lastError: null,
      meta: input?.meta && typeof input.meta === 'object' ? { ...input.meta } : null,
    };
    record.bytes = estimateValueBytes(record);
    this._admit(record.bytes);

    this.records.set(id, record);
    this.order.push(id);
    if (idempotencyKey) this.idempotency.set(idempotencyKey, id);
    this.bytes += record.bytes;
    this.stats.appended++;
    this.emit('available', cloneRecord(record));
    return { inserted: true, duplicate: false, record: cloneRecord(record) };
  }

  _admit(bytes) {
    while (this.records.size >= this.maxItems || this.bytes + bytes > this.maxBytes) {
      if (this.overflow !== 'drop-completed') {
        this.stats.rejected++;
        throw new EventAdmissionError('Outbox capacity exceeded', {
          code: 'EVENT_OUTBOX_CAPACITY', details: { bytes, maxItems: this.maxItems, maxBytes: this.maxBytes },
        });
      }
      const removable = this.order.find((id) => ['published', 'dead'].includes(this.records.get(id)?.status));
      if (!removable) {
        this.stats.rejected++;
        throw new EventAdmissionError('Outbox capacity exceeded and no completed record can be pruned', { code: 'EVENT_OUTBOX_CAPACITY' });
      }
      this.remove(removable);
    }
  }

  async claim(options = {}) {
    const now = Number(options.now) || Date.now();
    const owner = String(options.owner || `worker-${process.pid}`);
    const leaseMs = Math.max(1, Number(options.leaseMs) || 30_000);
    const limit = Math.max(1, Number(options.limit) || 100);
    const claimed = [];

    for (const id of this.order) {
      if (claimed.length >= limit) break;
      const record = this.records.get(id);
      if (!record) continue;
      const expiredLease = record.status === 'processing' && record.leaseUntil > 0 && record.leaseUntil <= now;
      const available = (record.status === 'pending' || record.status === 'failed' || expiredLease) && record.availableAt <= now;
      if (!available) continue;
      record.status = 'processing';
      record.leaseOwner = owner;
      record.leaseUntil = now + leaseMs;
      record.updatedAt = now;
      claimed.push(cloneRecord(record));
    }
    this.stats.claimed += claimed.length;
    return claimed;
  }

  async complete(id, options = {}) {
    const record = this._owned(id, options.owner);
    const now = Number(options.now) || Date.now();
    record.status = 'published';
    record.publishedAt = now;
    record.updatedAt = now;
    record.leaseOwner = null;
    record.leaseUntil = 0;
    record.lastError = null;
    this.stats.completed++;
    return cloneRecord(record);
  }

  async fail(id, error, options = {}) {
    const record = this._owned(id, options.owner);
    const now = Number(options.now) || Date.now();
    record.attempts++;
    record.updatedAt = now;
    record.leaseOwner = null;
    record.leaseUntil = 0;
    record.lastError = {
      name: error?.name || 'Error',
      message: error?.message || String(error || 'Outbox publish failed'),
      code: error?.code,
      at: now,
    };
    if (record.attempts >= record.maxAttempts || options.deadLetter === true) {
      record.status = 'dead';
      record.availableAt = 0;
      this.stats.deadLettered++;
    } else {
      record.status = 'failed';
      record.availableAt = now + Math.max(0, Number(options.retryAfterMs) || 0);
      this.stats.failed++;
      this.emit('available', cloneRecord(record));
    }
    return cloneRecord(record);
  }

  async release(id, options = {}) {
    const record = this._owned(id, options.owner);
    record.status = 'pending';
    record.leaseOwner = null;
    record.leaseUntil = 0;
    record.availableAt = Number(options.availableAt) || Date.now();
    record.updatedAt = Date.now();
    this.emit('available', cloneRecord(record));
    return cloneRecord(record);
  }

  _owned(id, owner) {
    const record = this.records.get(String(id));
    if (!record) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Outbox record not found: ${id}`, { code: 'EVENT_OUTBOX_NOT_FOUND' });
    if (owner != null && record.leaseOwner && record.leaseOwner !== String(owner)) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Outbox lease is owned by ${record.leaseOwner}`, { code: 'EVENT_OUTBOX_LEASE_OWNER' });
    }
    return record;
  }

  get(id) { return cloneRecord(this.records.get(String(id))); }
  all(options = {}) {
    let records = this.order.map((id) => this.records.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
    if (options.status) records = records.filter((record) => record.status === String(options.status));
    if (options.event) records = records.filter((record) => record.event === String(options.event));
    const limit = Math.max(0, Number(options.limit) || 0);
    if (limit) records = records.slice(-limit);
    return records.map(cloneRecord);
  }

  remove(id) {
    const key = String(id);
    const record = this.records.get(key);
    if (!record) return false;
    this.records.delete(key);
    if (record.idempotencyKey) this.idempotency.delete(record.idempotencyKey);
    this.bytes = Math.max(0, this.bytes - (record.bytes || 0));
    const index = this.order.indexOf(key);
    if (index !== -1) this.order.splice(index, 1);
    this.stats.pruned++;
    return true;
  }

  prune(options = {}) {
    const before = Number(options.before) || Date.now();
    const statuses = new Set(options.statuses || ['published', 'dead']);
    let removed = 0;
    for (const id of [...this.order]) {
      const record = this.records.get(id);
      if (record && statuses.has(record.status) && record.updatedAt <= before && this.remove(id)) removed++;
    }
    return removed;
  }

  snapshot() {
    const status = Object.create(null);
    for (const record of this.records.values()) status[record.status] = (status[record.status] || 0) + 1;
    return Object.freeze({
      items: this.records.size,
      bytes: this.bytes,
      maxItems: this.maxItems,
      maxBytes: this.maxBytes,
      status: Object.freeze(status),
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }

  close() { this.removeAllListeners(); }
}

export default MemoryOutboxStore;

'use strict';

/** Fixed-capacity O(1) ring buffer. */
export class RingBuffer {
  constructor(capacity) {
    const value = Number(capacity);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 1) throw new TypeError('RingBuffer capacity must be a positive safe integer');
    this.capacity = value;
    this.buffer = new Array(value);
    this.head = 0;
    this.length = 0;
  }

  push(value) {
    let evicted;
    if (this.length < this.capacity) {
      const index = (this.head + this.length) % this.capacity;
      this.buffer[index] = value;
      this.length++;
    } else {
      evicted = this.buffer[this.head];
      this.buffer[this.head] = value;
      this.head = (this.head + 1) % this.capacity;
    }
    return evicted;
  }

  peek() {
    return this.length ? this.buffer[this.head] : undefined;
  }

  shift() {
    if (!this.length) return undefined;
    const value = this.buffer[this.head];
    this.buffer[this.head] = undefined;
    this.head = (this.head + 1) % this.capacity;
    this.length--;
    if (this.length === 0) this.head = 0;
    return value;
  }

  clear() {
    this.buffer.fill(undefined);
    this.head = 0;
    this.length = 0;
  }

  /**
   * Remove matching entries while preserving logical order.
   * Normal append and capacity eviction remain O(1); this O(n) path is used
   * only for explicit cleanup such as TTL and global-budget enforcement.
   */
  remove(predicate) {
    if (typeof predicate !== 'function') throw new TypeError('RingBuffer.remove expects a predicate function');
    if (!this.length) return 0;

    const retained = new Array(this.length);
    let write = 0;
    let removed = 0;
    for (const value of this) {
      if (predicate(value)) removed++;
      else retained[write++] = value;
    }

    if (!removed) return 0;
    this.clear();
    for (let index = 0; index < write; index++) this.push(retained[index]);
    return removed;
  }

  toArray() {
    const output = new Array(this.length);
    for (let index = 0; index < this.length; index++) {
      output[index] = this.buffer[(this.head + index) % this.capacity];
    }
    return output;
  }

  *[Symbol.iterator]() {
    for (let index = 0; index < this.length; index++) {
      yield this.buffer[(this.head + index) % this.capacity];
    }
  }
}

export default RingBuffer;

'use strict';

import { RingBuffer } from './RingBuffer.js';
import { compileMatcherList, matchesAny } from '../support/glob.js';
import { estimateValueBytes } from '../support/size.js';
import { SafeJsonCodec } from '../serialization/SafeJsonCodec.js';

class EventJournalCompatibilityView {
  constructor(journal) { this.journal = journal; }
  get size() { return this.journal.eventCount; }
  has(name) { return this.journal.has(name); }
  get(name) { return this.journal.get(name); }
  clear() { this.journal.clear(); }
  delete(name) { return this.journal.clear(name) > 0; }
  keys() { return this.journal.eventNames()[Symbol.iterator](); }
  values() { return Array.from(this.journal.entries(), ([, entries]) => entries)[Symbol.iterator](); }
  entries() { return this.journal.entries(); }
  [Symbol.iterator]() { return this.entries(); }
}

function publicEntry(entry) {
  return { ts: entry.ts, args: entry.args, ctx: entry.ctx };
}

export class EventJournal {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxEntriesPerEvent = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxEntriesPerEvent ?? options.historyLimit ?? 0) || 0);
    this.maxEventNames = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxEventNames ?? options.maxHistoryEvents ?? 0) || 0);
    this.maxEntriesTotal = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxEntriesTotal ?? 0) || 0);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxBytes ?? options.maxHistoryBytes ?? 0) || 0);
    this.maxPayloadBytes = Math.max(0, Number(options.maxPayloadBytes ?? 0) || 0);
    this.ttlMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.ttlMs ?? 0) || 0);
    this.clonePolicy = options.clonePolicy || 'reference';
    this.allow = compileMatcherList(options.allow ?? options.historyAllow);
    this.deny = compileMatcherList(options.deny ?? options.historyDeny);
    this.codec = options.codec || new SafeJsonCodec({
      maxBytes: this.maxPayloadBytes,
      redact: options.redact !== false,
      redactKeys: options.redactKeys,
      reconstruct: true,
    });

    this.buffers = new Map();
    this.entryBySeq = new Map();
    this.global = [];
    this.globalHead = 0;
    this.sequence = 0;
    this.totalEntries = 0;
    this.totalBytes = 0;
    this.compatibilityView = new EventJournalCompatibilityView(this);
    this.stats = {
      recorded: 0,
      rejected: 0,
      evicted: 0,
      expired: 0,
      oversized: 0,
      eventNamesEvicted: 0,
      serializationFailures: 0,
    };
  }

  get enabled() { return this.maxEntriesPerEvent > 0; }
  get eventCount() { return this.buffers.size; }

  shouldRecord(eventName) {
    if (!this.enabled) return false;
    if (this.allow.length && !matchesAny(this.allow, eventName)) return false;
    if (this.deny.length && matchesAny(this.deny, eventName)) return false;
    return true;
  }

  _clone(args, ctx) {
    if (this.clonePolicy === 'reference') return { args, ctx: ctx && typeof ctx === 'object' ? { ...ctx } : ctx };
    if (this.clonePolicy === 'shallow') return {
      args: Array.isArray(args) ? args.slice() : args,
      ctx: ctx && typeof ctx === 'object' ? { ...ctx } : ctx,
    };
    try {
      const encoded = this.codec.encode({ args, ctx });
      const decoded = this.codec.parse(encoded.text);
      return { args: decoded.args, ctx: decoded.ctx };
    } catch {
      this.stats.serializationFailures++;
      return {
        args: Array.isArray(args) ? args.slice() : [],
        ctx: ctx && typeof ctx === 'object' ? { ...ctx } : null,
      };
    }
  }

  record(eventName, args, ctx = null, now = Date.now()) {
    if (!this.shouldRecord(eventName)) return { accepted: false, reason: 'policy' };
    this.pruneExpired(now);

    const cloned = this._clone(args, ctx);
    const bytes = estimateValueBytes(cloned, { maxDepth: 24, maxKeys: 10_000 });
    if (this.maxPayloadBytes && bytes > this.maxPayloadBytes) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      this.stats.oversized++;
      return { accepted: false, reason: 'maxPayloadBytes', bytes };
    }

    if (!this.buffers.has(eventName) && this.maxEventNames && this.buffers.size >= this.maxEventNames) {
      this._evictOldestEventName();
    }

    let ring = this.buffers.get(eventName);
    if (!ring) {
      ring = new RingBuffer(this.maxEntriesPerEvent);
      this.buffers.set(eventName, ring);
    }

    const entry = {
      seq: ++this.sequence,
      eventName,
      ts: now,
      args: cloned.args,
      ctx: cloned.ctx,
      bytes,
    };
    const evicted = ring.push(entry);
    if (evicted) this._removeAccounting(evicted, 'evicted');

    this.entryBySeq.set(entry.seq, entry);
    this.global.push({ seq: entry.seq, eventName });
    this.totalEntries++;
    this.totalBytes += bytes;
    this.stats.recorded++;
    this._enforceGlobalBounds();
    this._compactGlobal();
    return { accepted: true, entry: publicEntry(entry), bytes };
  }

  _removeAccounting(entry, reason) {
    if (!entry || !this.entryBySeq.has(entry.seq)) return false;
    this.entryBySeq.delete(entry.seq);
    this.totalEntries = Math.max(0, this.totalEntries - 1);
    this.totalBytes = Math.max(0, this.totalBytes - entry.bytes);
    if (reason === 'expired') this.stats.expired++;
    else this.stats.evicted++;
    return true;
  }

  _removeFromRing(entry, reason) {
    const ring = this.buffers.get(entry.eventName);
    if (!ring) return false;
    const removed = ring.remove((candidate) => candidate.seq === entry.seq);
    if (removed) this._removeAccounting(entry, reason);
    if (ring.length === 0) this.buffers.delete(entry.eventName);
    return removed > 0;
  }

  _oldestLive() {
    while (this.globalHead < this.global.length) {
      const marker = this.global[this.globalHead];
      const entry = this.entryBySeq.get(marker.seq);
      if (entry) return entry;
      this.globalHead++;
    }
    return null;
  }

  _evictOldest(reason = 'evicted') {
    const entry = this._oldestLive();
    if (!entry) return false;
    this.globalHead++;
    return this._removeFromRing(entry, reason);
  }

  _evictOldestEventName() {
    const oldest = this._oldestLive();
    if (!oldest) return false;
    const count = this.clear(oldest.eventName);
    if (count) this.stats.eventNamesEvicted++;
    return count > 0;
  }

  _enforceGlobalBounds() {
    while (this.maxEntriesTotal && this.totalEntries > this.maxEntriesTotal) {
      if (!this._evictOldest()) break;
    }
    while (this.maxBytes && this.totalBytes > this.maxBytes) {
      if (!this._evictOldest()) break;
    }
  }

  _compactGlobal() {
    if (this.globalHead < 4096 || this.globalHead < this.global.length / 2) return;
    this.global = this.global.slice(this.globalHead);
    this.globalHead = 0;
  }

  pruneExpired(now = Date.now()) {
    if (!this.ttlMs) return 0;
    let removed = 0;
    const threshold = now - this.ttlMs;
    while (true) {
      const entry = this._oldestLive();
      if (!entry || entry.ts > threshold) break;
      this.globalHead++;
      if (this._removeFromRing(entry, 'expired')) removed++;
    }
    this._compactGlobal();
    return removed;
  }

  has(eventName) { this.pruneExpired(); return this.buffers.has(String(eventName)); }

  get(eventName, options = {}) {
    this.pruneExpired(options.now);
    const ring = this.buffers.get(String(eventName));
    if (!ring) return [];
    let entries = ring.toArray();
    if (options.since != null) entries = entries.filter((entry) => entry.ts >= Number(options.since));
    if (options.until != null) entries = entries.filter((entry) => entry.ts <= Number(options.until));
    if (options.correlationId != null) entries = entries.filter((entry) => entry.ctx?.correlationId === options.correlationId || entry.ctx?.id === options.correlationId);
    if (options.tenantId != null) entries = entries.filter((entry) => entry.ctx?.tenantId === options.tenantId);
    if (typeof options.predicate === 'function') entries = entries.filter((entry) => options.predicate(publicEntry(entry)));
    const limit = Number(options.limit) || 0;
    if (limit > 0 && entries.length > limit) entries = entries.slice(entries.length - limit);
    return entries.map(publicEntry);
  }

  all(options = {}) {
    this.pruneExpired(options.now);
    const output = [];
    for (const entry of this.entryBySeq.values()) {
      if (options.since != null && entry.ts < Number(options.since)) continue;
      if (options.until != null && entry.ts > Number(options.until)) continue;
      if (options.correlationId != null && entry.ctx?.correlationId !== options.correlationId && entry.ctx?.id !== options.correlationId) continue;
      if (options.tenantId != null && entry.ctx?.tenantId !== options.tenantId) continue;
      const item = { eventName: entry.eventName, ...publicEntry(entry) };
      if (typeof options.predicate === 'function' && !options.predicate(item)) continue;
      output.push(item);
    }
    output.sort((left, right) => left.ts - right.ts || left.eventName.localeCompare(right.eventName));
    const limit = Number(options.limit) || 0;
    return limit > 0 && output.length > limit ? output.slice(output.length - limit) : output;
  }

  eventNames() { this.pruneExpired(); return Array.from(this.buffers.keys()); }

  *entries() {
    this.pruneExpired();
    for (const [eventName, ring] of this.buffers) yield [eventName, ring.toArray().map(publicEntry)];
  }

  clear(eventName = null) {
    if (eventName == null) {
      const count = this.totalEntries;
      this.buffers.clear();
      this.entryBySeq.clear();
      this.global.length = 0;
      this.globalHead = 0;
      this.totalEntries = 0;
      this.totalBytes = 0;
      return count;
    }
    const name = String(eventName);
    const ring = this.buffers.get(name);
    if (!ring) return 0;
    const entries = ring.toArray();
    this.buffers.delete(name);
    for (const entry of entries) this._removeAccounting(entry, 'evicted');
    return entries.length;
  }

  snapshot() {
    this.pruneExpired();
    return Object.freeze({
      enabled: this.enabled,
      eventNames: this.buffers.size,
      entries: this.totalEntries,
      bytes: this.totalBytes,
      limits: Object.freeze({
        maxEntriesPerEvent: this.maxEntriesPerEvent,
        maxEventNames: this.maxEventNames,
        maxEntriesTotal: this.maxEntriesTotal,
        maxBytes: this.maxBytes,
        maxPayloadBytes: this.maxPayloadBytes,
        ttlMs: this.ttlMs,
      }),
      clonePolicy: this.clonePolicy,
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }
}

export default EventJournal;
