'use strict';

// src/events/RedisEventBridge.js
// Compatibility-preserving, bounded, lifecycle-safe Redis event bridge.

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { hostname } from 'node:os';

import { BridgeStateMachine } from './bridge/BridgeStateMachine.js';
import { PublishQueue } from './bridge/PublishQueue.js';
import { SeenMessageWindow } from './bridge/SeenMessageWindow.js';
import {
  createEventEnvelope,
  signEventEnvelope,
  validateEventEnvelope,
} from './serialization/EventEnvelope.js';
import { SafeJsonCodec } from './serialization/SafeJsonCodec.js';
import { compileMatcherList, matchesAny } from './support/glob.js';
import { shallowEventContext } from './context/EventContext.js';
import { createLogger } from './support/logger.js';
import { deferred, isPromiseLike, timeoutError } from './support/async.js';
import { EventTransportError } from './errors/EventError.js';

function isPlainObject(value) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
  const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  return prototype === Object.prototype || prototype === null;
}

function safeResolve(app, key, fallback = null) {
  try {
    const value = app?.resolve?.(key);
    return value === undefined ? fallback : value;
  } catch { return fallback; }
}

function configGet(config, path, fallback = undefined) {
  try {
    if (config && typeof config.get === 'function') {
      const value = config.get(path);
      return value === undefined ? fallback : value;
    }
  } catch {}
  return fallback;
}

function positive(value, fallback, minimum = 1) {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= minimum ? Math.trunc(parsed) : fallback;
}

function nonNegative(value, fallback = 0) {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= 0 ? parsed : fallback;
}

function boolean(value, fallback = false) {
  if (value == null) return fallback;
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
  const normalized = String(value).trim().toLowerCase();
  if (['1', 'true', 'yes', 'on', 'enabled'].includes(normalized)) return true;
  if (['0', 'false', 'no', 'off', 'disabled'].includes(normalized)) return false;
  return fallback;
}

async function withTimeout(value, timeoutMs, label) {
  if (!(timeoutMs > 0)) return await value;
  let timer;
  try {
    return await Promise.race([
      Promise.resolve(value),
      new Promise((_, reject) => {
        timer = setTimeout(() => reject(timeoutError(timeoutMs)), timeoutMs);
        timer.unref?.();
      }),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error?.name === 'TimeoutError') error.message = `${label || 'Operation'} timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`;
    throw error;
  } finally {
    if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

async function waitForReady(client, timeoutMs) {
  if (!client) throw new EventTransportError('Redis client is missing', { code: 'EVENT_BRIDGE_REDIS_CLIENT_MISSING' });
  if (client.isReady?.() === true || client.ready === true || client.status === 'ready') return client;

  if (typeof client.connectAsync === 'function') {
    await client.connectAsync({ timeoutMs });
    return client;
  }

  let result;
  try { result = client.connect?.(); }
  catch (error) {
    if (!/already (?:open|connect|connecting)|is already/i.test(error?.message || '')) throw error;
  }
  if (isPromiseLike(result)) await withTimeout(result, timeoutMs, 'Redis connection');
  if (client.isReady?.() === true || client.ready === true || client.status === 'ready') return client;
  if (typeof client.once !== 'function') return client;

  await withTimeout(new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let settled = false;
    const cleanup = () => {
      client.off?.('ready', onReady);
      client.off?.('error', onError);
      client.off?.('close', onClose);
    };
    const finish = (method, value) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      cleanup();
      method(value);
    };
    const onReady = () => finish(resolve, client);
    const onError = (error) => finish(reject, error);
    const onClose = () => finish(reject, new EventTransportError('Redis connection closed before readiness', { code: 'EVENT_BRIDGE_REDIS_CLOSED' }));
    client.once('ready', onReady);
    client.once('error', onError);
    client.once('close', onClose);
    if (client.isReady?.() === true || client.ready === true || client.status === 'ready') onReady();
  }), timeoutMs, 'Redis readiness');
  return client;
}

async function closeClient(client) {
  if (!client) return;
  for (const method of ['quit', 'close', 'disconnect', 'destroy']) {
    if (typeof client[method] !== 'function') continue;
    try { await client[method](); } catch {}
    return;
  }
}

function createLegacyEnvelope(eventName, args, options) {
  const now = Date.now();
  const envelope = {
    v: 1,
    id: options.id || `${options.nodeId}-${now.toString(36)}-${randomUUID()}`,
    node: options.nodeId,
    ts: now,
    expiresAt: options.ttlMs > 0 ? now + options.ttlMs : 0,
    hop: Math.max(0, Number(options.hop) || 0),
    namespace: options.namespace || 'default',
    event: String(eventName),
    args: Array.isArray(args) ? args : [args],
    ctx: options.context || null,
    headers: options.headers || null,
  };
  if (options.secret) envelope.signature = signEventEnvelope(envelope, options.secret);
  return envelope;
}

export class RedisEventBridge {
  constructor(app, options = {}) {
    this.app = app;
    this.options = isPlainObject(options) ? { ...options } : {};

    // Existing public fields remain available.
    this.enabled = false;
    this.redis = null;
    this.subscriber = null;
    this.channel = 'rawnode:events';
    this.nodeId = process.env.NODE_ID || `${hostname()}:${process.pid}`;
    this.allow = [];
    this.deny = [];

    this.required = false;
    this.namespace = 'default';
    this.stateMachine = new BridgeStateMachine();
    this._logger = createLogger(console);
    this._codec = new SafeJsonCodec();
    this._seen = new SeenMessageWindow();
    this._queue = new PublishQueue();
    this._dispatcher = null;
    this._publisherHandle = null;
    this._publisherOff = null;
    this._subscription = null;
    this._subscriptionHandler = null;
    this._publisherOwned = false;
    this._subscriberOwned = false;
    this._clientCleanups = [];
    this._suppress = 0;
    this._startPromise = null;
    this._stopPromise = null;
    this._drainPromise = null;
    this._retryTimer = null;
    this._config = null;
    this._closed = false;
    this._failureStreak = 0;
    this._circuitOpenUntil = 0;

    this.stats = {
      starts: 0,
      stops: 0,
      published: 0,
      publishBytes: 0,
      publishErrors: 0,
      publishRetries: 0,
      received: 0,
      receiveBytes: 0,
      dispatched: 0,
      selfIgnored: 0,
      duplicateIgnored: 0,
      policyIgnored: 0,
      remoteSuppressed: 0,
      malformed: 0,
      oversized: 0,
      expired: 0,
      signatureRejected: 0,
      namespaceRejected: 0,
      versionRejected: 0,
      dispatchErrors: 0,
      circuitOpened: 0,
    };

    // Additive aliases keep metrics readable and preserve names used by earlier
    // enterprise previews without duplicating mutable counters.
    Object.defineProperties(this.stats, {
      publishFailures: { enumerable: true, get: () => this.stats.publishErrors },
      duplicates: { enumerable: true, get: () => this.stats.duplicateIgnored },
      loopPrevented: { enumerable: true, get: () => this.stats.remoteSuppressed },
      policyRejected: { enumerable: true, get: () => this.stats.policyIgnored },
    });
  }

  get state() { return this.stateMachine.state; }
  get ready() { return this.state === 'ready'; }

  start(overrides = null) {
    if (this.ready) return Promise.resolve(this);
    if (this._startPromise) return this._startPromise;
    if (this._closed) return Promise.reject(new EventTransportError('Redis event bridge is closed', { code: 'EVENT_BRIDGE_CLOSED' }));

    const config = this._loadConfig(overrides);
    if (!config.enabled) {
      if (this.state === 'idle') this.stateMachine.transition('disabled');
      this.enabled = false;
      return Promise.resolve(this);
    }

    this._startPromise = this._start(config)
      .finally(() => { this._startPromise = null; });
    return this._startPromise;
  }

  async _start(config) {
    if (!['idle', 'disabled', 'stopped', 'failed'].includes(this.state)) {
      throw new EventTransportError(`Cannot start Redis event bridge from state ${this.state}`, { code: 'EVENT_BRIDGE_STATE' });
    }

    this.stateMachine.transition('starting');
    this._config = config;
    this.required = config.required;
    this.channel = config.channel;
    this.nodeId = config.nodeId;
    this.namespace = config.namespace;
    this.allow = compileMatcherList(config.allow);
    this.deny = compileMatcherList(config.deny);
    this._logger = createLogger(config.logger);
    this._codec = new SafeJsonCodec({
      ...config.codec,
      maxBytes: config.limits.maxPacketBytes,
      redact: config.codec.redact !== false,
    });
    this._seen = new SeenMessageWindow(config.seen);
    this._queue = new PublishQueue(config.queue);
    this._failureStreak = 0;
    this._circuitOpenUntil = 0;

    try {
      this._dispatcher = config.dispatcher || safeResolve(this.app, 'events');
      if (!this._dispatcher) throw new EventTransportError('Events dispatcher not found', { code: 'EVENT_BRIDGE_DISPATCHER_MISSING' });

      const factory = await this._resolveClientFactory(config);
      this.redis = config.publisherClient || factory(config.redis || {});
      this.subscriber = config.subscriberClient || factory(config.redis || {});
      this._publisherOwned = !config.publisherClient;
      this._subscriberOwned = !config.subscriberClient;

      this._attachClientLifecycle(this.redis, 'publisher');
      if (this.subscriber !== this.redis) this._attachClientLifecycle(this.subscriber, 'subscriber');

      await Promise.all([
        waitForReady(this.redis, config.connectTimeoutMs),
        waitForReady(this.subscriber, config.connectTimeoutMs),
      ]);

      await this._subscribe();
      this._attachPublisher();
      this.stateMachine.transition('ready');
      this.enabled = true;
      this.stats.starts++;
      this._dispatcher.setBridge?.(this);
      this._diagnostic('ready', this.snapshot());
      this._logger.info(`[RedisEventBridge] ready on channel "${this.channel}" as node "${this.nodeId}"`);
      void this._drainQueue();
      return this;
    } catch (error) {
      await this._rollbackStart();
      this.enabled = false;
      this.stateMachine.transition('failed', error);
      this._diagnostic('start:error', { error, state: this.state });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async _subscribe() {
    this._subscriptionHandler = (...values) => {
      let message = values[0];
      if (values.length > 1) {
        if (values[0] === this.channel) message = values[1];
        else if (values[1] === this.channel) message = values[0];
        else message = values.at(-1);
      }
      void this._onMessage(message);
    };
    const result = this.subscriber.subscribe(this.channel, this._subscriptionHandler, { serial: true });
    this._subscription = isPromiseLike(result) ? await result : result;
    await this._subscription?.ready?.();
  }

  _attachPublisher() {
    const dispatcher = this._dispatcher;
    const listener = (eventName, ...args) => this._publish(eventName, args);

    if (typeof dispatcher.subscribeAny === 'function') {
      this._publisherHandle = dispatcher.subscribeAny(listener, {
        priority: -1000,
        owner: 'rawnode:events:redis-bridge',
        tags: ['events.bridge', 'events.bridge.redis'],
      });
      return;
    }
    if (typeof dispatcher.onAny === 'function') {
      dispatcher.onAny(listener, { priority: -1000 });
      this._publisherOff = () => dispatcher.offAny?.(listener);
      return;
    }
    if (typeof dispatcher.on === 'function') {
      dispatcher.on('*', listener);
      this._publisherOff = () => dispatcher.off?.('*', listener);
      return;
    }
    throw new EventTransportError('Dispatcher does not support onAny/on', { code: 'EVENT_BRIDGE_DISPATCHER_API' });
  }

  _publish(eventName, args) {
    const result = this.publish(eventName, args);
    result?.promise?.catch?.((error) => {
      this._logger.error('[RedisEventBridge] publish failed', error);
    });
    return result;
  }

  publish(eventName, args = [], options = {}) {
    if (!this.enabled || !['ready', 'degraded'].includes(this.state)) {
      return { accepted: false, reason: 'not-ready', promise: Promise.resolve({ published: false, reason: 'not-ready' }) };
    }

    const name = String(eventName || '');
    if (!name || !this._allowed(name)) {
      this.stats.policyIgnored++;
      return { accepted: false, reason: 'policy', promise: Promise.resolve({ published: false, reason: 'policy' }) };
    }

    const dispatcher = this._dispatcher;
    const current = options.context || dispatcher?.getContext?.() || null;
    if (!this._config.rebridgeRemote && (this._suppress > 0 || current?.originTransport === 'redis' || current?.remote === true)) {
      this.stats.remoteSuppressed++;
      return { accepted: false, reason: 'remote-origin', promise: Promise.resolve({ published: false, reason: 'remote-origin' }) };
    }

    let envelope;
    let encoded;
    try {
      // Sanitize before signing so redaction, circular markers and unsupported
      // values are part of the authenticated wire representation. The envelope
      // canonicalizer recognizes these tagged values and their reconstructed
      // runtime equivalents identically on the receiving node.
      const safePayload = this._codec.sanitize({
        args: Array.isArray(args) ? args : [args],
        context: shallowEventContext(current),
        headers: options.headers && typeof options.headers === 'object' ? options.headers : null,
      }).value;

      const envelopeOptions = {
        id: options.id,
        nodeId: this.nodeId,
        namespace: this.namespace,
        context: safePayload.context,
        headers: safePayload.headers,
        ttlMs: options.ttlMs ?? this._config.protocol.ttlMs,
        hop: current?.hop || 0,
        secret: this._config.protocol.secret,
      };
      envelope = this._config.protocol.publishVersion === 1
        ? createLegacyEnvelope(name, safePayload.args, envelopeOptions)
        : createEventEnvelope(name, safePayload.args, envelopeOptions);

      encoded = this._codec.encode(envelope, { maxBytes: this._config.limits.maxPacketBytes });
    } catch (error) {
      this.stats.oversized += error?.code === 'EVENT_CODEC_MAX_BYTES' ? 1 : 0;
      this.stats.publishErrors++;
      this._diagnostic('publish:rejected', { eventName: name, error });
      const promise = Promise.reject(error);
      promise.catch(() => {});
      return { accepted: false, reason: error.code || 'encode', error, promise };
    }

    const completion = deferred();
    completion.promise.catch(() => {});
    const item = {
      envelope,
      json: encoded.text,
      bytes: encoded.bytes,
      attempts: 0,
      completion,
      onDrop: (reason) => completion.reject(new EventTransportError(`Redis event publish dropped: ${reason}`, {
        code: 'EVENT_BRIDGE_PUBLISH_DROPPED',
        details: { eventName: name, envelopeId: envelope.id, reason },
      })),
    };
    const admission = this._queue.push(item);
    if (!admission.accepted) {
      const error = new EventTransportError(`Redis event publish rejected: ${admission.reason}`, {
        code: 'EVENT_BRIDGE_QUEUE_REJECTED',
        details: { eventName: name, envelopeId: envelope.id, admission },
      });
      completion.reject(error);
      completion.promise.catch(() => {});
      this._diagnostic('publish:rejected', { eventName: name, envelopeId: envelope.id, admission });
      return { ...admission, envelopeId: envelope.id, promise: completion.promise };
    }

    void this._drainQueue();
    return { accepted: true, envelopeId: envelope.id, bytes: encoded.bytes, promise: completion.promise };
  }

  async _drainQueue() {
    if (this._drainPromise) return this._drainPromise;
    this._drainPromise = this._drainQueueLoop().finally(() => { this._drainPromise = null; });
    return this._drainPromise;
  }

  async _drainQueueLoop() {
    while (this.enabled && this._queue.length > 0) {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now < this._circuitOpenUntil || this.state === 'degraded' && !this._clientReady(this.redis)) {
        this._scheduleRetry(Math.max(1, this._circuitOpenUntil - now || this._config.queue.retryDelayMs));
        return;
      }

      const item = this._queue.shift();
      if (!item) return;
      try {
        await withTimeout(this.redis.publish(this.channel, item.json), this._config.publishTimeoutMs, 'Redis publish');
        this._failureStreak = 0;
        this.stats.published++;
        this.stats.publishBytes += item.bytes;
        item.completion.resolve({ published: true, envelopeId: item.envelope.id, bytes: item.bytes });
        if (this.state === 'degraded' && this._clientReady(this.redis)) this._transitionReady();
      } catch (error) {
        this.stats.publishErrors++;
        this._failureStreak++;
        item.attempts++;
        if (item.attempts < this._config.queue.maxAttempts) {
          this.stats.publishRetries++;
          this._queue.unshift(item);
        } else {
          item.completion.reject(error);
          item.completion.promise.catch(() => {});
        }
        this._onPublishFailure(error);
        this._scheduleRetry(this._config.queue.retryDelayMs);
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  _onPublishFailure(error) {
    const circuit = this._config.circuit;
    if (this._failureStreak >= circuit.failureThreshold) {
      this._circuitOpenUntil = Date.now() + circuit.openMs;
      this.stats.circuitOpened++;
      this._transitionDegraded(error);
    }
    this._diagnostic('publish:error', { error, failureStreak: this._failureStreak, circuitOpenUntil: this._circuitOpenUntil });
  }

  _scheduleRetry(delayMs) {
    if (this._retryTimer || !this.enabled) return;
    this._retryTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this._retryTimer = null;
      if (Date.now() >= this._circuitOpenUntil && this._clientReady(this.redis)) this._transitionReady();
      void this._drainQueue();
    }, Math.max(1, Number(delayMs) || 1));
    this._retryTimer.unref?.();
  }

  async _onMessage(message) {
    if (!this.enabled || message == null) return false;
    const bytes = Buffer.isBuffer(message) || message instanceof Uint8Array
      ? message.byteLength
      : Buffer.byteLength(String(message));
    this.stats.receiveBytes += bytes;
    if (bytes > this._config.limits.maxPacketBytes) {
      this.stats.oversized++;
      this._diagnostic('receive:rejected', { reason: 'maxPacketBytes', bytes });
      return false;
    }

    let packet;
    try { packet = this._codec.parse(message); }
    catch (error) {
      this.stats.malformed++;
      this._diagnostic('receive:rejected', { reason: 'parse', error });
      return false;
    }

    const validation = validateEventEnvelope(packet, {
      acceptedVersions: this._config.protocol.acceptedVersions,
      namespace: this.namespace,
      secret: this._config.protocol.secret,
      acceptUnsignedV1: this._config.protocol.acceptUnsignedV1,
      maxAgeMs: this._config.protocol.maxAgeMs,
      maxClockSkewMs: this._config.protocol.maxClockSkewMs,
      maxHops: this._config.protocol.maxHops,
      maxArgs: this._config.limits.maxArgs,
      maxEventNameBytes: this._config.limits.maxEventNameBytes,
    });
    if (!validation.ok) {
      this._recordValidationFailure(validation.code);
      this._diagnostic('receive:rejected', validation);
      return false;
    }

    const envelope = validation.envelope;
    if (envelope.node === this.nodeId) { this.stats.selfIgnored++; return false; }
    if (this._seen.has(envelope.id)) { this.stats.duplicateIgnored++; return false; }
    this._seen.remember(envelope.id);
    if (!this._allowed(envelope.event)) { this.stats.policyIgnored++; return false; }

    const dispatcher = this._dispatcher || safeResolve(this.app, 'events');
    if (!dispatcher) return false;
    const incoming = isPlainObject(envelope.ctx) ? envelope.ctx : {};
    const context = typeof dispatcher.createContext === 'function'
      ? dispatcher.createContext({
          ...incoming,
          parentId: incoming.parentId ?? incoming.id ?? null,
          correlationId: incoming.correlationId ?? incoming.id ?? envelope.id,
          causationId: incoming.causationId ?? incoming.id ?? envelope.id,
          transport: incoming.transport || 'redis',
          remote: true,
          originTransport: 'redis',
          originNode: envelope.node,
          envelopeId: envelope.id,
          hop: (Number(envelope.hop) || 0) + 1,
        })
      : {
          ...incoming,
          remote: true,
          originTransport: 'redis',
          originNode: envelope.node,
          envelopeId: envelope.id,
          hop: (Number(envelope.hop) || 0) + 1,
        };

    this.stats.received++;
    this._suppress++;
    try {
      const invoke = () => dispatcher.dispatch(envelope.event, ...envelope.args);
      if (context && typeof dispatcher.run === 'function') dispatcher.run(context, invoke);
      else invoke();
      this.stats.dispatched++;
      this._diagnostic('receive:dispatch', { envelopeId: envelope.id, eventName: envelope.event, originNode: envelope.node });
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      this.stats.dispatchErrors++;
      this._diagnostic('receive:dispatch-error', { error, envelopeId: envelope.id, eventName: envelope.event });
      return false;
    } finally {
      this._suppress = Math.max(0, this._suppress - 1);
    }
  }

  _recordValidationFailure(code) {
    if (code === 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_EXPIRED') this.stats.expired++;
    else if (code === 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_SIGNATURE') this.stats.signatureRejected++;
    else if (code === 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_NAMESPACE') this.stats.namespaceRejected++;
    else if (code === 'EVENT_ENVELOPE_VERSION') this.stats.versionRejected++;
    else this.stats.malformed++;
  }

  _allowed(eventName) {
    if (this.allow.length && !matchesAny(this.allow, eventName)) return false;
    if (this.deny.length && matchesAny(this.deny, eventName)) return false;
    return true;
  }

  _attachClientLifecycle(client, role) {
    if (!client || typeof client.on !== 'function') return;
    const onReady = () => {
      if (this.enabled || this.state === 'degraded') this._transitionReady();
      void this._drainQueue();
    };
    const onError = (error) => {
      this._logger.error(`[RedisEventBridge] ${role} error`, error);
      if (this.state === 'ready') this._transitionDegraded(error);
      this._diagnostic('client:error', { role, error });
    };
    const onClose = () => {
      if (this.state === 'ready') this._transitionDegraded(new EventTransportError(`${role} connection closed`, { code: 'EVENT_BRIDGE_REDIS_CLOSED' }));
      this._diagnostic('client:close', { role });
    };
    client.on('ready', onReady);
    client.on('error', onError);
    client.on('close', onClose);
    client.on('end', onClose);
    this._clientCleanups.push(() => {
      client.off?.('ready', onReady);
      client.off?.('error', onError);
      client.off?.('close', onClose);
      client.off?.('end', onClose);
    });
  }

  _clientReady(client) {
    return !!client && (client.isReady?.() === true || client.ready === true || client.status === 'ready' || client.status == null);
  }

  _transitionDegraded(error) {
    if (this.state === 'ready') this.stateMachine.transition('degraded', error);
    this._diagnostic('degraded', { error, state: this.state });
  }

  _transitionReady() {
    if (this.state === 'degraded') {
      this._failureStreak = 0;
      this._circuitOpenUntil = 0;
      this.stateMachine.transition('ready');
      this._diagnostic('recovered', this.snapshot());
    }
  }

  /**
   * Wait until all currently admitted publications have either completed or
   * reached their configured retry limit. This never admits new work and is
   * safe to call repeatedly during graceful shutdown.
   */
  async flush(options = {}) {
    const timeoutMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.timeoutMs ?? this._config?.flushTimeoutMs ?? 30_000) || 0);
    const startedAt = Date.now();

    while (this._queue.length > 0 || this._drainPromise) {
      if (timeoutMs && Date.now() - startedAt >= timeoutMs) {
        throw new EventTransportError(`Redis event bridge flush timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`, {
          code: 'EVENT_BRIDGE_FLUSH_TIMEOUT',
          details: { queue: this._queue.snapshot(), state: this.state },
        });
      }

      if (!this._drainPromise && this._queue.length > 0) void this._drainQueue();
      if (this._drainPromise) {
        await this._drainPromise;
        continue;
      }

      // A circuit-open or retry timer can temporarily leave admitted work in
      // the queue. Yield to timers rather than spinning in the microtask queue.
      if (this._queue.length > 0) {
        const remaining = timeoutMs ? Math.max(1, timeoutMs - (Date.now() - startedAt)) : 50;
        const delay = Math.min(50, remaining);
        await new Promise((resolve) => {
          const timer = setTimeout(resolve, delay);
          timer.unref?.();
        });
      }
    }

    return this.snapshot();
  }

  stop() {
    if (this._stopPromise) return this._stopPromise;
    this._stopPromise = this._stop().finally(() => { this._stopPromise = null; });
    return this._stopPromise;
  }

  async _stop() {
    if (['idle', 'disabled', 'stopped', 'closed'].includes(this.state)) {
      this.enabled = false;
      return this.snapshot();
    }
    if (this.state === 'starting' && this._startPromise) {
      try { await this._startPromise; } catch {}
      if (['failed', 'stopped'].includes(this.state)) return this.snapshot();
    }

    if (['ready', 'degraded', 'failed'].includes(this.state)) this.stateMachine.transition('stopping');
    this.enabled = false;
    if (this._retryTimer) clearTimeout(this._retryTimer);
    this._retryTimer = null;

    this._publisherHandle?.dispose?.();
    this._publisherHandle = null;
    try { this._publisherOff?.(); } catch {}
    this._publisherOff = null;

    try {
      if (this._subscription?.unsubscribe) await this._subscription.unsubscribe();
      else if (this.subscriber?.unsubscribe) {
        try { await this.subscriber.unsubscribe(this.channel, this._subscriptionHandler); }
        catch { await this.subscriber.unsubscribe(this.channel); }
      }
    } catch {}
    this._subscription = null;
    this._subscriptionHandler = null;

    for (const cleanup of this._clientCleanups.splice(0)) {
      try { cleanup(); } catch {}
    }

    if (this._subscriberOwned) await closeClient(this.subscriber);
    if (this._publisherOwned && this.redis !== this.subscriber) await closeClient(this.redis);
    if (this._publisherOwned && this.redis === this.subscriber && !this._subscriberOwned) await closeClient(this.redis);
    this.redis = null;
    this.subscriber = null;
    this._publisherOwned = false;
    this._subscriberOwned = false;
    this._queue.clear('bridge-stopped');
    this._seen.clear();
    this._dispatcher?.setBridge?.(null);
    this._dispatcher = null;

    if (this.state === 'stopping') this.stateMachine.transition('stopped');
    this.stats.stops++;
    this._logger.info('[RedisEventBridge] stopped');
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  async close() {
    if (this._closed) return this.snapshot();
    await this.stop();
    if (this.state === 'idle' || this.state === 'disabled' || this.state === 'stopped' || this.state === 'failed') {
      this.stateMachine.transition('closed');
    }
    this._closed = true;
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  async _rollbackStart() {
    this.enabled = false;
    try { this._publisherHandle?.dispose?.(); } catch {}
    this._publisherHandle = null;
    try { this._publisherOff?.(); } catch {}
    this._publisherOff = null;
    try { await this._subscription?.unsubscribe?.(); } catch {}
    try { await this.subscriber?.unsubscribe?.(this.channel, this._subscriptionHandler); } catch {}
    for (const cleanup of this._clientCleanups.splice(0)) { try { cleanup(); } catch {} }
    if (this._subscriberOwned) await closeClient(this.subscriber);
    if (this._publisherOwned && this.redis !== this.subscriber) await closeClient(this.redis);
    this.redis = null;
    this.subscriber = null;
    this._subscription = null;
    this._subscriptionHandler = null;
  }

  _diagnostic(name, payload) {
    try { this._dispatcher?._emitDiagnostic?.(`bridge:${name}`, payload); } catch {}
  }

  async _resolveClientFactory(config) {
    if (typeof config.clientFactory === 'function') return config.clientFactory;
    const boundFactory = safeResolve(this.app, 'redis.createClient') || safeResolve(this.app, 'redis.factory');
    if (typeof boundFactory === 'function') return boundFactory;
    const redis = safeResolve(this.app, 'redis');
    if (typeof redis?.createClient === 'function') return redis.createClient.bind(redis);
    try {
      const module = await import('#redis');
      if (typeof module.createClient === 'function') return module.createClient;
      if (typeof module.default?.createClient === 'function') return module.default.createClient.bind(module.default);
    } catch {}
    throw new EventTransportError('Redis client factory is unavailable. Bind redis.createClient or pass clientFactory.', {
      code: 'EVENT_BRIDGE_REDIS_FACTORY_MISSING',
    });
  }

  _loadConfig(overrides) {
    const config = safeResolve(this.app, 'config');
    const fromConfig = configGet(config, 'events.bridge.redis', configGet(config, 'app.events.bridge.redis', {})) || {};
    const raw = {
      ...fromConfig,
      ...this.options,
      ...(isPlainObject(overrides) ? overrides : {}),
    };
    const redisConfig = raw.redis || configGet(config, 'redis', configGet(config, 'database.redis', {})) || {};
    const protocolRaw = isPlainObject(raw.protocol) ? raw.protocol : {};
    const limitsRaw = isPlainObject(raw.limits) ? raw.limits : {};
    const queueRaw = isPlainObject(raw.queue) ? raw.queue : {};
    const seenRaw = isPlainObject(raw.seen) ? raw.seen : {};
    const circuitRaw = isPlainObject(raw.circuit) ? raw.circuit : {};

    return {
      enabled: boolean(raw.enabled, boolean(process.env.EVENTS_REDIS, false)),
      required: boolean(raw.required, false),
      channel: String(raw.channel || 'rawnode:events'),
      nodeId: String(raw.nodeId || process.env.NODE_ID || `${hostname()}:${process.pid}`),
      namespace: String(raw.namespace || 'default'),
      allow: Array.isArray(raw.allow) ? raw.allow : [],
      deny: Array.isArray(raw.deny) ? raw.deny : ['internal:**', 'container:**', 'http:**', 'ws:**', 'tcp:**', 'udp:**'],
      rebridgeRemote: boolean(raw.rebridgeRemote, false),
      connectTimeoutMs: positive(raw.connectTimeoutMs, 10_000),
      publishTimeoutMs: positive(raw.publishTimeoutMs, 5_000),
      redis: redisConfig,
      logger: raw.logger || safeResolve(this.app, 'logger', console),
      dispatcher: raw.dispatcher || null,
      clientFactory: typeof raw.clientFactory === 'function' ? raw.clientFactory : null,
      publisherClient: raw.publisherClient || raw.clients?.publisher || null,
      subscriberClient: raw.subscriberClient || raw.clients?.subscriber || null,
      codec: isPlainObject(raw.codec) ? raw.codec : {},
      seen: {
        maxItems: positive(seenRaw.maxItems ?? raw.seenLimit, 50_000),
        ttlMs: positive(seenRaw.ttlMs ?? raw.seenTtlMs, 60_000),
      },
      queue: {
        maxItems: positive(queueRaw.maxItems, 10_000),
        maxBytes: positive(queueRaw.maxBytes, 16 * 1024 * 1024),
        overflow: ['reject', 'drop-newest', 'drop-oldest'].includes(queueRaw.overflow) ? queueRaw.overflow : 'drop-oldest',
        // `maxPublishRetries` is a compatibility alias expressed as retries;
        // the internal queue uses total attempts, therefore add one.
        maxAttempts: queueRaw.maxAttempts != null
          ? positive(queueRaw.maxAttempts, 3)
          : Math.max(1, Math.trunc(nonNegative(raw.maxPublishRetries, 2)) + 1),
        retryDelayMs: positive(queueRaw.retryDelayMs, 250),
      },
      circuit: {
        failureThreshold: positive(circuitRaw.failureThreshold, 5),
        openMs: positive(circuitRaw.openMs, 2_000),
      },
      limits: {
        maxPacketBytes: positive(limitsRaw.maxPacketBytes ?? raw.maxPacketBytes, 1024 * 1024),
        maxEventNameBytes: positive(limitsRaw.maxEventNameBytes, 512),
        maxArgs: positive(limitsRaw.maxArgs, 128),
      },
      protocol: {
        publishVersion: [1, 2].includes(Number(protocolRaw.publishVersion ?? raw.publishVersion)) ? Number(protocolRaw.publishVersion ?? raw.publishVersion) : 2,
        acceptedVersions: Array.isArray(protocolRaw.acceptedVersions) ? protocolRaw.acceptedVersions.map(Number) : [1, 2],
        maxAgeMs: nonNegative(protocolRaw.maxAgeMs, 0),
        maxClockSkewMs: nonNegative(protocolRaw.maxClockSkewMs, 30_000),
        maxHops: positive(protocolRaw.maxHops, 4),
        ttlMs: nonNegative(protocolRaw.ttlMs, 0),
        secret: protocolRaw.secret || raw.secret || null,
        acceptUnsignedV1: boolean(protocolRaw.acceptUnsignedV1, true),
      },
    };
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      ...this.stateMachine.snapshot(),
      enabled: this.enabled,
      required: this.required,
      ready: this.ready,
      channel: this.channel,
      nodeId: this.nodeId,
      namespace: this.namespace,
      queue: this._queue.snapshot(),
      seen: this._seen.snapshot(),
      circuitOpenUntil: this._circuitOpenUntil,
      circuit: Object.freeze({ failureStreak: this._failureStreak, openUntil: this._circuitOpenUntil }),
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }

  health() {
    const unhealthy = this.required && !this.ready;
    return Object.freeze({
      ok: !unhealthy,
      ready: !unhealthy,
      state: this.state,
      required: this.required,
      reasons: Object.freeze(unhealthy ? [`bridge_${this.state}`] : []),
      snapshot: this.snapshot(),
    });
  }

  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await this.close(); }
}

export default RedisEventBridge;

'use strict';

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { estimateValueBytes } from '../support/size.js';
import { raceWithSignal } from '../support/async.js';
import {
  EventAdmissionError,
  EventClosedError,
  EventTimeoutError,
  EventAbortError,
} from '../errors/EventError.js';

const OVERFLOW_POLICIES = new Set(['reject', 'drop-oldest', 'drop-lowest']);

function abortReason(signal, fallback = 'aborted') {
  const reason = signal?.reason;
  if (reason instanceof Error) return reason;
  return new EventAbortError(reason == null ? fallback : String(reason));
}

class JobHandle {
  constructor(queue, job, promise) {
    this.queue = queue;
    this.id = job.id;
    this.name = job.name;
    this.promise = promise;
  }
  get status() { return this.queue.get(this.id)?.status || 'settled'; }
  cancel(reason = 'cancelled') { return this.queue.cancel(this.id, reason); }
  then(...args) { return this.promise.then(...args); }
  catch(...args) { return this.promise.catch(...args); }
  finally(...args) { return this.promise.finally(...args); }
}

/**
 * Bounded, priority-aware, cancellation-safe, cooperative in-process job queue.
 * It is intentionally not a durable queue; use EventOutbox/Redis Streams when
 * work must survive process loss.
 */
export class EventJobQueue {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxItems = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxItems) || 100_000);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxBytes) || 64 * 1024 * 1024);
    this.concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(options.concurrency) || 8);
    this.overflow = OVERFLOW_POLICIES.has(options.overflow) ? options.overflow : 'reject';
    this.defaultAttempts = Math.max(1, Number(options.attempts) || 3);
    this.retryBaseMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.retryBaseMs) || 100);
    this.retryMaxMs = Math.max(this.retryBaseMs, Number(options.retryMaxMs) || 30_000);
    this.shutdownTimeoutMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.shutdownTimeoutMs) || 30_000);
    this.forceOnShutdownTimeout = options.forceOnShutdownTimeout !== false;
    this.unrefTimers = options.unrefTimers === true;

    this.handlers = new Map();
    this.queue = [];
    this.jobs = new Map();
    this.running = new Map();
    this.bytes = 0;
    this.active = 0;
    this.sequence = 0;
    this.closed = false;
    this.accepting = true;
    this.pumpScheduled = false;
    this.wakeTimer = null;
    this.flushWaiters = new Set();
    this.lastShutdown = null;
    this.stats = {
      enqueued: 0,
      completed: 0,
      failed: 0,
      retried: 0,
      cancelled: 0,
      rejected: 0,
      dropped: 0,
      timedOut: 0,
      highWaterItems: 0,
      highWaterBytes: 0,
    };
  }

  register(name, handler, options = {}) {
    const key = String(name || '').trim();
    if (!key || typeof handler !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Queue handler name and function are required');
    if (this.handlers.has(key) && options.replace !== true) {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Queue handler already registered: ${key}`, { code: 'EVENT_QUEUE_HANDLER_DUPLICATE' });
    }
    this.handlers.set(key, handler);
    return this;
  }

  unregister(name) { return this.handlers.delete(String(name)); }
  get(id) { return this.jobs.get(String(id)) || null; }

  enqueue(name, payload, options = {}) {
    if (!this.accepting || this.closed) {
      throw new EventClosedError('Event job queue is not accepting work', { code: 'EVENT_QUEUE_CLOSED' });
    }
    const key = String(name || '').trim();
    if (!this.handlers.has(key) && typeof options.handler !== 'function') {
      throw new EventAdmissionError(`Queue handler not found: ${key}`, { code: 'EVENT_QUEUE_HANDLER_MISSING' });
    }

    const bytes = estimateValueBytes(payload);
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const externalSignal = options.signal || null;
    const onExternalAbort = externalSignal
      ? () => controller.abort(abortReason(externalSignal))
      : null;
    if (externalSignal?.aborted) controller.abort(abortReason(externalSignal));
    else externalSignal?.addEventListener?.('abort', onExternalAbort, { once: true });

    const job = {
      id: String(options.id || randomUUID()),
      name: key,
      payload,
      handler: options.handler || null,
      priority: Number(options.priority) || 0,
      sequence: ++this.sequence,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      availableAt: Number(options.availableAt) || (Date.now() + Math.max(0, Number(options.delayMs) || 0)),
      attempts: 0,
      maxAttempts: Math.max(1, Number(options.attempts) || this.defaultAttempts),
      timeoutMs: Math.max(0, Number(options.timeoutMs) || 0),
      bytes,
      status: 'queued',
      controller,
      signal: controller.signal,
      externalSignal,
      onExternalAbort,
      context: options.context || null,
      meta: options.meta || null,
      resolve: null,
      reject: null,
    };

    const promise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => { job.resolve = resolve; job.reject = reject; });
    promise.catch(() => {});
    try { this._admit(job); }
    catch (error) { this._cleanupSignal(job); throw error; }

    this.jobs.set(job.id, job);
    this.queue.push(job);
    this.bytes += bytes;
    this.stats.enqueued++;
    this.stats.highWaterItems = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterItems, this.jobs.size);
    this.stats.highWaterBytes = Math.max(this.stats.highWaterBytes, this.bytes);
    this._sort();
    this._schedulePump();
    return new JobHandle(this, job, promise);
  }

  dispatch(eventName, ...args) { return this.enqueue('dispatch', { eventName, args }); }

  _admit(job, options = {}) {
    if (job.bytes > this.maxBytes) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Event job exceeds queue byte limit', { code: 'EVENT_QUEUE_JOB_BYTES' });
    }

    const selfAlreadyCounted = options.retry === true ? 1 : 0;
    const overCapacity = () => (this.jobs.size - selfAlreadyCounted) >= this.maxItems || this.bytes + job.bytes > this.maxBytes;
    while (overCapacity()) {
      let dropped = null;
      if (this.overflow === 'drop-oldest') {
        let index = -1;
        let oldest = Infinity;
        for (let i = 0; i < this.queue.length; i++) {
          if (this.queue[i].sequence < oldest) { oldest = this.queue[i].sequence; index = i; }
        }
        if (index !== -1) [dropped] = this.queue.splice(index, 1);
      } else if (this.overflow === 'drop-lowest') {
        let index = -1;
        for (let i = 0; i < this.queue.length; i++) {
          if (index === -1 || this.queue[i].priority < this.queue[index].priority ||
              (this.queue[i].priority === this.queue[index].priority && this.queue[i].sequence < this.queue[index].sequence)) index = i;
        }
        if (index !== -1) [dropped] = this.queue.splice(index, 1);
      }
      if (!dropped) {
        this.stats.rejected++;
        throw new EventAdmissionError('Event job queue capacity exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_QUEUE_CAPACITY' });
      }
      this._finishDropped(dropped, 'overflow');
    }
  }

  _finishDropped(job, reason) {
    if (!job) return;
    this.bytes = Math.max(0, this.bytes - job.bytes);
    this.jobs.delete(job.id);
    job.status = 'dropped';
    this.stats.dropped++;
    this._cleanupSignal(job);
    job.reject?.(new EventAdmissionError(`Event job dropped: ${reason}`, { code: 'EVENT_QUEUE_DROPPED' }));
  }

  _sort() {
    this.queue.sort((left, right) => right.priority - left.priority || left.availableAt - right.availableAt || left.sequence - right.sequence);
  }

  _schedulePump() {
    if (this.pumpScheduled || this.closed) return;
    this.pumpScheduled = true;
    const immediate = setImmediate(() => { this.pumpScheduled = false; void this._pump(); });
    if (this.unrefTimers) immediate.unref?.();
  }

  async _pump() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    while (this.active < this.concurrency && this.queue.length) {
      const index = this.queue.findIndex((job) => job.availableAt <= now);
      if (index === -1) break;
      const [job] = this.queue.splice(index, 1);
      this.bytes = Math.max(0, this.bytes - job.bytes);
      if (job.signal.aborted) { this._cancelJob(job, abortReason(job.signal)); continue; }
      this.active++;
      job.status = 'running';
      this.running.set(job.id, job);
      void this._run(job).finally(() => {
        this.running.delete(job.id);
        this.active = Math.max(0, this.active - 1);
        this._resolveFlushWaiters();
        this._schedulePump();
      });
    }

    if (this.queue.length && this.active < this.concurrency) {
      const nextAt = Math.min(...this.queue.map((job) => job.availableAt));
      const delay = Math.max(1, nextAt - Date.now());
      if (!this.wakeTimer) {
        this.wakeTimer = setTimeout(() => { this.wakeTimer = null; this._schedulePump(); }, delay);
        if (this.unrefTimers) this.wakeTimer.unref?.();
      }
    }
    this._resolveFlushWaiters();
  }

  async _run(job) {
    job.attempts++;
    const handler = job.handler || this.handlers.get(job.name);
    try {
      const operation = Promise.resolve().then(() => handler(job.payload, {
        id: job.id,
        name: job.name,
        attempt: job.attempts,
        maxAttempts: job.maxAttempts,
        context: job.context,
        meta: job.meta,
        signal: job.signal,
        queue: this,
      }));
      const result = await raceWithSignal(operation, { signal: job.signal, timeoutMs: job.timeoutMs });
      job.status = 'completed';
      this.jobs.delete(job.id);
      this.stats.completed++;
      this._cleanupSignal(job);
      job.resolve(result);
    } catch (rawError) {
      let error = rawError;
      if (rawError?.name === 'TimeoutError') {
        this.stats.timedOut++;
        error = new EventTimeoutError(`Event job timed out after ${job.timeoutMs}ms`, {
          timeoutMs: job.timeoutMs,
          cause: rawError,
          details: { jobId: job.id, name: job.name },
        });
        job.controller.abort(error);
      }

      const canRetry = job.attempts < job.maxAttempts && !job.signal.aborted && !this.closed;
      if (canRetry) {
        job.status = 'queued';
        job.availableAt = Date.now() + Math.min(this.retryMaxMs, this.retryBaseMs * (2 ** Math.max(0, job.attempts - 1)));
        try {
          this._admit(job, { retry: true });
          this.queue.push(job);
          this.bytes += job.bytes;
          this.stats.retried++;
          this._sort();
        } catch (admissionError) {
          job.status = 'failed';
          this.jobs.delete(job.id);
          this.stats.failed++;
          this._cleanupSignal(job);
          job.reject(new EventAdmissionError('Event job retry could not be admitted', {
            code: 'EVENT_QUEUE_RETRY_CAPACITY',
            cause: admissionError,
          }));
        }
      } else if (job.signal.aborted && !(error instanceof EventTimeoutError)) {
        this._cancelJob(job, abortReason(job.signal));
      } else {
        job.status = 'failed';
        this.jobs.delete(job.id);
        this.stats.failed++;
        this._cleanupSignal(job);
        job.reject(error);
      }
    }
  }

  cancel(id, reason = 'cancelled') {
    const job = this.jobs.get(String(id));
    if (!job || ['completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'dropped'].includes(job.status)) return false;
    const error = reason instanceof Error ? reason : new EventAbortError(`Event job cancelled: ${reason}`, {
      code: 'EVENT_QUEUE_CANCELLED',
      details: { jobId: job.id, name: job.name },
    });
    if (!job.signal.aborted) job.controller.abort(error);
    if (job.status === 'queued') {
      const index = this.queue.indexOf(job);
      if (index !== -1) this.queue.splice(index, 1);
      this.bytes = Math.max(0, this.bytes - job.bytes);
      this._cancelJob(job, error);
      this._resolveFlushWaiters();
    }
    return true;
  }

  _cancelJob(job, reason) {
    if (!job || job.status === 'cancelled') return;
    const error = reason instanceof Error ? reason : new EventAbortError(`Event job cancelled: ${reason}`, { code: 'EVENT_QUEUE_CANCELLED' });
    job.status = 'cancelled';
    this.jobs.delete(job.id);
    this.stats.cancelled++;
    this._cleanupSignal(job);
    job.reject(error);
  }

  _cleanupSignal(job) {
    if (job.externalSignal && job.onExternalAbort) job.externalSignal.removeEventListener?.('abort', job.onExternalAbort);
    job.onExternalAbort = null;
  }

  pause() { this.accepting = false; return this; }
  resume() { if (!this.closed) { this.accepting = true; this._schedulePump(); } return this; }

  flush(options = {}) {
    const operation = (!this.queue.length && this.active === 0)
      ? Promise.resolve(this.snapshot())
      : new Promise((resolve) => this.flushWaiters.add(resolve));
    return raceWithSignal(operation, { signal: options.signal, timeoutMs: Math.max(0, Number(options.timeoutMs) || 0), unrefTimer: false });
  }

  _resolveFlushWaiters() {
    if (this.queue.length || this.active) return;
    for (const resolve of this.flushWaiters) resolve(this.snapshot());
    this.flushWaiters.clear();
  }

  async close(options = {}) {
    if (this.closed) return this.snapshot();
    this.accepting = false;
    let forced = options.force === true || options.drain === false;
    let error = null;
    if (!forced) {
      try {
        await this.flush({
          signal: options.signal,
          timeoutMs: Math.max(0, Number(options.timeoutMs ?? this.shutdownTimeoutMs) || 0),
        });
      } catch (failure) {
        error = failure;
        if (options.forceOnTimeout === false || this.forceOnShutdownTimeout === false) throw failure;
        forced = true;
      }
    }

    this.closed = true;
    if (this.wakeTimer) clearTimeout(this.wakeTimer);
    this.wakeTimer = null;
    for (const job of [...this.queue]) this._cancelJob(job, 'queue closed');
    this.queue.length = 0;
    this.bytes = 0;
    if (forced) {
      for (const job of this.running.values()) {
        if (!job.signal.aborted) job.controller.abort(new EventClosedError('Event job queue forced closed'));
      }
    }
    this.lastShutdown = Object.freeze({ forced, error, closedAt: Date.now() });
    this._resolveFlushWaiters();
    return this.snapshot();
  }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      accepting: this.accepting,
      closed: this.closed,
      queued: this.queue.length,
      active: this.active,
      bytes: this.bytes,
      handlers: this.handlers.size,
      limits: Object.freeze({ maxItems: this.maxItems, maxBytes: this.maxBytes, concurrency: this.concurrency, overflow: this.overflow }),
      shutdown: this.lastShutdown,
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }

  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() { await this.close(); }
}

export { JobHandle };
export default EventJobQueue;

'use strict';

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

function parsePart(part, minimum, maximum) {
  const values = new Set();
  for (const token of String(part).split(',')) {
    const [rangeToken, stepToken] = token.split('/');
    const step = Math.max(1, Number(stepToken) || 1);
    let start = minimum;
    let end = maximum;
    if (rangeToken !== '*') {
      if (rangeToken.includes('-')) [start, end] = rangeToken.split('-').map(Number);
      else start = end = Number(rangeToken);
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(start) || !Number.isInteger(end) || start < minimum || end > maximum || start > end) throw new TypeError(`Invalid cron field: ${part}`);
    for (let value = start; value <= end; value += step) values.add(value);
  }
  return values;
}

export function compileCron(expression) {
  const fields = String(expression || '').trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (fields.length !== 5) throw new TypeError('Cron expression must contain five fields: minute hour day month weekday');
  const [minute, hour, day, month, weekday] = fields;
  const spec = {
    minute: parsePart(minute, 0, 59),
    hour: parsePart(hour, 0, 23),
    day: parsePart(day, 1, 31),
    month: parsePart(month, 1, 12),
    weekday: parsePart(weekday, 0, 6),
  };
  return (date) => spec.minute.has(date.getMinutes()) && spec.hour.has(date.getHours()) && spec.day.has(date.getDate()) && spec.month.has(date.getMonth() + 1) && spec.weekday.has(date.getDay());
}

export class EventScheduler {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.dispatcher = options.dispatcher || null;
    this.queue = options.queue || null;
    this.entries = new Map();
    this.timer = null;
    this.closed = false;
    this.stats = { scheduled: 0, fired: 0, skipped: 0, errors: 0, cancelled: 0 };
  }

  every(intervalMs, task, options = {}) {
    const interval = Math.max(1, Number(intervalMs) || 0);
    return this._add({ ...options, task, type: 'interval', intervalMs: interval, nextAt: Number(options.startAt) || Date.now() + interval });
  }

  at(date, task, options = {}) {
    const timestamp = date instanceof Date ? date.getTime() : Number(date);
    if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp)) throw new TypeError('Scheduled date is invalid');
    return this._add({ ...options, task, type: 'once', nextAt: timestamp });
  }

  cron(expression, task, options = {}) {
    const matcher = compileCron(expression);
    return this._add({ ...options, task, type: 'cron', expression: String(expression), matcher, nextAt: this._nextCron(matcher, Date.now()) });
  }

  event(eventName, args = [], options = {}) {
    const task = () => this.dispatcher?.dispatchAsync?.(eventName, ...(Array.isArray(args) ? args : [args]));
    return options.cron ? this.cron(options.cron, task, options) : options.at ? this.at(options.at, task, options) : this.every(options.everyMs, task, options);
  }

  _add(input) {
    if (this.closed) throw new Error('EventScheduler is closed');
    if (typeof input.task !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Scheduled task must be a function');
    const entry = {
      id: input.id || randomUUID(),
      name: input.name || input.id || input.type,
      type: input.type,
      task: input.task,
      nextAt: input.nextAt,
      intervalMs: input.intervalMs || 0,
      expression: input.expression || null,
      matcher: input.matcher || null,
      overlap: input.overlap === true,
      running: false,
      enabled: input.enabled !== false,
      runs: 0,
      maxRuns: Math.max(0, Number(input.maxRuns) || 0),
      lastRunAt: 0,
      lastError: null,
    };
    this.entries.set(entry.id, entry);
    this.stats.scheduled++;
    this._arm();
    return Object.freeze({ id: entry.id, cancel: () => this.cancel(entry.id), pause: () => this.pause(entry.id), resume: () => this.resume(entry.id) });
  }

  _nextCron(matcher, after) {
    const date = new Date(after);
    date.setSeconds(0, 0);
    date.setMinutes(date.getMinutes() + 1);
    const maximum = 366 * 24 * 60;
    for (let index = 0; index < maximum; index++, date.setMinutes(date.getMinutes() + 1)) if (matcher(date)) return date.getTime();
    throw new Error('Cron expression has no occurrence within one year');
  }

  _arm() {
    if (this.closed) return;
    if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer);
    this.timer = null;
    const enabled = Array.from(this.entries.values()).filter((entry) => entry.enabled);
    if (!enabled.length) return;
    const nextAt = Math.min(...enabled.map((entry) => entry.nextAt));
    this.timer = setTimeout(() => { this.timer = null; void this._tick(); }, Math.max(1, nextAt - Date.now()));
    this.timer.unref?.();
  }

  async _tick(now = Date.now()) {
    const due = Array.from(this.entries.values()).filter((entry) => entry.enabled && entry.nextAt <= now);
    for (const entry of due) {
      if (entry.running && !entry.overlap) { this.stats.skipped++; this._advance(entry, now); continue; }
      entry.running = true;
      entry.lastRunAt = now;
      entry.runs++;
      this.stats.fired++;
      this._advance(entry, now);
      const execute = async () => {
        try {
          if (this.queue) await this.queue.enqueue(entry.name, null, { handler: entry.task });
          else await entry.task({ id: entry.id, name: entry.name, run: entry.runs, scheduledAt: now });
          entry.lastError = null;
        } catch (error) { entry.lastError = error; this.stats.errors++; }
        finally { entry.running = false; if (entry.maxRuns && entry.runs >= entry.maxRuns) this.cancel(entry.id); }
      };
      void execute();
    }
    this._arm();
  }

  _advance(entry, now) {
    if (entry.type === 'once') { entry.enabled = false; return; }
    if (entry.type === 'interval') {
      do { entry.nextAt += entry.intervalMs; } while (entry.nextAt <= now);
      return;
    }
    entry.nextAt = this._nextCron(entry.matcher, now);
  }

  cancel(id) { const removed = this.entries.delete(String(id)); if (removed) this.stats.cancelled++; this._arm(); return removed; }
  pause(id) { const entry = this.entries.get(String(id)); if (!entry) return false; entry.enabled = false; this._arm(); return true; }
  resume(id) { const entry = this.entries.get(String(id)); if (!entry) return false; entry.enabled = true; if (entry.nextAt <= Date.now()) entry.nextAt = entry.type === 'interval' ? Date.now() + entry.intervalMs : entry.type === 'cron' ? this._nextCron(entry.matcher, Date.now()) : Date.now(); this._arm(); return true; }
  list() { return Array.from(this.entries.values()).map(({ task, matcher, lastError, ...entry }) => ({ ...entry, lastError: lastError ? { name: lastError.name, message: lastError.message } : null })); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ closed: this.closed, entries: this.entries.size, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
  close() { this.closed = true; if (this.timer) clearTimeout(this.timer); this.timer = null; this.entries.clear(); }
  [Symbol.dispose]() { this.close(); }
}

export default EventScheduler;

'use strict';

// src/events/Broadcastable.js

export const Broadcastable = (Base) => class extends Base {
  shouldBroadcast() { return true; }
  broadcastChannel() { return 'global'; }
  broadcastChannels() {
    const channel = this.broadcastChannel();
    return Array.isArray(channel) ? channel : [channel];
  }
  broadcastAs() { return this.constructor.name; }
  broadcastWith() { return this.payload; }
  broadcastWhen() { return true; }
  broadcastNow() { return false; }

  toBroadcastEnvelope() {
    return {
      event: this.broadcastAs(),
      channels: this.broadcastChannels(),
      payload: this.broadcastWith(),
      id: this.id,
      timestamp: this.timestamp,
      meta: this.meta ? { ...this.meta } : null,
    };
  }
};

'use strict';

export class EventError extends Error {
  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, options.cause ? { cause: options.cause } : undefined);
    this.name = options.name || new.target.name || 'EventError';
    this.code = options.code || 'EVENT_ERROR';
    this.details = options.details ?? null;
    this.eventName = options.eventName ?? null;
  }
}

export class EventConfigurationError extends EventError {
  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventConfigurationError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_CONFIGURATION_ERROR' });
  }
}

export class EventAdmissionError extends EventError {
  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventAdmissionError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_ADMISSION_REJECTED' });
  }
}

export class EventTimeoutError extends EventError {
  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventTimeoutError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_TIMEOUT' });
    this.timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? null;
  }
}

export class EventAbortError extends EventError {
  constructor(message = 'Event operation aborted.', options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventAbortError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_ABORTED' });
  }
}

export class EventClosedError extends EventError {
  constructor(message = 'Event subsystem is closed.', options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventClosedError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_CLOSED' });
  }
}

export class EventTransportError extends EventError {
  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventTransportError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_TRANSPORT_ERROR' });
  }
}


export class EventStoreError extends EventError {
  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventStoreError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_STORE_ERROR' });
  }
}

export class EventConcurrencyError extends EventStoreError {
  constructor(message, options = {}) {
    super(message, { ...options, name: 'EventConcurrencyError', code: options.code || 'EVENT_CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT' });
    this.expectedVersion = options.expectedVersion ?? null;
    this.actualVersion = options.actualVersion ?? null;
    this.streamId = options.streamId ?? null;
  }
}

'use strict';

/**
 * Minimal event-sourced aggregate base. Subclasses implement `apply<EventName>`
 * methods or override applyEvent(event, replaying).
 */
export class AggregateRoot {
  constructor(id = null) {
    this.id = id;
    this.version = 0;
    this._uncommittedEvents = [];
  }

  record(event) {
    if (!event || typeof event !== 'object') throw new TypeError('AggregateRoot.record expects an event object');
    this.applyEvent(event, false);
    this._uncommittedEvents.push(event);
    return this;
  }

  applyEvent(event, replaying = false) {
    const eventName = event.eventName || event.constructor?.eventName || event.constructor?.name || 'Event';
    const method = `apply${String(eventName).split(/[:.\-_/]+/).filter(Boolean).map(capitalize).join('')}`;
    if (typeof this[method] === 'function') this[method](event.payload ?? event, event);
    else if (typeof this.apply === 'function' && this.apply !== AggregateRoot.prototype.apply) this.apply(event, replaying);
    this.version++;
    return this;
  }

  loadFromHistory(events = []) {
    this._uncommittedEvents.length = 0;
    this.version = 0;
    for (const record of events) {
      const event = record?.eventObject || record?.event || record;
      this.applyEvent(event, true);
      if (record?.streamVersion != null) this.version = Number(record.streamVersion);
    }
    return this;
  }

  uncommittedEvents() { return this._uncommittedEvents.slice(); }
  hasUncommittedEvents() { return this._uncommittedEvents.length > 0; }
  markCommitted() { this._uncommittedEvents.length = 0; return this; }

  toSnapshot() {
    const state = {};
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(this)) {
      if (key === '_uncommittedEvents') continue;
      state[key] = clone(value);
    }
    return Object.freeze({ id: this.id, version: this.version, state });
  }

  restoreSnapshot(snapshot) {
    if (!snapshot || typeof snapshot !== 'object') throw new TypeError('Aggregate snapshot is required');
    Object.assign(this, clone(snapshot.state || {}));
    this.id = snapshot.id ?? this.id;
    this.version = Math.max(0, Number(snapshot.version) || 0);
    this._uncommittedEvents = [];
    return this;
  }
}

function capitalize(value) { return value ? value[0].toUpperCase() + value.slice(1) : ''; }
function clone(value) {
  try { return structuredClone(value); } catch {}
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(clone);
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
  if (value instanceof Date) return new Date(value);
  const output = {};
  for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) output[key] = clone(child);
  return output;
}

export default AggregateRoot;

'use strict';

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { estimateValueBytes } from '../support/size.js';
import { EventAdmissionError, EventConcurrencyError, EventStoreError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

function clone(value) {
  try { return structuredClone(value); } catch {}
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(clone);
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
  if (value instanceof Date) return new Date(value);
  if (value instanceof Error) return { name: value.name, message: value.message, code: value.code };
  const output = {};
  for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) output[key] = clone(child);
  return output;
}

function normalizeEvent(event, options = {}) {
  const eventObject = event && typeof event === 'object' ? event : null;
  const eventName = options.eventName || eventObject?.eventName || eventObject?.constructor?.eventName || eventObject?.constructor?.name || 'Event';
  return {
    eventName: String(eventName),
    eventVersion: Math.max(1, Number(options.eventVersion ?? eventObject?.version) || 1),
    payload: clone(options.payload !== undefined ? options.payload : eventObject?.payload !== undefined ? eventObject.payload : event),
    eventObject: eventObject ? clone(eventObject) : null,
  };
}

/** Bounded in-memory event store with optimistic concurrency and snapshots. */
export class MemoryEventStore {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxStreams = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxStreams) || 100_000);
    this.maxEvents = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxEvents) || 1_000_000);
    this.maxBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxBytes) || 256 * 1024 * 1024);
    this.maxEventBytes = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxEventBytes) || 4 * 1024 * 1024);
    this.streams = new Map();
    this.snapshots = new Map();
    this.subscribers = new Set();
    this.events = 0;
    this.bytes = 0;
    this.globalPosition = 0;
    this.closed = false;
    this.stats = { appended: 0, reads: 0, conflicts: 0, rejected: 0, snapshots: 0, subscriberErrors: 0 };
  }

  version(streamId) { return this.streams.get(String(streamId))?.length || 0; }

  async append(streamId, events, options = {}) {
    if (this.closed) throw new EventStoreError('Event store is closed', { code: 'EVENT_STORE_CLOSED' });
    const id = String(streamId || '').trim();
    if (!id) throw new TypeError('streamId is required');
    const input = Array.isArray(events) ? events : [events];
    if (!input.length) return { streamId: id, version: this.version(id), records: [] };

    const existing = this.streams.get(id) || [];
    const actualVersion = existing.length;
    const expectedVersion = options.expectedVersion;
    if (expectedVersion !== undefined && expectedVersion !== null && expectedVersion !== 'any' && Number(expectedVersion) !== actualVersion) {
      this.stats.conflicts++;
      throw new EventConcurrencyError(`Expected stream ${id} at version ${expectedVersion}, found ${actualVersion}`, {
        streamId: id,
        expectedVersion: Number(expectedVersion),
        actualVersion,
      });
    }
    if (!this.streams.has(id) && this.streams.size >= this.maxStreams) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Event store stream limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_STORE_STREAM_LIMIT' });
    }
    if (this.events + input.length > this.maxEvents) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Event store event limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_STORE_EVENT_LIMIT' });
    }

    const timestamp = Date.now();
    const records = [];
    let additionalBytes = 0;
    for (let index = 0; index < input.length; index++) {
      const normalized = normalizeEvent(input[index], options.events?.[index] || {});
      const record = {
        id: String(options.ids?.[index] || normalized.eventObject?.id || randomUUID()),
        streamId: id,
        streamVersion: actualVersion + index + 1,
        globalPosition: this.globalPosition + index + 1,
        eventName: normalized.eventName,
        eventVersion: normalized.eventVersion,
        payload: normalized.payload,
        eventObject: normalized.eventObject,
        metadata: clone(options.metadata || normalized.eventObject?.meta || null),
        correlationId: options.correlationId || normalized.eventObject?.correlationId || null,
        causationId: options.causationId || normalized.eventObject?.causationId || null,
        tenantId: options.tenantId || normalized.eventObject?.tenantId || null,
        occurredAt: Number(options.occurredAt || normalized.eventObject?.timestamp) || timestamp,
        recordedAt: timestamp,
      };
      const bytes = estimateValueBytes(record, { maximum: this.maxEventBytes + 1 });
      if (bytes > this.maxEventBytes) {
        this.stats.rejected++;
        throw new EventAdmissionError('Event store record exceeds maxEventBytes', { code: 'EVENT_STORE_RECORD_BYTES', details: { bytes, maximum: this.maxEventBytes } });
      }
      record.bytes = bytes;
      additionalBytes += bytes;
      records.push(Object.freeze(record));
    }
    if (this.bytes + additionalBytes > this.maxBytes) {
      this.stats.rejected++;
      throw new EventAdmissionError('Event store byte limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_STORE_BYTES' });
    }

    const stream = existing.slice();
    stream.push(...records);
    this.streams.set(id, stream);
    this.events += records.length;
    this.bytes += additionalBytes;
    this.globalPosition += records.length;
    this.stats.appended += records.length;
    await this._notify(records);
    return { streamId: id, version: stream.length, records: records.map(publicRecord) };
  }

  async commit(aggregate, options = {}) {
    if (!aggregate || typeof aggregate.uncommittedEvents !== 'function') throw new TypeError('commit expects an AggregateRoot-like object');
    const events = aggregate.uncommittedEvents();
    const expectedVersion = Math.max(0, Number(aggregate.version) - events.length);
    const result = await this.append(options.streamId || aggregate.id, events, { ...options, expectedVersion: options.expectedVersion ?? expectedVersion });
    aggregate.markCommitted?.();
    aggregate.version = result.version;
    return result;
  }

  read(streamId, options = {}) {
    const stream = this.streams.get(String(streamId)) || [];
    const fromVersion = Math.max(1, Number(options.fromVersion) || 1);
    const toVersion = options.toVersion == null ? Infinity : Math.max(fromVersion, Number(options.toVersion) || Infinity);
    const limit = Math.max(0, Number(options.limit) || 0);
    let records = stream.filter((record) => record.streamVersion >= fromVersion && record.streamVersion <= toVersion);
    if (limit) records = records.slice(0, limit);
    this.stats.reads += records.length;
    return records.map(publicRecord);
  }

  readAll(options = {}) {
    const fromPosition = Math.max(1, Number(options.fromPosition) || 1);
    const limit = Math.max(0, Number(options.limit) || 0);
    let records = [];
    for (const stream of this.streams.values()) {
      for (const record of stream) if (record.globalPosition >= fromPosition) records.push(record);
    }
    records.sort((left, right) => left.globalPosition - right.globalPosition);
    if (options.eventName) records = records.filter((record) => record.eventName === String(options.eventName));
    if (options.tenantId != null) records = records.filter((record) => record.tenantId === options.tenantId);
    if (limit) records = records.slice(0, limit);
    this.stats.reads += records.length;
    return records.map(publicRecord);
  }

  async *iterate(options = {}) {
    const batchSize = Math.max(1, Number(options.batchSize) || 1000);
    let position = Math.max(1, Number(options.fromPosition) || 1);
    while (true) {
      const batch = this.readAll({ ...options, fromPosition: position, limit: batchSize });
      if (!batch.length) return;
      for (const record of batch) { yield record; position = record.globalPosition + 1; }
      if (batch.length < batchSize) return;
      await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
    }
  }

  subscribe(listener) {
    if (typeof listener !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Event store subscriber must be a function');
    this.subscribers.add(listener);
    return () => this.subscribers.delete(listener);
  }

  async _notify(records) {
    for (const listener of this.subscribers) {
      try { await listener(records.map(publicRecord)); }
      catch { this.stats.subscriberErrors++; }
    }
  }

  async saveSnapshot(streamId, snapshot) {
    const id = String(streamId);
    const version = Number(snapshot?.version);
    if (!Number.isInteger(version) || version < 0 || version > this.version(id)) throw new EventStoreError('Invalid snapshot version', { code: 'EVENT_STORE_SNAPSHOT_VERSION' });
    this.snapshots.set(id, Object.freeze({ ...clone(snapshot), streamId: id, savedAt: Date.now() }));
    this.stats.snapshots++;
    return this.getSnapshot(id);
  }

  getSnapshot(streamId) { const snapshot = this.snapshots.get(String(streamId)); return snapshot ? clone(snapshot) : null; }
  deleteSnapshot(streamId) { return this.snapshots.delete(String(streamId)); }

  snapshot() {
    return Object.freeze({
      closed: this.closed,
      streams: this.streams.size,
      events: this.events,
      bytes: this.bytes,
      globalPosition: this.globalPosition,
      snapshots: this.snapshots.size,
      subscribers: this.subscribers.size,
      limits: Object.freeze({ maxStreams: this.maxStreams, maxEvents: this.maxEvents, maxBytes: this.maxBytes, maxEventBytes: this.maxEventBytes }),
      stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }),
    });
  }

  close() { this.closed = true; this.subscribers.clear(); return this.snapshot(); }
}

function publicRecord(record) {
  const { bytes, ...value } = record;
  return clone(value);
}

export default MemoryEventStore;

'use strict';

import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { EventAdmissionError } from '../errors/EventError.js';

export class MemoryProjectionCheckpointStore {
  constructor() { this.values = new Map(); }
  async get(name) { return this.values.get(String(name)) || 0; }
  async set(name, position) { this.values.set(String(name), Math.max(0, Number(position) || 0)); return position; }
  async clear(name = null) { if (name == null) this.values.clear(); else this.values.delete(String(name)); }
  snapshot() { return Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(this.values)); }
}

/** Projection runner with checkpoints, selective handlers and cooperative rebuilds. */
export class ProjectionManager {
  constructor(eventStore, options = {}) {
    if (!eventStore || typeof eventStore.readAll !== 'function') throw new TypeError('ProjectionManager requires an event store');
    this.eventStore = eventStore;
    this.checkpoints = options.checkpoints || new MemoryProjectionCheckpointStore();
    this.projections = new Map();
    this.maxProjections = Math.max(1, Number(options.maxProjections) || 1000);
    this.batchSize = Math.max(1, Number(options.batchSize) || 1000);
    this.budgetMs = Math.max(0, Number(options.budgetMs) || 5);
    this.stats = { registered: 0, processed: 0, rebuilds: 0, failures: 0 };
  }

  register(name, handlers, options = {}) {
    const key = String(name || '').trim();
    if (!key) throw new TypeError('Projection name is required');
    if (this.projections.has(key) && options.replace !== true) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Projection already exists: ${key}`, { code: 'EVENT_PROJECTION_DUPLICATE' });
    if (!this.projections.has(key) && this.projections.size >= this.maxProjections) throw new EventAdmissionError('Projection limit exceeded', { code: 'EVENT_PROJECTION_LIMIT' });
    const normalized = typeof handlers === 'function' ? { '*': handlers } : handlers;
    if (!normalized || typeof normalized !== 'object') throw new TypeError('Projection handlers must be a function or event-name map');
    for (const handler of Object.values(normalized)) if (typeof handler !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Projection handler must be a function');
    this.projections.set(key, Object.freeze({ name: key, handlers: { ...normalized }, reset: typeof options.reset === 'function' ? options.reset : null }));
    this.stats.registered++;
    return this;
  }

  unregister(name) { return this.projections.delete(String(name)); }

  async project(name, options = {}) {
    const projection = this.projections.get(String(name));
    if (!projection) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Projection not found: ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_PROJECTION_UNKNOWN' });
    const fromPosition = options.fromPosition ?? (await this.checkpoints.get(projection.name)) + 1;
    const records = this.eventStore.readAll({ fromPosition, limit: options.limit || this.batchSize, tenantId: options.tenantId });
    for (const record of records) await this._apply(projection, record, options);
    return { name: projection.name, processed: records.length, position: records.at(-1)?.globalPosition || fromPosition - 1 };
  }

  async rebuild(name, options = {}) {
    const projection = this.projections.get(String(name));
    if (!projection) throw new EventAdmissionError(`Projection not found: ${name}`, { code: 'EVENT_PROJECTION_UNKNOWN' });
    await projection.reset?.({ name: projection.name });
    await this.checkpoints.clear(projection.name);
    this.stats.rebuilds++;
    let processed = 0;
    let sliceStarted = performance.now();
    for await (const record of this.eventStore.iterate({ fromPosition: 1, batchSize: options.batchSize || this.batchSize, tenantId: options.tenantId })) {
      await this._apply(projection, record, options);
      processed++;
      if (this.budgetMs > 0 && performance.now() - sliceStarted >= this.budgetMs) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
        sliceStarted = performance.now();
      }
    }
    return { name: projection.name, processed, position: await this.checkpoints.get(projection.name) };
  }

  async _apply(projection, record, options) {
    const handler = projection.handlers[record.eventName] || projection.handlers['*'];
    try {
      if (handler) await handler(record.payload, record, options);
      await this.checkpoints.set(projection.name, record.globalPosition);
      this.stats.processed++;
    } catch (error) {
      this.stats.failures++;
      throw error;
    }
  }

  snapshot() { return Object.freeze({ projections: this.projections.size, checkpoints: this.checkpoints.snapshot?.() || null, stats: Object.freeze({ ...this.stats }) }); }
}

export default ProjectionManager;

import { Event } from './Event.js';

function connectionDescriptor(connection) {
  if (!connection || typeof connection !== 'object') return null;
  return {
    id: connection.id ?? connection.connectionId ?? null,
    remoteAddress: connection.remoteAddress ?? connection.socket?.remoteAddress ?? null,
    remotePort: connection.remotePort ?? connection.socket?.remotePort ?? null,
    localAddress: connection.localAddress ?? connection.socket?.localAddress ?? null,
    localPort: connection.localPort ?? connection.socket?.localPort ?? null,
  };
}

export class ProtocolEvent extends Event {
  constructor(payload = {}, meta = {}) {
    super(payload, meta);
    this.protocol = meta.protocol || 'app';
    this.connection = meta.connection || null;
    this.transport = meta.transport || null;
    this.connectionMeta = meta.connectionMeta || connectionDescriptor(this.connection);
  }

  toJSON() {
    return {
      ...super.toJSON(),
      protocol: this.protocol,
      transport: this.transport,
      connection: this.connectionMeta,
    };
  }
}

export class EventsBenchCommand {

  }

  async handle(options = {}) {
    const iterations = Math.max(1, Math.min(10_000_000, Number(options.iterations) || 100_000));
    const bus = new AdvancedEventDispatcher({ profile: 'compat' });
    let sink = 0;
    bus.on('bench:exact', (value) => { sink += value; });
    for (let index = 0; index < 10_000; index++) bus.dispatch('bench:exact', 1);

    for (let index = 0; index < iterations; index++) bus.dispatch('bench:exact', 1);
    const durationMs = performance.now() - started;
    await bus.close();
    return {
      iterations,
      durationMs,
      opsPerSecond: durationMs ? iterations / durationMs * 1000 : Infinity,

      sink,
    };
